table.name: Injector Scaling
table.description:
Injector size constant, shown as the injector flow (g/s) the ECU assumes at the 0.3 MPa reference of Injector Flow Compensation; stock 2.61 g/s, which the stock compensation curve makes about 15.2 g/s at 10 MPa. For new injectors scale it by new flow / stock flow (raw value by stock / new). Cranking pulses, latency, minimum pulse and the throttle-rate transient fuel are in microseconds and do not follow it.
Details: Injector size constant, read as the injector flow the ECU assumes at the reference pressure of Injector Flow Compensation (where that table is 256: 0.3 MPa in stock). 0x0B8030 (read) computes FFF8ADEA = air quantity FFF8C250 x this x 0.10266 / 14.7 / 4 / rpm x 0.125, and 0x0D15EC (read) the base pulse FFF8C05C = 16 x FFF8ADEA x fuel-trim factors (1.0 at nominal trims) in microseconds; 0x0D1528 then applies the fuel factor and 0x0D2BB8 the flow compensation and latency. Result: base pulse [us at 0.3 MPa] = 131.40 x this x stoichiometric fuel mass per cylinder per cycle [g], i.e. flow = 7610.3 / this g/s (shown). Stock 2918 = 2.61 g/s at 0.3 MPa, which the stock compensation curve makes 15.2 g/s at 10 MPa. For new injectors set the reference flow to new flow at 10 MPa x 44/256 (if Injector Flow Compensation is kept), or equivalently scale the raw value by stock flow / new flow. Stock 2918 in both images. Not scaled by this value (must be rescaled by hand when it changes): Injector Latency, Minimum Pulse Width, the cranking pulses (Cranking Fuel tables, Cranking Fuel Secondary), Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain and Term Minimum, and the HPFP fuel-quantity axes, which are all in microseconds of pulse; the open-loop/enrichment tables and Transient Fuel Film Target are mass-based and follow automatically (read: cal 0x1C6EE is read by 0x0B8030, the film step 0x0F6B18 and the Tip-In Extra Pulse step 0x0F54B8 (off in stock), which also scales with it). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injector Latency
table.description:
Fixed time added to every injection pulse, by rail pressure; probably the injector opening delay. Raise it if the injectors open slower than stock.
Details: Added to every injection pulse: 0x0D3848 writes FFF8B08C = this(rail pressure) [+ Injector Latency Adder], and 0x0D2BB8 adds FFF8B08C x 0.8 us to the fuel time (read). Interpreted as injector opening delay (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Injector Latency Adder
table.description:
Extra latency added only while an injector-driver fault (P062D / P2146) is active. No effect on a healthy car.
Details: Added to Injector Latency (saturating) only while FFF88F4A bit 1 is set (0x0C7808 / 0x0D3848, read). That bit is the injector-driver fault flag set by 0x080B96 (P062D / P2146; the same bit selects Rail Pressure Fail-Safe Target A, read), so this is a fault-mode latency: no effect on a healthy car. Confidence: read.

table.name: Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 1/3)
table.description:
Multiplier on the fuel quantity of injectors 1 and 3 by rail pressure: more pressure means more flow, so less pulse. Stock follows the injector flow-versus-pressure law referenced to 0.3 MPa. Keep equal to Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4).
Details: When used: Used by the pulse functions of injectors 1 and 3 (read); injectors 2 and 4 use Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4). Multiplier on the fuel quantity of every injection: pulse = latency + quantity x this / 256 (0x0D2BB8), looked up from rail pressure FFF88886 by 0x0CB0C8 into FFF8AFEA (read). Stock values follow sqrt(0.3 MPa / P) - 256 at 0.3 MPa, 29 at 24 MPa - the injector flow-versus-pressure law, so the base pulse is referenced to 0.3 MPa (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4)
table.description:
Same as Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 1/3) but for injectors 2 and 4 (rail pressure plus Injector 2/4 Rail Pressure Offset). Stock identical; keep the two equal unless you deliberately trim one bank.
Details: When used: by the pulse functions of injectors 2 and 4 (0x0D2EDC / 0x0D300C / 0x0D3524 / 0x0D3654, read). Looked up by 0x0CB0C8 from FFF89222 = rail pressure FFF88886 + Injector 2/4 Rail Pressure Offset (all zero in stock) into FFF8AFEC (read). Same shape and stock values as Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 1/3); keep them equal unless deliberately trimming one bank (bank reading inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injector Minimum Pulse Width
table.description:
Shortest pulse the ECU will command; any shorter computed pulse is raised to this. Adjust for injectors with a different minimum controllable pulse.
Details: Floor for every injection pulse: 0x0D2BB8 takes the larger of the computed pulse and this value (FFF8B088, from 0x0D2B9C) before the 1 s cap at cal 0x11CFC (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure
table.description:
Main fuel rail pressure target in normal warm running, by load and rpm. Higher pressure = better atomisation and more injector flow at the cost of pump load. Replaced by Target Rail Pressure (Pedal Released) with the pedal released. Stock 3 MPa at light load, rising to 15 MPa from about 1.29 g/rev (100 %) at 3,600 rpm and above, but only from about 2.1-2.6 g/rev (160-200 %) below 3,600 rpm.
Details: Rail-pressure target 0x165180 (called from the HPFP module 0x164804, read) writes FFF8B9A0, the target used by the pump feedback and the P0087/P0088 monitor. Normal running (combustion mode FFF8A85C = 4 and engine state FFF99844 = 3; cal 0x3F28C = 0 makes the wait timer zero): target = base byte table x 150 counts. The byte target is held at its previous value while it changes by less than cal 0x3F28A (4 = 0.37 MPa), and capped at cal 0x3F39A x 153/28 (no cap in stock). This is the main base table: load FFF8A616 x rpm FFF8CD56. If FFF8A774 bit 0 is set it is replaced by Target Rail Pressure (Pedal Released); with no sensor faults (FFF88E28 bit 2, FFF88E2B bit 5 clear) Target Rail Pressure Additive x Additive Multiplier / 255 is added. Stock 3.0 MPa at light load to 15.0 MPa from about 1.81 g/rev (140 % load). Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Pedal Released)
table.description:
Rail pressure target used instead of Target Rail Pressure while the accelerator is fully released (cranking or running), by coolant. Stock 7 MPa cold to 3 MPa hot.
Details: When used: Replaces Target Rail Pressure while FFF8A774 bit 0 is set: accelerator fully released while cranking or running (0x0E127C / 0x09FF9A, read). 0x165180 (read): replaces Target Rail Pressure while FFF8A774 bit 0 is set (the same flag selects Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed/Open)); coolant FFF88A44. Stock 7.0 MPa cold to 3.0 MPa hot. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure Additive
table.description:
Extra rail pressure added to Target Rail Pressure, scaled by Target Rail Pressure Additive Multiplier, only with no rail-pressure sensor faults. Stock all 0, so it has no effect.
Details: 0x165180 (read): added to Target Rail Pressure (in its byte units) after scaling by Target Rail Pressure Additive Multiplier / 255, only while FFF88E28 bit 2 and FFF88E2B bit 5 are clear; result clipped to 0...255. All 0 in stock. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure Additive Multiplier
table.description:
Scaling (255 = x1.0) for Target Rail Pressure Additive, by an unidentified input and what is probably intake air temperature. Stock all 0, so the additive is off.
Details: 0x165180 (read): multiplier (/255) on Target Rail Pressure Additive, looked up from FFF88A9D (unidentified) and FFF88662 (intake air temperature + 50, inferred). All 0 in stock. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 0)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in the first phase after start (combustion mode 0), by coolant and rpm. Stock 10-15 MPa.
Details: 0x165180 (read): target x 150 while combustion mode FFF8A85C is 0 (first phase after start), coolant FFF88A44 x rpm FFF8CD56 (400...1,600 rpm). Stock 10.0...15.0 MPa. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 4, Start Delay)
table.description:
Rail pressure target used in normal running mode only during a start delay before the engine counts as running. The delay is 0 in stock, so it is normally skipped. Stock 10 MPa.
Details: 0x165180 (read): used in combustion mode 4 instead of Target Rail Pressure until the engine is running (FFF99844 = 3) and the counter FFF86A54 >= cal 0x3F28C (0 in stock, so it is normally skipped). Stock 10.0 MPa. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 3, Pedal Released)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in combustion mode 3 (the phase before normal running) with the accelerator fully released, by coolant. Stock 15 MPa cold to 3 MPa hot.
Details: When used: FFF88C64 bit 5 = accelerator fully released (0 % for 2 passes, cleared at 0.25 %; 0x09FF9A, read). 0x165180 (read): target in combustion mode FFF8A85C = 3 while FFF88C64 bit 5 is set (else Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 3, Pedal Applied)); coolant FFF88A44. Stock 15 MPa cold to 3 MPa hot. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 3, Pedal Applied)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in combustion mode 3 (the phase before normal running) with the accelerator pressed, by coolant. Stock 15 MPa cold to 8 MPa hot.
Details: When used: Combustion mode 3 with the accelerator applied (FFF88C64 bit 5 clear, read). 0x165180 (read): target in combustion mode 3 while FFF88C64 bit 5 is clear. Stock 15 MPa cold to 8 MPa hot. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Feedforward Command

scaling.units: us (injector pulse, 0.3 MPa ref, incl. latency)

table.description:
Open-loop high-pressure pump command (a crank angle) by fuel quantity and rpm; the pressure controller adds its correction on top. Lower angles appear to mean more pump delivery. The fuel-quantity axis is in microseconds of injector pulse, so it must be rescaled when Injector Scaling changes.
Details: 0x16474C (read): open-loop pump command FFF8B984 from fuel quantity FFF8AFEE (injector pulse words / 8, 0x0CB0F4) x rpm FFF8CD56. Command FFF8B99A = this + proportional + integral/16 (0x164778, 0x165094), clamped to cal 0x3ED0E...0x3ED10+0x3ED16 (2,250...3,450). Lower values at higher fuel quantity, i.e. lower command = more delivery (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Proportional Gain
table.description:
Proportional gain of the rail-pressure controller, by rpm: how hard the pump command reacts to pressure error. Higher = faster but risks oscillation. Stock high below 800 rpm, lower in the mid range.
Details: 0x164DB0 (read): proportional term FFF8B996 = (actual rail pressure FFF88884 - target FFF8B9A0) x this / 41967, saturated to s16. Stock 6400 below 800 rpm, 1280 from 2,000-4,500 rpm, 2048 above. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Integral Step
table.description:
How much the rail-pressure controller's integral term moves each 10 ms pass, toward removing a steady pressure error. Higher = faster correction, more risk of hunting. Stock 16.
Details: 0x164B3C (read): only in HPFP state FFF8AB35 = 3 the integrator FFF86A44 (added to the command as /16) steps down by this when target - actual >= HPFP Integral Threshold, up by this when actual - target >= the threshold, and holds while |target - actual| < the threshold; it is frozen while the command sits at its clamp, and limited to cal 0x3F346...0x3F344 (-19200...19200). Stock 16 (one command count per pass). p16 (read): 0x164B3C (<- 0x164804 <- 0x07C408) runs every 10 ms. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Integral Threshold

scaling.units: us (injector pulse, 0.3 MPa ref, incl. latency)

table.description:
Deadband of the rail-pressure integrator, by fuel quantity (microseconds of injector pulse): while the pressure error is smaller than this, the integral term holds; beyond it, it steps toward removing the error. Larger = more steady error tolerated, less hunting. Stock 0.5 MPa flat.
Details: 0x164B3C (read): pressure error (target - actual) at which the integrator changes direction, by fuel quantity FFF8AFEE. Stock 820 = 0.5 MPa flat. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Command Minimum
table.description:
Lower limit of the high-pressure pump command, a crank angle in the pump frame. The upper limit is HPFP Command Maximum Base (also 225 degrees in stock) plus HPFP Command Range, so raising this does not raise the upper limit; keep it below that. Stock 225 degrees.
Details: 0x165094 (read): lower clamp of the pump command FFF8B99A; also an integrator freeze point (0x164B3C). Stock 2250. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Command Maximum Base
table.description:
Base of the high-pressure pump command upper limit: the limit is this + HPFP Command Range. Raise this (or the Range) to raise the upper limit; HPFP Command Minimum does not move it. Stock 225 degrees (limit 345 degrees).
Details: 0x165094 (read): the upper clamp of the pump command FFF8B99A is this + HPFP Command Range (2250 + 1200 = 3450 stock; 0xFFFF if the sum overflows); the lower clamp is HPFP Command Minimum, a separate cal that only equals this in stock. 0x164B3C also treats a command equal to this + Range as saturated (integrator freeze). While the fixed-command flag (third argument of 0x165094) is set the command is cal 0x3ED14 instead. Stock 2250. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Command Range
table.description:
Range of the high-pressure pump command: the upper limit is HPFP Command Maximum Base + this, so it does not move with HPFP Command Minimum. Also used by the pump solenoid circuit monitor. Stock 120 degrees (limit 345 degrees).
Details: 0x165094 (read): the upper clamp is HPFP Command Maximum Base (cal 0x3ED10) + this (2250 + 1200 = 3450 stock); 0x0776BA compares the solenoid window FFF8B994 - FFF8B99C with 2 x this for the circuit monitor's enable flags. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Solenoid Window Start
table.description:
Start of the pump solenoid's energised window, by battery voltage and rpm, as a crank angle in the pump frame. Used whenever the engine is running. Leave at stock unless the pump hardware changes.
Details: When used: whenever the engine is not in state 1 (FFF99844, 0x165120, read): FFF8B99C = this(battery FFF9DD61, rpm FFF8CD54) - FFF8B98C (+0x8000 offset); 0 in state 1. B99C is the lower bound of the end angle FFF8B994 and the start of the energised window (inferred). HPFP module 0x164804 (read). Values are in the HPFP command unit (the same unit as FFF8B99A and the angle reference FFF8B98C = cal 0x3F302 - FFF8C21E); the window FFF8B994 - FFF8B99C is what 0x0776BA converts to time with rpm for the solenoid circuit monitor. Unit: 0.1 degree crank angle (the driver 0x1E9824 schedules cmd x 2 in units of 0.05 degree of a 10-degree tooth, read), shown in degrees. Stock 1550-1650 at low rpm falling to 1070 at high rpm; 100 lower at the lowest battery row. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Solenoid Window End Limit
table.description:
Upper limit on the end of the pump solenoid's energised window, by battery voltage and rpm, as a crank angle. Stock 345 degrees (the command maximum) below about 8 V and below 1600 rpm; at normal battery voltage (10 V and above) it falls from 333 degrees at 1600 rpm to 305 degrees from 4000 rpm, so it can limit the window in normal running. Leave at stock unless the pump hardware changes.
Details: When used: whenever the engine is not in state 1 (0x164D04, read): FFF8B994 = max(FFF8B99C, min(this(battery, rpm) - B98C, command FFF8B99A - HPFP Solenoid End Offset - B98C)) (+0x8000 offsets); in pump state FFF8AB35 = 4 only this limit is used. HPFP module 0x164804 (read). Values are in the HPFP command unit (the same unit as FFF8B99A and the angle reference FFF8B98C = cal 0x3F302 - FFF8C21E); the window FFF8B994 - FFF8B99C is what 0x0776BA converts to time with rpm for the solenoid circuit monitor. Unit: 0.1 degree crank angle (the driver 0x1E9824 schedules cmd x 2 in units of 0.05 degree of a 10-degree tooth, read), shown in degrees. Stock 3450 (= the command maximum) at 8 V and below and below 1600 rpm at any voltage; from 9 V it falls with rpm from 1600 rpm, to 3250 at 9 V and 3050 at 10 V and above from 4000 rpm (normal running voltage). Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Solenoid End Offset
table.description:
Crank angle subtracted from the pump command to give the end of the solenoid's energised window, by rpm. Stock 2.4 degrees at 200 rpm rising to 32 degrees at 7000 rpm. Leave at stock unless the pump hardware changes.
Details: When used: whenever the engine is not in state 1 (0x164D04, read): subtracted from the pump command FFF8B99A to give the solenoid end angle FFF8B994 (before the HPFP Solenoid Window End Limit). Written to FFF8B998. HPFP module 0x164804 (read). Values are in the HPFP command unit (the same unit as FFF8B99A and the angle reference FFF8B98C = cal 0x3F302 - FFF8C21E); the window FFF8B994 - FFF8B99C is what 0x0776BA converts to time with rpm for the solenoid circuit monitor. Unit: 0.1 degree crank angle (the driver 0x1E9824 schedules cmd x 2 in units of 0.05 degree of a 10-degree tooth, read), shown in degrees. Stock 24 at 200 rpm rising to 320 at 7000 rpm. Confidence: read.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop)
table.description:
Minimum enrichment whenever the engine is out of closed loop for any reason: the mixture is at least this rich. Stock 0 below 4000 rpm except at very high load, rich from 4400 rpm. Check it as well as Primary Open Loop Fueling when leaning the open-loop target.
Details: When used: whenever the closed-loop state FFF8A820 is not 1 (closed loop) and the combustion mode FFF8A85C >= 3 (normal running or its phase before). 0x0C9DCC (read): FFF8A662 = this(rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616) + FFF8B06C/128, FFF8B06C = 05B1DC(rpm, load) x 05B1F0(DAM)/128 (0x0D13B4); 0 in closed loop. The fuel factor 0x0C558C uses max(open-loop enrichment FFF8A684 + Additional Enrichment FFF8AFE8, FFF8A662), capped at 2 x cal 0x13E5C (128), as an enrichment candidate (read). So while open loop for any reason, the mixture is at least this rich. Unit 1/256 of fuel, shown as AFR like Primary Open Loop Fueling. Stock 0 below 4000 rpm except at 2.07-2.59 g/rev (160-200 % load) (15-64), 28-46 at all loads from 4400 rpm, and 81-100 (AFR 11.0-10.6) at 6000-6400 rpm; compare with Primary Open Loop Fueling when leaning the open-loop target. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Open Loop Delay Load Threshold
table.description:
Load, by rpm, above which the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV ..., AVCS ...) group takes effect after a delay; below it that group is off. Stock 95 % at low rpm, 80 % mid range, 0 % (always) from 4400 rpm.
Details: When used: always while running; gates the FFF8A681 open-loop group (Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV ..., AVCS ...)). 0x0C9CCC (read): a flag is set while load FFF8A616 <= this(rpm FFF8CE9C) (+ cal 0x151B8 hysteresis, 0 in stock); while set the timer FFF8AFD6 is held at 0, above the threshold it counts up by cal 0x138AE (1) per pass; with FFF8AFE6 = 0 it is 0xFFFF. 0x0CEA80 accepts FFF8A681 only while FFF8AFD6 >= FFF8AFE6, the delay from 0x0CAA44 (coolant, drive mode and other conditions; not decoded). So above this load the TGV/AVCS open-loop group takes effect after the delay. Stock 95 % up to 1600 rpm, 80 % around 2000/3600-4000 rpm, 0 % (always) from 4400 rpm. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Low-DAM Enrichment
table.description:
Extra fuel, by rpm and load, that richens the closed-loop target, the closed-loop override and the open-loop floor, scaled up as DAM falls (Low-DAM Enrichment DAM Multiplier). Probably a knock-history safety enrichment. Stock up to 24 % at very high load, 0 at low rpm/load.
Details: When used: always while running; scaled to zero at DAM >= 15/16. 0x0D13B4 (read): FFF8B06C = this(rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616) x Low-DAM Enrichment DAM Multiplier(FFF811AE)/128 (equivalence ratio x 32768). B06C makes the closed-loop lambda target richer by 43194 x B06C/(B06C + 32768) (0x0FF468), is added to the Closed Loop Target Override (0x0FFBD8), and B06C >> 7 is added to 05A6DC(rpm, load) into FFF8A662 in combustion mode >= 3 when not in closed loop (0x0C9DCC) (read). Full at DAM 1/16, none at DAM 15/16 (stock multiplier), so it is a knock-history (low DAM) enrichment (inferred). Stock: up to 7864 = 24 % at 1.81-2.59 g/rev (140-200 % load); 6.8 % at every load from 0.13 g/rev (10 %) at 4400-5600 rpm and 1.7 % at 6000 rpm part load; 0 elsewhere. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Low-DAM Enrichment DAM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales Low-DAM Enrichment by DAM. Stock full (x1.0) at the lowest DAM falling linearly to 0 at DAM 15/16, so the enrichment only applies with knock history.
Details: When used: multiplies Low-DAM Enrichment (0x0D13B4, read), indexed by FFF811AE (DAM x 16). Stock 1.0 at DAM 1/16 falling linearly to 0 at 15/16. Confidence: read.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open)
table.description:
Coolant-based warm-up enrichment with the TGVs open, blended with Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Closed) by TGV position and scaled by Warm-Up Enrichment RPM Multiplier. Raising it adds fuel while cold. Warm-up role inferred from the coolant axis.
Details: Enrichment FFF8B030 (0x0CF19C): a blend of this table and Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Closed) weighted by FFF8B3E8 (this table at TGVs fully open), times the RPM multiplier (read). FFF8B030 is one of the terms of the commanded lambda 256/(256 + B030 + A684 + AFE8) (0x171C88, read) and enters the pulse through the fuel factor FFF8AFBC (0x0C558C, read). Role as warm-up enrichment inferred from the coolant axis. Blend weight FFF8B3E8 is the TGV position weight from 0x10C948: average of the two TGV position sensors FFF88AA6/88AA8 through 05D29C/05D290, ramped (cal 0x379EC/0x379EE) and gated by FFF8A881 bit 4 and FFF88E2A bit 5 (read). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, so FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction; 0x10C948 drives it toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so that bit set = TGVs closed. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Closed)
table.description:
Coolant-based warm-up enrichment with the TGVs closed, blended with Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open) by TGV position. Raising it adds fuel while cold.
Details: Warm-up enrichment with the TGVs closed: FFF8B030 (0x0CF19C, read) = this x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open) x FFF8B3E8, times Warm-Up Enrichment RPM Multiplier; see Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open). FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction from 0x10C948: average of the two TGV position sensors FFF88AA6/88AA8 through 05D29C/05D290, ramped (cal 0x379EC/0x379EE) and gated by FFF8A881 bit 4 and FFF88E2A bit 5 (read). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, and 0x10C948 drives FFF8B3E8 toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so bit set = TGVs closed. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment RPM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales the warm-up enrichment by rpm (128 = x1.0). Stock all 128, so it has no effect.
Details: Scales the FFF8B030 warm-up enrichment blend (0x0CF19C). All 128 (x1.0) in stock. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment (Coolant Window Override)
table.description:
Replaces the warm-up enrichment for a while after start, but only when the start coolant falls inside a calibrated window. That window is empty in stock, so practically never used. Stock data identical to Start Enrichment (Coolant Window Override).
Details: When used: only when coolant at start FFF88A46 lies within cal 0x237B4...0x237B2 (both 0 in stock: -40 degC, practically never). 0x0CF19C (read): in fuel states 2/3 FFF8B030 = this(coolant FFF88A44) instead of the Warm-Up Enrichment TGV blend until the accelerator has been pressed for cal 0x2377F (40) passes within the first cal 0x237B6 (800) counts of FFF8B06A; the output may move by at most cal 0x23780 (65535 = unlimited) per pass. FFF8B030 is the warm-up term of commanded lambda 256/(256 + B030 + A684 + AFE8) (0x171C88). Stock data identical to Start Enrichment (Coolant Window Override). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Fuel Factor Correction (RPM x Load)
table.description:
General fuel correction by rpm and load in open and closed loop (128 = no change, each count about 0.4 %). Probably a light-load base-fuel correction. Stock -5 % to +6 % below 1600 rpm and 0.39 g/rev (30 % load), neutral elsewhere.
Details: 0x0FD5F8 (called every pass from the closed-loop scheduler 0x0FD76C, read) looks this up by rpm FFF8CD56 (x50) and load FFF8A616 into FFF8A828; the fuel factor 0x0C558C sums A828 + cal 0x38460 (128) - 128 + trims + enrichment into FFF8AFBC (256 = x1.0), and the start path uses (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 (0x0D1400); with 128 as the neutral value each count above 128 adds 1/256 (0.39 %) of fuel in open and closed loop alike (read). Stock 115-143 below 1,600 rpm and 0.39 g/rev (30 % load) (-5 % to +5.9 %), 128 elsewhere. Role (light-load base-fuel correction) inferred. p16 (read): the closed-loop scheduler 0x0FD76C runs in the 20 ms OS task (0x1E0AE8). Confidence: read.

table.name: Additional Enrichment Throttle Threshold (Off in Stock)
table.description:
Throttle opening above idle, by rpm, needed to enable Additional Enrichment A/B (Off in Stock). The other enable conditions are set out of reach in stock, so this has no effect.
Details: When used: never in stock. 0x0D3BFC (from 0x0C782C, args read) sets the Additional Enrichment enable FFF8A654 bit 1 only when, among others, FFF88A3C (throttle opening above the idle opening: FFF88A3A - FFF8AFB8, 0x08015C) >= this(rpm FFF8CD54) or FFF88EDA bit 0, and rpm >= cal 0x13E08 = 65535 and coolant >= cal 0x13E14 = 65535 (or FFF88E28 bit 1), so the enable never sets (read; my research notes section 3). Once met, the threshold becomes cal 0x13E12 itself (1049 = 2.4 %), not the table value minus 1049: the code computes threshold - (threshold - 0x13E12) (0x0D3C90-0x0D3CAE, read); the rpm and coolant hysteresis cals 0x13E0A/0x13E16 work the same way. Stock 95.7 % below 1600 rpm, 82 % at 1600, falling to 4.7 % from 3600 rpm (scale inferred, see p17p_throttle_a3a). Belongs to Additional Enrichment A/B (Off in Stock). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Open, EGR Off)
table.description:
Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs open and little or no EGR; holds the rich full-load cells in stock. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).
Details: When used: EGR flow estimate below 1000; this holds the rich full-load cells in stock. Used when TGVs are open and FFF8B2A6 < 1000. Stock goes as rich as lambda 0.72 at high rpm; cells richer than lambda 0.80 put the controller in open-loop state 9 (read). 0x0FF468 (from the closed-loop module 0x0FD76C, read) picks one of four target tables by TGV state flag FFF8A881 bit 4 (set = TGVs closed) and by FFF8B2A6 >= cal 0x2DE6C (1000); FFF8B2A6 is the estimated EGR flow from EGR Valve Flow Model (05CB70) at the actual valve position (0x0FA830, read); 1000 = 0.67 g/s (EGR flow unit g/s x 1500, p16). The table value plus Closed Loop Target Cold-Start Trim (FFF8B326 - 32768, 0x0FFA0C; -0.03 AFR after cold starts in stock), minus the Low-DAM Enrichment term 43194 x B06C/(B06C + 32768), is combined with 43194 + Closed Loop Target Lean Limit - 32768 by taking the lower (richer) value into FFF8B30A, so the lean-limit table caps this target at about 14.7-14.75 AFR when warm in stock (read, 0x0FF468); then FFF8B312 = FFF8B30A + FFF8B336 (0x0FF634), converted to the final target FFF8B31E (0x0FF904, 0x0FF8C8). table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Closed, Other Modes)
table.description:
Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Stock caps it at about 14.7 AFR when warm. Used with TGVs closed outside normal combustion mode.
Details: 0x0FF9A0 (read) writes FFF8B324 from coolant (FFF88A44) x load % (FFF8A616): TGVs closed (FFF8A881 bit 4 set) use 05CD8C when combustion mode FFF8A85C = 4 (normal) and 05CD78 otherwise; TGVs open use 05CDB4 / 05CDA0 the same way. 0x0FF468 forms 43194 + FFF8B324 - 32768 and the richer of that and the selected Closed Loop Target becomes FFF8B30A (read), so values below 32768 cap the target richer when cold. 32768 = no change. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Override
table.description:

Details: 0x0FFBD8 (read): FFF8B32A = this(rpm FFF8CD56, load % FFF8A616) + FFF8B06C. 0x0FF8C8 (read) writes FFF8B32A into the final closed-loop target FFF8B31E when FFF8A65C bit 0 is set (FFF8A65C is written by fuel routines 0x0C73D0 / 0x0CC6A4; the condition is not decoded). table.name: Closed Loop Integral Gain (Negative Error)
table.description:
How fast closed-loop fuel trim corrects when the error is negative, by rpm and load. Larger = faster correction, too large can make the trims oscillate. Stock 5 at idle rising to 14 at higher rpm and load; the two tables are identical.
Details: When used: closed loop active, error FFF8B2C8 < 0. Axes rpm FFF8CD5C (rpm/25) x load % FFF8A616 (0x0FEC3C, read). Stock 5 at idle/low load rising to 14 from 3200 rpm and 0.47 g/rev (36 % load); the two tables are identical. Larger = faster integral action. Closed-loop fuel controller 0x0FEC3C (from 0x0FD76C, read): while closed loop is active (FFF8A82E bit 7) the integrator FFF85190 (-> FFF8B2F8 and the correction FFF8B2F4) is stepped each pass by (shaped error x gain) >> 8, where the shaped error is one of six curves of the error FFF8B2C8 = target - measured (equivalence ratio x 32768, Phase 7) and the gain is Closed Loop Integral Gain (rpm, load) x 05CCBC(coolant) x cals (read). Curve selection (read, disassembly checked at 0x0FEE44-0x0FEEEA): pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) -> 05CC4C (negative error, by |error|, result negated) / 05CC58 (positive); pedal applied -> coolant FFF8CD65 below cal 0x4B294 (100 = 50 degC) 05CC70 (negative) / 05CC88 (positive), warmer 05CC64 (negative) / 05CC7C (positive). Positive error = target richer than measured (sign inferred). The axis is |error|; output in the same unit. Confidence: read.

table.name: Closed Loop Learning Averaging Passes
table.description:
Number of passes the closed-loop correction is averaged over before each long-term trim learning update, by rpm and load; probably the learning window. Stock 112 at low rpm/load down to 24 at high rpm/load.
Details: When used: while long-term learning is enabled (FFF8A82E bit 0; 0x0FFE40). FFF8B304 = this(rpm FFF8CD56, load FFF8A616) (0x0FF3B0, read). 0x0FB100 / 0x0FB3CC sum the closed-loop correction FFF8B2F4 each pass and, once the pass count reaches B304, publish the mean (sum / B304) as FFF8B2B0 / FFF8B2B2 (read), which the learning step routines 0x0FC400 / 0x0FC5C0 use. So this is the averaging window per learning update (inferred). Stock 112 passes at low rpm/load down to 24 at high rpm/load. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Learning Step
table.description:
How much long-term fuel trim changes per learning update, by the size of the averaged closed-loop correction. Stock no step below 0.8 %, one LTFT count (0.39 %) at 0.8-1.6 %, rising to 4.4 % at 10 %.
Details: When used: learning state FFF8A821 = 11 (0x0FC400 / 0x0FC5C0, read). FFF8B2DA = this(|averaged correction FFF8B2B0|) (0x0FC3D0, read); when B2B0 >= cal 0x4B160 (262 = +0.8 %) the learned value FFF8B2E0 (= FFF811D6 << 8) is raised by B2DA, when B2B0 <= cal 0x4B162 (-0.8 %) it is lowered, within cal 0x4B165...0x4B164 (-115...+115 counts) (read). FFF811D6 / 811D7 feed the long-term trim FFF811D9 -> OBD LTFT FFF8A689 via 0x0FD3E4 / 0x0CECA8 (read). Stock: no step below 0.8 %, one LTFT count (0.39 %) per update at 0.8-1.6 %, rising to 4.4 % at 10 % average correction. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: LTFT Coolant Scaling (Positive)
table.description:
Scales a learned long-term trim that adds fuel, by coolant (128 = x1.0). Stock flat 128, so learned trims apply fully at all temperatures.
Details: Long-term fuel trim (0x0C589C -> 0x0CECA8 and 0x0FD76C -> 0x0FD3E4, read). The trim used in the fuel quantity, FFF8A689 (OBD PID 0x07, 128 = 0 %), is FFF811D9 (backup RAM), capped at cal 0x384D6 only when coolant FFF8CD65 is below cal 0x384D7 (0 in stock, so never). 0x0FD3E4 builds FFF811D9 from ten learned cells FFF81466[0..9] (backup RAM, cleared to 0 by 0x0FC054): cell = load range (FFF8A616 against the four LTFT Load Range Boundaries, 1-5) + 5 if engine speed FFF8CE9C >= LTFT RPM Range Boundary; FFF8A823 = cell. The cell value is filtered (cal 0x4B16C) into FFF8C53C. Only while FFF886AB bit 5 is set (= FFF88C64 bit 5, accelerator fully released; copied by 0x0B9344) is it scaled by coolant: FFF811D9 = 128 + (FFF8C53C - 128) x LTFT Coolant Scaling (Positive or Negative)(coolant FFF88A44) / 128; with the pedal applied FFF811D9 = FFF8C53C unscaled (read, 0x0FD3E4 param 12). How the cells themselves are learned (0x0FCAF0 / 0x0FC400 / 0x0FC5C0, from the closed-loop integrators FFF8B2B0/B2FA) is not decoded. Used when the filtered learned value is at or above 128 (adding fuel). Stock flat 128 (x1.0). Confidence: read.

table.name: LTFT Coolant Scaling (Negative)
table.description:
Scales a learned long-term trim that removes fuel, by coolant (128 = x1.0). Stock flat 128, so learned trims apply fully at all temperatures.
Details: Long-term fuel trim (0x0C589C -> 0x0CECA8 and 0x0FD76C -> 0x0FD3E4, read). The trim used in the fuel quantity, FFF8A689 (OBD PID 0x07, 128 = 0 %), is FFF811D9 (backup RAM), capped at cal 0x384D6 only when coolant FFF8CD65 is below cal 0x384D7 (0 in stock, so never). 0x0FD3E4 builds FFF811D9 from ten learned cells FFF81466[0..9] (backup RAM, cleared to 0 by 0x0FC054): cell = load range (FFF8A616 against the four LTFT Load Range Boundaries, 1-5) + 5 if engine speed FFF8CE9C >= LTFT RPM Range Boundary; FFF8A823 = cell. The cell value is filtered (cal 0x4B16C) into FFF8C53C. Only while FFF886AB bit 5 is set (= FFF88C64 bit 5, accelerator fully released; copied by 0x0B9344) is it scaled by coolant: FFF811D9 = 128 + (FFF8C53C - 128) x LTFT Coolant Scaling (Positive or Negative)(coolant FFF88A44) / 128; with the pedal applied FFF811D9 = FFF8C53C unscaled (read, 0x0FD3E4 param 12). How the cells themselves are learned (0x0FCAF0 / 0x0FC400 / 0x0FC5C0, from the closed-loop integrators FFF8B2B0/B2FA) is not decoded. Used when the filtered learned value is below 128 (removing fuel). Stock flat 128 (x1.0). Confidence: read.

table.name: LTFT Load Range Boundary 1
table.description:
Load boundary 1 of the 10 long-term fuel trim cells (5 load ranges x 2 rpm ranges); load range 1 is below this value. Stock boundaries 2 / 125 / 140 / 160 %.

The trim used in the fuel quantity, FFF8A689 (OBD PID 0x07, 128 = 0 %), is FFF811D9 (backup RAM), capped at cal 0x384D6 only when coolant FFF8CD65 is below cal 0x384D7 (0 in stock, so never). 0x0FD3E4 builds FFF811D9 from ten learned cells FFF81466[0..9] (backup RAM, cleared to 0 by 0x0FC054): cell = load range (FFF8A616 against the four LTFT Load Range Boundaries, 1-5) + 5 if engine speed FFF8CE9C >= LTFT RPM Range Boundary; FFF8A823 = cell. The cell value is filtered (cal 0x4B16C) into FFF8C53C and then scaled by coolant: FFF811D9 = 128 + (FFF8C53C - 128) x LTFT Coolant Scaling (Positive or Negative)(coolant FFF88A44) / 128. table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain
table.description:
Acceleration/deceleration fuel on throttle movement, by coolant: larger = more fuel when the throttle opens and less when it closes. The table the manual car uses, every pass while running. Keep the three Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain tables consistent. Stock high when cold, 64 from 80 degC.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running (always the selected table on the manual car). 0x0F6D98 (read): the coolant factor of B26E = 32768 + (FFF8ADF2/256 - 128) x this x Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate RPM Multiplier/256 x 0.8188. Larger = more fuel on throttle opening and less on closing. Input FFF88A44 (coolant). Stock 255 to 0 degC, 237 at 10, 158 at 20, 103 at 30-60, 90 at 70, 64 from 80 degC. Selection (0x0F6D98, read; same in stock call 0x0F6260): Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain is used while FFF8A618 bit 0 is set, which is always on the manual coding (cal 0x2F794 bit 1 clear, 0x0B8544, read); the (AT/CVT) table is used on AT/CVT codings while FFF8A618 bit 0 is clear (FFF886B0 bit 6 set after the first cal 0x34978 passes, not identified); the (Off in Stock) table when the manual flag FFF886AB bit 7 is set and either bit 0 is clear or cal 0x2F794 bit 2 is clear (rule: (A618 b0 = 0 or (0x2F794 b2 = 0 and 886AB b7)) ? (886AB b7 ? Off in Stock : AT/CVT) : this one, read). Stock 0x2F794 = 0xFD (bit 2 set), so it is never used in stock; clearing 0x2F794 bit 2 on the manual car would switch to it. Keep the three coolant tables consistent. The transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 runs in the 10 ms task (0x07C408 chain, read) and only in fuel state 3 (running, FFF8906B); outside it every term is reset to 0x8000 = none (read). It keeps two per-cylinder terms that are summed into FFF8C1E4 = C1F4 + C1EC - 32768 (0x0F5EA0, read), which 0x0D168C adds to each injector quantity as 4 x (C1E4 - 32768) counts (Phase 7, read). Each term decays by a factor only for the cylinders injected since the previous pass (masks below, read), so this is a per-cylinder wall-film / transient fuel compensation (inferred). Fuel-trim learning (0x0FFE40) is enabled only while all four C1F4 words are within cals 0x4B850..0x4B852 (32674..32862) (Phase 7, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate RPM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales the throttle-movement transient fuel by rpm (256 = x1.0). Raise it for more tip-in fuel at that rpm. Not active for the first second with the pedal released or at steady idle at standstill. Stock 0.24 at low rpm to 0.55 from 4000 rpm.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running, unless the inhibit conditions hold (first 1 s of running with the accelerator released; steady idle at standstill, read). 0x0F6D98 (read): B26E = 32768 + (FFF8ADF2/256 - 128) x coolant gain x this/256 x 0.8188, in the 3.2 us transient-term unit; FFF8ADF2 is the 10 ms change of the throttle-area air estimate FFF8ADF0 (0x0B8BB0 / 0x0B8A6C, read; air-estimate meaning inferred), centred on 32768. B26E is accumulated into each cylinder term FFF8C1F4 (0x0F6750), so opening the throttle adds fuel and closing it removes fuel, down to Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Term Minimum (acceleration/deceleration fuel, inferred). Input FFF8CE9C (rpm). Stock 0.24 to 1200 rpm, 0.30 at 1600, 0.40 at 2400-3200, 0.55 from 4000 rpm. The transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 runs in the 10 ms task (0x07C408 chain, read) and only in fuel state 3 (running, FFF8906B); outside it every term is reset to 0x8000 = none (read). It keeps two per-cylinder terms that are summed into FFF8C1E4 = C1F4 + C1EC - 32768 (0x0F5EA0, read), which 0x0D168C adds to each injector quantity as 4 x (C1E4 - 32768) counts (Phase 7, read). Each term decays by a factor only for the cylinders injected since the previous pass (masks below, read), so this is a per-cylinder wall-film / transient fuel compensation (inferred). table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Term Minimum
table.description:
Largest fuel reduction the throttle-closing side of the transient fuel may command, by coolant. Stock -998 us up to 60 degC and -499 us when warm (at 0.3 MPa reference).
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running. 0x0F6750 (read): the throttle-rate term of each cylinder FFF8C1F4 = max(this(coolant FFF8CD65), previous + increment), where the increment is (FFF8A802 + 64)/64 x (B26E - 32768) (B26E from Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain, 0x0F6D98). Cylinders injected since the previous pass are then decayed toward 32768: they keep FFF8A7F8/256 of their deviation (64/256 = 25 % kept at stock: 05C80C x 05C818 >> 6, flat). So this is the largest fuel reduction the throttle-closing side of the term may command. Stock -998 us (reference) up to 60 degC coolant and -499 us from 70 degC (0.3 MPa reference; real pulse = this x Injector Flow Compensation/256). The transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 runs in the 10 ms task (0x07C408 chain, read) and only in fuel state 3 (running, FFF8906B); outside it every term is reset to 0x8000 = none (read). table.name: Transient Fuel Film Target
table.description:
Fuel film mass target (mg) by load and rpm; when it rises, the difference is added to the following injections and then decays, compensating fuel film build-up (inferred). Stock 0 at 0.21 g/rev (16 % load) or less, 0.3 mg at 30 %, 3.5 mg at 1.29 g/rev (100 % load), same at every rpm. The values are fuel mass, but the load axis is fuel-based and scales with Injector Scaling: after changing Injector Scaling, multiply the load axis by new raw / 2918 to keep the same real loads.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running. 0x0F6B18 (read; call in 0x0F6260): the table value at fuel-based load (FFF8ADEE >> 8) x rpm/25 (FFF8CD5C) is compared with its value of the previous pass; the change d becomes the step B26C = d x Injector Scaling/1279 x 1024/6554 x Transient Fuel Film Gain (Coolant, 64 = x1.0)/64 (0.3565 x d at stock), which 0x0F5B60 adds to all four per-cylinder film terms FFF8C1DC. C1DC then decays only for cylinders that injected, by FFF8B25C/65536 per pass (98.5 % kept at stock: 05C7F4/05C800 x 768 + x 05C7E0, all flat), and becomes C1EC = 32768 + (C1DC - 32768) x Transient Fuel Film Gain RPM Multiplier/128 (0x0F6048), clamped by 05C8DC (32768 = no negative term at stock) and 05C8E8 (read). So raising load adds fuel to the following injections (build-up of a fuel film, inferred) and a fall in load would remove it (blocked at stock by the 32768 floor). No step (B26C = none) while the throttle-air rate FFF8ADF2 is within 32717..32819, or in the first cal 0x344AC (100) passes (1 s) of running with the accelerator released, or at steady idle (FFF8A61F within 108..147, standstill, rpm within about +-50 rpm of the idle target B236) (read). Stock: 0 at load <= 0.21 g/rev (16 %), 101 at 0.39 g/rev (30 %), 505 at 0.78 g/rev (60 %), 1188 at 1.29 g/rev (100 %), the same at every rpm. A rise from 0.39 to 1.03 g/rev (30 to 80 % load) adds about 870 us (0.3 MPa reference) to each following injection, decaying about 1.5 % per injection (computed). The transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 runs in the 10 ms task (0x07C408 chain, read) and only in fuel state 3 (running, FFF8906B); outside it every term is reset to 0x8000 = none (read). It keeps two per-cylinder terms that are summed into FFF8C1E4 = C1F4 + C1EC - 32768 (0x0F5EA0, read), which 0x0D168C adds to each injector quantity as 4 x (C1E4 - 32768) counts (Phase 7, read). Each term decays by a factor only for the cylinders injected since the previous pass (masks below, read), so this is a per-cylinder wall-film / transient fuel compensation (inferred). Fuel-trim learning (0x0FFE40) is enabled only while all four C1F4 words are within cals 0x4B850..0x4B852 (32674..32862) (Phase 7, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Transient Fuel Film Gain RPM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales the load-rise (film) transient fuel by rpm while it adds fuel (128 = x1.0). Companion of Transient Fuel Film Target. Stock 1.0 up to 2000 rpm, falling to 0.69 from 5200 rpm.

table.name: Transient Fuel Injected-Cylinder Mask (Event Index 0)
table.description:
Tells the transient fuel logic which cylinders were injected since the last pass, following the firing order 1-3-2-4. Do not edit unless the injection order changes.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running, when the event index FFF8CD93 is 0. 0x0F5AD0 (read): the mask FFF8A804 of cylinders injected since the previous 10 ms pass = table[current event index FFF8CD93 + 1](number of events since the last pass, FFF8A7FD). 0x0F5B60 and 0x0F6750 decay the transient-fuel terms only for the cylinders in the mask (read). Stock masks (bit n = cylinder n+1): one event = one cylinder, two = two, three = three, in the order 1-3-2-4 (the firing order; computed). Do not edit unless the injection order changes. Confidence: read.

table.name: Standstill Tip-In Enrichment
table.description:
Extra fuel when pulling away from standstill, by coolant; the largest active enrichment wins. Probably a cold drive-away aid. Triggered below 5 km/h as the pedal is first pressed. Stock 12.4 % up to -10 degC, 4 % at 0 degC, 0 above 10 degC.
Details: When used: pulling away from standstill (see below). Enrichment amount. 0x0CE3E0 (read): armed while running (FFF8906B = 3), vehicle speed FFF99835 <= cal 0x384A2 (5 km/h) and at least cal 0x384A4 (200) passes since the last event; it fires when the accelerator leaves the fully released state (falling edge of FFF886AB bit 5 = FFF88C64 bit 5, accelerator fully released, my research notes) and ends when the pedal is released again. Coolant FFF8CD65 (degC + 50) is latched at the event. FFF8B022 = Amount x 32 for the first Hold Time passes, then falls by 2 x Decay per pass to 0. The fuel factor 0x0C558C uses FFF8B022 >> 8 as one of the enrichment candidates (the largest wins, read); FFF8B022 also blocks long-term trim learning (0x0FFE40). Stock 254 (12.4 %) up to -10 degC, 82 (4 %) at 0 degC, 0 above 10 degC. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Standstill Tip-In Enrichment Hold Time
table.description:
How long Standstill Tip-In Enrichment is held at full amount before it decays, by coolant. Stock 200 passes cold, 60-150 mid; the amount is 0 when hot anyway.
Details: When used: pulling away from standstill. Passes for which the full amount is held (counter FFF84421 < this). 0x0CE3E0 (read): armed while running (FFF8906B = 3), vehicle speed FFF99835 <= cal 0x384A2 (5 km/h) and at least cal 0x384A4 (200) passes since the last event; it fires when the accelerator leaves the fully released state (falling edge of FFF886AB bit 5 = FFF88C64 bit 5, accelerator fully released, my research notes) and ends when the pedal is released again. table.name: Standstill Tip-In Enrichment Decay
table.description:
How fast Standstill Tip-In Enrichment fades after the hold time, by coolant; larger = faster fade. Stock 64 cold rising to 128 hot.
Details: When used: pulling away from standstill, after the hold time. Step by which FFF8B022 falls per pass (x 2). 0x0CE3E0 (read): armed while running (FFF8906B = 3), vehicle speed FFF99835 <= cal 0x384A2 (5 km/h) and at least cal 0x384A4 (200) passes since the last event; it fires when the accelerator leaves the fully released state (falling edge of FFF886AB bit 5 = FFF88C64 bit 5, accelerator fully released, my research notes) and ends when the pedal is released again. Coolant FFF8CD65 (degC + 50) is latched at the event. FFF8B022 = Amount x 32 for the first Hold Time passes, then falls by 2 x Decay per pass to 0. The fuel factor 0x0C558C uses FFF8B022 >> 8 as one of the enrichment candidates (the largest wins, read); FFF8B022 also blocks long-term trim learning (0x0FFE40). Stock 64 cold rising to 128 hot. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Fuel Cut Recovery Enrichment (Pedal Pressed)
table.description:
Extra fuel after a fuel cut, by cut duration and coolant, while the oxygen sensor still reads lean and the pedal is pressed; probably to restore the catalyst. Longer cuts give more. Stock up to 15 % after long cuts.
Details: When used: after a fuel cut, accelerator not fully released (FFF886AB bit 5 clear). 0x0CAE40 (read): FFF8B08A counts the passes of the current or last cylinder fuel cut (FFF8A64C bit 0, reset at its start). While the closed-loop state FFF8A820 = 3 (the state entered with FFF9DD60 bit 5 and its hold timer), the A/F signal FFF88AF6 >= cal 0x14F5A (43492, slightly lean of the 43194 = lambda 1.0 unit), FFF8881E < cal 0x14F5C, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 >= cal 0x14F5E (0), open-loop enrichment FFF8A684 and FFF8AFE8 both 0, and FFF88A2D bit 0 / FFF89053 bit 1 clear, FFF8A66C = this(cut duration FFF8B08A, coolant FFF88A44); else 0. FFF8A66C is one of the enrichment candidates of the fuel factor 0x0C558C (the largest wins, read). Role inferred: extra fuel after a fuel cut while the oxygen sensor still reads lean, larger after longer cuts. Unit 1/256 of fuel. Stock 0 for no cut, rising to 38 (15 %) after 200 passes, all coolant. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Fuel Cut Recovery Enrichment (Pedal Released)
table.description:
Extra fuel after a fuel cut while the sensor still reads lean and the pedal is released; probably to restore the catalyst. Stock up to 20 % after long cuts when hot.
Details: When used: after a fuel cut with the accelerator fully released (FFF886AB bit 5 set). 0x0CAE40 (read): FFF8B08A counts the passes of the current or last cylinder fuel cut (FFF8A64C bit 0, reset at its start). While the closed-loop state FFF8A820 = 3 (the state entered with FFF9DD60 bit 5 and its hold timer), the A/F signal FFF88AF6 >= cal 0x14F5A (43492, slightly lean of the 43194 = lambda 1.0 unit), FFF8881E < cal 0x14F5C, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 >= cal 0x14F5E (0), open-loop enrichment FFF8A684 and FFF8AFE8 both 0, and FFF88A2D bit 0 / FFF89053 bit 1 clear, FFF8A66C = this(cut duration FFF8B08A, coolant FFF88A44); else 0. FFF8A66C is one of the enrichment candidates of the fuel factor 0x0C558C (the largest wins, read). Role inferred: extra fuel after a fuel cut while the oxygen sensor still reads lean, larger after longer cuts. Unit 1/256 of fuel. Stock as the pedal-pressed table, 51 (20 %) after 500 passes when hot. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: TGV Transition Enrichment (Closing)
table.description:
Short fuel adder after the TGVs start to move, below 3600 rpm and only when cold (TGV Transition Enrichment Coolant Multiplier). Initial amount after a closing event, by rpm and load. Stock +3.5 % to +9 % at 1600-2000 rpm and mid load, 0 elsewhere.
Details: When used: briefly after the TGVs start to move (event-triggered transient fuel). Initial fuel adder after a closing event, rpm FFF8CE9C x load FFF8A616 (signed). Stock +3.5 % to +9 % at 1600-2000 rpm and 0.59-1.20 g/rev (46-93 % load), 0 elsewhere. 0x0CA144 (read; called with air quantity FFF8B4D6, coolant FFF88A44, rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616, FFF8A64C bit 0, FFF8A881 bit 5, FFF8AB28 bit 3, the TGV position sensors FFF88AA8/FFF88AA6 and their learned end positions FFF80698/80694 (low) and FFF80696/80692 (high)): a closing event fires when a sensor leaves its high end position by more than cal 0x13EAA (82 counts), an opening event when it leaves its low end position by more than cal 0x13EA6 (82). High sensor value = TGV open (FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction, rises with the sensor average through 05D29C/05D290; inferred polarity). After an event and a short delay (05A6F0 / 05A6FC, 2 passes stock) the compensation is set to the Enrichment table value, held for Hold Time passes, then moved toward 0 by Decay Step per pass; the alternate tables apply while FFF8AB28 bit 3 is set (flag not identified). FFF8AFE0 = closing + opening terms, only while rpm FFF8CE9C < cal 0x13EAE (3600 rpm), FFF8A64C bit 0 clear (no cylinder fuel cut) and FFF8A881 bit 5 set (TGV-module flag, not identified); FFF8AFDE = FFF8AFE0 x Coolant Multiplier / 32768. FFF8AFDE >> 8 is added to the fuel factor FFF8AFBC (256 = x1.0, 0x0C558C) and FFF8AFDE x 2^-16 to the fuel-mode-2 factor (0x0D1470) (read). Confidence: inferred.

Alternate version of TGV Transition Enrichment (Closing), used under an unidentified condition. Stock identical; edit together.
Details: When used: briefly after the TGVs start to move (event-triggered transient fuel). As TGV Transition Enrichment (Closing), used while FFF8AB28 bit 3 is set. High sensor value = TGV open (FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction, rises with the sensor average through 05D29C/05D290; inferred polarity). After an event and a short delay (05A6F0 / 05A6FC, 2 passes stock) the compensation is set to the Enrichment table value, held for Hold Time passes, then moved toward 0 by Decay Step per pass; the alternate tables apply while FFF8AB28 bit 3 is set (flag not identified). FFF8AFE0 = closing + opening terms, only while rpm FFF8CE9C < cal 0x13EAE (3600 rpm), FFF8A64C bit 0 clear (no cylinder fuel cut) and FFF8A881 bit 5 set (TGV-module flag, not identified); FFF8AFDE = FFF8AFE0 x Coolant Multiplier / 32768. FFF8AFDE >> 8 is added to the fuel factor FFF8AFBC (256 = x1.0, 0x0C558C) and FFF8AFDE x 2^-16 to the fuel-mode-2 factor (0x0D1470) (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: TGV Transition Enrichment Decay Step (Closing)
table.description:

table.name: Event Fuel Adder Initial Hold (A7E2 bit0 Clear)

table.name: Tip-In Extra Pulse Angle (Off in Stock)
table.description:
Part of an extra fuel pulse on fast tip-in. Its trigger can never fire with the stock calibration, so it has no effect on a stock car. Probably the injection angle of that extra pulse, by rpm.

FFF8A656 bit 7 is written in the transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 from 0x0F6FA8, the tip-in trigger of Tip-In Extra Pulse RPM/Coolant Multiplier (needs running, combustion mode 4, rpm FFF8CE9C < cal 0x3824A, FFF8CD82 > cal 0x34436, FFF8ADF4 > cal 0x34438 and FFF888CF > cal 0x346A6); the same bit latches the throttle-air rate B260 (0x0F5424) that sizes the extra pulse B262 (0x0F54B8), and it blocks multiple injection (read). Cal 0x346A6 = 255 and the compare at 0x0F7028 is an unsigned CMP/HI against the sign-extended byte (0xFFFFFFFF), so the bit can never set (read): the table is unused in stock. Reading: the angle of the tip-in extra pulse whose quantity is B262 (inferred from the shared trigger and the segment-3 condition; it is not part of any learning). Confidence: inferred.

Stock data identical to Tip-In Extra Pulse Coolant Multiplier (Off in Stock). 0x0F54B8 (read; called from 0x0F6260): extra-pulse quantity FFF8B262 = (latched throttle-air rate FFF8B260 - 32768) x Injector Scaling x cals 0x343E2/0x343E4/0x343E0 x period FFF8CD46 (float) x Tip-In Extra Pulse Coolant Multiplier/64 x Tip-In Extra Pulse RPM Multiplier/128 x 05C830(FFF8CD82)/128 x FFF8A7FE/128, only in fuel state 3 with combustion mode FFF8A85C = 4; it is held at its maximum while the injector-1 state FFF8888E does not change. 0x0D2CE8 / 0x0D300C / 0x0D3330 / 0x0D3654 (read) use B262 x Injector Flow Compensation x 0.0125 as the second-pulse time of each injector when mode 4 and the per-injector flag FFF8A6F1..A6F4 (set while FFF8888E..8891 = 3) rises. B260 latches FFF8ADF4 (filtered throttle-air rate) only on the rising edge of FFF8A656 bit 7 (0x0F5424), which 0x0F6FA8 sets on a fast tip-in (rpm, FFF8ADF4 > cal 0x34438, MAP-based threshold 05C98C on FFF8B4CA) only if a byte exceeds cal 0x346A6 = 0xFF (sign-extended compare, read in the disassembly at 0x0F7020): never. So B260 stays at its initial value and B262 = 0 in stock (read; initial value 0 inferred). "Tip-in" is inferred from the trigger inputs. Confidence: read.

table.name: Cranking Fuel (First Attempt)
table.description:
Main cranking fuel pulse by coolant, for a normal first cranking attempt. Raise for more fuel while cranking. Raw units: change it proportionally.
Details: When used: THE normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (combustion mode 0 maps to fuel mode 0, 0x108B08, read) on a first attempt (no repeat-crank history). Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (0x0C9038, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 clear (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C9038): FFF842C8 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x C535 x coolant multiplier x 64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125 (the 64 is fixed, folded into the constant 5.843592e-11; Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier 05A1FC acts only on the secondary pulse in 0x0C8A28), and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. table.name: Cranking Fuel (Repeat Attempt)

table.name: Cranking Fuel RPM Multiplier (TGV Closed)
table.description:
Reduces cranking fuel as cranking rpm rises, by rpm and coolant, TGVs closed side of a TGV blend (255 = x1.0, inferred). Edit the TGV Closed / Open pair together. Stock 1.0 at 200 rpm and when warm, down to 0.52 at 800 rpm when cold.
Details: When used: every pass of 0x0C9038 while rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x1CBD8 (4000 rpm) (read). 0x0C9038 blends this table (weight 1 - FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction) with 05A388, both on rpm FFF8CD54 x coolant FFF88A44, and filters the blend toward the target with weight cal 0x11D71 / 0x11D72 (13/256 at coolant FFF8CD65 >= cal 0x11D70 = 13 degC, else 179/256) through boot helper 0x6C70 into FFF8C535 / FFF842CC (read). table.description:

Details: FFF8A687 = this(FFF88668), or 255 when a flag is set (0x0CEBF4, read); FFF8A687 is a factor of the cranking pulse (0x0C8A28, read). FFF88668 runs 48-104 kPa on this axis, so it is taken as barometric pressure (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Pedal Multiplier
table.description:
Cranking fuel multiplier by accelerator position. Stock slightly more fuel at 10-50 % pedal and zero at 100 %: a wide-open pedal appears to cut cranking fuel to clear a flooded engine.
Details: When used: start types other than 3 (FFF8A6E7 != 3). 0x0CD7E4 (read): FFF8A67E = this(accelerator FFF88A5E), updated only while rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x1CBD8 (4000 rpm). table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay (First Attempt)
table.description:
How fast the cranking fuel floor fades away after the engine starts, by start coolant, on a first attempt. 65536 = no decay, smaller = faster fade. Stock identical to Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay (First Attempt); keep equal.
Details: When used: cal 0x38448 bit 0 clear (stock) and FFF8A881 bit 2 set (s4, always in stock), FFF811A7 bit 7 clear (no repeat-crank history). Indexed by FFF8CD67, coolant (degC + 50) held from start. 0x0C9038 (read): outside cranking (fuel state FFF8906B != 2) the normal cranking pulse is no longer recomputed; each pass FFF842D0 = previous value x this / 65536, so FFF8AFC6 decays geometrically from its last cranking value. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel modes 0/3, where 10 x it is a floor on the quantity (0x0D168C). 65536 = no decay; smaller = faster fade. Argument mapping from the call at 0x0C6896 (my research notes, read). Stock data identical to Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay (First Attempt) (the FFF8AFC4 path); keep them equal unless the two paths should differ. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary (First Attempt)
table.description:

It is the cranking pulse whenever the engine cranks in normal combustion mode instead of the start mode: after about 10 s of continuous cranking, when the low-rail-pressure start latch is set (then scaled by Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier), or on a re-crank before the start sequence reset; it also sets a floor on fuel in normal running until it decays. Raw units: change it proportionally.
Details: When used: Secondary cranking pulse FFF8AFC4, used only in fuel modes 1/2 (a re-crank that starts before the combustion mode returned to 0, and as the running floor). Raw units: the factors' normalisation is not fully resolved, so change it proportionally. FFF8AFC4 feeds injectors in fuel mode 1 or 2. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay (First Attempt)
table.description:
How fast the secondary cranking fuel floor fades after the engine starts, by start coolant, on a first attempt (per 10 ms pass). 65536 = no decay, smaller = faster fade. Keep equal to Cranking Fuel Decay (First Attempt).
Details: When used: cal 0x38448 bit 0 clear (stock) and FFF8A881 bit 2 set (s4, always in stock), FFF811A7 bit 7 clear (no repeat-crank history). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier
table.description:
Multiplies the secondary cranking fuel by coolant when rail pressure is still low some time into a start (64 = x1.0). Stock x1.5 between -10 and 40 degC, otherwise x1.0.
Details: When used: while the low-rail-pressure start latch FFF8A856 bit 6 is set (0x0C8A28 argument from the call in 0x0C589C, read; the latch is set by 0x10B54C when rail pressure is still low after a calibrated time, my research notes). 0x0C8A28 multiplies the secondary cranking pulse FFF8AFC4 by this(coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50) instead of the fixed 64 (read), so 64 = x1.0. Stock 1.0, and 1.5 between -10 and 40 degC. Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C8A28 / 0x0C9038): FFF842B4 = clamp(base x ramp x A67E x A687 x filtered RPM multiplier x coolant multiplier (x 05A1FC-or-64 in 0x0C8A28) x const, 0, 524280) x 0.125; the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Low Rail Pressure Start Enrichment
table.description:
Extra fuel by coolant when rail pressure is still low some time into a start, until pressure has stayed close to target for a while. Stock +50 % between -10 and 40 degC, otherwise 0.
Details: When used: while the low-rail-pressure start latch FFF8A856 bit 6 is set (0x10B54C, my research notes). 0x0CDD8C (read): FFF8B014 = this(coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50) until rail pressure FFF88884 has stayed at or above the rail target FFF8B9A0 minus cal 0x15194 (3279 counts, about 2 MPa) for cal 0x15196 (500) passes; then FFF8B014 ramps down by cal 0x15192 / 2 = 1 count (1/256 of fuel) per 20 ms pass (0x0CDD8C runs in the 20 ms task 0x0C73D0), so stock +50 % fades out over 128 passes = 2.6 s; the 500-pass hold is 10 s. It returns to the full table value whenever rail pressure drops below the threshold again (counter reset). FFF8B014 is added to FFF8B010 (see Running After-Start Enrichment 1). Unit 1/256 of fuel (inferred, same as FFF8B010). Stock 128 (+50 %) between -10 and 40 degC, else 0. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Open)
table.description:
Start-path enrichment by load and coolant with the TGVs open, blended with the TGV Closed table by TGV position. Raising it adds fuel during start-up.
Details: FFF8B02C (0x0CEF04, read): Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Open) weighted by FFF8B3E8, Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Closed) by 1 - FFF8B3E8 and Start Enrichment (Load) RPM Multiplier; B02C adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 used by fuel modes 0 and 3 (0x0D1400, read). Unit 1/256 of base fuel (inferred). Blend weight FFF8B3E8 is the TGV position weight from 0x10C948: average of the two TGV position sensors FFF88AA6/88AA8 through 05D29C/05D290, ramped (cal 0x379EC/0x379EE) and gated by FFF8A881 bit 4 and FFF88E2A bit 5 (read). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, so FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction; 0x10C948 drives it toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so that bit set = TGVs closed. Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Start-path enrichment by load and coolant with the TGVs closed, blended with the TGV Open table by TGV position and scaled by Start Enrichment (Load) RPM Multiplier.
Details: FFF8B02C (0x0CEF04, read): Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Open) weighted by FFF8B3E8, Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Closed) by 1 - FFF8B3E8 and Start Enrichment (Load) RPM Multiplier; B02C adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 used by fuel modes 0 and 3 (0x0D1400, read). Unit 1/256 of base fuel (inferred). Blend weight FFF8B3E8 is the TGV position weight from 0x10C948: average of the two TGV position sensors FFF88AA6/88AA8 through 05D29C/05D290, ramped (cal 0x379EC/0x379EE) and gated by FFF8A881 bit 4 and FFF88E2A bit 5 (read). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, so FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction; 0x10C948 drives it toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so that bit set = TGVs closed. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Enrichment (Load) RPM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Closed) by rpm (128 = x1.0); the TGV Open table is not scaled. Stock all 128, no effect.
Details: Scales only Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Closed) (the part weighted by 1 - FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction) by this(rpm)/128 (0x0CEF04, read); Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Open) is not scaled. Stock 1.00 (raw 128) everywhere. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Enrichment Additive (Load, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Extra start enrichment by load and coolant, added on top of Start Enrichment (Load) only while a start condition flag is set (depends on start coolant, pedal and speed; not fully decoded). TGVs closed side of a TGV blend. Stock equal to the TGV Open table below 50 degC.
Details: When used: only while FFF8A857 bit 7 is set (set by 0x10BF88 only when FFF8A852 = 2, the second-pulse share FFF8A85F = 0 and a computed quantity is below FFF8B088 + cal 0x2A3CC; cal 0x2996C bit 3, coolant, the pedal-released flag and vehicle speed only pick the share table used in that computation; meaning inferred). 0x0CF0F4 (read): FFF8B02E = 05AD58(load FFF8A616, coolant FFF88A44) x FFF8B3E8 + 05AD44 x (1 - FFF8B3E8) x 05AD6C(rpm)/128 (this table weighted by 1 - FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction); 0x0CEF04 adds FFF8B02E to Start Enrichment (Load) FFF8B02C under the same bit (read). FFF8B02C (0x0CEF04) adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 of fuel modes 0 and 3 (0x0D1400, read). Unit 1/256 of base fuel (inferred, as Start Enrichment (Load)). Stock: the two tables are equal below 50 degC coolant; at 50 degC and above the TGV Open table is 0. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Enrichment Additive (Load, TGV Open)
table.description:
Extra start enrichment by load and coolant, added on top of Start Enrichment (Load) only while a start condition flag is set (depends on start coolant, pedal and speed; not fully decoded). TGVs open side of a TGV blend. Stock equal to the TGV Closed table below 50 degC and 0 from 50 degC.
Details: When used: only while FFF8A857 bit 7 is set (set by 0x10BF88 only when FFF8A852 = 2, the second-pulse share FFF8A85F = 0 and a computed quantity is below FFF8B088 + cal 0x2A3CC; cal 0x2996C bit 3, coolant, the pedal-released flag and vehicle speed only pick the share table used in that computation; meaning inferred). 0x0CF0F4 (read): FFF8B02E = 05AD58(load FFF8A616, coolant FFF88A44) x FFF8B3E8 + 05AD44 x (1 - FFF8B3E8) x 05AD6C(rpm)/128 (this table weighted by FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction); 0x0CEF04 adds FFF8B02E to Start Enrichment (Load) FFF8B02C under the same bit (read). table.name: Start Enrichment (Coolant Window Override)
table.description:
Replaces Start Enrichment (Load) for a while after start, but only when the start coolant falls inside a calibrated window. That window is empty in stock, so practically never used.
Details: When used: only when coolant at start FFF88A46 lies within cal 0x11D24...0x11D26 (both 0 in stock: -40 degC, practically never). 0x0CEF04 (read): in fuel states 2/3 FFF8B02C = this(coolant FFF88A44) instead of the Start Enrichment (Load) blend until the accelerator has been pressed for cal 0x11D02 (40) passes within the first cal 0x11D00 (800) counts of FFF8B06A (passes since running); the output may move by at most cal 0x11D38 (65535 = unlimited) per pass. FFF8B02C (0x0CEF04) adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 of fuel modes 0 and 3 (0x0D1400, read). Stock data identical to Warm-Up Enrichment (Coolant Window Override). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: After-Start Enrichment RPM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales the largest of the three after-start enrichments by rpm (128 = x1.0) while cranking and running.
Details: Scales the largest of the three faded after-start enrichments (0x0CD834, read) when FFF8906B is 2 or 3. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: After-Start Enrichment Coolant Multiplier (Repeat Start, Unused)
table.description:
Computed after a repeat crank but never used by the fuel calculation, so editing it does nothing. Stock x1.0.
Details: 0x0CD834 (read): FFF843F3 = this(coolant FFF8CD65, deg C + 50) while FFF811A7 bit 7 (repeat-crank history, backup RAM) is set, else 128 (x1.0); copied out to FFF8A697, which no code reads (my disassembler finds only the two writers 0x0CD834 and the init 0x0CC6A4), so editing it has no effect. Stock flat 128 (x1.0). Confidence: read.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment 1 (First Start)
table.description:
Running-path after-start enrichment 1 by coolant for a first start (start type meaning inferred). The ECU uses the largest of the three terms, each faded by its decay table; cut at very high load. Also blocks long-term trim learning while active.
Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 0, in fuel states 2 (cranking) and 3 (running). Amount E1 (1/256 of fuel) for this start type, on coolant FFF88A44. 0x0CDD8C (read) builds FFF8B010: three amounts E1/E2/E3, each from a coolant table chosen by start type FFF8A6E7 (0 first start, 1 restart after key-off, 2 restart after stall, else special start; type and coolant FFF88A44 latched when fuel state 2/3 is entered (start of cranking, or a return from 3 to 2) for the amounts E1-E3, and latched again when fuel state 3 is entered (end of cranking) for the decay tables D1-D3), each faded linearly to zero over 8 x D passes of FFF8B06A (passes since fuel state 3, 0x0D1354) by its own decay table D1/D2/D3 (factor = clamp((8D - FFF8B06A) x 32 / D, 0, 255) / 256; no fade while cranking); FFF8B010 = max(E1, E2, E3) x 05AA60(rpm)/128 x FFF8A696/128 + Low Rail Pressure Start Enrichment, forced to 0 at load FFF8A616 >= cal 0x237C8 (255, hysteresis cal 0x237C9) and outside fuel states 2/3. FFF8B010 is summed with Warm-Up Enrichment FFF8B030 in the enrichment term of the fuel factor 0x0C558C (read), blocks long-term trim learning (0x0FFE40) and is read by the closed-loop controller 0x0FD76C. This is the running-path counterpart of After-Start Enrichment 1-3 (0x0CD834 -> FFF8B012, start path). Confidence: inferred.

Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 0, in fuel states 2 (cranking) and 3 (running). Decay time D2, applied to E2 (8 x value passes of FFF8B06A to fade out) for this start type, on coolant FFF88A44. 0x0CDD8C (read) builds FFF8B010: three amounts E1/E2/E3, each from a coolant table chosen by start type FFF8A6E7 (0 first start, 1 restart after key-off, 2 restart after stall, else special start; type and coolant FFF88A44 latched when fuel state 2/3 is entered (start of cranking, or a return from 3 to 2) for the amounts E1-E3, and latched again when fuel state 3 is entered (end of cranking) for the decay tables D1-D3), each faded linearly to zero over 8 x D passes of FFF8B06A (passes since fuel state 3, 0x0D1354) by its own decay table D1/D2/D3 (factor = clamp((8D - FFF8B06A) x 32 / D, 0, 255) / 256; no fade while cranking); FFF8B010 = max(E1, E2, E3) x 05AA60(rpm)/128 x FFF8A696/128 + Low Rail Pressure Start Enrichment, forced to 0 at load FFF8A616 >= cal 0x237C8 (255, hysteresis cal 0x237C9) and outside fuel states 2/3. FFF8B010 is summed with Warm-Up Enrichment FFF8B030 in the enrichment term of the fuel factor 0x0C558C (read), blocks long-term trim learning (0x0FFE40) and is read by the closed-loop controller 0x0FD76C. This is the running-path counterpart of After-Start Enrichment 1-3 (0x0CD834 -> FFF8B012, start path). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start History Reset Delay (Coolant)
table.description:
Time after ignition-off, by coolant, after which the ECU forgets the previous start, so the next start counts as a first start rather than a restart. Shorter with a weak battery. Stock 1500 counts up to 40 degC, 50 above.
Details: When used: 0x0D39DC with 0x0D3A74 (read; my research notes): after the ignition is switched off (FFF8A65A bit 5) a counter runs; when it reaches this(coolant FFF88A44) (or cal 0x13E5E = 50 while battery FFF88A7E < cal 0x13E60, 11.0 V) FFF8A65A bit 6 is set, which clears the start history FFF811A7 bits 2-5/7 and FFF81408 used for the restart start type FFF8A6E7. Stock 1500 counts up to 40 C, 50 above. Confidence: read.

table.name: Cranking Fuel (Repeat Attempt, Special Start, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Cranking fuel pulse by coolant for a repeat attempt in the special start type. Never used on a stock car (that start type is disabled by calibration). Stock identical to Cranking Fuel (Repeat Attempt).
Details: When used: Repeat attempt in start type 3, which never occurs in stock (cal 0x57E9C = 0xFFFF). Identical to Cranking Fuel (Repeat Attempt) in stock. Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (0x0C9038, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 set, FFF8A6E7 = 3 (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C9038): FFF842C8 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x C535 x coolant multiplier x 64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125 (the 64 is fixed, folded into the constant 5.843592e-11; Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier 05A1FC acts only on the secondary pulse in 0x0C8A28), and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. Raw units: the factors' normalisation is not fully resolved, so change it proportionally. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel mode 0 or 3. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel (Stall Window, First Attempt, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Cranking fuel pulse by coolant for a restart after a stop inside a calibrated coolant window, first attempt. Never used on a stock car: that window is empty in stock.
Details: When used: Only when FFF8A881 bit 2 is clear: a restart after a stop in combustion mode >= 1 with coolant inside cal 0x37A17..0x37A18, both 0 in stock, so never used (0x10E078, read). Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (0x0C9038, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) clear, s8 clear (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Special Start, Off in Stock)
table.description:

Details: When used: Start type FFF8A6E7 = 3, which never occurs in stock (cal 0x57E9C = 0xFFFF) (0x0D1268, read; meaning inferred). A first start (type 0) uses x1.0. Multiplier in the normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 when FFF8A6E7 = 3 (0x0C9038, coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50, read from the call at 0x0C6896); 255 (x1.0) for other values. The FFF8AFC4 path uses Cranking Fuel Secondary Coolant Multiplier (...), identical in stock (0.70 cold to 1.0 hot). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Unused Routine, Restart after Key-Off)
table.description:
Belongs to a third cranking-fuel routine whose results nothing reads, so editing it has no effect. Its coolant axis is shared with the live coolant multipliers; edit that axis only there.
Details: Role in the routine: multiplier by coolant FFF8CD65 for start type FFF8A6E7 = 1 (0x0CD124, read). Unused in this ROM: third cranking-pulse routine 0x0CD124 (called once from 0x0C589C, read). Its outputs FFF8B000 / FFF8A67B / FFF8B002 / FFF8A67C have no reader (ram_xref: writers 0x0CC6A4 and 0x0CD124 only, no readers), and its statics FFF843B0..FFF843BC are read only by itself. Editing it has no effect. Data equals Cranking Fuel Secondary Coolant Multiplier (Restart after Key-Off); the axis 0x03828C is shared with the live coolant multipliers, so edit the axis only there. Confidence: read.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay (Stall Window, First Attempt, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Post-start fade of cranking fuel for a stall-window restart, first attempt. Never used on a stock car (the stall-window condition never occurs). Stock identical to its Secondary copy.
Details: When used: cal 0x38448 bit 0 clear (stock) and s4 clear (never in stock), FFF811A7 bit 7 clear. Indexed by FFF8CD67, coolant (degC + 50) held from start. 0x0C9038 (read): outside cranking (fuel state FFF8906B != 2) the normal cranking pulse is no longer recomputed; each pass FFF842D0 = previous value x this / 65536, so FFF8AFC6 decays geometrically from its last cranking value. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel modes 0/3, where 10 x it is a floor on the quantity (0x0D168C). 65536 = no decay; smaller = faster fade. Argument mapping from the call at 0x0C6896 (my research notes, read). Stock data identical to Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay (Stall Window, First Attempt) (the FFF8AFC4 path); keep them equal unless the two paths should differ. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay (Unused Routine)
table.description:
Belongs to a third cranking-fuel routine whose results nothing reads, so editing it has no effect. Its axis is shared with the start-type decay tables.
Details: Role in the routine: per-pass decay of the pulse after cranking by coolant at start FFF88A46 (0x0CD124, read). Unused in this ROM: third cranking-pulse routine 0x0CD124 (called once from 0x0C589C, read). Its outputs FFF8B000 / FFF8A67B / FFF8B002 / FFF8A67C have no reader (ram_xref: writers 0x0CC6A4 and 0x0CD124 only, no readers), and its statics FFF843B0..FFF843BC are read only by itself. Editing it has no effect. Axis 0x03836C is shared with the start-type decay tables. Confidence: read.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary (Repeat Attempt, Special Start, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Secondary cranking fuel pulse for a repeat attempt in the special start type. Never used on a stock car (start type disabled by calibration).
Details: When used: Secondary pulse, repeat attempt in start type 3 (FFF8A6E7 = 3), which never occurs in stock. Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC4 (0x0C8A28, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 set, FFF8A6E7 = 3 (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C8A28 / 0x0C9038): FFF842B4 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x 842C4 x coolant multiplier x 05A1FC-or-64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125, and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. Raw units: the factors' normalisation is not fully resolved, so change it proportionally. FFF8AFC4 feeds injectors in fuel mode 1 or 2. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay (Stall Window, First Attempt, Off in Stock)
table.description:

Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Prime Pulse Coolant Multiplier (Off in Stock)

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment 1 (Special Start, Off in Stock)
