table.name: Injection Timing (Single Injection)
table.description:
Main injection angle in normal running (degrees BTDC of compression TDC, larger = earlier), by rpm and load, with one injection per cycle (the stock case). Replaced by Injection Timing (High Pedal) at high pedal. Stock 260-360 BTDC: early intake stroke.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC (display 720 - x/2; 0x0CFE8C clamps the code to 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC, read); larger = earlier. Stock 260-360 BTDC: early intake stroke. When used: Main-injection angle with one injection per cycle, the stock case (0x0CB394, read), unless the high-pedal latch selects Injection Timing (High Pedal). Main injection angle FFF8B052 in running mode (FFF8906B = 3) after a start delay (counter FFF84480 >= cal 0x12008) (0x0CFE8C, read): this table, plus Injection Timing Additive x multiplier / 255 when the high-pedal latch FFF8A8A4 bit 6 is clear (with FFF88E28 bit 2 or FFF88E2B bit 5 set: this table alone), clamped to 360..1079 code units (half degrees) (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing (High Pedal)
table.description:
Injection angle used instead of Injection Timing (Single Injection) and its additive while the pedal is at 90 % or more (released below 85 %). Stock 260-360 BTDC: early intake stroke.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC (display 720 - x/2; 0x0CFE8C clamps the code to 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC, read); larger = earlier. Stock 260-360 BTDC: early intake stroke. When used: replaces Injection Timing (Single Injection) + additive while FFF8A8A4 bit 6 is set, a high-pedal latch built like bit 7 (set at >= 90 % pedal, cleared below 85 %; 0x11C0C4 / 0x10F608, read), and only while FFF88E28 bit 2 and FFF88E2B bit 5 are clear (0x0CFE8C, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing Additive
table.description:
Retard (degrees later) applied to Injection Timing (Single Injection), scaled by Injection Timing Additive Multiplier. Stock table 15-40 degrees later at 1600-4000 rpm and 1.29-2.07 g/rev, but the stock multiplier is 0 except at hot intake air (95 F and up) with a high value of its unidentified row input, so it is mostly inactive in stock.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees LATER, i.e. subtracted from the degrees-BTDC of Injection Timing (Single Injection) after the multiplier/255 (0x0CFE8C, read). Stock 0 except 15-40 degrees later at 1600-4000 rpm, 1.29-2.07 g/rev (100-160 % load). Added to the primary injection angle, scaled by Injection Timing Additive Multiplier / 255 (0x0CFE8C, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing Additive Multiplier
table.description:
Scales Injection Timing Additive (255 = x1.0), by an unidentified input and intake air temperature.
Details: Scales Injection Timing Additive (0x0CFE8C, read). Inputs: FFF88A9D (rows, not identified) and FFF88662 (columns), intake air temperature + 50 degC (the OBD IAT source, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Injection Timing
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking and for the first 0.3 s of running, by rpm and coolant, but only when the engine is in normal combustion mode (fuel mode 1): after about 10 s of cranking, when the low-rail-pressure start latch is set, or on a re-crank before the start sequence reset. A normal start uses Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) instead. Stock 245 BTDC everywhere (intake stroke).
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC (display 720 - x/2; 0x0CFE8C clamps the code to 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC, read); larger = earlier. Stock 245 BTDC everywhere (intake stroke). When used: 0x0CFE8C (read) writes this table into FFF8B052 while cranking (FFF8906B = 2) and for the first cal 0x12008 (30 passes, 0.3 s) after the engine is running. FFF8B052 is the injection angle only for injectors in fuel mode 1 (0x0CB394, read). A normal start cranks in combustion mode 0 = fuel mode 0 (init 0, 0x109B4C; 0x108B08, read), where the angle is FFF8B050 = Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) (05AF80, 0x0CFB28 / 0x0CB394, read), so this table does not set the normal cranking angle. It applies when the crank runs in combustion mode 4 / fuel mode 1: after about 10 s of continuous cranking (cal 0x29A32 = 1000 passes, 0x109B4C), when the low-rail-pressure start latch FFF8A856 bit 6 forces mode 4, or on a re-crank before the mode returned to 0 (read). Columns are coolant temperature FFF88A44 (passed by 0x0C589C, read; breakpoints -30..80 C). Replaced by Cranking Injection Timing (Stop-Start Restart) when FFF89066 bit 0 is set; a fixed cal 0x11FE6 overrides it when cal 0x38448 bit 6 is set (clear in stock). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0)
table.description:
Injection angle in the first phase after start, by rpm and coolant: a compression-stroke injection, probably for the stratified start. Kept within 0.5-180 BTDC. Stock 160 BTDC when very cold, otherwise 80-116 BTDC.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (0 = firing TDC, 180 = intake BDC (start of compression), 360 = gas-exchange TDC, 540 = expansion BDC); larger = earlier. Same scale as every Injection Timing table. Clamped to 0.5-180 BTDC (code 1080-1439, 0x0CFB28, read). Stock 160 BTDC in the two coldest columns, otherwise 80 BTDC at 200 rpm to 116.5 BTDC at 900 rpm: a compression-stroke injection for the first phase after start (inferred stratified start). Injections cannot start in the last 10 degrees before TDC: 0.5-10 BTDC act as 10.5 BTDC (0x1DCA04, read). When used: fuel mode 0 (combustion mode 0, the first phase after start, 0x108B08). 0x0CFB28 (read): in fuel states 2/3 FFF8B050 = this(rpm/50 FFF8CD56, coolant FFF88A44) clamped to 1080...1439; else 0x636. In cranking with FFF89066 bit 0 set it is replaced by 05AF74/05AF68 (coolant) by rail pressure FFF88884 vs cal 0x2A65E; with cal 0x38448 bit 7 set the fixed cal 0x11EBC is used. 0x0CB394 and its three siblings (one per injector) use FFF8B050 - 1080 as the injection angle when that injector's fuel mode FFF8A858.. is 0 (read). Stock 1120 at -40/-30 degC coolant; otherwise 1280 at 200 rpm falling to 1207 at 900 rpm. p16 (read): FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN ID 0x15A byte 2 bit 0 (mailbox 15, decoder 0x085D20). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Double Injection Quantity Window Low
table.description:
Lower fuel-quantity limit for using two injections per cycle; with Double Injection Quantity Window High it defines when split injection is used. Stock 65535, so double injection is disabled.
Details: 0x0CF3EC (read): two injections (FFF8A69E = 2) are allowed while the quantity FFF8B07A x FFF8AFEA / 256 lies between this and Double Injection Quantity Window High (with hysteresis cal 0x17D54), and half of it plus latency still exceeds the minimum pulse plus cal 0x183B8. 65535 in stock, i.e. disabled. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Double Injection Quantity Window High
table.description:
Upper fuel-quantity limit for two injections per cycle. Stock 65535, so double injection is disabled.
Details: Upper edge of the two-injection quantity window (0x0CF3EC, read). 65535 in stock. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Quantity Window Low
table.description:
Lower fuel-quantity limit for using three injections per cycle. Stock 65535, so triple injection is disabled.
Details: 0x0CF3EC (read): three injections (FFF8A69E = 3) are chosen first while the quantity lies between this and Triple Injection Quantity Window High, a third of it plus latency exceeds the minimum pulse plus cal 0x183BA, and an enable argument is set. 65535 in stock. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Quantity Window High
table.description:
Upper fuel-quantity limit for three injections per cycle. Stock 65535, so triple injection is disabled.
Details: Upper edge of the three-injection quantity window (0x0CF3EC, read). 65535 in stock. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, Low Rail Pressure)
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking for a stop-start restart with rail pressure below 2 MPa. Stop-start cannot activate in this calibration, so probably unused. Not clamped by the ECU: keep it within 0.5-180 BTDC. Edit with the High Rail Pressure table. Stock 115 BTDC.
Details: When used: while cranking (fuel state FFF8906B = 2) with the stop-start restart request FFF89066 bit 0 set and rail pressure FFF88884 below cal 0x2A65E (3279 = 2.0 MPa / 290 psi) (0x0CFB28, called from 0x0C589C with (906B, coolant FFF88A44, rpm/50, cal 0x38448 bit 7, FFF89066 bit 0, FFF88884, &FFF8B050, &FFF8B008), args read in the caller's disassembly). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). It replaces Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) in FFF8B050, which 0x0CB394 uses as the first-pulse angle of injectors in fuel mode 0 (segment 3, offset B050 - 1080) (read). Unlike that table it is only floored at code 0, not clamped to 1080-1439, so keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439) (read). Setting cal 0x38448 bit 7 (clear in stock) would force cal 0x11EBC (clamped to 1080-1439) instead. FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read); that feature cannot activate in this calibration (TE.md 2.3), so this table is expected to be unused in stock (inferred). Stock 115 BTDC at every coolant temperature (code 1210), i.e. compression stroke, like the normal start angle. Edit with the High Rail Pressure table. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, High Rail Pressure)
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking for a stop-start restart with rail pressure at or above 2 MPa. Probably unused (stop-start cannot activate). Not clamped: keep within 0.5-180 BTDC. Stock 115 BTDC.
Details: When used: as Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, Low Rail Pressure), but with rail pressure FFF88884 at or above cal 0x2A65E (3279 = 2.0 MPa / 290 psi) (0x0CFB28, read). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). Only floored at code 0, not clamped (read): keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439). FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read); that feature cannot activate in this calibration (TE.md 2.3), so this table is expected to be unused in stock (inferred). Stock 115 BTDC everywhere (code 1210), identical to the Low Rail Pressure table. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Injection Timing (Stop-Start Restart)
table.description:
Replaces Cranking Injection Timing while cranking for a stop-start restart. Stop-start cannot activate in this calibration, so probably unused. Stock 245 BTDC, same as Cranking Injection Timing.
Details: When used: while cranking (FFF8906B = 2) with the stop-start restart request FFF89066 bit 0 set; then it replaces Cranking Injection Timing as the main injection angle FFF8B052 (0x0CFE8C, read; args read in 0x0C589C: param_5 = coolant FFF88A44, param_11 = FFF89066 bit 0). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). Clamped to code 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC (read). Cal 0x38448 bit 6 (clear in stock) would force cal 0x11FE6. FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read); that feature cannot activate in this calibration (TE.md 2.3), so this table is expected to be unused in stock (inferred). Stock 245 BTDC at every coolant temperature (code 950), the same as Cranking Injection Timing (intake stroke). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing (Triple Injection, 1st, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Angle of the first pulse with three injections per cycle. No effect in stock: multiple injection is disabled.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC, stored directly (0x0CFC20: code = 1440 - x, then clamped to 0.5-540 BTDC; read). Same scale as every other Injection Timing / injection-angle table. When used: First pulse with three injections per cycle (0x0CB394, read). Unused in stock. Injection angle for FFF8B058 (0x0C589C via 0x0CFC20-style helper, read): computed only while FFF99844 is 2 or 3 (otherwise a fixed 0x1FE) (0x0CFC20, read). 0x0CB394 uses B054 for two injections and B058 for three in normal fuel mode (read); the Double Injection tables cover 1100-3200 rpm, the Triple Injection tables 600-1300 rpm. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing (Triple Injection, 2nd, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Angle of the second pulse with three injections per cycle. No effect in stock: multiple injection is disabled.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC, stored directly (0x0CFC20: code = 1440 - x, then clamped to 0.5-540 BTDC; read). Same scale as every other Injection Timing / injection-angle table. When used: Second pulse with three injections per cycle (0x0CB604, read). Unused in stock. Injection angle for FFF8B05A (0x0C589C via 0x0CFC20-style helper, read): computed only while FFF99844 is 2 or 3 (otherwise a fixed 0x1FE) (0x0CFC20, read). 0x0CB394 uses B054 for two injections and B058 for three in normal fuel mode (read); the Double Injection tables cover 1100-3200 rpm, the Triple Injection tables 600-1300 rpm. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing (Triple Injection, 3rd, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Angle of the third pulse with three injections per cycle. No effect in stock: multiple injection is disabled.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC, stored directly (0x0CFC20: code = 1440 - x, then clamped to 0.5-540 BTDC; read). Same scale as every other Injection Timing / injection-angle table. When used: Third pulse with three injections per cycle, on the first-pulse channel in a later segment (0x0CB1E4, read). Unused in stock. Injection angle for FFF8B05C (0x0C589C via 0x0CFC20-style helper, read): computed only while FFF99844 is 2 or 3 (otherwise a fixed 0x1FE) (0x0CFC20, read). 0x0CB394 uses B054 for two injections and B058 for three in normal fuel mode (read); the Double Injection tables cover 1100-3200 rpm, the Triple Injection tables 600-1300 rpm. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Split 1
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the first of three injections (the third gets what the first two leave). Stock 0, and triple injection is disabled anyway.
Details: Share of the fuel in the first of three injections (0x0D06EC -> FFF8A6C9 -> FFF8A6D3, read); the third gets 128 minus the first two (0x0D0DC0). All zero in stock. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Split 2
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the second of three injections. Stock 0, and triple injection is disabled anyway.
Details: Share of the fuel in the second of three injections (0x0D06EC -> FFF8A6CA -> FFF8A6D4, read). All zero in stock. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Spark Retard
table.description:
How far spark is retarded from base timing during cold-start catalyst heating, which heats the catalyst faster. The spark moves toward this target in steps.
Details: Spark target during catalyst heating: in running state (FFF8866C >= 3) FFF8A76C = min(selected base timing FFF8A645 - this(max(FFF8A64B, cal 0x1B8CC = 1) x 128), cal 0x1B83C = 60 degrees) (0x0DD4EC, read); before running it is cal 0x1B8CA (0). Units are base-timing units (0.5 degree). The ignition module then moves toward the target in steps (cal 0x1B894/0x1B895) within cal 0x1B896/0x1B897 limits (0x0DA51C, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Spark Retard (Phase 2)
table.description:
Same as Catalyst Heating Spark Retard for the second catalyst-heating phase; its result also selects the phase 2 injection angles.
Details: FFF8A76B, the spark-linked value used in fuel mode 2 (FFF8A85C 1 and 3): in running state (FFF8866C >= 3) = min(base timing FFF8A645 - this(max(FFF8A64B, cal 0x1B8C8 = 1) x 128), cal 0x1B83C = 60 degrees); before running it is Spark Angle Before Running (Coolant) (05BA84) (0x0DD464, read). FFF8A76B is also the spark input of the Catalyst Heating Phase 2 injection-angle tables. Units 0.5 degree (base-timing units). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Injection Angle
table.description:
Injection angle during stratified catalyst heating, by rpm and spark target: a compression-stroke pulse that follows the retarded spark (inferred). The ECU limits it to 10.5-180 BTDC, and stock cells outside that are simply clipped.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (0 = firing TDC, 180 = intake BDC (start of compression), 360 = gas-exchange TDC, 540 = expansion BDC); larger = earlier. Same scale as every Injection Timing table. First pulse in catalyst-heating fuel mode 3; clamped to 0.5-180 BTDC (code 1080-1439, 0x0D03C8, read), and 0.5-10 BTDC act as 10.5 (0x1DCA04, read). Cells outside 0.5-180 are stored in stock and are cut by the clamp: stock (unclamped) is -50 BTDC at spark 0 and 60 degrees earlier per column: the pulse sits at the late limit (10.5 BTDC) for spark at 2 BTDC or later (all ATDC catalyst-heating spark; spark axis in ign_raw half degrees, its unit inferred), is 70 BTDC at 4 BTDC spark, 130 at 6, and the 180 BTDC limit from 8 BTDC spark on. A compression-stroke pulse that follows the retarded spark (inferred). Catalyst-heating mode = FFF8A85C 2 (0x109B4C, read): it maps to fuel mode 3 (0x108B08), in which the ignition target is FFF8A76C (0x0DA51C, read) and the injection angle is FFF8B062 (0x0CB394, read). FFF8B062 = this(rpm, spark target FFF8A76C), clamped to 1080-1439 (0x0D03C8, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Second Injection Share
table.description:
Share of fuel moved into the late second pulse during stratified catalyst heating (combustion mode 2). 0 = single injection. Stock 0, so stock mode 2 fires one late injection only; raising it adds a pulse at Catalyst Heating Injection Angle 2 (about 170 degrees after TDC).
Details: Share of the injection quantity given to the second pulse during stratified catalyst heating (combustion mode FFF8A85C 2 = fuel mode 3, 0x108B08, read). 0x10A6D8 copies this byte to FFF8A860 (read); 0x0D0A7C-0x0D0C14 copy A860 into the per-injector split FFF8A6D6...A6D9 when that injector's fuel mode FFF8A858...A85B is 3 and rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x1CBD8 (4000 rpm) (read); 0x0D1FB8 gives the second pulse A6D6/256 of the quantity, and 0x0CB604 places it at Catalyst Heating Injection Angle 2 (FFF8B064, about 170 degrees ATDC in stock) (read). Stock 0: mode 2 fires a single late injection and no second pulse. The double/triple injection windows (0x0CF3EC) are a separate mechanism and play no part. Confidence: read.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description:
Rpm x load correction to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal); positive = later. TGVs not closed. Stock all 0, no effect.
Details: When used: catalyst-heating phase 2 first pulse, while the TGVs are not forced closed (FFF8A881 bit 4 clear). 0x0D00A8 (called from 0x0C589C with (906B, cal 0x38448 bit 5, rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616, FFF88E28 bit 2, FFF88E2B bit 5, FFF88A9D, IAT FFF88662, coolant FFF88A44, spark target FFF8A76B, TGV closed FFF8A881 bit 4, &FFF8B05E), read): in fuel states 2/3 FFF8B05E = Base(rpm, coolant) + Base Adder(rpm, load) x multiplier(FFF88A9D, IAT)/255 + Base Spark Adder(spark, coolant), clamped to code 720-1079 (180.5-360 BTDC); with FFF88E28 bit 2 or FFF88E2B bit 5 set only the Base is used (read). This table is the rpm x load adder, scaled by 05B090 (FFF88A9D x IAT)/255. Units (FU_UNITS): added to the code angle, so a positive value moves the pulse LATER (fewer degrees BTDC), x/2 degrees (fu_units_inj_delta_later). FFF8B05E is the first-pulse angle of injectors in fuel mode 2 (0x0CB394, segment 2, offset B05E - 720, read). Stock all 0. Edit with Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description:
Correction to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Normal), the second pulse; positive = later. Stock all 0, no effect. Edit with that table.
Details: When used: catalyst-heating phase 2 second pulse, TGVs not forced closed; scaled by 05B158/255. 0x0D023C (called from 0x0C589C with (906B, spark target FFF8A76B, rpm/50 FFF8CD56, cal 0x38448 bit 4, FFF88E28 bit 2, FFF88E2B bit 5, FFF88A9D, IAT FFF88662, rpm FFF8CD54, TGV closed FFF8A881 bit 4, &FFF8B060, &FFF8B00A), read): unless rpm > cal 0x1CBD8 (20480 = 4000 rpm), FFF8B060 = Phase 2 Injection Angle(rpm/50, spark) + this adder(rpm/50, spark) x multiplier(FFF88A9D, IAT)/255 (adder skipped while FFF88E28 bit 2 or FFF88E2B bit 5), clamped to code 1080-1439 (180-0.5 BTDC) in fuel states 2/3 (read). FFF8B060 is the second-pulse angle in fuel mode 2 (0x0CB604, segment 3, read). Units (FU_UNITS): added to the code angle, so a positive value moves the pulse LATER (fewer degrees BTDC), x/2 degrees (fu_units_inj_delta_later). Stock all 0. Edit with Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Normal). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Spark Angle Before Running (Coolant)
table.description:
Spark value assumed before the engine reaches running mode, used only to choose the catalyst-heating phase 2 injection angles; it is not the actual cranking spark. Stock 10 degrees up to 0 degC, 5 above.
Details: When used: 0x0DD464 (read): while the engine state FFF8866C < 3 (before running mode), FFF8A76B = this(coolant FFF88A44); in running mode it is base timing FFF8A645 - Catalyst Heating Spark Retard (Phase 2). FFF8A76B is the spark-angle input of the Catalyst Heating Phase 2 injection-angle tables (05B130/05B144, 05B0E0/05B0F4) (read). It is not the cranking spark itself (0x0D9E40 uses FFF8A751 in state 2, read). Stock 10 degrees up to 0 C, 5 degrees above. Confidence: read.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Exit Threshold (Neutral Switch On)
table.description:
Coolant-based threshold of an internal counter at which catalyst-heating phase 2 ends and normal running starts, used while the neutral switch is on. Stock lower than the in-gear table at 90 degC and above, so phase 2 ends sooner in neutral.
Details: When used: while FFF88ADA bit 6 is set; with the manual-transmission coding that bit follows FFF8A29E bit 5 = pin PH5 (active low), the neutral switch: the P0851/P0852 (Park/Neutral Switch Input Circuit Low/High) monitor 0x06F436 tests this bit (read, p16). Phase FFF8A85C 3 ends (mode 4, normal) when FFF8A64B reaches this(coolant) (0x109B4C, read); the partner table is Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Exit Threshold (Neutral Switch Off). Differs from it in stock: drops to 64 at 90 C and above, so phase 2 ends sooner in neutral. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Exit Threshold (Neutral Switch Off)
table.description:
Coolant-based threshold of an internal counter at which catalyst-heating phase 2 ends and normal running starts, used in gear (neutral switch off). Stock 205-230.
Details: When used: while FFF88ADA bit 6 is clear (neutral switch FFF8A29E bit 5 / pin PH5 off, i.e. in gear; identity confirmed by the P0851/P0852 monitor 0x06F436, read, p16). Phase FFF8A85C 3 ends (mode 4, normal) when FFF8A64B reaches this(coolant) (0x109B4C, read). Partner of Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Exit Threshold (Neutral Switch On). Stays 205-230 in stock. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Maximum Time
table.description:
Longest time catalyst-heating phase 2 may last, by coolant. Stock 5 s when very cold, 2 s at 0-40 degC, down to 1 s from 80 degC.
Details: Phase FFF8A85C 3 also ends when its timer FFF853BA reaches this(coolant) (0x109B4C, read). The timer counts 10 ms passes of 0x109B4C (p16, read). Stock 5 s up to -10 degC, 2 s from 0 to 40 degC, 1.5 s from 50 to 70 degC, 1 s from 80 degC. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Delay
table.description:
Delay between the closed-pedal decel fuel cut condition being met and cylinders starting to be cut, by coolant and rpm. Stock 0 when cold or below 1500 rpm, 0.05 s otherwise.
Details: When used: on the rising edge of the decel fuel cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0, 0x0BD684 (limit state, 10 ms module 0x0BE694; stack args checked at 0x0BF9F6..0x0BFA52: s20 = coolant FFF8CD65, s24 = rpm/50 FFF8CD56) looks this table up once and latches it; limit state FFF8A638 becomes 8 when bit 0 has stayed set for this many 10 ms passes (0 = at once; FFF8A620 bit 0 forces 0). Until then the torque cap is the plain torque estimate (state 1), so no cylinder is cut; from state 8 the staging of the Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time tables applies (0x0B9EF0, 0x0B9DC8, 0x0C1AC8, read). When bit 0 drops after state 8 the state goes to 9, which sets FFF8A774 bit 3 if cylinders were cut and starts Decel Fuel Cut Resume Timing Retard (0x0E1628, round 3). Rows = coolant (x - 50 C), columns = rpm (x 50) (lookup 0x1B0918: first argument = first axis = row, read). Stock: 0 below 20 C or below 1500 rpm, 5 passes (0.05 s) from 20 C and 1500 rpm. Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (Coolant)
table.description:
Added to the idle target to set the rpm at which the decel fuel cut ends (and, 200 rpm higher, where it starts), by coolant. Raising it probably ends the cut at a higher rpm. Stock 1150 rpm cold to 300 rpm from 30 degC (cut ends near 1000 rpm warm).
Details: When used: always while running; looked up by coolant FFF88A44 (R5 = R6 at 0x0BA0AA, read). Resume threshold FFF8A62E (0x0BA044, 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; stack args checked at 0x0BEE90..0x0BEF52, read) = max(FFF8A62A, idle target FFF8B236/128 + sum of adders), clamped to 255, in 25 rpm units. Adders: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (Coolant), 059638(coolant) below cal 0x1DB52 (15 km/h), max(A/C adder FFF8A628, cal-0x1DB56 term), and cal terms 0x1DB68 / 0x1DB69 / 0x1DB72 / 0x1DB73 / 0x1DB74 under further conditions (stock 0 / 1000 / 0 / 600 / 0 rpm; 0x1DB69 depends on the rpm rate FFF8CEA6 and on the MT coding, 0x1DB73 on FFF8A7E2 bit 2; not decoded further). FFF8A62E is the rpm (FFF8CE9C/128) below which the decel fuel cut ends with the pedal still released; the cut starts above FFF8A62E x 25 + 200 rpm (cal 0x1DE1C; +1300 rpm for 3 s and then +800 rpm once the rpm has already fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, cals 0x1DE20 / 0x1DE24 / 0x1DE1E, 0x0BD4E0) (0x0C06F0, 0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC, read). Raising it ends the cut at a higher rpm (inferred effect). It also starts Decel Fuel Cut Resume Timing Retard (0x0DAFD4) and selects Decel Fuel Cut Recovery Timing Ramp (0x0DB21C). Stock 1150 rpm up to -10 C, 1050 at 0 C, 1000 at 10 C, 400 at 20 C, 300 rpm from 30 C (with a 700 rpm warm idle target and none of the conditional cal terms, the cut ends near 1000 rpm and starts near 1200 rpm above 15 km/h; below 15 km/h the Low Speed adder (900 rpm stock) raises both by 900 rpm). Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (Low Speed)
table.description:
Extra resume-rpm adder for the decel fuel cut below 15 km/h, by coolant. Raising it probably ends the cut at a higher rpm. Stock 900 rpm flat.
Details: When used: vehicle speed FFF88BE8 below cal 0x1DB52 (267 = 15 km/h); looked up by coolant FFF88A44 (0x0BA0C6..0x0BA0D2, read); 0 otherwise. Resume threshold FFF8A62E (0x0BA044, 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; stack args checked at 0x0BEE90..0x0BEF52, read) = max(FFF8A62A, idle target FFF8B236/128 + sum of adders), clamped to 255, in 25 rpm units. Adders: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (Coolant), 059638(coolant) below cal 0x1DB52 (15 km/h), max(A/C adder FFF8A628, cal-0x1DB56 term), and cal terms 0x1DB68 / 0x1DB69 / 0x1DB72 / 0x1DB73 / 0x1DB74 under further conditions (stock 0 / 1000 / 0 / 600 / 0 rpm; 0x1DB69 depends on the rpm rate FFF8CEA6 and on the MT coding, 0x1DB73 on FFF8A7E2 bit 2; not decoded further). FFF8A62E is the rpm (FFF8CE9C/128) below which the decel fuel cut ends with the pedal still released; the cut starts above FFF8A62E x 25 + 200 rpm (cal 0x1DE1C; +1300 rpm for 3 s and then +800 rpm once the rpm has already fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, cals 0x1DE20 / 0x1DE24 / 0x1DE1E, 0x0BD4E0) (0x0C06F0, 0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC, read). Raising it ends the cut at a higher rpm (inferred effect). It also starts Decel Fuel Cut Resume Timing Retard (0x0DAFD4) and selects Decel Fuel Cut Recovery Timing Ramp (0x0DB21C). Stock 900 rpm flat. Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Gear 1, A/C Off)
table.description:
Decel fuel cut staging for gear 1 (and 0) with the A/C off (inferred): for each rpm band, the times after the cut starts at which 1, 2, 3 and all 4 cylinders are cut. Lower = faster, harsher cut. Values should rise along each row. Manual coding.
Details: When used: gear FFF88FCE = 1 (also gear 0) (MT coding) and FFF8A9A2 bit 7 clear (A/C not engaged, inferred; see the A/C On tables). Decel fuel cut cylinder staging, 0x0B93FC (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; all 27 arguments checked against the push order at 0x0BF7D4..0x0BF890, read). Row = rpm band of FFF8CE9C (cals 0x20C02..0x20C0A: 1 below 1800, 2 below 2800, 3 below 3800, 4 below 4800, 5 below 5800, 6 from 5800 rpm); column n = the time, in 10 ms passes after the decel fuel cut condition starts, from which n cylinders are cut. How it works (read): gear FFF88FCE, rpm band and the A/C flag are latched on the pass where FFF8A63D bit 2 clears, i.e. when the closed-pedal condition of 0x0C06F0 becomes true (pedal released FFF88C64 bit 5, rpm/25 >= resume threshold FFF8A62E, FFF88A76 >= cal 0x23702 = 6 s after start, no inhibit flag). The cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0 = bit 1 and not bit 2 (0x0C0FCC); bit 1 sets at rpm >= FFF8AED4 = FFF8A62E x 128 + FFF8AECE and holds down to FFF8A62E (0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC); FFF8AECE (0x0BD4E0, read) is cal 0x1DE1C (+200 rpm) until the rpm has fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, then cal 0x1DE20 (+1300 rpm) for cal 0x1DE24 (300 passes = 3 s) and cal 0x1DE1E (+800 rpm) after that until the pedal is pressed (plus cal 0x1DE22 = 0 with A/C), so FFF8A62E (25 rpm units) is the resume rpm. From the rising edge of bit 0 the pass counter FFF8AE16 runs and the stage FFF8A625 = number of boundaries reached (0..4). 0x0BD684 sets limit state FFF8A638 = 8 (engine running; state 9 has priority) once bit 0 has been set for Decel Fuel Cut Delay (059D44) passes; in state 8, 0x0B9EF0 makes the torque cap FFF8AE58 = f x gross torque estimate FFF8AF40 - losses FFF8AF62 with f = (cal 0x23D53/54/55/56 - 1)/256 = 191/127/63/9 for stages 1-4 (stage 0: no reduction), and 0x0B9DC8 selects it as the final cap FFF8AE54. 0x0C1AC8 turns the resulting torque ratio FFF8A64F (0x0C4BA0) into the number of cylinders cut FFF8A643 using the same cals as thresholds (>= 192: none, >= 128: 1, >= 64: 2, >= 10: 3, else 4), so stage n asks for n cylinders cut (read; FFF8A643 is the cylinder-cut count of round 3, also read by the fuel factor 0x0C558C and flag bits FFF8A64C 0-2; its path to the injectors was not traced here). Values should rise along each row. Gear 0 uses the gear 1 table and gears above 6 the gear 6 table. With FFF88ADA bit 6 set (neutral switch on the MT coding) all four boundaries come from Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Neutral) instead. Cruise: while cruise control is active (FFF88E12 bit 1) and speed minus target FFF8B9C4 < cal 0x20EC2 (2.5 km/h), with FFF88E11 bit 6 and FFF8A8A4 bit 4 clear, the stage is held at 0 for up to cal 0x20EC0 (1800 passes = 18 s); when the hold ends because the cruise condition drops, the held time (capped at the first boundary) counts toward the first boundary; when it ends by reaching cal 0x20EC0 the held time is discarded and staging starts from 0 (0x0B9A8A-0x0B9AA8 and 0x0B9B1E, read). 'Decel fuel cut' is the reading of a closed-pedal, rpm-hysteresis condition whose output is a cylinder cut count (inferred name, mechanism read). Stock: band 1: 0.20/1.20/1.50/1.90 s; band 2: 0.80/1.20/1.45/1.65 s; band 3: 0.80/1.20/1.40/1.60 s; band 4: 0.80/1.20/1.45/1.70 s; band 5: 0.60/0.90/1.20/1.50 s; band 6: 0.60/0.90/1.20/1.50 s. Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Gear 1, A/C On)
table.description:
Decel fuel cut staging for gear 1 (and 0) with the A/C engaged (inferred): for each rpm band, the times after the cut starts at which 1, 2, 3 and all 4 cylinders are cut. Lower = faster, harsher cut. Values should rise along each row. Manual coding.
Details: When used: gear FFF88FCE = 1 (also gear 0) (MT coding) and FFF8A9A2 bit 7 set: the A/C engaged flag FFF8A9A2 bit 6 confirmed for cal 0x396F0 (2) passes above cal 0x396EE rpm (0 rpm), 0x122AC4 (read; A/C identity of bit 6 inferred, as in the existing A/C entries). Decel fuel cut cylinder staging, 0x0B93FC (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; all 27 arguments checked against the push order at 0x0BF7D4..0x0BF890, read). Row = rpm band of FFF8CE9C (cals 0x20C02..0x20C0A: 1 below 1800, 2 below 2800, 3 below 3800, 4 below 4800, 5 below 5800, 6 from 5800 rpm); column n = the time, in 10 ms passes after the decel fuel cut condition starts, from which n cylinders are cut. How it works (read): gear FFF88FCE, rpm band and the A/C flag are latched on the pass where FFF8A63D bit 2 clears, i.e. when the closed-pedal condition of 0x0C06F0 becomes true (pedal released FFF88C64 bit 5, rpm/25 >= resume threshold FFF8A62E, FFF88A76 >= cal 0x23702 = 6 s after start, no inhibit flag). The cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0 = bit 1 and not bit 2 (0x0C0FCC); bit 1 sets at rpm >= FFF8AED4 = FFF8A62E x 128 + FFF8AECE and holds down to FFF8A62E (0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC); FFF8AECE (0x0BD4E0, read) is cal 0x1DE1C (+200 rpm) until the rpm has fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, then cal 0x1DE20 (+1300 rpm) for cal 0x1DE24 (300 passes = 3 s) and cal 0x1DE1E (+800 rpm) after that until the pedal is pressed (plus cal 0x1DE22 = 0 with A/C), so FFF8A62E (25 rpm units) is the resume rpm. table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (A/C, Alternate) (Off in Stock)
table.description:

Details: When used: never in stock. 0x0BA044 uses this(FFF8A8C6) as the A/C adder FFF8A628 only while FFF8A9A2 bit 6 (A/C engaged) and cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 are set (stack args s8/s12 and the branch at 0x0BA110..0x0BA136, read); cal 0x1D0AE = 0x00 in stock, so the A/C adder is cal 0x1DB67 (0) instead. FFF8A62E is the rpm (FFF8CE9C/128) below which the decel fuel cut ends with the pedal still released; the cut starts above FFF8A62E x 25 + 200 rpm (cal 0x1DE1C; +1300 rpm for 3 s and then +800 rpm once the rpm has already fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, cals 0x1DE20 / 0x1DE24 / 0x1DE1E, 0x0BD4E0) (0x0C06F0, 0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC, read). Raising it ends the cut at a higher rpm (inferred effect). It also starts Decel Fuel Cut Resume Timing Retard (0x0DAFD4) and selects Decel Fuel Cut Recovery Timing Ramp (0x0DB21C). Stock 0 / 50 / 100 / 150 / 200 / 400 rpm at FFF8A8C6 = 0 / 8 / 13 / 26 / 38 / >= 51. Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Alternate Set, A/C Off) (Off in Stock)
table.description:
Alternate decel fuel cut staging (A/C off). Its enable threshold can never be reached in stock, so it has no effect.
Details: When used: never in stock. Replaces the gear tables when FFF8AE0A (10 ms passes since FFF8A88F was last non-zero, 0x0B93C8) is above cal 0x20C0C; the cal is 65535 and the compare is unsigned greater-than on a u16, so it can never be true (0x0B93FC, read); FFF8A9A2 bit 7 clear (A/C not engaged, inferred; see the A/C On tables). Decel fuel cut cylinder staging, 0x0B93FC (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; all 27 arguments checked against the push order at 0x0BF7D4..0x0BF890, read). Row = rpm band of FFF8CE9C (cals 0x20C02..0x20C0A: 1 below 1800, 2 below 2800, 3 below 3800, 4 below 4800, 5 below 5800, 6 from 5800 rpm); column n = the time, in 10 ms passes after the decel fuel cut condition starts, from which n cylinders are cut. How it works (read): gear FFF88FCE, rpm band and the A/C flag are latched on the pass where FFF8A63D bit 2 clears, i.e. when the closed-pedal condition of 0x0C06F0 becomes true (pedal released FFF88C64 bit 5, rpm/25 >= resume threshold FFF8A62E, FFF88A76 >= cal 0x23702 = 6 s after start, no inhibit flag). The cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0 = bit 1 and not bit 2 (0x0C0FCC); bit 1 sets at rpm >= FFF8AED4 = FFF8A62E x 128 + FFF8AECE and holds down to FFF8A62E (0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC); FFF8AECE (0x0BD4E0, read) is cal 0x1DE1C (+200 rpm) until the rpm has fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, then cal 0x1DE20 (+1300 rpm) for cal 0x1DE24 (300 passes = 3 s) and cal 0x1DE1E (+800 rpm) after that until the pedal is pressed (plus cal 0x1DE22 = 0 with A/C), so FFF8A62E (25 rpm units) is the resume rpm. From the rising edge of bit 0 the pass counter FFF8AE16 runs and the stage FFF8A625 = number of boundaries reached (0..4). 0x0BD684 sets limit state FFF8A638 = 8 (engine running; state 9 has priority) once bit 0 has been set for Decel Fuel Cut Delay (059D44) passes; in state 8, 0x0B9EF0 makes the torque cap FFF8AE58 = f x gross torque estimate FFF8AF40 - losses FFF8AF62 with f = (cal 0x23D53/54/55/56 - 1)/256 = 191/127/63/9 for stages 1-4 (stage 0: no reduction), and 0x0B9DC8 selects it as the final cap FFF8AE54. 0x0C1AC8 turns the resulting torque ratio FFF8A64F (0x0C4BA0) into the number of cylinders cut FFF8A643 using the same cals as thresholds (>= 192: none, >= 128: 1, >= 64: 2, >= 10: 3, else 4), so stage n asks for n cylinders cut (read; FFF8A643 is the cylinder-cut count of round 3, also read by the fuel factor 0x0C558C and flag bits FFF8A64C 0-2; its path to the injectors was not traced here). Values should rise along each row. Gear 0 uses the gear 1 table and gears above 6 the gear 6 table. With FFF88ADA bit 6 set (neutral switch on the MT coding) all four boundaries come from Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Neutral) instead. Cruise: while cruise control is active (FFF88E12 bit 1) and speed minus target FFF8B9C4 < cal 0x20EC2 (2.5 km/h), with FFF88E11 bit 6 and FFF8A8A4 bit 4 clear, the stage is held at 0 for up to cal 0x20EC0 (1800 passes = 18 s); when the hold ends because the cruise condition drops, the held time (capped at the first boundary) counts toward the first boundary; when it ends by reaching cal 0x20EC0 the held time is discarded and staging starts from 0 (0x0B9A8A-0x0B9AA8 and 0x0B9B1E, read). 'Decel fuel cut' is the reading of a closed-pedal, rpm-hysteresis condition whose output is a cylinder cut count (inferred name, mechanism read). Stock: band 1: 0.50/1.00/1.50/1.50 s; band 2: 0.50/1.00/1.50/1.50 s; band 3: 0.10/0.20/0.50/0.50 s; band 4: 0.10/0.30/0.50/0.50 s; band 5: 0.35/0.55/0.75/0.75 s; band 6: 0.10/0.30/0.50/0.50 s. Confidence: read.

table.name: Purge Rate Limit (Off-Idle)
table.description:
Maximum canister purge rate by learned vapour concentration, scaled by Purge Rate Limit Coolant Multiplier; less purge when the vapour is rich. Used with the pedal pressed. Stock 42.6 % at lean vapour down to 2.3 % at rich.
Details: When used: accelerator not released (FFF886AB bit 5 clear) and FFF886FA bit 4 clear (0x0D4B40, read). Limit A6FD = this(learned concentration FFF8B0BE) x Purge Rate Limit Coolant Multiplier / 255; the purge-rate ramp A709 is capped at A6FD (0x0D6060) and the purge rate A70C = min(A709 x (1 - cut), capacity A70F) (0x0D615C, read). FFF886FA bit 4 forces cal 0x24869 (38 = 14.8 %) instead. Stock 42.6 % at low concentration down to 2.3 % at the highest (0.13 .. 1.72 on the axis): less purge flow when the vapour is rich. Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: read.

table.description:

table.description:

table.name: Purge Rate (Open-Loop Enrichment)
table.description:
Purge rate by load while open-loop enrichment is active. Stock all 0: purge closes during enrichment.
Details: When used: while the open-loop enrichment flag FFF8A703 bit 7 is set (0x0D833C: FFF8A684 non-zero, latched) and the purge circuit is fault-free (FFF89CB1 bits 0/1 clear) (0x0D615C, read): purge rate A70C = min(this(load FFF8A616), capacity A70F). table.name: Purge Air Density (IAT, Baro)
table.description:
Air density by intake temperature and barometric pressure, used to compute purge flow capacity. Exact physics: normally no reason to edit.
Details: When used: every 80 ms pass of the purge module (0x0D44DC, read): FFF8A6F9 = this(IAT FFF88662, baro FFF88668). Used as the density factor in the purge capacity A70F = A6F9 x 05B334(vacuum) x 2 / air quantity (0x0D61EC, read) and, only with cal 0x24AAD bit 7 (clear in stock), in the flow conversions 0x0D7458 / 0x07E898. Stock values equal ideal-gas air density x 128: 1.30 g/L at 0 C / 101 kPa down to 0.65 g/L at 70 C / 64 kPa (computed). Physical air density; normally no reason to edit. Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Purge Valve Maximum Flow
table.description:
Maximum purge flow (air volume, L/s) the valve can pass at a given manifold vacuum; sets the purge capacity. Stock about 6 L/s at 53 kPa vacuum. Change only for a different purge valve, together with Purge Valve Duty.
Details: When used: every 80 ms pass (0x0D61EC, read): FFF8B0B8 = this(manifold vacuum FFF8CDFA); with none of the nine fault/status flags set (89AFE b2, 89B0B b7/b2/b1, AD75 b0, 89AFD b5/b6, AD6A b2, AD5A b7) the purge capacity is A70F = Purge Air Density x this x 2 / air quantity FFF8B4D6, capped at 255, else Purge Rate Limit (Fallback). Because the capacity multiplies it by air density (g/L), this is a volume flow: L/s = x/300 (mass = density x volume). Stock 0 at 2.7 kPa vacuum, 1.94 L/s at 6.7 kPa, 6.15 L/s (369 L/min) at 53 kPa; these are large for a canister purge valve, but they are consistent with Purge Valve Duty (full duty at 53 kPa about 6.7 g/s), so the model is self-consistent (computed). Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: read.

table.name: Purge Valve Minimum Duty
table.description:
Duty at which the purge valve starts to flow, by battery voltage and vacuum; the commanded duty is built on top of it. Stock 8.2 % at low vacuum to 5.9 % at high vacuum.
Details: When used: with cal 0x24AAC bit 7 set (0xC0 in stock) and none of the flags 89AFE b2, 89B0B b7/b2/b1, AD75 b0, AD5A b7 set (0x0D6324, read); otherwise cal 0x37C4E (13 = 5.1 %). A713 = this(battery FFF9DD61, vacuum FFF8CDFA); the valve duty is A713 + (100 % - A713) x Purge Valve Duty (0x0D6118, read), so this is the duty at which the valve starts to flow. Stock 8.2 % at low vacuum to 5.9 % at 67 kPa, the same at all battery voltages. Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: read.

table.name: Purge Learning Weight (Purge Rate)
table.description:
Weight by purge rate on how much each sample moves the learned vapour concentration (255 = x1.0). Stock 0 with no purge, about 1.0 from 4.7 %.
Details: When used: every 80 ms pass (0x0D63D8, read): the concentration sample FFF8B0B0 = 32768 + 256 x (256 - B09C) x w / purge rate A70C, where B09C is the averaged closed-loop correction (256 = none) and w is the product of this(purge rate A70C), Purge Learning Weight (Purge Flow) and Purge Learning Weight (Trim Deviation), each x/256 and skipped when 255. 0x0D715C then moves the learned concentration FFF81412 by half the sample offset in state 4. Stock 0 at 0 %, 0.45 at 1.2-1.6 %, 0.95-1.0 from 4.7 %, 0.75 at 15.6 %. Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: read.

table.name: Purge Learning Weight (Purge Flow)
table.description:
Weight by purge flow on how much each sample moves the learned vapour concentration (255 = x1.0). Stock 0 at no flow rising to 1.0.
Details: When used: every 80 ms pass (0x0D63D8, read): weight by target purge flow FFF8B0C0 on the concentration sample (see Purge Learning Weight (Purge Rate)); 255 = x1.0 (skipped). Stock 0 at no flow, 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 at 0.21 / 0.54 / 1.07, 1.0 from 1.6 (airq_raw g/s). Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: read.

table.name: Purge Learning Weight (Trim Deviation)
table.description:
Weight by the size of the closed-loop correction on the vapour concentration learning (255 = x1.0); a dead band so small trim noise does not move it. Stock 0 at 0 %, 1.0 from 4.7 %.
Details: When used: every 80 ms pass (0x0D63D8, read; input checked in the disassembly at 0x0D646C: |256 - FFF8B09C| clamped to 255): weight by the size of the averaged closed-loop correction on the concentration sample; 255 = x1.0. Stock 0 at 0 %, 0.5 at 2.3 %, 1.0 from 4.7 %: a dead band so small trim noise does not move the learned concentration. Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: read.

table.name: Purge Injector Minimum Pulse Margin
table.description:
Margin above Injector Minimum Pulse Width, by rail pressure: when an injector pulse comes this close to the minimum (or the fuel trim nears its lower limit) with rich purge vapour, the ECU cuts purge so fuel can still be metered. Stock 200 us at low pressure down to 24 us at 20 MPa.
Details: When used: every 80 ms pass (0x0D7504, read; rail pressure FFF88886 as stack argument checked in the disassembly). Flag FFF8A701 bit 6 is set when (any cylinder pulse FFF8CF3C[n] <= Injector Minimum Pulse Width/4 + this x 2.5, or the closed-loop correction FFF8B2F2 <= its lower limit FFF8B2FE + 5 %) while coolant FFF8CD65 >= cal 0x249B6 (35 C), purge duty A70A > 0 and learned concentration B0BE >= cal 0x26E34 (35328, the learning maximum). That flag raises the purge cut B0A0 by cal 0x37C32 (11.7 %) per pass off-idle (0x0D5D4C, read). Stock 200 us at 0.3 MPa down to 24 us at 20 MPa (8 us per count, inferred from the compare). Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Off, TGV Open)
table.description:
Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map for pedal pressed, EGR off and TGVs open, which covers wide-open throttle and high rpm. The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus knock correction advance and fine learning; at high load in stock that sum is far lower, so these cells rarely set the fired timing there. Stock at 1.29-3.10 g/rev (100-240 % load): 23-26.5 degrees at 6000 rpm, 30.5-31.5 at 6400, 34.5-35.5 at 6800 and 40-42.5 from 7200 rpm (34.5-45.5 across all loads from 6800 rpm, above the 6,700 rpm rev limit).
Details: When used: Used while the accelerator is pressed, EGR is off (FFF8A813 bit 7 clear) and the TGVs are not forced closed: the map for wide-open throttle and high rpm (EGR is not enabled there). Stock at 1.29-3.10 g/rev (100-240 % load) (read from 059FF8, x/2): 23-26.5 degrees at 6000 rpm, 30.5-31.5 at 6400, 34.5-35.5 at 6800 and 40-42.5 from 7200 rpm; across all loads 23-36.5 at 6000, 30.5-40 at 6400 and 34.5-45.5 from 6800 rpm (the 6800+ rows lie above the 6,700 rpm rev limit). Base ignition timing. 0x0C2C08 uses this 22x16 table when cal 0x1071E bit 0 or FFF8A774 bit 0 is clear, and F1 and F2 clear (F1 = FFF8A813 bit 7 = EGR active, F2 = FFF8A881 bit 4 = TGVs closed). The result is rate-limited (cals 0x1058C / 0x1058E) and the IAT and coolant compensations FFF8A782 + FFF8A787 are added (0x0C2C08) to give base timing FFF8A645, which is the upper limit of the fired base timing, not a value fired as is: 0x0DD568 sets FFF8A76A = FFF8A645 - Torque Reduction Spark Retard(max(FFF8A64B, 102) x 128) - tip-in retard, and FFF8A64B carries the request efficiency FFF8AF22 (0x0C13B4 / 0x0C39DC), so in effect FFF8A76A = min(FFF8A645, Primary Ignition request + KCA + FLKC) less any torque-reduction retard (Torque Reduction Spark Retard is the inverse of Ignition Efficiency vs Retard; min() form computed). FFF8A76A then goes through the rate limiter 0x0DD760, the base sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600) and the fired sum 0x0D9E40 (FBKC and the retard terms) to FFF8A744 (read). The knock correction advance and FLKC are not added on top of this map: where Primary + KCA + FLKC is lower (most of the high-load map in stock), raising this map changes nothing at the coil; where this map is lower it is the fired base and KCA / FLKC have no effect. In limit states FFF8A639 = 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B the spark target FFF8A72A replaces FFF8A645 (read). The F2 selector is FFF8A881 bit 4, set by the TGV module 0x10CAE0 (0x10DEFC) - set = TGVs closed (see below). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, so FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction; 0x10C948 drives it toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so that bit set = TGVs closed. Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map used while the pedal is pressed, EGR is off (or only a few percent) and the TGVs are closed (typically cold or light-load running). The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus knock correction advance and fine learning, so raising cells adds timing only where this map is the lower one.

table.name: Minimum Ignition Timing (Coolant)
table.description:
Lowest timing the ECU will fire, by coolant temperature, used with the pedal pressed and the throttle between about 3 % and 46 % open; otherwise Minimum Ignition Timing applies. Lowering it allows more retard. Stock -25 degrees everywhere, the same as Minimum Ignition Timing.
Details: 0x0D9E40 (read): floor for final timing FFF8A744, looked up from coolant FFF88A44 while the accelerator is pressed (FFF886AB bit 5 clear) and the throttle opening FFF8CD74 (706 = 100 %, Phase 17) lies within cal 0x2FC6C (20, about 2.8 %) ... cal 0x2FC6A (328, about 46 %) (0x0D9EC0-0x0D9ED4); otherwise the floor is Minimum Ignition Timing. Stock -25 degrees everywhere. Confidence: read.

table.name: Ignition Dwell Time
table.description:
Coil charge (dwell) time in milliseconds by rpm and battery voltage, used whenever the engine runs. More dwell gives a stronger spark but heats the coils. Stock about 3.1 ms at 14 V and 3000 rpm; at 5 V about 7 ms at 500-1000 rpm and up to 8.9 ms at 1500 rpm.
Details: When used: always while running. 0x0DC960 (read): FFF8A762 = this(rpm FFF8CD54, battery FFF9DD61); FFF8A762 is passed to the ignition output layer (0x1DB782 -> FFF8D0C6, used by the timer D compare scheduling in 0x1DBD94) and converted by 0x0DC88C into the dwell angle FFF8A761 = x x rpm >> 12 (+ cal 0x37E46 briefly after a fuel-mode change, clamped cal 0x2FC7F..0x2FC7E; fixed cal 0x2FC80 in engine state 2) (read). Falls with battery voltage, as a coil dwell does (inferred). Stock about 3.1 ms at 14 V and 3000 rpm, 7 ms at 5 V. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier
table.description:
Scales Base Timing IAT Compensation by rpm and load: 0 = no intake-temperature timing correction, 1.0 = the full amount. Stock 0 below 0.65 g/rev (50 % load) and 0.125-0.875 above, so hot-air retard only bites at higher load.
Details: When used: multiplies Base Timing IAT Compensation, /128 (0x0E0184, read). FFF8A782 = rate-limited (cals 0x32DE2/0x32DE4 = 65535, i.e. none) value, enabled once FFF8CD5C >= cal 0x37F9E (800 rpm) in running mode FFF8866C = 3 (0x0E0184, read; cal 0x239AE bit 3 clear, so the knock-limit min() is not applied). FFF8A782 is added to the torque-model base timing FFF8A645 (0x0C2C08, A-D path with FFF8A787; E/F path with FFF8A788; my research notes, Ghidra stack args) and to the timing request FFF8A78A/FFF8B10E -> FFF8A789 (0x0E0A30, register args, read), which becomes the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088). table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation (TGV Open)
table.description:

table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation Weight (TGV Open)
table.description:

Details: When used: percentage applied to Base Timing Coolant Compensation (TGV Open). 0x0E0584 (read): in running mode FFF8866C = 3 and once FFF8CD5C >= cal 0x37F9E (800 rpm, latched) and load >= cal 0x38120, FFF8A787 = FFF8A765 (EGR term, 128 = none) + the compensation - 128. table.name: Timing Request Enrichment Retard
table.description:
Retard ramped into the timing request while open-loop power enrichment is active, by load and rpm. The ECU fires the lower of Base Timing and request + knock advance, and at high load in stock the request is the lower side, so this retard does reach the spark. Stock 0 up to 3200 rpm, down to -4 degrees from 5600 rpm at 1.94 g/rev (150 % load).
Details: When used: 0x0E0910 (read; my research notes section 5): while FFF8A655 bit 0 is set, or the open-loop enrichment FFF8A684 is between 1 and FFF8A681, and FFF8A8A3 bit 6 / FFF8A8A4 bit 7 are clear, FFF84848 ramps toward (this - 128) x 64 at cal 0x3107C (4) per pass and back to 0 at cal 0x3107E otherwise; FFF8A77A = FFF84848/64 + 128 is added to the timing request: FFF8A789 = FFF8B10E + FFF8A77A + cal 0x23CE6 - 256 (read). FFF8A789 becomes the normal-mode spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088) and is the request side of the P050B monitor; it is not a term of the final timing sum 0x0D9E40, but it lowers the request side of the fired-timing limit (0x0C13B4 -> FFF8AF22 -> 0x0C39DC / 0x0DD568: fired base = min(Base Timing + comps, request + KCA + FLKC); read, min() form computed), so it retards the spark at the coil wherever the request is the lower side, which in stock includes the high-load area where it acts (5600 rpm / 150 %: request about 6 degrees + KCA vs Base Timing about 22 degrees; computed). Axes load FFF8A616 (50/100/150 %) x rpm FFF8CD54. Stock 0 up to 3200 rpm, down to -4 degrees from 5600 rpm at 1.94 g/rev (150 % load). Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation (Alternate, Below 5000 RPM, Off in Stock)
table.description:

Details: When used: only with cal 0x31E38 bit 0 clear (set in stock, so unused), below 5000 rpm (FFF8CD5C < cal 0x38122 = 200, hysteresis to 192). 0x0E0584 (read): in running mode FFF8866C = 3 and once FFF8CD5C >= cal 0x37F9E (800 rpm, latched) and load >= cal 0x38120, FFF8A787 = FFF8A765 (EGR term, 128 = none) + the compensation - 128. Stock same curve as the 0.1-degree tables (15 degrees cold, 0 at 70 C). Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation (Alternate, Above 5000 RPM, Off in Stock)
table.description:

Details: When used: only with cal 0x31E38 bit 0 clear (set in stock, so unused) and FFF8CD5C >= cal 0x38122 (5000 rpm; hysteresis to 192 = 4800 rpm) in mode 2/3. 0x0E0584 (read): in running mode FFF8866C = 3 and once FFF8CD5C >= cal 0x37F9E (800 rpm, latched) and load >= cal 0x38120, FFF8A787 = FFF8A765 (EGR term, 128 = none) + the compensation - 128. table.name: Filtered RPM Rate Timing Term (Off in Stock)
table.description:
Timing added or removed according to how fast engine speed is changing, which looks like an rpm-oscillation (surge) damper. It has no effect on a stock car because its output limits are both set to zero. Stock about -2.9 to +2.9 degrees across the rpm-change axis.
Details: When used: never effective in stock. 0x0DB888 (called from 0x0DF0B8 with FFF8AA85 bit 1 and FFF8A8A1 bit 7, read): while FFF8AA85 bit 1 is set (set by 0x07FA1A when the surge damping trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 and FFF8A8A2 bit 6 are clear, the request is not being shaped (FFF8AEC2 <= FFF8AEBE), FFF8CEC1 bits 0-4 (rpm and load window flags) are set, speed >= cal 0x57576, gear FFF8A621 within cals 0x57577..0x57578, and FFF886AB bit 7 or FFF8A88F), FFF8A757 = clamp((this(FFF88CA4) + cal 0x2FEDE (s8 -3) x (rpm k passes ago - filtered rpm k passes ago) >> 7) x 100 >> 8, cal 0x2FEDD .. cal 0x2FEDC); k = 05B784/05B790(gear FFF8A621) + 1 (both all 0, so k = 1); rpm history FFF88CAC.. and the filtered-rpm history FFF88CC8.. (FFF8CE9A, a second lag of FFF8CEB2) (read). A757 is added to the base timing sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600, read). Off in Stock: cals 0x2FEDC (upper clamp) and 0x2FEDD (lower clamp) are both 0, and the signed compares at 0x0DBA44/0x0DBA64 then force A757 = 0 (read). Axis: FFF88CA4 = change of the lag-filtered rpm FFF8CEB2 between passes of 0x07E96C (read). Stock -15 / -10 / 0 / +10 / +15 counts (about -2.9 to +2.9 degrees) at -40 / -25 / 0 / +25 / +40 rpm per pass; together with the rpm-minus-filtered-rpm term this has the form of an rpm-oscillation damper (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Correction Advance Max A (TGV Open)
table.description:
First part of the knock correction advance (timing added as DAM rises), by rpm and load, for TGVs open; blended with the TGV Closed table and scaled by KCA DAM Curve A. It is added to the Primary Ignition request, not to the Base Timing map: the ECU fires the lower of Base Timing and Primary + knock advance + fine learning, so raising it adds timing only where that sum is still below Base Timing (at high load in stock it is). Stock up to about 7.7 degrees.
Details: Knock correction advance (0x0E71FC and 0x0E1FD8, read). Two components, A and B, are each looked up by rpm (FFF8CD54) x load (FFF8ADE4) and blended by the TGV open fraction v = FFF8B3E8: A = 05C078 x (1 - v) + 05C08C x v (FFF8A7A4), B = 05C0A0 x (1 - v) + 05C0B4 x v (FFF8A7A6), and the maximum FFF8A7A5 = A + B (capped at 255). With cal 0x35509 bit 0 set (it is, in both images) the applied advance FFF8A791 = (A x KCA DAM Curve A(DAM) + B x KCA DAM Curve B(DAM)) / 128; otherwise it is A7A5 x DAM / 16. One count = 0.3516 degrees (x 180 >> 8 in 0x0C13B4 / 0x0DB3D4, x 90 / 128 in 0x0D9088, read). Where it goes (read, knock routing review 2026-10-31): FFF8A791 is not a term of the fired-timing sum 0x0D9E40 (FBKC FFF8A79A is the only knock term there). It reaches the coil through the timing request: 0x0C13B4 (combustion modes FFF8A85C = 3/4, i.e. normal running) forms the request retard r = max(0, FFF8A645 - (FFF8A789 - 32 + (FFF8A791 + FLKC FFF8A7A7) x 180 / 256)) and FFF8AF22 = Ignition Efficiency vs Retard(r); 0x0C39DC folds AF22 (times the torque-cap ratio) into FFF8A64B, and 0x0DD568 sets the spark angle FFF8A76A = FFF8A645 - Torque Reduction Spark Retard(max(A64B, 102) x 128) - tip-in retard (AF22 >> 7 directly with the pedal released or a cylinder cut active). Torque Reduction Spark Retard is the exact inverse of Ignition Efficiency vs Retard, so in effect FFF8A76A = min(base timing FFF8A645, timing request + KCA + FLKC) less any torque-reduction retard; it then rate-limits (0x0DD760) into the base sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600) and the fired timing FFF8A744 (min() form computed from the inverse tables). In limit states FFF8A639 = 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088: request + 0.3516 deg x (A791 + A7A7) with the pedal pressed) replaces FFF8A645 outright. The total FFF8A77B (0x0DFA88) has one reader, 0x0DDBBC, whose output FFF8A770 is 0 in stock (05BB24 / 05BB38 all zero), and the headroom term of 0x0DB3D4 (A7A5 - A791 into FFF8A754) is capped at cal 0x2FEC2 = 0. So the advance is fired only where Primary Ignition (+ compensations + EGR Timing Advance) + KCA + FLKC is below the Base Timing map; it can never lift the fired timing above Base Timing. In stock at high load that is the normal case (e.g. 4000 rpm / 160 %, TGVs open: Primary Ignition 3 degrees, Base Timing 21 degrees, so full-DAM KCA of about 6.7 degrees fires almost degree for degree; computed). Component A, TGVs open (weight v). Stock up to 22 counts = 7.7 degrees. Confidence: read.

table.name: KCA DAM Curve A
table.description:
How much of Knock Correction Advance Max A is applied at each DAM value (0 = none, 1.0 = all). Stock ramps from 0 at DAM 0 to full at DAM 11/16. The resulting advance raises the Primary Ignition side of the timing limit, so it reaches the spark only where Primary + advance is below Base Timing; the stock axis has a repeated 15/16 point, keep it increasing.

With cal 0x35509 bit 0 set (it is, in both images) the applied advance FFF8A791 = (A x KCA DAM Curve A(DAM) + B x KCA DAM Curve B(DAM)) / 128; otherwise it is A7A5 x DAM / 16. One count = 0.3516 degrees (x 180 >> 8 in 0x0C13B4 / 0x0DB3D4, x 90 / 128 in 0x0D9088, read). Torque Reduction Spark Retard is the exact inverse of Ignition Efficiency vs Retard, so in effect FFF8A76A = min(base timing FFF8A645, timing request + KCA + FLKC) less any torque-reduction retard; it then rate-limits (0x0DD760) into the base sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600) and the fired timing FFF8A744 (min() form computed from the inverse tables). In limit states FFF8A639 = 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088: request + 0.3516 deg x (A791 + A7A7) with the pedal pressed) replaces FFF8A645 outright. In stock at high load that is the normal case (e.g. 4000 rpm / 160 %, TGVs open: Primary Ignition 3 degrees, Base Timing 21 degrees, so full-DAM KCA of about 6.7 degrees fires almost degree for degree; computed). Weight (/128) on component A by DAM (FFF811AE, 0...16 = DAM 0...1; DAM unit inferred). Stock ramps 0 -> 1.0 between DAM 0 and 11/16, flat above. The stock axis is 0, 2, 3 ... 15, 15, 16 /16 (no 1/16, 15/16 twice): a stock quirk, keep it monotonic when editing. Confidence: read.

table.name: FBKC Window RPM Maximum
table.description:
Upper rpm limit for feedback knock correction. Above it the current knock retard is held: no new retard and no recovery. Stock 6,400 rpm, below the 6,700 rpm rev limit, so knock correction freezes near the limiter. Raise this if you raise the rev limit.
Details: 0x0E8128 / 0x0E2F94 (read): upper end of the FBKC working range. While rpm FFF8CE9C is above this (with hysteresis cal 0x1C27C), FFF8A7AE is clear and FBKC goes to state 5, which holds the current correction (x cal 0x1C26E / 128 = 1.0): no new knock retard and no recovery. Inside the window (FBKC Window RPM Minimum...this, and FFF8A7AF set) the knock retard states 0x0D/0x0E, the hold state 0x10 (no knock, fewer than 100 events since the last knock) and the recovery state 0x0F are used. Stock 32768 = 6,400 rpm, below the 6,700 rpm rev limit, so FBKC is frozen near the limiter. Confidence: read.

table.name: FBKC Window RPM Minimum
table.description:
Lower rpm limit for feedback knock correction: below it no new knock retard is taken, and any existing knock retard is given back by FBKC Recovery Step each combustion event. Stock 1,200 rpm.
Details: Lower end of the FBKC working range: below it no knock retard or recovery steps are taken (see FBKC Window RPM Maximum). 0x0E2BE4 (read): the second window flag is true while rpm FFF8CE9C >= this (once true, it stays until rpm < this - 0x1C286). Stock 6144 = 1,200 rpm. Confidence: read.

table.name: DAM Step Gain (FLKC Cell)

scaling.units: FLKC cell (5 x rpm range + load range)

table.description:
How strongly each fine-knock-learning step moves DAM, per FLKC learning cell (index = 5 x rpm range + load range, 0-34; index 0 is the lowest rpm and load cell). Larger values make DAM move faster when the ECU learns knock in that cell; 0 means that cell never moves DAM. Stock non-zero only at indices 1-3, 6-8 and 11-13 (below 7200 rpm, loads 0.41-3.19 g/rev); 0 in the lowest load range. Purpose is inferred.
Details: When used: every combustion event while the DAM state FFF8A7AA is 8 (0x0E7AEC: FFF8A7CF set and no other state applies, read). 0x0E792C (read): DAM x 256 += this(FLKC cell FFF8A790) x FFF8A799 x 90 >> 16, clamped 0..256 (DAM 0..1); FFF8A799 is the signed step chosen by the FLKC state (-23/-24/-14 in states 8/9/10, +6/+3 in states 5/6, 0x0E2ABC). So DAM moves by this x step count; a larger value makes DAM react more to learning in that cell. Index = FLKC cell FFF8A790 = 5 x rpm range + load range, 0..34 (0x0E1C58, read; 0x0E1F90 reads the learned value FFF81414[A790]), so index 0 is the lowest rpm / lowest load cell and is used. Stock (DAM per step count) 0.0044/0.0048/0.0060 at indices 1-3 (below 2400 rpm; load ranges 0.41-0.93 / 0.93-1.70 / 1.70-3.19 g/rev = 31.5-71.5 / 71.5-131.5 / 131.5-246.5 %), 0.0067/0.0051/0.0058 at 6-8 (2400-4400 rpm, same load ranges), 0.0055/0.0089/0.0105 at 11-13 (4400-7200 rpm); 0 elsewhere, including the lowest load range (indices 0/5/10, at or below 0.41 g/rev) and the top load range (4/9/14, above 3.19 g/rev). With the -23 step of state 8 that is -0.10..-0.24 DAM per step (computed). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: FLKC Advance Learning Inhibit Zones

scaling.units: zone index (5 x rpm band + load band)

table.description:
Per rpm/load zone switch: 1 stops fine knock learning from learning timing back upward there, so it can only learn retard (inferred). Stock 1 in the high-load, low-to-mid rpm area (2100-4300 rpm at higher loads). These zones use their own rpm/load boundaries, not the FLKC cell boundaries.
Details: When used: every combustion event (0x0E74B0 <- 0x0E402C <- 0x07D0E0, crank task, read). Zone index FFF8A7A8 = 5 x rpm band + load band: rpm bands <=2100, 2100-3000, 3000-3400, 3400-3800, 3800-4300, 4300-8000, >8000 rpm (FFF8CE9C, cals 0x26FBC..0x26FC6, hysteresis cal 0x26FC8 = 50 rpm); load bands <=1.42, 1.42-1.68, 1.68-1.94, 1.94-2.20, >2.20 g/rev (<=110, 110-130, 130-150, 150-170, >170 %) (FFF8ADE4, cals 0x26FB2..0x26FB8, hysteresis cal 0x26FBA = 2.5 %) (read). FFF8A7A9 = this(zone). With 1 the fine-learning state machine 0x0E1A38 cannot enter states 4-7, which include the positive learning steps (FFF8A799 = +cal 0x1C269 / 0x1C268 in states 5/6, 0x0E2ABC), and 0x0E9970 sets the latch FFF8A7D0 (read). So in the flagged zones FLKC learns only downward (inferred from the step signs). Stock 1 in zones 6-9 (2100-3000 rpm above 110 %), 12-14 (3000-3400 above 130 %), 18-19 (3400-3800 above 150 %) and 24 (3800-4300 above 170 %): the high-load, low-to-mid rpm area. Zone boundaries differ from the FLKC cell boundaries. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 0)
table.description:
Timing offset added to base timing only at high pedal (above High Pedal Entry Threshold, 90 % stock), blended by DAM with Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 1); this table applies at DAM 0. 32 = no change, 0.5-degree steps. Stock flat 32, so no effect. Not the knock correction advance (renamed from Knock Correction Advance DAM 0/1).
Details: When used: only while the AVCS high-pedal latch FFF8A8A4 bit 7 (0x11C15C) is set (accelerator at or above High Pedal Entry Threshold, 90 % stock; cleared below High Pedal Exit Threshold); otherwise the blend is 32 = no change (0x0DA600, caller 0x0DF0B8, read). 0x0DA600 blends this table with its pair, weighted (16 - w)/16 where w = FFF811AE (FFF8B128 >> 4, a 0..256 learned value stepped up and down by the knock-learning logic at 0x0E792C: DAM x 256, inferred). The blend is added to the base timing sum FFF8A74B. Base Timing DAM Blend B uses the other high-pedal latch, FFF8A8A4 bit 6 (0x11C0C4, the one that selects Injection Timing (High Pedal)); both are 90 % / 85 % in stock (read). Flat 32 (no change) in both stock images. Not the knock correction advance itself: that is Knock Correction Advance Max A/B with the KCA DAM curves (0x0E1FD8, read). Renamed from "Knock Correction Advance (DAM 0/1)". Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 1)
table.description:

table.name: FLKC Counted-Cell Learned Value Threshold (Off in Stock)
table.description:
By DAM: a fine-knock-learning cell is counted when its learned value is at or above this, and the count sets an internal flag. It has no effect on a stock car because the flag is only used in a DAM range that DAM can never reach. Stock 3.87 degrees at low DAM down to 0.35 near full DAM.
Details: When used: computed every pass of 0x0E3DF4 (10 ms task), but without effect in stock. 0x0E7DF8 (read): one cell per pass, it counts the FLKC cells whose flag FFF811AF[cell] is 1 and whose learned value FFF81414[cell] is at or above this(DAM FFF811AE); after all 35 cells the count goes to FFF8A792 and FFF8A7A3 bit 1 = count >= cal 0x1C699 (4). 0x0E7D0C (read) uses that bit only together with DAM inside cal 0x1C698..0x1C697 (32..48 in DAM x 16 units), which DAM (0..16) never reaches, so the bit has no effect in stock. Stock 3.87 degrees at DAM 1/16 down to 0.35 degrees at 15/16. Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Threshold (Event 1, Full Window)
table.description:
Knock intensity (sum of the three strongest knock-channel ratios to their background, 3.0 = all at background) (by rpm and load) above which a knock event in slot 1 counts as knock and triggers feedback knock retard; used while the extended (full) knock window is in use. Higher = less sensitive. Warning: the Full / Short Window sets were renamed on 2026-10-30 (earlier names had them swapped). Which cylinder slot 1 is has not been mapped.
Details: Knock decision (0x0E8654 / 0x0E80B4, read): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4) the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot] (output of the signal processing 0x0E51E4) is compared with two thresholds. Knock B, FFF8A7B5 = intensity > Knock Threshold (this family, FFF8C1CC[slot] by 0x0E77E0) or FFF8CDC4[slot] >= cal 0x1BD92 (65535, off); this is the active path in stock and drives FBKC states 7 / 0x0E (retard 0x1C275 / 0x1C274, 4 counts = 1.41 degrees). Knock A, FFF8A7AD = intensity > Secondary Knock Threshold (FFF8C1D4[slot] by 0x0E78E4); all 65535 in stock, so it never fires (states 6 / 0x0D). Each event also sets bits of FFF8A79D (0x10/0x20/0x30/0x40 by slot). Slot vs cylinder number not mapped. Knock Threshold (0x0E77E0, read): looked up by rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500) and load FFF8A616 for each event slot; set A (05C104/118/12C/140) while FFF8A7C1 = 0, i.e. the nominal (short) window; set B (05C154/168/17C/190) while A7C1 = 1, i.e. the extended window (0x0E77E0 at 0x0E7836-0x0E784A; flag polarity read in 0x0E20E0 at 0x0E21AA-0x0E21EC; corrected 2026-10-30, the earlier names had the two sets swapped). A higher value needs a larger knock signal to count as knock (less sensitive). Set B (extended / full window). Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Window Start
table.description:
Crank angle (probably degrees after top dead centre) at which the ECU starts listening for knock, by rpm; limited by Knock Window Start Minimum and Maximum. table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 1, Channel 2)
table.description:
Knock signal processing for event slot 1, channel 2 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock. Larger = that event less likely to count as knock. Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 1 (Event 1), knock channel 2 of 8 (index 1 of FFF8CDB0; enabled in stock: bit 1 of cal 0x1B97C is clear), on the knock window where FFF8A7C2 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C180[1] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D2, gain curve cal 0x26F6F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F (per slot; stock 0xC1 = channels 1, 7 and 8 off) give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes (cal 0x28B9E = 0 in stock selects these flags): +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Stock 0 to 70 (raw); the sibling tables for channels 1, 7 and 8 (masked in stock) are all 0. Confidence: read.
