table.name: Overboost Margin
table.description:
How far above Overboost Limit boost must be before overboost time is counted toward the overboost flag, which makes the overboost cut a full fuel cut. Stock 26.7 kPa (3.9 psi).
Details: When used: always. 0x0C0FE0: overboost time is counted while MAP FFF88FF4 >= Overboost Limit + this (read); after Overboost Delay the flag FFF8A63A bit 6 sets. The flag makes the limit-state overboost cut (Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State)) a full fuel cut on all four cylinders; it has no effect outside that state (read). Stock 6835 = 26.7 kPa (3.9 psi). Confidence: read.

table.name: Overboost Delay
table.description:
How long boost must stay above Overboost Limit plus Overboost Margin before the overboost flag sets and the overboost cut becomes a full fuel cut. Stock 2.0 s.
Details: When used: always. 0x0C0FE0: consecutive 10 ms passes with MAP >= Overboost Limit + Overboost Margin before the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6 sets (read); the count restarts when MAP drops below that level. The flag turns the limit-state overboost cut into a full fuel cut on all four cylinders (see Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State)). Stock 200 = 2.0 s. Confidence: read.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit
table.description:
Vehicle speed limiter. It needs this speed, Vehicle Speed Limit Minimum RPM and Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed to act, and then cuts fuel to all cylinders without closing the throttle. Stock 255 km/h with a 6375 rpm minimum: off (no effect in stock).
Details: When used: always (off in stock). Set speed of the vehicle-speed latch FFF84168 (0x0BE140, read): it sets when vehicle speed FFF99835 >= this minus Vehicle Speed Limit Offset and engine speed FFF8CD5C (rpm/25) >= Vehicle Speed Limit Minimum RPM, and holds until speed is below that level and MAP FFF88FF4 <= Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP. While it is set (and no higher state), the limit state FFF8A639 is 0x0C. State 0x0C does not reduce torque by itself: the final torque cap FFF8AE54 is limited (0x0B9DC8) to FFF8AF1A (0x0C058C), which is zero torque only while speed >= Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed (then all four injectors are cut every event through the cylinder-cut count FFF8A643, see Rev Limit RPM part 3), otherwise the current torque. There is no throttle cap in state 0x0C (0x0BDA84 caps only state 0x0B) and the spark stays on its normal target (Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Speed Limit). Fuel trims for state 0x0C (cals 0x3845C-0x3845F, by number of cylinders cut) are 0 in stock (0x0C558C, Ghidra stack arguments, not checked). Stock 255 km/h with a 6,375 rpm minimum and a 255 km/h full-cut speed: off. A working speed limiter needs this, Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed and Vehicle Speed Limit Minimum RPM (inferred); it is then a hard fuel cut. Limit-state priority: not running 1, FFF8A640 bit 0 0x19, latch FFF8416C 0x1B, rev/overboost 0x0B, speed 0x0C (0x0BE37E-0x0BE476, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Minimum RPM
table.description:
The speed limiter only starts at or above this engine speed. Stock 6375 rpm, part of why the speed limiter is off in stock.
Details: When used: always (off in stock). The vehicle-speed latch (state 0x0C, see Vehicle Speed Limit) sets only while engine speed FFF8CD5C (rpm/25) >= this (0x0BE1E8-0x0BE1F4, read). Stock 255 = 6,375 rpm, which together with the 255 km/h limit keeps the speed limiter off. Confidence: read.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed Hysteresis
table.description:
How far speed must fall below Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed before the fuel cut ends. Stock 2 km/h; no effect in stock.
Details: When used: only in limit state 0x0C. Subtracted from Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed after a pass at or above it (FFF8418A), so the full cut holds down to that speed (0x0C058C, read). Stock 2 km/h. Confidence: read.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Offset
table.description:
Subtracted from Vehicle Speed Limit to give the speed where the limiter state starts; it is not a release hysteresis. Stock 2 km/h; no effect in stock.
Details: When used: always (the speed limiter is off in stock). Subtracted from Vehicle Speed Limit in the set test of the speed latch FFF84168 (0x0BE1CA-0x0BE1E4, read), so the latch sets at Vehicle Speed Limit minus this. It is not a release hysteresis: the latch releases when speed is below the same level and MAP <= Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP (read). See Vehicle Speed Limit for what the latch does (state 0x0C). Stock 2 km/h. Confidence: read.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP
table.description:
The speed limiter cannot release while manifold pressure is above this. Stock 168 kPa absolute; no effect in stock.
Details: When used: always (off in stock). Neither the vehicle-speed latch FFF84168 (0x0BE140) nor the speed full-cut latch FFF84188 (0x0C058C) releases while MAP FFF88FF4 is above this, even below its speed (read). Plays the role Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP has for the rev limiter. Stock 39599 = 168 kPa abs. Confidence: read.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP Hysteresis
table.description:
Hysteresis on Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP. Stock 0; no effect in stock.
Details: When used: always (off in stock). Added to Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP after a pass with MAP at or below it (FFF84165 / FFF84189), saturating (0x0BE270-0x0BE28E, 0x0C058C, read). Stock 0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Fail-Safe Rev Limit (Rail Pressure Fault)
table.description:
Rev limit used only while a fuel-rail pressure fault is active: above it fuel to all cylinders is cut. Stock 6100 rpm.
Details: When used: only while fault flag FFF88EDA bit 5 or 7 (set by 0x080B96 from rail-pressure monitor bits FFF89BDE 0-3, next to the P0087/P0088 bits, inferred) or FFF88E2C bit 2 (pending P0192/P0193, rail pressure sensor) is set. 0x0C1AC8 (read): limit FFF8AF4C = the lowest of this and the other active Fail-Safe Rev Limit cals (65535 when none), and FFF8AF4A = max(FFF8AF4C, idle target FFF8B236 + Fail-Safe Rev Limit Minimum Above Idle Target). While rpm >= FFF8AF4A (release Fail-Safe Rev Limit Hysteresis lower) the cylinder-cut count FFF8A643 is forced to 4: all four injectors are cut every event, in any limit state (same injector path as Rev Limit RPM part 3). Stock 31232 = 6,100 rpm. Precisely (0x0C1AC8, read): while the fail-safe comparator FFF841F9 is set the count is cal 0x38248 (the cylinder count, 4 in stock), not a literal 4; and it is overridden when FFF89BFE bit 2 is set (the count then comes from cals 0x23D58-0x23D5F, not yet defined). Confidence: read.

table.name: Fail-Safe Rev Limit (Injector Driver Fault)
table.description:
Rev limit used only while an injector-driver fault has put the fuel system in its low-pressure fail-safe: above it fuel to all cylinders is cut. Stock 6100 rpm.
Details: When used: only while FFF88F4A bit 1 is set (0x080B96, from the P062D / P2146 injector-driver monitors; the same flag selects Rail Pressure Fail-Safe Target A and the Injector Latency Adder, read). Otherwise as Fail-Safe Rev Limit (Rail Pressure Fault): rpm at or above the lowest active fail-safe limit cuts fuel on all four cylinders (0x0C1AC8, read). Stock 31232 = 6,100 rpm. Precisely (0x0C1AC8, read): while the fail-safe comparator FFF841F9 is set the count is cal 0x38248 (the cylinder count, 4 in stock), not a literal 4; and it is overridden when FFF89BFE bit 2 is set (the count then comes from cals 0x23D58-0x23D5F, not yet defined). Confidence: read.

table.name: Fail-Safe Rev Limit (Unused Fault Flag)
table.description:
Fail-safe rev limit tied to a fault flag that nothing sets in this software, so no effect in stock. Stock 6100 rpm.
Details: When used: only while FFF88F4A bit 2 is set; no writer of that bit exists in LF75404S (my research notes), so no effect in stock. Otherwise as Fail-Safe Rev Limit (Rail Pressure Fault) (0x0C1AC8, read). Stock 31232 = 6,100 rpm. Precisely (0x0C1AC8, read): while the fail-safe comparator FFF841F9 is set the count is cal 0x38248 (the cylinder count, 4 in stock), not a literal 4; and it is overridden when FFF89BFE bit 2 is set (the count then comes from cals 0x23D58-0x23D5F, not yet defined). Confidence: read.

table.name: Fail-Safe Rev Limit Hysteresis
table.description:
How far rpm must fall below an active fail-safe rev limit before fuel returns. Stock 100 rpm.
Details: When used: only while a fail-safe rev limit is active. Once the fail-safe cut is on (FFF841F9), it stays on until rpm drops this far below the limit FFF8AF4A (0x0C1C72-0x0C1C8C, read). Stock 512 = 100 rpm. Confidence: read.

table.name: Fail-Safe Rev Limit Minimum Above Idle Target
table.description:
A fail-safe rev limit is never set lower than the idle target plus this. Stock 200 rpm.
Details: When used: only while a fail-safe rev limit is active. The fail-safe limit is never below the idle target FFF8B236 plus this (0x0C1C02-0x0C1C16, read; saturating). Stock 1024 = 200 rpm. Confidence: read.

table.name: External Torque Limit Baro Factor (Off in Stock)
table.description:
Air-density correction (barometric part) applied to a torque limit received over CAN, probably from the transmission controller. Has no effect on a stock car because its enable setting is off. Stock 0.69 at 66.6 kPa to 1.0 at sea level.
Details: When used: only with cal 0x20F04 = 1, 2 or 3 (0 in stock). Barometric part of the air density factor FFF8AE9E. 0x0BB0A4 (read): FFF8AE9E = Baro Factor(FFF88A36) x IAT Factor(FFF88A48) / 16384. 0x0BB0EC / 0x0BB118 copy it to FFF8AEA0 / FFF8AEA2 only when cal 0x20F04 is 1 or 3 / 1 or 2 and FFF88E28 bit 2 / FFF88E2A bit 0 are clear, else 16384 (x1.0). FFF8AEA2 divides the external (CAN) torque limit in 0x0BB1AC: limit = 16000 + FFF88DF6 x 160 x 16384 / FFF8AEA2 (read; the limit byte is inferred to come from another controller, my research notes); FFF8AEA0 goes to 0x116158. Stock cal 0x20F04 = 0, so the factor is not applied in stock. The product is the air density relative to 101.3 kPa and 25 degC (inferred from the stock values: 0.69 at 66.6 kPa, 1.18 at -20 degC). Stock 0.69 at 66.6 kPa to 1.0 at 101.3 kPa. p16 (read): FFF88DF6 = CAN 0x149 byte 4 (mailbox 1, TCM frame group: decoding gated by the U0101/U0402 status and forced off by the MT coding FFF886AB b7, which then loads cal 0x572D0), decoder 0x085D20. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: External Torque Limit IAT Factor (Off in Stock)
table.description:
Air-density correction (intake temperature part) applied to a torque limit received over CAN, probably from the transmission controller. Has no effect on a stock car because its enable setting is off. Stock 1.18 at -20 C, 1.0 at 25 C.
Details: When used: only with cal 0x20F04 = 1, 2 or 3 (0 in stock). Intake-air-temperature part of the air density factor FFF8AE9E. 0x0BB0A4 (read): FFF8AE9E = Baro Factor(FFF88A36) x IAT Factor(FFF88A48) / 16384. 0x0BB0EC / 0x0BB118 copy it to FFF8AEA0 / FFF8AEA2 only when cal 0x20F04 is 1 or 3 / 1 or 2 and FFF88E28 bit 2 / FFF88E2A bit 0 are clear, else 16384 (x1.0). FFF8AEA2 divides the external (CAN) torque limit in 0x0BB1AC: limit = 16000 + FFF88DF6 x 160 x 16384 / FFF8AEA2 (read; the limit byte is inferred to come from another controller, my research notes); FFF8AEA0 goes to 0x116158. Stock cal 0x20F04 = 0, so the factor is not applied in stock. The product is the air density relative to 101.3 kPa and 25 degC (inferred from the stock values: 0.69 at 66.6 kPa, 1.18 at -20 degC). Stock 1.18 at -20 degC, 1.0 at 25 degC, 0.95 at 40 degC. p16 (read): FFF88DF6 = CAN 0x149 byte 4 (mailbox 1, TCM frame group: decoding gated by the U0101/U0402 status and forced off by the MT coding FFF886AB b7, which then loads cal 0x572D0), decoder 0x085D20. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio Hysteresis
table.description:
Hysteresis on the cylinder-cut torque ratios and decel cut stages. Stock 0.
Details: When used: with the four Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio thresholds. Subtracted from a threshold while the ratio is at or above it (latches FFF841FA-FFF841FD), and from the decel stage levels (0x0B9EF0). 0x0C1AC8 (read): in limit states 8, 9, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x18 (unless FFF8A638 = 2) and 0x19-0x1B the torque ratio FFF8A64F (capped / unreduced torque, 0x0C4BA0) is compared with four thresholds: cylinders cut FFF8A643 = 0 if the ratio >= the 1-cylinder threshold, 1 if >= the 2-cylinder threshold, 2 if >= the 3-cylinder threshold, 3 if >= the 4-cylinder threshold, else 4 (each threshold minus Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio Hysteresis while it is crossed). Once per event 0x0C4B84 then skips n of every 4 injections. The same four cals set the torque level of each decel fuel cut stage (0x0B9EF0), so changing them also changes the decel cut. The rev limiter and the overboost full cut use a zero cap (ratio 0, 4 cylinders) and do not depend on them. Stock 0. Further gating in 0x0C1AC8 (read): the ratio comparison also runs outside those states while FFF8A63B bit 0 or FFF899EC bit 1 / bit 4 is set; while FFF89BFE bit 2 is set (a fault latch from 0x09FE44, meaning not decoded) the count is instead taken from cals 0x23D58-0x23D5F by rpm FFF8CD62 and speed FFF99835 (not yet defined) and overrides both this ratio and the Fail-Safe Rev Limit; and with engine state FFF99844 = 4, or FFF8A65F bit 7 set while FFF89066 bit 0 is clear, the count is cal 0x38248 (the cylinder count, 4), i.e. all cylinders. Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque
table.description:
Torque by rpm that counts as 100 % in the Throttle Opening from Target Torque maps: at or above it they give wide-open throttle. Raise it together with Full-Load Reference Brake Torque for a higher-torque tune. Edit together with Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque (Monitor).
Details: 0x0C0010 (read): normalises the target brake torque FFF8AECA into the column index of the eight Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables (idx = 255 x AECA / this); at or above this torque every table gives 100 % (wide open). Stock 103 ft-lb (140 Nm) at 800 rpm rising to ~221 ft-lb (300 Nm), 165 ft-lb (224 Nm) above 6600 rpm; identical to Full-Load Reference Brake Torque 05A054 from 2000 rpm, lower below (122 vs 136 ft-lb, 165 vs 184 Nm at 1000 rpm). Raising it with 05A054 keeps the WOT point of the opening tables and the full-load excess term (0x0BDAA0) together. Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque (Monitor)
table.description:
Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque. Keep identical to the main table, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred).
Details: When used: always, in the throttle monitor. 0x18A790 (from 0x189DF0, read) is the monitor copy of 0x0C0010: column index = 255 x monitor target torque FFF8BBC8 / 05FBB0(rpm), the eight tables are looked up on (rpm FFF8CD54, index) and blended with the same TGV FFF8B3E8 and EGR FFF8B290 weights into FFF8BBEE, the monitor's opening request. This is the normaliser of the index (the copy of 059DD0; data 0x045336, axis 0x04530C). The throttle-monitor module (0x18620C / 0x189DF0 / 0x186290, run from 0x07C408 on one pass in four, each right after its primary 0x0C3D14 / 0x0BE694 / 0x0C3E34, read) repeats the primary computation into its own FFF8BBxx variables with a separate copy of the data and axes. Byte-identical to the original in stock. Edit both together, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed)
table.description:
This is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded throttle opening is essentially this map (by rpm and target torque) plus the idle air. Used with the TGVs closed and no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount). Edit together with Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed, Monitor).
Details: 0x0C0010 (called from torque module 0x0BE694): column index = 255 x target torque FFF8AECA / Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque 059DD0(rpm); result blended by TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 and EGR realisation FFF8B290 (min 256) into FFF8AF12, which 059D2C/059D64/05A148/05A0BC turn back into the commanded throttle, so at part throttle the commanded opening is essentially this map plus the idle area (read, numeric check in TD.md). Weight (1 - TGV open) x (1 - EGR) on the normal (non-cruise) path. Stock: 0 to 100 %; e.g. 15.7 % at 3200 rpm/100 Nm. THIS is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded opening is about this table plus the idle area (end-to-end model, my research notes). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open, EGR)

This is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded throttle opening is essentially this map (by rpm and target torque) plus the idle air. Probably used while cruise control is active; TGVs open, EGR active. Edit together with Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open, EGR, Monitor).
Details: 0x0C0010 (called from torque module 0x0BE694): column index = 255 x target torque FFF8AECA / Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque 059DD0(rpm); result blended by TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 and EGR realisation FFF8B290 (min 256) into FFF8AF12, which 059D2C/059D64/05A148/05A0BC turn back into the commanded throttle, so at part throttle the commanded opening is essentially this map plus the idle area (read, numeric check in TD.md). Cruise path (inferred), weight TGV open x EGR realisation. THIS is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded opening is about this table plus the idle area (end-to-end model, my research notes). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open, EGR, Monitor)
table.description:
Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open, EGR). Make the same edit here as on the main table, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).
Details: When used: as the original, in the throttle monitor. 0x18A790 (from 0x189DF0, read) is the monitor copy of 0x0C0010: column index = 255 x monitor target torque FFF8BBC8 / 05FBB0(rpm), the eight tables are looked up on (rpm FFF8CD54, index) and blended with the same TGV FFF8B3E8 and EGR FFF8B290 weights into FFF8BBEE, the monitor's opening request. Copy of Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open, EGR) 059E40 (data 0x048054, own axes). If you edit the part-throttle opening map, make the same edit here. The throttle-monitor module (0x18620C / 0x189DF0 / 0x186290, run from 0x07C408 on one pass in four, each right after its primary 0x0C3D14 / 0x0BE694 / 0x0C3E34, read) repeats the primary computation into its own FFF8BBxx variables with a separate copy of the data and axes. Byte-identical to the original in stock. Edit both together, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Opening (Required Area)
table.description:
Converts the required throttle area into commanded throttle opening (%). It is the exact inverse of Throttle Area from Opening; keep the two consistent, and edit Throttle Opening (Monitor) too. Leave alone unless the throttle body changes. Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: 0x0C326C (read): commanded throttle FFF8AF84 = this(max(Throttle Required Area output FFF8AFB4, idle area FFF8AE00)) x 400 / cal 0x3826E (706); 25600 = 100 % (OBD PID 0x4C, SSM 0x15, logger J11). The accelerator pedal FFF88824 x 100/256 is added only with the engine stopped (state 1) or with cal 0x23D0C bit 0 set (clear in stock), never while running. Stock 0 % at area 18 to 99.9 % at 21468 (wide open). It is the exact inverse of Throttle Area from Opening; keep the two consistent. The same data is also read as 05A170 (idle floor) and 060B10. The monitor copy Throttle Opening (Monitor) (05F3FC, data 0x048EE6) must be edited too. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Throttle Opening (Monitor)
table.description:
Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening (Required Area). Identical in stock; edit both together. Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: 0x185DD8 (read): separate copy (data 0x048EE6, axis 0x048F06) of Throttle Opening 05A0BC with its own divisor cal 0x48F5A (706); identical in stock. Edit together with 05A0BC. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Required Area
table.description:
Throttle area needed for a given fraction of full-load torque, by rpm. At part throttle it cancels out against Torque Fraction from Throttle Area, so part-throttle feel is set by the Throttle Opening from Target Torque maps instead. If you edit it, edit it with Torque Fraction from Throttle Area and Throttle Required Area (Monitor). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: Columns: FFF8AFA8 = (torque request + losses) / (full-load reference torque) x spark compensation (0x0C37D8, read), i.e. the requested fraction of full-load torque (1.0 = full load). 0x0C3408 multiplies the same value by the Boost Limit to form the model's pressure AF8A (read). Rows: rpm. 0x0C4D84 (read): FFF8AFB4 = this(rpm, AFA8) in engine states 1/3/4; during cranking (FFF8906B = 2) FFF8AFB4 = FFF8AED6 instead. AFB4 goes through Throttle Opening (Required Area) in 0x0C326C to the commanded throttle FFF8AF84. The last column (AFA8 = 1.0) is 21468 = wide open in every row. At part throttle this table and Torque Fraction from Throttle Area cancel (one is the inverse of the other within interpolation), so the opening is set by the Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables. If you edit it at all, edit it with Torque Fraction from Throttle Area. The same data is also read as 05A15C. The monitor copy Throttle Required Area (Monitor) (05F3E8, data 0x049552) must be edited too. See my research notes. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Throttle Required Area (Monitor)
table.description:
Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Required Area. Identical in stock; edit both together. Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: 0x185DD8 in the throttle monitor 0x186290 (read): separate copy (data 0x049552, axes 0x049A32/0x048F26) of Throttle Required Area 05A148, identical in stock. Edit together with 05A148. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Area from Opening
table.description:
Converts a throttle opening (%) into throttle area; the exact inverse of Throttle Opening (Required Area). Also gives the required area during cranking. Keep the two consistent; leave alone unless the throttle body changes. Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: 0x0BD5CC (read): FFF8AED6 = FFF8AE00 + this(FFF8AF12), FFF8ADFC = this(AF12). Its axis in % equals the Throttle Opening data and its data equals the Throttle Opening axis, point for point: it is the exact inverse of 05A0BC. AED6 is the required area used during cranking (0x0C4D84). AF12 comes from 0x0C0010 (inferred: a torque-model opening). Keep consistent with 05A0BC. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Area from Opening (Monitor)
table.description:
Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Area from Opening. Keep it identical to the main table (and the inverse of Throttle Opening), or expect a plausibility fault (inferred). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: When used: always, in the throttle monitor. 0x189458 (read): FFF8BBCA = FFF8BB5E + this(FFF8BBEE), the copy of FFF8AED6 = AE00 + 059D2C(AF12) in 0x0BD5CC; BBEE is the monitor's opening from 0x18A790. Copy of Throttle Area from Opening 059D2C (data 0x044A04, axis 0x044A24). Keep it the inverse of Throttle Opening as for the original. The throttle-monitor module (0x18620C / 0x189DF0 / 0x186290, run from 0x07C408 on one pass in four, each right after its primary 0x0C3D14 / 0x0BE694 / 0x0C3E34, read) repeats the primary computation into its own FFF8BBxx variables with a separate copy of the data and axes. Byte-identical to the original in stock. Edit both together, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Torque Fraction from Throttle Area
table.description:
Fraction of full-load torque expected from a given throttle area, by rpm; used to build the throttle torque request. The inverse of Throttle Required Area: if you edit one, edit the other, and Torque Fraction from Throttle Area (Monitor). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: 0x0BDB00: FFF8AEE8 = AF64 x this(rpm, AED6), where AED6 = idle area AE00 + 059D2C(air request AF12 from the target torque, 0x0C0010). 0x0B9D08 then makes the throttle brake-torque request AE4C = AEE8 + max(AECA + AF62 - AF64, 0) - AF62, which becomes FFF8AEDA, the numerator source of 0x0C37D8. Shares its data (0x01C6F4) with 059D78. Stock rows run 0 to 1.0 at full area. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Torque Fraction from Throttle Area (Monitor)
table.description:
Throttle-monitor copy of Torque Fraction from Throttle Area. Keep identical, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: When used: always, in the throttle monitor. 0x189500 (read): FFF8BBD2 = BB38 x this(rpm, area FFF8BBCA), the copy of FFF8AEE8 in 0x0BDB00. Copy of Torque Fraction from Throttle Area 059D64 (data 0x046E84, axes 0x047304/0x047334; the original's data is also read as 059D78). The throttle-monitor module (0x18620C / 0x189DF0 / 0x186290, run from 0x07C408 on one pass in four, each right after its primary 0x0C3D14 / 0x0BE694 / 0x0C3E34, read) repeats the primary computation into its own FFF8BBxx variables with a separate copy of the data and axes. Byte-identical to the original in stock. Edit both together, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Request Limit (Coolant)
table.description:
Upper limit, by coolant temperature, on the idle air request (probably from idle speed control) before it is converted to throttle area. Stock no limit up to 0 C, falling as the engine warms.
Details: 0x0B9394 (read): FFF8AE00 = 0594F0(min(FFF8B202, this(coolant))). Stock 65533 (no limit) up to 0 degC, falling to 29854 at 100 degC. B202 is written by the idle module (call in seg 0x0E0000) and read as the idle airflow request (inferred). Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air Request to Throttle Area
table.description:
Converts the idle air request into throttle area, which is added to the pedal-driven opening and sets the idle throttle floor. Edit together with Idle Air Request to Throttle Area (Monitor). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: 0x0B9394: FFF8AE00 = this(min(B202, Idle Air Request Limit)). Stock 0-2982 in the required-area unit. AE00 adds to the pedal area (AED6), forms the idle-only area (AED8) and gives the idle throttle floor FFF8AFB8 via 05A170 (0x0C4E18). Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air Request to Throttle Area (Monitor)
table.description:
Throttle-monitor copy of Idle Air Request to Throttle Area. Keep identical, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: When used: always, in the throttle monitor. 0x186ACC (from 0x189DF0, read): FFF8BB5E = this(min(FFF8B202, 05F474(coolant FFF88A44))), the copy of FFF8AE00 in 0x0B9394. Copy of Idle Air Request to Throttle Area 0594F0 (data 0x045380, axis 0x045360). The throttle-monitor module (0x18620C / 0x189DF0 / 0x186290, run from 0x07C408 on one pass in four, each right after its primary 0x0C3D14 / 0x0BE694 / 0x0C3E34, read) repeats the primary computation into its own FFF8BBxx variables with a separate copy of the data and axes. Byte-identical to the original in stock. Edit both together, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Start Throttle Opening Add (Coolant)
table.description:
Extra throttle opening during engine start (cranking, car stopped), by coolant temperature. Stock 0 below -10 C, 7.2 % at 0-40 C, 31-34 % from 50 C. Edit together with Start Throttle Opening Add (Monitor).
Details: 0x0C4E5C (read): FFF8AF9E = this(coolant), clamped to 0xAD3A, added to the idle-area opening while rpm <= 10 (until rpm > 300), speed < 4 km/h, counter FFF88A76 < 200, FFF8A64E bit0 set, bit1 clear, FFF88ADA bit6 set and FFF8A6E7 != 3; AFBA = max(T, AFB8 x 1.057 + AF9E). Stock 0 % below -10 degC, 7.2 % at 0...40 degC, 31-34 % from 50 degC (ETC %). Monitor copy 05F45C (data 0x048F6A) must be edited too. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Start Throttle Opening Add (Monitor)
table.description:
Throttle-monitor copy of Start Throttle Opening Add (Coolant). Identical in stock; edit both together.
Details: 0x186704, the monitor copy of 0x0C4E5C (read): separate copy (data 0x048F6A, axis 0x048F94) of 05A1AC, identical in stock. The monitor's four caps 05F450/05F42C/05F438/05F444 share data with 05A17C/05A1A0/05A194/05A188. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Torque Request Cap
table.description:
Cap on the torque request (plus engine losses) that the throttle model works from. Stock 369 ft-lb (500 Nm), which already binds at roughly 284-358 ft-lb (385-485 Nm) of requested torque. Raise it for high-torque tunes.
Details: 0x0C1414 (read): the torque request plus losses that the throttle model works from (FFF8AF24 -> AF2C) is capped at this. Stock 56000 = 369 ft-lb (500 Nm), which binds at roughly 284-358 ft-lb (385-485 Nm) requested torque (losses are 12-85 ft-lb, 16-115 Nm). Raise it for high-torque tunes; see my research notes. Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Limit (Rail Pressure Deviation, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Throttle opening cap by rpm for a rail-pressure-deviation fault mode. Has no effect on a stock car: the mode is disabled by a calibration switch that is off in stock.
Details: 0x0C4E5C (read): AFBA = min(this(rpm), T) while FFF8A9C9 bit 2 is set; 0x1296A8 sets it when rail pressure FFF88884 exceeds FFF8B9A0 by cal 0x38B00 for 05DA3C(rpm) passes, only if cal 0x38AD4 bit 0 - which is 0, so the mode is disabled in stock (read). Same stock values as 05A194. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). p16 (read): 0x1296A8 (<- 0x1289AC <- 0x1E0AE8) counts 20 ms passes. Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Limit (Fuel Pressure Fault)
table.description:
Limp-mode throttle cap by rpm while a fuel pressure fault (P0087, P0088, P0192/P0193 and related codes) is pending; probably meant to limit speed with a high-pressure fuel fault. Stock about 18 % at 2000-4000 rpm, 6 % from 4400 rpm.
Details: 0x0C4E5C (read): AFBA = min(this(rpm), T) while FFF88E2C bit 2 (pending P0192/P0193) or bit 4 (pending P0087, P0088, P062D, P1261-P1264, P0192/P0193) is set (0x080B96, codes by slot). Stock 95 % at 400 rpm, ~18 % at 2000-4000 rpm, 6 % from 4400 rpm: closes the throttle to cap speed in a high-pressure fuel fault (inferred). Overridden only by 05A188. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Limit (Injector Circuit Fault)
table.description:
Limp-mode throttle cap by rpm while an injector or injector-driver fault (P1261-P1264, P2146, P062D) is set. Stock 6 % above 4400 rpm.
Details: 0x0C4E5C (read): AFBA = min(this(rpm), T) while FFF88F4A bit 3 is set; 0x080B96 sets it for DTC-enabled results in FFF89CD1 bits 1-4 (P1261-P1264), FFF89CF2 bits 6/7 (P2146 mask) and FFF89B67 bits 0-3 (P062D mask). Same stock values as 05A194 (6 % above 4400 rpm). Priority below 05A194/05A188, above 05A17C. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Offset RPM Threshold (Coolant)
table.description:
Engine speed, by coolant temperature, below which a throttle offset ramp acts (probably a cold / low-speed throttle offset). All 0 in stock, so the offset is never applied.
Details: 0x0C3700: while this(coolant) (less cal 0x10870 hysteresis) exceeds FFF8AF66 (= engine speed FFF8CE9C), FFF8AF9C follows a ramp (step AF7E, clamped AF80..AF82) or cal 0x11AD2; otherwise cal 0x1080C. AF9C goes to the throttle shaping 0x0C4E5C (a cold/low-speed throttle offset, inferred). All 0 in stock, so AF9C = 0. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Throttle Limit (Unused Mode)
table.description:
Highest-priority throttle cap by rpm for a fault mode that nothing in this ROM ever sets, so it has no effect.
Details: 0x0C4E5C (read): highest-priority cap, AFBA = min(this(rpm), T) while FFF88F4A bit 2 is set. No code in LF75404S sets that bit (0x080B96 sets bits 0, 1, 3 only), so the table is unused in this image. Same stock values as 05A194. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Command Rate Term (Unused)

scaling.units: % per pass (change of throttle command, FFF8AF84 unit)

table.description:
Has no effect: the ECU calculates a value from it that nothing reads.
Details: Unused in this ROM: 0x0B7FA0 (read) writes FFF8ADE8 = 059490(commanded throttle FFF8AF84) + this(|change of FFF8AF84 since the previous pass|); ram_xref finds no reader of FFF8ADE8 (writers 0x0B7EB4 init and 0x0B7FA0 only), so the result is never used. Editing it has no effect. Stock 0 rising to 58982 over the axis. Axis: FFF8AF84 in its own unit, 25600 = 100 % (x/256; corrected in Phase 19). Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Command Term (Unused)
table.description:
Has no effect: the ECU calculates a value from it that nothing reads.
Details: Unused in this ROM: 0x0B7FA0 (read; called once from 0x0B7E00) writes FFF8ADE8 = this(commanded throttle FFF8AF84) + Throttle Command Rate Term(|change of FFF8AF84 since the previous pass|), capped at 65535. ram_xref finds no reader of FFF8ADE8 (writers 0x0B7EB4 init and 0x0B7FA0 only), and the address appears in the ROM only in those two functions' literal pools (0x0B7E84 caller, 0x0B7EE8 init), so the result is never used. Editing it has no effect. Stock 6553 at 0 %, 22937 at 20 %, 19660 from 50 % (raw; unit not identified). Confidence: read.

table.name: Full-Load Reference Brake Torque
table.description:
Full-load torque by rpm (density corrected) that the throttle/boost model divides every request by. It does not change part-throttle opening; it moves the full-load handover, target MAP and torque limits (raising it lowers target MAP for the same torque). Keep it equal to Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque from 2000 rpm, and edit the (Monitor) copy too.
Details: CORRECTION (end-to-end model, read arithmetic): at part throttle this table does NOT change the commanded opening (scaling it by 0.9 changes part-throttle opening by 0.00 %); it moves the full-load handover point and the target-MAP / torque-limit behaviour. Keep it equal to Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque (059DD0) from 2000 rpm, as stock. 0x0C2E70: scaled by FFF8AF52 = baro/101.3 kPa x 059F00(IAT) and added to 05A048 into FFF8AF64, the full-load indicated torque. The throttle opens in proportion to request / AF64, and target MAP = request/AF64 x boost ceiling (0x0C2F0C), so raising this table closes the throttle and lowers target MAP for the same torque. Stock 119-223 ft-lb (162-303 Nm); from 2000 rpm identical to 059DD0, the normaliser 0x0C0010 uses on the target torque. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Full-Load Reference Brake Torque (Monitor)
table.description:
Throttle-monitor copy of Full-Load Reference Brake Torque. Keep identical, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred).
Details: When used: always, in the throttle monitor. 0x185B20 (from 0x18620C, read): FFF8BB38 = 05F380(rpm) + density FFF8BB32 x this(rpm FFF8CD54), the copy of FFF8AF64 in 0x0C2E70. Copy of Full-Load Reference Brake Torque 05A054 (data 0x049464, axis 0x0494C4). The throttle-monitor module (0x18620C / 0x189DF0 / 0x186290, run from 0x07C408 on one pass in four, each right after its primary 0x0C3D14 / 0x0BE694 / 0x0C3E34, read) repeats the primary computation into its own FFF8BBxx variables with a separate copy of the data and axes. Byte-identical to the original in stock. Edit both together, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Full-Load Reference Torque Loss
table.description:
Engine loss torque by rpm added to Full-Load Reference Brake Torque to give the full-load reference the whole throttle/boost model divides by. Probably a mechanical loss at full load (about the same as Friction and Pumping Torque Loss there). Stock 13-58 ft-lb (18-79 Nm). Edit the (Monitor) copy too.
Details: Inferred a mechanical loss at the boost limit (not density-scaled; within a few Nm of Friction and Pumping Torque Loss at 120-150 kPa). 0x0C2E70 (task 0x0C3D14): FFF8AF64 = this + density x (Full-Load Reference Brake Torque - 0 ft-lb), density = baro/101.3 kPa x IAT factor. AF64 is the denominator of every torque ratio in the throttle module (0x0C37D8, 0x0C385C) and of the target MAP (0x0C2F0C). Stock 13-58 ft-lb (17.9-78.8 Nm), about the friction table at full load (inferred). Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Full-Load Reference Torque Loss (Monitor)
table.description:
Throttle-monitor copy of Full-Load Reference Torque Loss. Keep identical, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).
Details: When used: always, in the throttle monitor. 0x185B20 (read): added to the density-scaled 05F374 into FFF8BB38, the monitor's full-load indicated torque. Copy of Full-Load Reference Torque Loss 05A048 (data 0x049494). The throttle-monitor module (0x18620C / 0x189DF0 / 0x186290, run from 0x07C408 on one pass in four, each right after its primary 0x0C3D14 / 0x0BE694 / 0x0C3E34, read) repeats the primary computation into its own FFF8BBxx variables with a separate copy of the data and axes. Byte-identical to the original in stock. Edit both together, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Friction and Pumping Torque Loss
table.description:
Friction and pumping losses by rpm and manifold pressure, added to every torque request in the throttle/boost model. Cancels out at part throttle; matters near full load, for the torque estimate and limiters (raising it probably opens the throttle and raises target MAP). Edit the (Monitor) copy too.
Details: CORRECTION (end-to-end model, read arithmetic): at part throttle the losses cancel out of the commanded opening (Throttle Required Area is the inverse of Torque Fraction from Throttle Area); this table matters near full load, for the torque estimate and the limiters. 0x0C2FE4 -> FFF8AF76, which 0x0C2B2C adds (with accessory torques, 0 ft-lb in stock) into FFF8AF62. AF62 is added to every brake-torque request before the throttle ratio (0x0C36A0/0x0C36D0) and subtracted from the modelled delivered torque (0x0C1824), so this table converts brake torque to indicated torque for the throttle/boost model. Stock 12-85 ft-lb (16-115 Nm), rising with rpm. Raising it opens the throttle and raises the target MAP (0x0C2F0C) for the same torque request (inferred). Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Friction and Pumping Torque Loss (Monitor)
table.description:
Throttle-monitor copy of Friction and Pumping Torque Loss. Keep identical, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).
Details: When used: always, in the throttle monitor. 0x185C34 (from 0x186290, read): FFF8BB44 = this(rpm FFF8CD54, FFF8C5D2 = FFF8AF6E filtered with cal 0x23E08), the copy of the loss term of 0x0C2FE4. Copy of Friction and Pumping Torque Loss 05A060 (data 0x048FE4, axes 0x0494C4/0x048FB4). The throttle-monitor module (0x18620C / 0x189DF0 / 0x186290, run from 0x07C408 on one pass in four, each right after its primary 0x0C3D14 / 0x0BE694 / 0x0C3E34, read) repeats the primary computation into its own FFF8BBxx variables with a separate copy of the data and axes. Byte-identical to the original in stock. Edit both together, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Full-Load Reference Torque IAT Factor
table.description:
Intake-temperature correction on the full-load reference torque (and on an upper torque ceiling). Flat 1.0 in stock, so only barometric pressure corrects it.
Details: 0x0C24F8 -> FFF8AF54; 0x0C2494 forms FFF8AF52 = cal 0x10720 x baro FFF88668 x AF54 / 2^30 (32768 = 1.0 at 101.3 kPa), the density factor on 05A054 in FFF8AF64 (0x0C2E70). AF54 also scales the 457 ft-lb (619 Nm) ceiling in 0x0BD48C. Flat 1.0 in stock, so only barometric pressure moves AF64. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: read.

table.name: Ignition Efficiency vs Retard
table.description:
How much torque the engine loses when timing is retarded from base timing (1.0 = no loss). The torque model uses it, and together with its inverse, Torque Reduction Spark Retard, it also decides how far the fired timing is pulled down toward Primary Ignition plus knock advance. Stock 0.96 at 8 degrees retard, 0.79 at 20, 0.48 at 32; shares data with two other entries. Leave alone, or edit together with its inverse.
Details: Ignition efficiency (torque ratio) versus retard below the base timing FFF8A645, 32768 = 1.0; stock 1.0 at 0, 0.96 at 8 deg, 0.79 at 20 deg, 0.48 at 32 deg, 0.13 at 60 deg. table.name: Air Quantity for Torque
table.description:
Air quantity needed for a given torque, by rpm; the torque model uses it to judge how much of the requested air has actually arrived (air-path lag), which feeds spark-based torque reduction and the cylinder-cut level. Only the shape matters. Extend the 277 ft-lb (375 Nm) torque axis if your torque request plus losses exceeds it.
Details: 0x0C34F8 (read): AF74 = Air Quantity for Torque(rpm, AF24); AF68 = AF74 lagged with the air-path lag rate; AF96 = min(1.0, AF68/AF74) is the fraction of the requested air already delivered. 0x0C1854 and 0x0C39DC scale torque by AF96 into AF40 / AF3E (predicted air torque for ignition torque reduction and the cylinder-cut level). The torque axis ends at 277 ft-lb (375 Nm); extend it if requested torque plus losses exceeds that. Only the ratio AF68/AF74 is used, so the data unit does not matter. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Air Quantity Filter Rate
table.description:
Smoothing of the air quantity input to the air-path lag tables (lower = more smoothing). Stock no smoothing.
Details: 0x0C34F8 (read): FFF8AF7A / C558 = air quantity FFF8B4D6 filtered with this coefficient; C558 is the axis of the air-path lag rate tables. Stock 65535 (no filtering). Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). p16 (read): this torque-model function (0x0C3E34 subtree) runs every 10 ms (0x07C408 <- 0x1DFE3C); 'pass' = 10 ms. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Air-Path Lag Rate (Torque Rising)

Used after AF24 rose by more than 74 ft-lb (100 Nm) over two passes (cal 0x243CE), until it falls by more than 74 ft-lb (100 Nm) (cal 0x243D0). table.name: Torque Response Filter Weight (Throttle Opening)
table.description:
How quickly the torque model expects delivered torque to follow after the throttle opens quickly (larger = faster), by rpm. Part of the modelled torque used for spark compensation. Leave alone unless you know the model.
Details: 0x0C38E0 (read, 10 ms): FFF8AFAC = this(rpm) once the throttle change AF36 = FFF8CD77 - FFF8CD7A (throttle position now minus 30 ms ago; CD77 = (ETC throttle position FFF8A342 - 10)/4) has risen past +15 counts (about +8 % throttle, scale inferred). table.name: Torque Response Filter Weight (Throttle Closing)

table.name: Torque Delay
table.description:

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A
table.description:
Torque-model smoothing multiplier by coolant (1.0 = normal; very high values mean no smoothing), used for a while after a combustion-mode change while final timing is still well short of the spark target. Stock 0.70-0.80 below -10 C, 1.0 from 0 C. Leave alone unless you know the model.

table.name: Spark Compensation Event Hold Time
table.description:

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Closed, AVCS Active)
table.description:
Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs closed while the cams are under AVCS control. With the knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit: the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map, and at high load in stock this side is the lower one, so it is effectively the WOT timing map.
Details: When used: Weight a (FFF84710) jumps to 255 when both cam controllers are in an active state (intake FFF8AB2C, exhaust FFF8AB1E = 1, 2, 6, or 9 with their bit 5) and falls by 8 per pass otherwise; forced to 0 while FFF88A2D bit 0 (engine stopped) is set (0x0D952C, read). So this table applies while AVCS is controlling. 0x0D952C (from 0x0DE0E0, read): Closed = 05B4A0 x a + 05B4B4 x (1 - a), Open = 05B4C8 x a + 05B4DC x (1 - a), result = Closed x (1 - TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, degrees = x/2 - 16, into FFF8A734 (closed blend) / FFF8A737 (open blend) / FFF8A736 (result), output FFF8A735 (optionally smoothed via FFF8C537 when FFF8AA85 bit 0 is set). FFF8A735 feeds the timing request (0x0E0A30 -> FFF8B10E -> FFF8A789) and so the spark target FFF8A72A, and FFF8A74A (0x0DA38C) (read). It sets the fired timing wherever it is the lower side of the timing limit (read, knock routing review 2026-10-31): 0x0E0A30 builds the pedal-pressed request FFF8A78A = this + coolant comp FFF8A787 + IAT comp FFF8A782 + EGR Timing Advance FFF8A769 (+ FFF8A77F / FFF8A786, neutral in stock); FFF8A789 adds the enrichment retard (0x0E0910); 0x0C13B4 compares FFF8A789 - 32 + 0.3516 deg x (KCA FFF8A791 + FLKC FFF8A7A7) with base timing FFF8A645, the shortfall becomes the efficiency FFF8AF22 (Ignition Efficiency vs Retard), and 0x0C39DC / 0x0DD568 turn it back into retard on FFF8A645 through the inverse table Torque Reduction Spark Retard. So the fired base FFF8A76A = min(Base Timing + comps, this + comps + EGR advance + KCA + FLKC) less torque-reduction retard (min() form computed), followed by tip-in retard, 0x0DD760, 0x0DA600 and the fired sum 0x0D9E40 (FBKC and retard terms). In stock at high load this table plus KCA is well below Base Timing (4000 rpm / 160 %, TGVs open, AVCS active: 3 degrees vs 21; computed), so this table with KCA and FLKC is effectively the wide-open-throttle timing. 0x0D9E40 uses FFF8A735 as the whole fired timing only when cal 0x239AE bit 1 is set (clear in stock), and in limit states FFF8A639 = 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088, built from this request) replaces base timing outright (read). Weight a is a 0-255 ramp kept in FFF84710: +cal 0x2FFB0 (255) per pass while both cam controllers are active, -cal 0x2FFAF (8) per pass otherwise (0x0D952C, read). Axes rpm FFF8CE9C x load FFF8ADE4 (g/rev alternate). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, so FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction; 0x10C948 drives it toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so that bit set = TGVs closed. p16 (read): 0x0D952C runs every 10 ms, so the weight falls 8 per 10 ms (full blend in about 0.32 s). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Volumetric Efficiency (TGV Closed)
table.description:
Volumetric efficiency by rpm and manifold pressure; feeds the ECU's air-mass model that defines engine load. The ECU blends the TGV Closed and TGV Open tables by actual TGV position. This is the TGVs-closed side. Retune when changing intake, cams or head flow.
Details: Volumetric efficiency, rpm x manifold pressure (psia). 0x11E280 blends Volumetric Efficiency (TGV Closed) x (1 - w) + Volumetric Efficiency (TGV Open) x w, with w = FFF8B3E8/65536 the TGV open fraction, into FFF8B4DA (read). 0x11E308 uses it (as VE = x/32768, rate-limited by cal 0x2B0E8/0x2B0EA). The exception is when cal 0x2C4D0 bit 0 is set (clear in stock) and FFF8A83B bit 7 is clear; then it uses Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready, Off in Stock). The result FFF8C25C feeds the air-mass model whose output FFF8C250 defines engine load (0x0B7EFC). FFF8B3E8 comes from 0x10C948: the average of the two TGV position sensors FFF88AA6/88AA8 through 05D29C/05D290, ramped (cal 0x379EC/0x379EE) and gated by FFF8A881 bit 4 and FFF88E2A bit 5 (read). Polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends ignition as Closed x (1 - B3E8) + Open x B3E8, and 0x10C948 drives B3E8 toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is set. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Throttle Flow Function
table.description:
Physics curve for airflow through the throttle versus the pressure ratio across it, used by the manifold model that is corrected toward the MAF. Leave alone: it is an exact physical constant.
Details: When used: every model pass. Stock 0.924 at r = 0.53 (choked) to 0 at r = 1.0, exactly 1.34889 x the compressible flow function for k = 1.4 (computed). 0x11DD04 (read), enabled by FFF8A8FB bit 0 (0x11E43C): the modelled throttle flow FFF8C24C = (P_up/101325) x flow function(r) x throttle area FFF8ADEC (= table 0594CC(FFF8CD74), 0x0B8940) x temperature factor x cal 0x2B06C/0x2B06D/64 x 60000 x 2.98e-15, with P_up = FFF8C244 and r = FFF8C240/FFF8C244 (inverted for reverse flow) clamped at 0.53 (choked), then filtered with the ratio-dependent weight. C24C feeds the manifold/airflow observer 0x11DB50, which corrects the estimated pre-throttle pressure C244 so the modelled flow matches the MAF (read). Physical constants of the orifice equation (inferred from the stock values); a tuner should normally leave them alone. Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Flow Temperature Correction
table.description:
Temperature correction for throttle airflow in the manifold model (the standard square-root-of-temperature law). Leave alone: it is exact physics.
Details: When used: every model pass. Input FFF8A8FF = estimated charge air temperature degC + 50 (0x11E0B8: IAT FFF88662 plus a pressure-ratio heating term, capped by FFF888CF, read). Stock 1.135 at -40 degC to 0.809 at 185 degC = sqrt(300 K / T). 0x11DD04 (read), enabled by FFF8A8FB bit 0 (0x11E43C): the modelled throttle flow FFF8C24C = (P_up/101325) x flow function(r) x throttle area FFF8ADEC (= table 0594CC(FFF8CD74), 0x0B8940) x temperature factor x cal 0x2B06C/0x2B06D/64 x 60000 x 2.98e-15, with P_up = FFF8C244 and r = FFF8C240/FFF8C244 (inverted for reverse flow) clamped at 0.53 (choked), then filtered with the ratio-dependent weight. C24C feeds the manifold/airflow observer 0x11DB50, which corrects the estimated pre-throttle pressure C244 so the modelled flow matches the MAF (read). Physical constants of the orifice equation (inferred from the stock values); a tuner should normally leave them alone. Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Flow Filter Weight
table.description:
Smoothing of the modelled throttle airflow by pressure ratio: when pressures either side of the throttle are nearly equal (small, noisy flow) it is smoothed more. Normally leave alone.
Details: When used: every model pass. C24C = new x w + previous x (1 - w) with w = this(r)/65536 (65535 = 1.0) (read). Stock 1.0 below r = 0.62, falling to 0.09 at r = 1.0: near-equal pressures (small, noisy flow) are filtered more. 0x11DD04 (read), enabled by FFF8A8FB bit 0 (0x11E43C): the modelled throttle flow FFF8C24C = (P_up/101325) x flow function(r) x throttle area FFF8ADEC (= table 0594CC(FFF8CD74), 0x0B8940) x temperature factor x cal 0x2B06C/0x2B06D/64 x 60000 x 2.98e-15, with P_up = FFF8C244 and r = FFF8C240/FFF8C244 (inverted for reverse flow) clamped at 0.53 (choked), then filtered with the ratio-dependent weight. C24C feeds the manifold/airflow observer 0x11DB50, which corrects the estimated pre-throttle pressure C244 so the modelled flow matches the MAF (read). Physical constants of the orifice equation (inferred from the stock values); a tuner should normally leave them alone. Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Area from Throttle Position (Airflow Model)
table.description:
Converts throttle position into effective throttle area (mm^2) for the airflow model and the throttle-based MAP substitute; about 2,150 mm^2 wide open. Stock it equals Throttle Area from Opening; for a different throttle body enter its measured open area here and in Throttle Area from Opening.
Details: When used: always (0x0B8BB0 -> 0x0B8940, read): FFF8ADEC = this(throttle position FFF8CD74). ADEC feeds the throttle flow of the manifold model (0x11D704: C24C = P_up/101325 x flow function x ADEC x temperature factor x cal, which corrects the pre-throttle pressure estimate toward the MAF, my research notes, read), the throttle-flow chain FFF8ADF8/ADF0 (Throttle Flow Curve (Area per RPM, MAP Fallback Model)) and FFF8A61F (its change per pass, 0x0B8A38) (read). Stock data are exactly 2 x Throttle Area from Opening at the same opening (read), so the scaling halves it into the area_raw unit (21468 = wide open). Keep it consistent with Throttle Area from Opening (and its Monitor copy) when the throttle body changes (inferred; the code does not compare them). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Throttle Flow Curve (Area per RPM, MAP Fallback Model)
table.description:
Airflow per revolution versus throttle area per rpm. Used for a throttle-based MAP substitute (probably when the MAP sensor is faulted) and as an input to transient (tip-in) fueling. Change only for a different throttle body.
Details: When used: always (0x0B8BB0 -> 0x0B8C74, read): FFF8ADF8 = rpm FFF8CD54 x this(FFF8ADEC x 1024 / CD54) / 32768, with ADEC from Throttle Area from Throttle Position; then 0x0B8980 forms FFF8ADF0 = ADF8 x 0.4/6e7 x cal 0x349C4 (14187) x FFF8CD46 x 0.0349 x 256 (filtered by cal 0x349C6), and when FFF88E28 bit 3 is set the MAP value FFF8913C becomes cal 0x58EA4 (52298) x ADF0 >> 15 instead of the sensor reading (0x1E0000 block, read): a throttle-based MAP substitute. ADF8 x 2 -> FFF8ADF6 -> filtered rate FFF8ADF4, and the rate of ADF0 -> FFF8ADF2, are inputs of the transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 (throttle-rate term and tip-in trigger) (read). Units: axis = throttle area (Throttle Area from Throttle Position units) x 1024 per rpm count, data raw; stock 0 rising to 16664 and saturating, the usual shape of air per revolution versus area per rpm (inferred). That FFF88E28 bit 3 is a MAP sensor fault is inferred. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Manifold Pressure Rate Span (RPM)
table.description:
How many samples (10 ms each) the ECU spans, by rpm, when measuring how fast manifold pressure is changing; that rate triggers the manifold model's transient corrections. Stock 7 samples at 800 rpm down to 2 from 5600 rpm.
Details: When used: every pass of 0x11CAB8 (from the airflow module, read). Seven MAP samples FFF88666 are kept in a delay line; FFF8B4CE = (MAP n passes ago - MAP now) / n x 3 (sign as coded; i.e. the negative MAP rate scaled to 3 passes), filtered with cal 0x2B9AC, where n = this(rpm FFF8CD54) clamped 1...7 (read). B4CE is the pressure-rate input of the transient-gain logic 0x11CEB4 (read). Stock 7 passes at 800 rpm down to 2 passes from 5600 rpm. Confidence: read.

table.name: Manifold Model Rising Transient Threshold
table.description:
How fast manifold pressure must rise (in gear) to count as a rising transient, which speeds up the ECU's manifold pressure model. Stock 4 kPa up to 90 kPa, 6 kPa at 105-150 kPa, 8 kPa from 165 kPa. Normally leave alone.
Details: Manifold-pressure model transient logic 0x11CEB4 (10 ms task, read). FFF8B4CA = MAP FFF8869C - filtered MAP FFF8C598 (filter of FFF88666 with cal 0x2BAD4). Rising transient: B4CA >= 05D7B8 (in gear) / 05D7C4 (neutral switch FFF88ADA b6 set), or a throttle step >= 05D80C (254, off). Falling transient: B4CA <= 05D7E8 (-6 kPa, hysteresis 05D7D0 +4 kPa) / 05D7F4 (-3 kPa, neutral). Output FFF8A8F9 multiplies the model gain FFF8B4D0 (0x11CC68: B4D0 is proportional to intake temperature x A8F9; 0x11D938 integrates R x B4D0 x (air in - air out) into the modelled pressure FFF8C238 when the model is active, FFF8A8FB b0 = running and rpm >= 100). Set: neutral switch -> Neutral tables; else TGV closed command FFF8A881 b4 -> TGV Closed tables; else the in-gear TGV-open tables. table.description:

table.name: Manifold Model Start Correction RPM Threshold
table.description:
After start, once rpm passes this value (by coolant at start), the manifold model is pulled onto the MAF reading with the start gain (Manifold Model Start Correction MAF Gain) until model and MAF agree. Below this rpm the gain is 1.0. Stock 550 rpm cold down to 300 rpm from 70 C. Normally leave alone.
Details: Manifold-pressure model start phase 0x11C788 (10 ms task, read). Both tables are looked up with coolant at start FFF88A46 (the first stack argument; the disassembly shows R5 = EXTU.W @(40,R15) for 05D74C). FFF8C234 = 05D758 / 64 x 05D764(FFF8C540) / 128 while FFF8A8FC b6 is clear, else 1.0; b6 clears once rpm >= 05D74C x 6.25 after the model started (FFF8A8FB b0 rising) and stays clear until the modelled air FFF8C254 and the MAF value FFF88820/1280 agree within cal 0x2B999 x 0.2 (or FFF886AB b5 falls). C234 is the gain on the (MAF - model) term in 0x11DB50 (read), so the tables shape how fast the model is pulled onto the MAF after start (inferred). Stock 550 rpm up to 0 C (32 F), 544 / 525 / 494 rpm at 10 / 20 / 30 C, 400 at 40 C, 338 at 50 C, 306 at 60 C, 300 rpm from 70 C (158 F). Confidence: read.

table.name: Manifold Model Start Correction MAF Gain

table.name: Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready, Off in Stock)
table.description:
VE table that would replace the normal TGV-blended VE while the cams are probably not yet ready. Has no effect on a stock car: it is only used when VE: Use AVCS-Not-Ready Table is set, which is off in stock.
Details: When used: never in stock. It needs cal 0x2C4D0 bit 0, which is clear in every stock image (read). When that bit is set, 0x11E308 uses this table instead of the Volumetric Efficiency (TGV Closed) / (TGV Open) blend while FFF8A83B bit 7 is clear (read). That bit is an AVCS-ready flag from 0x1050F4 that needs both cam references learned (inferred meaning). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Throttle Flow Coefficient (Forward Flow)
table.description:
Discharge coefficient of the throttle airflow model for normal flow into the manifold; 1.0 in stock. Leave at 1.0 and describe a new throttle body through the area tables instead.
Details: When used: every model pass while the pressure ratio r = FFF8C240/FFF8C244 is at most 1.0 (normal flow into the manifold). 0x11DD04 (read), enabled by FFF8A8FB bit 0 (0x11E43C): modelled throttle flow FFF8C24C [g/min] = (P_up/101325) x Throttle Flow Function(r) x FFF8ADEC (Throttle Area from Throttle Position, 0.05 mm^2) x Throttle Flow Temperature Correction x this x 60000 x 2.98e-15, which feeds the manifold/airflow observer 0x11DB50 / 0x11D938. Stock 64 = 1.0. With the area tables in mm^2 this is the discharge coefficient of the orifice equation; normally leave at 1.0 and correct the area tables instead. Confidence: read.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map (Enriched)
table.description:
Second exhaust/catalyst temperature estimate (inferred), by rpm and load, while open loop enrichment is active. When it gets high enough the ECU skips the delay before open loop fueling.
Details: When used: always while running. Map while open-loop enrichment is active. 0x0C965C (read): FFF8AFCE = filtered (Enrichment-dependent Map x Retard Multiplier (05A538 no enrichment / 05A52C enriched / 05A544 with FFF8A8A5 bit 4) / 256), maps on rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616; filter weight 05A4C8 while FFF8AFCC rises, 05A4F0 (05A504 with FFF8A8A5 bit 4) while it falls, 05A4DC rising with the bit, the previous weight when unchanged. 0x0C95F8: FFF8AFCC = FFF8AFCE filtered by 05A48C(rpm, load). In 0x0CAA44 FFF8AFCE is compared with cal 0x138D6 (39322, hysteresis 0x138D8) and FFF8AFCC with cal 0x138D2 (65535, so in stock that comparison is never met); reaching either sets the open-loop delay FFF8AFE6 to 0 (immediate open loop), and FFF8AFCC is read by 0x0E817C (read). A second estimate of the same kind as Exhaust Temperature Model Map A/B (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Filter (Rising)

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Filter (Falling)

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Second Filter
table.description:
Extra smoothing stage on the second exhaust temperature estimate. Identical to its other filter in stock. Normally leave alone.

Stock identical to Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Filter. 0x0C965C (read): FFF8AFCE = filtered (Enrichment-dependent Map x Retard Multiplier (05A538 no enrichment / 05A52C enriched / 05A544 with FFF8A8A5 bit 4) / 256), maps on rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616; filter weight 05A4C8 while FFF8AFCC rises, 05A4F0 (05A504 with FFF8A8A5 bit 4) while it falls, 05A4DC rising with the bit, the previous weight when unchanged. 0x0C95F8: FFF8AFCC = FFF8AFCE filtered by 05A48C(rpm, load).
