So this copy is used with the A/C on. Stock: identical data to Idle Air Altitude Factor (05C610), 1.72 at 58 kPa to 1.00 at 100 kPa; edit all three together to change the altitude correction. Confidence: read.

table.name: Minimum Idle Air (Moving in Gear)
table.description:
Floor on idle air by rpm (and coolant) whenever the car is moving in gear, so the throttle cannot close below it; acts mainly as a dashpot when the pedal is released (inferred). Raise to soften throttle closing on decel; lower for faster rpm drop. Not used at standstill or in neutral.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass of 0x0EE338 while running. 0x0ED5F8 (read; call order checked against 0x0EE338): B1DA = this(rpm/50 FFF8CD56, coolant FFF8CD65) x 256 (plus FFF8B19E x cal 0x250CB = 0). The floor candidate is this value while the vehicle moves (speed FFF99835 >= cal 0x250CA = 4 km/h) out of neutral; at standstill or in neutral it is 0 (or cal 0x2524E = 1536 with FFF88E2A bit 1 / FFF88E28 bit 0). While the accelerator is pressed and for cal 0x2525A (30 passes, 0.3 s) after release the floor is at least cal 0x250C8 (7127 in B1D4 units = 3563 as shown here); at -40 degC (CD65 <= 10) it is capped at cal 0x250C4 (2851 = 1426 as shown). The result rises by at most cal 0x250BE (1536 = 768 as shown) and falls by cal 0x250CC (831 = 416 as shown) per pass, becomes B1D4 = max(it, B1E0), and the idle-air minimum B1F6 = max(B1D4/2, cal 0x24EDC = 1280) (0x0EE318). So whenever the car moves in gear the idle air (and the idle throttle area) cannot fall below this, by rpm; it matters most with the accelerator released (decel dashpot, inferred), but with the pedal pressed it still sets the floor where it exceeds 3563 as shown (from about 1300 rpm cold, about 1500 rpm from 80 degC). Stock 3840 at 0 rpm, 2816 at 400-800 rpm, 4608 at 1600 (cold; 2944 at 1200 and 3840 at 1600 rpm from 80 degC), 5632 at 2000, 8192 at 2800, 13184 at 4000, 16384 at 4400, 20480 at 5600 and 22016 from 6400 rpm; otherwise independent of coolant. Shown x128 = B1D4/2, the candidate for the idle-air minimum B1F6. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air
table.description:
Manual cars only: extra air, by how far rpm has dipped below a held reference, while pulling away from a standstill in gear with the pedal pressed. Raise to make launches from rest harder to stall. Stock 0 with no dip, rising steeply to 5939 base-air units at a 30 rpm dip.
Details: When used: manual coding, standstill in gear with the accelerator pressed (pulling away, inferred). Input B148 = rpm minus the held reference. Stock 0 at no dip, 1188 base-air units at a 10 rpm dip, 2376 at 15, 3564 at 20, 5939 from 30 rpm. 0x0EBD00 (read; called once per combustion event from 0x0F08B8, crank task, disassembly checked for the table inputs): on the manual coding (FFF88ADA bit 7) while the engine turns, at vehicle speed <= cal 0x25CD1 (5 km/h, +6 hysteresis), not in neutral (FFF88ADA bit 6) and with FFF88C64 bit 7 clear (accelerator not released, debounced; inferred), after cal 0x25CD6 (8) such events: a reference rpm B192 = max(B192 - Pull-Away Anti-Stall Reference Decay(rpm), previous rpm FFF8CEB4 + k x its last change FFF8CEBA / 51 - 05C2EC(rpm), an undefined table that is 0 in stock) (k = cal 0x25CDE 102 when falling, 0x25CE0 1663 when rising) is kept; B148 = rpm FFF8CEB4 - B192 (FFF8CEB4 = 96e6/(two segment periods) = rpm x 5.12, read). The anti-stall air B18C = max(B18C - cal 0x25CD8 (0), Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air(B148)); it falls by cal 0x25CDC (713) per event with neutral or the accelerator released, and by cal 0x25CDA (238) per event above the speed limit (read). B18C enters the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8), which also floors the throttle area while driving off (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Pull-Away Anti-Stall Reference Decay
table.description:
Manual cars only: how fast (by rpm) the reference rpm used by Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air falls per combustion event, so dips are measured from the recent peak. Stock 0 up to 800 rpm (reference held), 100 rpm per event from 3000 rpm.
Details: When used: as Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air, every combustion event. Input FFF8CE9C (rpm). The held reference rpm B192 falls by this per event (read), so a dip is measured from the recent peak. Stock 0 up to 800 rpm (reference held), 100 rpm per event from 3000 rpm. 0x0EBD00 (read; called once per combustion event from 0x0F08B8, crank task, disassembly checked for the table inputs): on the manual coding (FFF88ADA bit 7) while the engine turns, at vehicle speed <= cal 0x25CD1 (5 km/h, +6 hysteresis), not in neutral (FFF88ADA bit 6) and with FFF88C64 bit 7 clear (accelerator not released, debounced; inferred), after cal 0x25CD6 (8) such events: a reference rpm B192 = max(B192 - Pull-Away Anti-Stall Reference Decay(rpm), previous rpm FFF8CEB4 + k x its last change FFF8CEBA / 51 - 05C2EC(rpm), an undefined table that is 0 in stock) (k = cal 0x25CDE 102 when falling, 0x25CE0 1663 when rising) is kept; B148 = rpm FFF8CEB4 - B192 (FFF8CEB4 = 96e6/(two segment periods) = rpm x 5.12, read). The anti-stall air B18C = max(B18C - cal 0x25CD8 (0), Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air(B148)); it falls by cal 0x25CDC (713) per event with neutral or the accelerator released, and by cal 0x25CDA (238) per event above the speed limit (read). B18C enters the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8), which also floors the throttle area while driving off (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Pull-Away Anti-Stall Reference Offset
table.description:
Manual cars only: offset (by rpm) subtracted from the predicted reference rpm for Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air; a positive value probably means a dip must be larger before the anti-stall air reacts. Stock 0, so no effect.
Details: When used: as Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air, once per combustion event (0x0EBD00, called from 0x0F08B8; axis FFF8CE9C confirmed in LF75404S_table_inputs, read). The held reference rpm B192 = max(B192 - Pull-Away Anti-Stall Reference Decay(rpm), previous rpm FFF8CEB4 + k x its last change FFF8CEBA / 51 - this(rpm)) (k = cal 0x25CDE 102 falling / 0x25CE0 1663 rising), and the dip B148 = rpm FFF8CEB4 - B192 indexes Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air (read). A positive value lowers the predicted reference, so a dip has to exceed it before the anti-stall air reacts (inferred from the arithmetic). Manual coding only (FFF88ADA bit 7), at standstill (<= cal 0x25CD1 = 5 km/h), not in neutral, accelerator not released. Stock 0 at all rpm (no offset). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle RPM-Drop Recovery Air (Drop Slowing)
table.description:
Extra idle air, by rpm change rate, to catch an rpm dip at idle once the drop is easing (pedal released, rpm at least 40 below target). Stock small: 128 base-air units for any falling rpm, 0 once rpm rises by 30 per event.
Details: When used: idle, accelerator released, rpm below target and FFF8B13A rising. Stock 128 base-air units for any falling rpm, 51 at +15 rpm per event, 0 at +30. 0x0EB9C4 (read; call 0x0EFA2A, stack arguments checked in the disassembly): active while FFF8A7E2 bit 3 is set, rpm FFF8CE9C is at least 40 rpm below the rate-limited idle target B196 (cals 0x25CBE/0x25CBC = -205/+205 hysteresis), not in neutral, at least cal 0x25CC8 (500 passes, 5 s) after start (FFF88A76), the accelerator released for cal 0x25CC6 (200 passes, 2 s), and FFF8A298 bit 3 / FFF8A7E3 bit 3 clear. Then B16A = this table, and the rpm-drop air B18E = max(B16A, B16C) with B16C from 05C2BC/05C2C8 (rpm error) (read); B18E enters the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8). When inactive B18E falls by cal 0x25CC2 (2376) or 0x25CC4 (950) per pass. Selection: this table while FFF8B13A is higher than in the previous pass (the drop is slowing), Idle RPM-Drop Recovery Air (Drop Continuing) otherwise (0x0EBA5C-0x0EBA74, read). FFF8B13A = (previous + change of the filtered rpm FFF8B19A)/2, updated once per combustion event (0x0E9D80 <- 0x0F08B8, crank task, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle RPM-Drop Recovery Air (Drop Continuing)
table.description:
Extra idle air, by how fast rpm is falling, to catch an rpm dip at idle (pedal released, rpm at least 40 below target, at least 5 s after start). Stock gives a large boost when rpm drops quickly. Used while the drop is not easing; see the Drop Slowing table.
Details: When used: idle, accelerator released, rpm below target and FFF8B13A not rising. Stock 2560 base-air units while rpm falls by 150 rpm or more per event, 128 from -100 to 0, 51 at +15, 0 at +30. 0x0EB9C4 (read; call 0x0EFA2A, stack arguments checked in the disassembly): active while FFF8A7E2 bit 3 is set, rpm FFF8CE9C is at least 40 rpm below the rate-limited idle target B196 (cals 0x25CBE/0x25CBC = -205/+205 hysteresis), not in neutral, at least cal 0x25CC8 (500 passes, 5 s) after start (FFF88A76), the accelerator released for cal 0x25CC6 (200 passes, 2 s), and FFF8A298 bit 3 / FFF8A7E3 bit 3 clear. Then B16A = this table, and the rpm-drop air B18E = max(B16A, B16C) with B16C from 05C2BC/05C2C8 (rpm error) (read); B18E enters the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8). When inactive B18E falls by cal 0x25CC2 (2376) or 0x25CC4 (950) per pass. Selection: this table while FFF8B13A is not higher than in the previous pass (the drop is continuing); Idle RPM-Drop Recovery Air (Drop Slowing) while it is higher (0x0EBA5C-0x0EBA74, read). FFF8B13A = (previous + change of the filtered rpm FFF8B19A)/2, updated once per combustion event (0x0E9D80 <- 0x0F08B8, crank task, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward
table.description:
Extra (or less) idle air applied immediately when the idle speed target changes, by the size of the step, so rpm follows the new target without waiting for feedback. Positive steps add air. Used at idle on manual cars (and most automatic states).
Details: 0x0ECA08 (read; call 0x0ECA88/0x0ECA94 R5 checked): while FFF88A26 bit0 (idle, inferred), engine running (FFF88A27 bit0 clear) and FFF99835 below cal 0x259C8 (255, i.e. always), B1AE = this(new target - ramped target = B236 - B23C/4, capped at cal 0x259CA = 1000 rpm); B1AE enters the idle air at half weight. A positive step (target raised) adds air ahead of the ramp. Used when FFF8A7E2 bit0 is set (bit0 = FFF8A7DD in 1..4 or 6, 0x0F38B0). Stock -1536..+847 base-air units. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Trim (Charging Command)
table.description:
Idle air trim by the alternator charging command: stock takes some air away (up to about 217 base-air units) when little charging is requested, and none from about 14.4 V. Probably compensates for lower alternator load.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass of 0x0EE338. 0x0EC640 (read): B1A2 = this(FFF8B718), summed into the idle air adder B19E (0x0EC09C) at half weight in the idle air (TE.md, read). FFF8B718 is the charging command of the 0x13xxxx charging module: B71E = 05E120(target charging voltage FFF8B6F4, mV inferred) clamped 167..1500 (0x138BB0, read; B718 = B71E because cal 0x57584 bit 4 is clear, 0x1373C8). Stock -217 base-air units at command 0 (and about -112 at 500, i.e. about 12.6 V), 0 from 1167 (about 14.4 V): less idle air when the alternator is asked for little charge (less alternator load, inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Electrical Load Idle Air Hold Release (Alternator Command)
table.description:
Flag table by alternator command that decides when the CAN load-value idle air adder (Idle Air Adder, CAN Load Value table) may increase while battery voltage is low. Stock allows it for alternator commands up to about 35 % duty and blocks it from 50 %.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass of 0x0EE338 while cal 0x57584 bit 6 is set (0xE4 in stock) (0x0ECBAC, read). A release flag (FFF84DC9) is set when this(alternator command FFF8B718) >= 10 and the received load word FFF8B458 >= 10, and cleared when B458 < 10. While it is clear and the filtered battery-sensor value (FFF89074 x 16/125 - 243200, filtered by cal 0x25A44; FFF89074 is a 24-bit received sensor value, 0x097xxx) is below cal 0x25A46 (12800, hysteresis 640), Idle Air Adder (CAN 0x370 Load Value) may not increase. Stock 10 (release) for commands up to 583 (35 % duty, about 12.8 V target through 05E120), 0 from 833 (50 %). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Adder (CAN 0x370 Load Value)
table.description:
Extra idle air by a load value received over CAN, probably electrical load (not confirmed), added to the accessory idle air. Stock 0 up to 300, rising to 1188 base-air units from 800.
Details: 0x0ECBAC (read): B1B2 = this(FFF8B458); increases are held off under a condition built from cal 0x57584 bit6, 05C3A0(FFF8B718) and a filtered value from FFF89074 (not decoded); B1B2 is part of the accessory-load air B1B0 (0x0ECAE0) that enters the idle air at half weight. FFF8B458 is a received word (FFF88BA4, zeroed when FFF88BA3 bit0; 0x114AD0, read); its meaning (electrical load, inferred) is not determined. Stock 0 up to 300, then rising to 1188 base-air units at 800+. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air Adder (CAN 0x280 Stage)
table.description:
Extra idle air by a 3-bit stage value received over CAN, used only with one body coding. Possibly the radiator fan stage, but that is a guess. Stock 0 to 538 base-air units.
Details: 0x0ECDF0 (read): while FFF88E2E bit6 is set, B1B4 = this(FFF8A8BF) if coding byte FFF811DC = 0x5A, or cal 0x25BDA (205) if FFF811DC = 0xA5, else 0; part of B1B0 (0x0ECAE0, capped with the other accessory adders at cal 0x25A02 = 4228) and added at half weight. FFF8A8BF is a 3-bit received value (0x114760); FFF88E2E bit6 follows FFF8A8A0 bit0 or input FFF88BC6 bit4 by coding (0x080532). Radiator-fan stage is a guess (inferred). Stock 0..538 base-air units. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air from Throttle Area (Torque Request)
table.description:
Converts a throttle area back into idle air units when another module requests torque over CAN. Stock is the exact inverse of Idle Air Request to Throttle Area: if you edit that table, edit this one to stay its inverse. Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: When used: every pass of the idle air output 0x0F0B8C (read). B132 = Throttle Required Area-shaped table 05C47C(rpm CD54, ratio of the CAN torque request FFF8B470 to FFF8AF64); B204 = min(this(B132), cal 0x25BB0 = 65535); when FFF8A89F bit 2 (torque request active) and B204 > B1FE, the idle air request B202 becomes B204 (0x0F0B8C, read; my research notes 1.1). Stock data is the exact inverse of Idle Air Request to Throttle Area (0594F0): its axis is 0594F0's data and its data is 0594F0's axis (read from the ROM). It converts a throttle area back into idle-air units, so if 0594F0 is edited this table must be edited to stay its inverse (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Post-Start Idle Air (Stop-Start Restart, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Post-start idle air for an automatic stop-start restart, by start type and coolant. Probably no effect on a stock car: the stop-start feature appears unable to activate in this calibration.
Details: 0x0F1270 (read; args per call in module 0x0EE338): post-start idle air B20E = max(start air, staged air 05C49C family), added to the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8). TGVs not forced closed. Selected instead of the cranking value only inside the engine stop-start restart window (FFF89053 bit3/bit4 with the FFF88ADA bit3 edge, before the decay delay), by start type FFF8A6E8 (read). That feature cannot activate in this calibration (my research notes section 2.3), so unused in stock (inferred from that trace). p16 (read): 0x0F1270 runs every 10 ms; its pass counter FFF84E42 counts 10 ms passes and the decay/ramp steps apply every 4th pass (40 ms). Confidence: read.

table.name: Post-Start Idle Air (Stop-Start Restart, TGV Closed, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Post-start idle air for an automatic stop-start restart with the TGVs closed. Probably no effect on a stock car: the stop-start feature appears unable to activate in this calibration.
Details: 0x0F1270 (read; args per call in module 0x0EE338): post-start idle air B20E = max(start air, staged air 05C49C family), added to the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8). TGVs closed (FFF8A881 bit4). Selected instead of the cranking value only inside the engine stop-start restart window (FFF89053 bit3/bit4 with the FFF88ADA bit3 edge, before the decay delay), by start type FFF8A6E8 (read). That feature cannot activate in this calibration (my research notes section 2.3), so unused in stock (inferred from that trace). p16 (read): 0x0F1270 runs every 10 ms; its pass counter FFF84E42 counts 10 ms passes and the decay/ramp steps apply every 4th pass (40 ms). Confidence: read.

table.name: A/C Idle Air (Alternate, Target RPM, Off in Stock)
table.description:
A/C idle air by an unidentified CAN load value and idle target rpm, for an alternate A/C idle-air path. No effect on a stock car: only used when a calibration switch is set, which is off in stock; stock uses the A/C Idle Air Steady / Initial Kick tables.
Details: When used: never in stock; with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set and cal 0x23CE9 bit 0 clear (0x07 in stock, so 05C330 would be used): A/C idle air FFF8B1A0 = max(this(FFF8A8C6, idle target FFF8B236), kick, cal 0x3539A = 712) while FFF8A9A3 bit 0 (0x0EC10C, read). Stock 356 .. 2376 base-air units, rising with FFF8A8C6. Alternate A/C idle-air path of 0x0EC10C (10 ms idle module 0x0EE338; call checked in the disassembly). Off in stock: the alternate branch, the only place these tables are read, runs only with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set (0x00 in stock); stock uses the A/C Idle Air Steady / Initial Kick tables. Row input FFF8A8C6 = cal 0x3555C (121) x received byte FFF88B91 (CAN 0x280 byte 5) / 100, capped at cal 0x35A84 (128), or cal 0x35A85 when FFF88B8E bit 0 (0x115F80, read); filtered by cal 0x353C1 while A/C (A9A3 bit 0) is on. Its physical meaning is not identified (A/C load related, inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: A/C Idle Air (Alternate, Engine Speed, Off in Stock)
table.description:
A/C idle air by an unidentified CAN load value and engine speed, for an alternate A/C idle-air path. No effect on a stock car: only used when a calibration switch is set, which is off in stock; stock uses the A/C Idle Air Steady / Initial Kick tables.
Details: When used: never in stock; with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set and cal 0x23CE9 bit 0 set (stock 0x07): A/C idle air FFF8B1A0 = max(this(FFF8A8C6, engine speed FFF8CE9C filtered by cal 0x353C2 while A/C is on), kick, cal 0x3539A) (0x0EC10C; column input checked in the disassembly at 0x0EC200..0x0EC21A, read). Stock identical to the target-rpm table. Alternate A/C idle-air path of 0x0EC10C (10 ms idle module 0x0EE338; call checked in the disassembly). Off in stock: the alternate branch, the only place these tables are read, runs only with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set (0x00 in stock); stock uses the A/C Idle Air Steady / Initial Kick tables. Row input FFF8A8C6 = cal 0x3555C (121) x received byte FFF88B91 (CAN 0x280 byte 5) / 100, capped at cal 0x35A84 (128), or cal 0x35A85 when FFF88B8E bit 0 (0x115F80, read); filtered by cal 0x353C1 while A/C (A9A3 bit 0) is on. Its physical meaning is not identified (A/C load related, inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: A/C Idle Air Initial Kick (Alternate, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Initial A/C idle air kick by an unidentified CAN code, for an alternate A/C idle-air path. No effect on a stock car: only used when a calibration switch is set, which is off in stock.
Details: When used: never in stock; with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set, while FFF8A9A3 bit 0 is set and the time since it was set is below A/C Idle Air Kick Duration: kick = this(FFF8A88A), afterwards the kick falls by cal 0x3539C (23) per 10 ms (0x0EC10C, read). FFF8A88A is a 0..6 code from received bits FFF88B8D 5-7 (CAN 0x280 byte 4 bits 5-7; 0x10E8C4 / 0x10E9C0, read; meaning not identified). Stock 0 for codes 0-3, 950 at 4, 1426 at 5-6. Alternate A/C idle-air path of 0x0EC10C (10 ms idle module 0x0EE338; call checked in the disassembly). Off in stock: the alternate branch, the only place these tables are read, runs only with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set (0x00 in stock); stock uses the A/C Idle Air Steady / Initial Kick tables. The sibling 2D tables' row input FFF8A8C6 (not used by this table) = cal 0x3555C (121) x received byte FFF88B91 (CAN 0x280 byte 5) / 100, capped at cal 0x35A84 (128), or cal 0x35A85 when FFF88B8E bit 0 (0x115F80, read); filtered by cal 0x353C1 while A/C (A9A3 bit 0) is on. Its physical meaning is not identified (A/C load related, inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: A/C Idle Air Kick Duration (Alternate, Off in Stock)
table.description:
How long the alternate A/C idle air kick is held, by an unidentified CAN code. No effect on a stock car: only used when a calibration switch is set, which is off in stock.
Details: When used: never in stock; with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set: the A/C idle-air kick (A/C Idle Air Initial Kick (Alternate)) is held while the 10 ms pass count since FFF8A9A3 bit 0 was set is below this(FFF8A88A) (0x0EC10C, read); FFF8A88A is a 0..6 code from received bits FFF88B8D 5-7 (CAN 0x280 byte 4; meaning not identified). Stock 0 for codes 0-3, 5.0 s for 4-6. Alternate A/C idle-air path of 0x0EC10C (10 ms idle module 0x0EE338; call checked in the disassembly). Off in stock: the alternate branch, the only place these tables are read, runs only with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set (0x00 in stock); stock uses the A/C Idle Air Steady / Initial Kick tables. The sibling 2D tables' row input FFF8A8C6 (not used by this table) = cal 0x3555C (121) x received byte FFF88B91 (CAN 0x280 byte 5) / 100, capped at cal 0x35A84 (128), or cal 0x35A85 when FFF88B8E bit 0 (0x115F80, read); filtered by cal 0x353C1 while A/C (A9A3 bit 0) is on. Its physical meaning is not identified (A/C load related, inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Low Voltage Idle Request Threshold (Alternator Command, Unused)
table.description:
Battery voltage threshold, by alternator command, for a low-voltage idle-up request. Unused in this ROM: its result is never read, so editing it has no effect.
Details: Unused in this ROM: 0x0F2274 (read; stack arguments checked against the push order at 0x0EF0FE..0x0EF110) compares module voltage FFF88A7E with this(alternator command FFF8B718) when cal 0x57584 bit 6 is set (else with cal 0x34EE0 = 12.0 V), while time since start FFF88A76 >= cal 0x34EE6 (10 s). Low for cal 0x34EE8 (15 s) gives cal 0x34EE2 (67), recovered after cal 0x34EE4 (300 s); the result goes only to FFF8A7F4, which nothing reads (ram_xref: one writer, no reader; its address appears only in the init 0x0ED850 and in this call). Editing it has no effect. Stock 10.7 / 11.7 / 12.5 V at commands 533 / 833 / 1200. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Feedback Map (Target MAP Offset)
table.description:
Probably the main idle speed feedback map: how much the target manifold pressure (air) is raised or cut, by rpm error from the idle target and how fast rpm is changing. Positive = more air. Larger values give a stronger correction but risk hunting. Only active while idle feedback is on.
Details: 0x0EB030 (call 0x0EB338, R5 = FFF8CEA6, R6 = rpm error; read): B144 = this(rpm change per pass FFF8CEA6, rpm error e = filtered rpm FFF8C57C - idle target FFF8B236); target MAP B24A = filtered MAP + B144/4 - 0x2000, clamped by cals 0x25346/0x25348. The velocity-form PI then drives intake flow (MAP x rpm) and MAP toward this target (0x0EB030/0x0EAE10/0x0EB710, read). Positive = more air: stock up to +0.28 psi (+1.9 kPa) when below target and falling, down to -2.90 psi (-20 kPa) when far above target and rising (read). Acts as the idle feedback gain map (inferred). Only active while idle feedback is on (FFF8A7E0 bits 2/4). p16 (read): the rpm-rate axis FFF8CEA6 is updated once per combustion event (0x07EF16, crank-synchronous, 180 deg CA); the feedback 0x0EB030 runs every 10 ms. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Feedback RPM Error Factor (Above Target)
table.description:
Scales the rpm error used by the idle feedback when rpm is above the idle target. Lower values make the feedback react less to overshoot. Stock 1.0 falling to 0.98.
Details: 0x0EB030 (call 0x0EB14C, R5 = e; read): for e = filtered rpm - target >= 0, g = this(e); for e < 0, g = cal 0x25320 (2028) or cal 0x25322 (1843) below -200 rpm (cal 0x25324). The shaped speed B224 = target + g x e/2048 feeds the proportional (flow) term; above target + 1200 rpm (cal 0x2525D x 64) B224 = rpm - cal 0x2531E instead. Stock 1.000 -> 0.980 (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Feedback Gain Multiplier (Time in Feedback)
table.description:
Multiplier on both idle feedback gains by how long idle feedback has been running with rpm near target. Stock 1.0 flat, so it has no effect.
Details: 0x0EA8EC (read): idle feedback gain B15E (4096 = 1.0, multiplies both P and I in 0x0EB030) = this(FFF8B256) when FFF8A7DB is not 1/2/3 (A7DB = 1 -> @0252F0(coolant), 2/3 -> @025C1C(coolant)). B256 counts consecutive feedback passes with |rpm - target| within 05C7C8 (80 x 64 = 1000 rpm) (0x0F33CC, read). Stock 1.0 flat. p16 (read): FFF8B256 counts 10 ms passes (0x0F33CC in module 0x0EE338). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Torque Feedback P
table.description:
Torque correction (ft-lb) for idle speed by idle target and rpm error (positive = engine too slow), used when idle is held by torque control (inferred), within about 500 rpm of the idle target. Stock cuts 5.9-15 ft-lb (8-20 Nm) at 200 rpm too fast and adds 1.1-2.6 ft-lb (1.5-3.5 Nm) at 200 rpm too slow.
Details: When used: idle limit state FFF8A638 = 2. Torque correction by idle target rpm FFF8B236 (rows) and rpm error = target - filtered rpm FFF88E3A (columns; positive = engine too slow). Stock -5.8 to -15 ft-lb (-7.8 to -20 Nm) at 200 rpm too fast, +1.1 to +2.6 ft-lb (+1.5 to +3.5 Nm) at 200 rpm too slow, 0 at no error. 0x0BA4F8 (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694 with (idle target FFF8B236, filtered rpm FFF88E3A, predicted air torque FFF8AF40, loss torque FFF8AF62, rpm FFF8CD54, vehicle speed FFF88BE8, cal 0x23704 bit 7, rpm FFF8CE9C, FFF8A64C bit 7, FFF8AF3E), read): P = Feedback P(B236, B236 - 88E3A) -> FFF8AE6E (negative part kept only while vehicle speed FFF88BE8 <= cal 0x1DCA6 (142, about 8 km/h; hysteresis 36), otherwise floored at 0 ft-lb); D = Feedback D(B236, CD54 change over 2 passes = 20 ms) -> FFF8AE70; FFF8AE62 = (P + D) x gain + (AF40 - AF62), with gain = (AF40 - 16000)/(Reference Torque(CE9C) - 16000) in stock (cal 0x22900 = 0, cal 0x23704 bit 7 clear; bit 7 set would make the gain 1.0) (read). AE62 is chosen as the torque cap FFF8AE54 by 0x0B9DC8 when the limit state FFF8A638 = 2 (read); 0x0BD684 sets state 2 while running with rpm FFF8CD62 at most about 500 rpm above the idle target B236 and its other flags clear (read), i.e. idle speed control by torque (inferred). Torque unit Nm = x/80 - 200 (16000 = 0 ft-lb). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Speed Torque Feedback D
table.description:
Torque correction (ft-lb) for idle speed by idle target and how fast rpm changed over the last 20 ms; damps rpm swings when idle is held by torque control (inferred), within about 500 rpm of the idle target. Stock adds torque on a fast rpm fall and cuts up to 66 ft-lb (90 Nm) on a fast rise.
Details: When used: idle limit state FFF8A638 = 2. Torque correction by idle target rpm FFF8B236 (rows) and the rpm change over the last 20 ms (FFF8CD54 now - two passes ago, columns; R6 at the JSR 0x0BA696 read in the disassembly). Stock up to +12 ft-lb (+16.5 Nm) for a fast rpm fall and down to -66 ft-lb (-90 Nm) for a fast rise (80 rpm per 20 ms) at targets of 600-1000 rpm; within -5.1..+1.3 ft-lb (-6.9..+1.7 Nm) at targets from 1200 rpm. 0x0BA4F8 (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694 with (idle target FFF8B236, filtered rpm FFF88E3A, predicted air torque FFF8AF40, loss torque FFF8AF62, rpm FFF8CD54, vehicle speed FFF88BE8, cal 0x23704 bit 7, rpm FFF8CE9C, FFF8A64C bit 7, FFF8AF3E), read): P = Feedback P(B236, B236 - 88E3A) -> FFF8AE6E (negative part kept only while vehicle speed FFF88BE8 <= cal 0x1DCA6 (142, about 8 km/h; hysteresis 36), otherwise floored at 0 ft-lb); D = Feedback D(B236, CD54 change over 2 passes = 20 ms) -> FFF8AE70; FFF8AE62 = (P + D) x gain + (AF40 - AF62), with gain = (AF40 - 16000)/(Reference Torque(CE9C) - 16000) in stock (cal 0x22900 = 0, cal 0x23704 bit 7 clear; bit 7 set would make the gain 1.0) (read). AE62 is chosen as the torque cap FFF8AE54 by 0x0B9DC8 when the limit state FFF8A638 = 2 (read); 0x0BD684 sets state 2 while running with rpm FFF8CD62 at most about 500 rpm above the idle target B236 and its other flags clear (read), i.e. idle speed control by torque (inferred). Torque unit Nm = x/80 - 200 (16000 = 0 ft-lb). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Speed Torque Feedback Reference Torque
table.description:
Reference torque by rpm that scales the idle torque feedback (P and D): a larger value gives a smaller correction. Must not be set to 0 ft-lb, which zeroes the feedback. Stock 15-19 ft-lb (20-26 Nm).
Details: When used: idle limit state FFF8A638 = 2. Reference torque by rpm FFF8CE9C that normalises the feedback gain: gain = (predicted air torque AF40 - 16000)/(this - 16000) (read), so a larger value gives a smaller P+D correction. 16000 (0 ft-lb) would zero the gain. Stock +15 to +19 ft-lb (+20.0 to +26.1 Nm). 0x0BA4F8 (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694 with (idle target FFF8B236, filtered rpm FFF88E3A, predicted air torque FFF8AF40, loss torque FFF8AF62, rpm FFF8CD54, vehicle speed FFF88BE8, cal 0x23704 bit 7, rpm FFF8CE9C, FFF8A64C bit 7, FFF8AF3E), read): P = Feedback P(B236, B236 - 88E3A) -> FFF8AE6E (negative part kept only while vehicle speed FFF88BE8 <= cal 0x1DCA6 (142, about 8 km/h; hysteresis 36), otherwise floored at 0 ft-lb); D = Feedback D(B236, CD54 change over 2 passes = 20 ms) -> FFF8AE70; FFF8AE62 = (P + D) x gain + (AF40 - AF62), with gain = (AF40 - 16000)/(Reference Torque(CE9C) - 16000) in stock (cal 0x22900 = 0, cal 0x23704 bit 7 clear; bit 7 set would make the gain 1.0) (read). AE62 is chosen as the torque cap FFF8AE54 by 0x0B9DC8 when the limit state FFF8A638 = 2 (read); 0x0BD684 sets state 2 while running with rpm FFF8CD62 at most about 500 rpm above the idle target B236 and its other flags clear (read), i.e. idle speed control by torque (inferred). Torque unit Nm = x/80 - 200 (16000 = 0 ft-lb). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Feedback Carry-Over Decay (Positive)
table.description:
How fast the idle feedback air kept when leaving idle is bled off, by rpm change rate; this acts like a dashpot (inferred). Larger = faster release. Stock holds it while rpm is falling quickly and releases slowly near steady rpm.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running and the carry-over FFF8B174 is positive. Input FFF8CEA6 (smoothed rpm change per combustion event). Stock: 0 (held) while rpm falls by 40 rpm per event or more, 3.5 base-air units per pass near steady rpm, up to 23.5 with rpm rising 100 rpm per event. 0x0EAC1C (read; called from the 10 ms idle module 0x0EE338 with FFF8906B, B180, A7E0 bit 4, FFF8CEA6, FFF88A3C): in the pass where idle speed feedback switches off (FFF8A7E0 bit 4 falls), the feedback air B180 is added to the carry-over FFF8B174 (clamped -2375..4751 by cals 0x25730/0x25732) and copied to B178. B174 then enters the idle air at half weight next to B180 (B1FE = (2 x B200 + B180 + B174) x F/64, 0x0F0A90) and decays every pass: a positive carry-over falls by Idle Feedback Carry-Over Decay (Positive) and may not exceed B178 x Idle Feedback Carry-Over Limit (Positive)/255; a negative one rises by the (Negative) decay and may not go below B178 x the (Negative) limit/255 (read). So the air the feedback had added when the driver leaves idle is kept and released gradually (dashpot-like, inferred). Engine state 3 only. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Feedback Carry-Over Decay (Negative)
table.description:
How fast a negative leftover of idle feedback air is released after leaving idle, by rpm change rate. Larger = cancels sooner. Stock cancels it at once when rpm is dropping fast.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running and the carry-over FFF8B174 is negative. Input FFF8CEA6. Stock 1188 base-air units per pass (cancels at once) while rpm falls by 80 rpm per event or more, 118 at -60, 59 at -40, 9.5 from -20 rpm per event. 0x0EAC1C (read; called from the 10 ms idle module 0x0EE338 with FFF8906B, B180, A7E0 bit 4, FFF8CEA6, FFF88A3C): in the pass where idle speed feedback switches off (FFF8A7E0 bit 4 falls), the feedback air B180 is added to the carry-over FFF8B174 (clamped -2375..4751 by cals 0x25730/0x25732) and copied to B178. B174 then enters the idle air at half weight next to B180 (B1FE = (2 x B200 + B180 + B174) x F/64, 0x0F0A90) and decays every pass: a positive carry-over falls by Idle Feedback Carry-Over Decay (Positive) and may not exceed B178 x Idle Feedback Carry-Over Limit (Positive)/255; a negative one rises by the (Negative) decay and may not go below B178 x the (Negative) limit/255 (read). So the air the feedback had added when the driver leaves idle is kept and released gradually (dashpot-like, inferred). Engine state 3 only. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Learn Filter Gain (Before First Transfer)
table.description:
Long-term idle learning speed used after an idle-learn reset until the first learned value has been stored. Stock fast (0.1) for the first 0.9 s, then slow (0.001).
Details: 0x0ED288 (read; R5 = FFF8145E for all three lookups, checked in the disassembly): long-term idle learn filter FFF8145C += (B1C6 slot learning + B1D0 + offset - FFF8145C) x this/65536, while learning is on (FFF8A7E0 bit5). Axis FFF8145E = learn passes since the last transfer (0x0ED46C; reset when 0x0ED3E0 transfers at the end of a drive: FFF8145A steps -95/+166 when FFF8145C passes -238/+238). Used while FFF811D4 bit0 is clear (set by the first transfer, cleared by the idle-learn reset 0x0EA984). Stock 0.1 up to 0.9 s, 0.001 from 1.0 s. p16 (read): 0x0ED288 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338); the gain is per 10 ms pass and the axis is shown in seconds of learning since the last transfer (1 pass = 0.01 s). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Learn Filter Gain (A/C Off)
table.description:
How fast the long-term idle air learning follows the current correction with the A/C off, by time since the last learning transfer. Larger = learns faster but less stable. Stock 0.002 per 10 ms pass (A/C meaning inferred).
Details: 0x0ED288 (read; R5 = FFF8145E for all three lookups, checked in the disassembly): long-term idle learn filter FFF8145C += (B1C6 slot learning + B1D0 + offset - FFF8145C) x this/65536, while learning is on (FFF8A7E0 bit5). Axis FFF8145E = learn passes since the last transfer (0x0ED46C; reset when 0x0ED3E0 transfers at the end of a drive: FFF8145A steps -95/+166 when FFF8145C passes -238/+238). Used when FFF811D4 bit0 is set and FFF8A9A2 bit6 (A/C, inferred) is clear. Stock 0.002, with 0.1 at exactly 1.00 s (one 10 ms pass). p16 (read): 0x0ED288 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338); the gain is per 10 ms pass and the axis is shown in seconds of learning since the last transfer (1 pass = 0.01 s). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Learn Filter Gain (A/C On)
table.description:
How fast the long-term idle air learning follows the current correction with the A/C on, by time since the last learning transfer. Larger = learns faster but less stable. Stock 0.001 flat (A/C meaning inferred).
Details: 0x0ED288 (read; R5 = FFF8145E for all three lookups, checked in the disassembly): long-term idle learn filter FFF8145C += (B1C6 slot learning + B1D0 + offset - FFF8145C) x this/65536, while learning is on (FFF8A7E0 bit5). Axis FFF8145E = learn passes since the last transfer (0x0ED46C; reset when 0x0ED3E0 transfers at the end of a drive: FFF8145A steps -95/+166 when FFF8145C passes -238/+238). Used when FFF811D4 bit0 is set and FFF8A9A2 bit6 (A/C, inferred) is set. Stock 0.001 flat. p16 (read): 0x0ED288 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338); the gain is per 10 ms pass and the axis is shown in seconds of learning since the last transfer (1 pass = 0.01 s). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Learn Bias Index Step
table.description:
How the drive-history index for Idle Learn Bias moves every 2 s, by vehicle speed (only with coolant at or above 80 degC). Stock negative at standstill (counts towards 'long idling'), positive from 20 km/h.
Details: When used: every 2 s while running with coolant at or above 80 degC. Stock -7 at standstill, -3 at 10 km/h, 0 at 11-19, +5 at 20, +20 at 30, +25 at 40, +30 from 50 km/h. 0x0ED4BC (read; called from 0x0EE338 with coolant FFF88A44 and vehicle speed FFF99835): every cal 0x25ADC (200) passes (2 s) the drive-history index FFF8B1D2 is updated: below 50 km/h (cal 0x25AEA) it moves by Idle Learn Bias Index Step(speed); from 50 km/h it becomes max(index, cal 0x25AE6 = 1000) + step; it is held at 1000 while coolant is below cal 0x25ADA (80 degC, unsigned compare read in the disassembly) and limited to 0..cal 0x25AE8 (1700). B1D0 = Idle Learn Bias(B1D2) (input register checked at 0x0ED586) is added to the target of the long-term idle learning filter 8145C = filter(B1C6 + B1D0 + offset) in 0x0ED288, which steps the learned idle air FFF8145A (half weight in the idle air, TE.md) (read). So long idling lowers, and sustained driving raises, the learned idle air (purpose, e.g. heat soak, inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Learn Bias
table.description:
Offset added to the long-term idle air learning by a drive-history index: long idling pushes the learned idle air down, sustained driving pushes it up (purpose, e.g. heat soak, inferred). Stock -238 to +238 base-air units, 0 in the middle. Index movement is set by Idle Learn Bias Index Step.
Details: When used: every 2 s update; enters the long-term idle learning target continuously. Stock -238 base-air units at index 0 (long idling), 0 from 400 to 1200 (1000 = neutral start value), +238 from 1700. 0x0ED4BC (read; called from 0x0EE338 with coolant FFF88A44 and vehicle speed FFF99835): every cal 0x25ADC (200) passes (2 s) the drive-history index FFF8B1D2 is updated: below 50 km/h (cal 0x25AEA) it moves by Idle Learn Bias Index Step(speed); from 50 km/h it becomes max(index, cal 0x25AE6 = 1000) + step; it is held at 1000 while coolant is below cal 0x25ADA (80 degC, unsigned compare read in the disassembly) and limited to 0..cal 0x25AE8 (1700). B1D0 = Idle Learn Bias(B1D2) (input register checked at 0x0ED586) is added to the target of the long-term idle learning filter 8145C = filter(B1C6 + B1D0 + offset) in 0x0ED288, which steps the learned idle air FFF8145A (half weight in the idle air, TE.md) (read). So long idling lowers, and sustained driving raises, the learned idle air (purpose, e.g. heat soak, inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate (TGV Open)
table.description:
Main EGR rate target (% of intake charge, probably external EGR) by rpm and load while the TGVs are open. 0 = no EGR. Stock up to about 13 % at 0.39-0.78 g/rev (30-60 % load), 0 at very light load and above 1.55 g/rev (120 % load). Capped by EGR Target Rate Maximum.
Details: When used: TGVs not closed and single injection (FFF8A775 bit 1 clear, the stock case); cal 0x2F797 bit 5 clear (stock). Base target EGR rate A818, looked up by 0x0FA10C with rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616 (read, disassembly). Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). 0 = no EGR. Stock: up to 12.8 % (TGV open) / 20.2 % (TGV closed) at 0.39-0.78 g/rev (30-60 % load), 1 count (0.2 %) at some higher loads, 0 at 0.13-0.26 g/rev (10-20 % load) and above 1.55 g/rev (120 % load). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate (TGV Closed)
table.description:
Main EGR rate target (% of intake charge, probably external EGR) by rpm and load while the TGVs are closed. 0 = no EGR. Raising it adds more exhaust gas at light load. Stock up to about 20 % at 0.39-0.78 g/rev (30-60 % load), 0 at very light load and above 1.55 g/rev (120 % load). Capped by EGR Target Rate Maximum.
Details: When used: TGVs closed and single injection (FFF8A775 bit 1 clear, the stock case); cal 0x2F797 bit 5 clear (stock). Base target EGR rate A818, looked up by 0x0FA10C with rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616 (read, disassembly). Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). 0 = no EGR. Stock: up to 12.8 % (TGV open) / 20.2 % (TGV closed) at 0.39-0.78 g/rev (30-60 % load), 1 count (0.2 %) at some higher loads, 0 at 0.13-0.26 g/rev (10-20 % load) and above 1.55 g/rev (120 % load). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Maximum
table.description:
Hard cap on the target EGR rate. Stock 30 %.
Details: Cap on the target EGR rate FFF8A81A (0x0FA260 and 0x0F9CB8, read). Stock 192 = 30 %. Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Coolant Multiplier
table.description:
Multiplier (255 = 1.0) by coolant on the target EGR rate. Stock 0 at 5 degC and below (no EGR when cold), 0.53 at 40 degC, 0.63 at 60 degC, 0.8 at 75 degC, 1.0 from 80 degC.
Details: Multiplier on the target EGR rate (0x0FA260, coolant FFF88A44, read), 255 = x1.0. Stock: 0 at 5 degC and below (no EGR when cold), 0.53 at 40 degC, 0.80 at 70 degC, 1.0 from 80 degC (read values). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate DAM Multiplier
table.description:
Multiplier (128 = 1.0) on the target EGR rate by the knock learning value (probably DAM). Stock flat 1.0, so it has no effect; lowering it would cut EGR when DAM drops.
Details: Multiplier on the target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read), indexed by FFF811AE (DAM x 16, inferred), 128 = x1.0. Stock flat 128 (no effect). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Reduction Multiplier
table.description:
Multiplier (255 = 1.0) by rpm and load that reduces the target EGR rate while an unidentified module requests it and EGR flow is present. Stock 0.45-0.8 at 1200-2000 rpm and 0.52-0.91 g/rev (40-70 % load), 1.0 elsewhere. When the request is active is not known.
Details: 0x0FA584 (read): A81C = 255 (x1.0) while the EGR flow FFF8B2A6 is below cal 0x2CD08 (500 = 0.33 g/s); with flow at or above it A81C holds its previous value, and while FFF8AA85 bits 6 and 5 are both set (from module 0x13BD40, not identified) it falls by cal 0x2CE66 (64) per pass down to this table's value (rpm FFF8CE9C x load FFF8A616, read disassembly). A81C multiplies the target EGR rate (0x0FA260). 255 = x1.0. Stock: 0.45-0.80 at 1200-2000 rpm, 0.52-0.91 g/rev (40-70 % load), 1.0 elsewhere. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Enable Minimum Air after Start
table.description:
Amount of air (probably the air drawn since start), by coolant at start, that must pass before EGR is enabled. Stock all 0, so no delay.
Details: 0x0FAAFC (read): EGR is enabled only while this(coolant at start FFF89224, latched from FFF88E20 by 0x082DE0) <= FFF81818, a 32-bit sum of FFF8B4D6 x 256 / FFF8A64B accumulated since start by 0x10A270 (read; meaning of the sum inferred: air since start). Stock all 0 (no delay). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Enable RPM Maximum
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when rpm is at or below this. Stock no limit.
Details: 0x0FAAFC: EGR enable needs rpm FFF8CE9C <= this (plus cal 0x2C4E0 once met) (read). Stock 65535 (no limit). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable Load Maximum
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when load is at or below this. Stock 250 %, i.e. no limit (the target tables are already 0 at high load).
Details: 0x0FAAFC: with cal 0x2F797 bit 6 set (stock) EGR enable also needs load FFF8A616 <= this (plus cal 0x2C4E4 once met) (read). Stock 250 % (no limit; the target tables are 0 at high load). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable Exhaust Pressure Margin
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when the estimated pressure upstream of the EGR valve exceeds manifold pressure by at least this much, so exhaust gas can actually flow. Stock 5 kPa.
Details: 0x0FAAFC (read): EGR enable needs MAP (kPa) + this <= EGR Upstream Pressure Estimate FFF8A81D x 2/3 (kPa), i.e. the estimated upstream pressure must exceed MAP by this margin (cal 0x2CCD2 hysteresis). Stock 5 kPa. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Active Threshold
table.description:
Target EGR rate above which EGR counts as active, which switches ignition to the Base Timing (EGR Active) tables. Stock 3 %. See EGR Active Threshold Hysteresis for the switch-off point.
Details: 0x0FB028 (read): FFF8A813 bit 7 ('EGR active') = EGR enabled (FFF8A811 bit 0) and target rate FFF8A81A >= this >> 1; it selects the Base Timing (EGR Active ...) tables. Stock 38 = 19/640 = 3.0 %. The 'Closed Loop Target (... EGR Active)' choice uses the flow FFF8B2A6 >= cal 0x2DE6C instead. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Active Threshold Hysteresis
table.description:
How far below EGR Active Threshold the target EGR rate must fall before EGR counts as inactive again. Stock gives off below about 2.5 %.
Details: 0x0FB028 (read): once active, EGR stays active until FFF8A81A < (EGR Active Threshold - this) >> 1. Stock 6, so off below (38-6)>>1 = 16 = 2.5 %. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Flow Coolant Multiplier
table.description:
Multiplier (128 = 1.0) by coolant and load on the target EGR flow that drives the valve. Stock 0 at 5 degC and below, partial from 20 degC, 1.0 at 80 degC.
Details: 0x0F9F14 (read): target EGR flow FFF8B296 = filtered (target-rate flow FFF8B298) x this / 128, by coolant FFF88A44 x load FFF8A616; FFF8B298 = fresh air x 5 x r/(1-r) from the target rate (0x0F9FE4). B296 drives the valve (feed-forward 05CB1C and the flow feedback). 128 = x1.0. Stock: 0 at 5 degC and below, 0.15-0.9 from 20 degC, 1.0 at 80 degC. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Valve Position from Target Flow
table.description:
Feed-forward EGR valve position (steps) for a target EGR flow; feedback is added on top. Stock is the inverse of the last row of EGR Valve Flow Model: keep the two consistent.
Details: Feed-forward valve position FFF8B29E = this(target EGR flow FFF8B296) (0x0FA4B8, read); the command FFF8B2A0 = this + the flow-feedback integral FFF8B294, clamped 0..114 steps (0x0FA4E0, read). Stock it is the inverse of the last row of EGR Valve Flow Model (0 g/s at 0 steps, 23.95 g/s at 114 steps). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Valve Flow Model
table.description:
Estimated EGR flow by pressure difference across the valve and valve position. Used both for the actual EGR flow estimate and for the flow feedback, so edits change both. Change only if the valve or plumbing differs from stock.
Details: Estimated EGR flow through the valve by pressure difference FFF8A810 (estimated upstream pressure - MAP) and valve position (read): 0x0FA830 looks it up at the actual position (FFF88A1C << 7) into FFF8B2A6 (used for the actual EGR rate, the Closed Loop Target 'EGR Active' choice at >= 1000 = 0.67 g/s and other modules), and 0x0FA034 looks up the same data (descriptor 05C9F4, identical bytes) at the commanded position into FFF8B29A, which the flow feedback compares with the target. Edits here change both. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Valve Flow Feedback Integral Step
table.description:
How fast the EGR valve feedback corrects position, by the error between target and modelled flow. Positive opens the valve. Larger = faster correction, more risk of hunting.
Details: 0x0F9E10 (read): each pass the valve integral FFF8B294 += this(previous target flow - flow at commanded position) >> 7, frozen against the end stops (0 and 114 steps) and limited to cal 0x2CC6E..0x2CC70 (-50..+90 steps). Signed: positive opens the valve. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). p16 (read): EGR module 0x0F94A8 runs every 10 ms (0x07C408 <- 0x1DFE3C). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Valve Feedback Integral Minimum
table.description:
Lower limit of the EGR valve flow-feedback correction (how far feedback may close the valve below feed-forward). Stock -50 steps.
Details: Lower bound of the valve flow-feedback integral FFF8B294 (0x0F9E10, read). Stock -6400 = -50 steps. Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Target Rate (TGV Open, Multi-Injection, Off in Stock)
table.description:
EGR rate target by rpm and load with the TGVs open and multiple injections per cycle. Probably no effect on a stock car: stock appears to always run one injection per cycle, so EGR Target Rate (TGV Open) is used.
Details: When used: TGVs not closed and multi-injection active (FFF8A775 bit 1); cal 0x2F797 bit 5 clear (stock). Base target EGR rate A818, looked up by 0x0FA10C with rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616 (read, disassembly). Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). Multi-injection = FFF8A775 bit 1, set by 0x0FAABC when the multi-injection enable FFF8A775 bit 0 is set and all four per-injector strategy bytes FFF8A69F..A6A2 are 2 or 3 (read); stock always runs one injection per cycle (my research notes), so these variants are not used in stock (inferred). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). 0 = no EGR. Stock: up to 12.8 % (TGV open) / 20.2 % (TGV closed) at 0.39-0.78 g/rev (30-60 % load), 1 count (0.2 %) at some higher loads, 0 at 0.13-0.26 g/rev (10-20 % load) and above 1.55 g/rev (120 % load). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate (Alternate, TGV Open, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Alternate EGR rate target by rpm and throttle position (instead of load) with the TGVs open. No effect on a stock car: only used when a calibration switch is set, which is off in stock.
Details: When used: only when cal 0x2F797 bit 5 is set (clear in stock, so unused). Alternate base target EGR rate A818 (0x0FA10C, read), indexed by rpm FFF8CD54 and throttle position FFF8CD77 (about 0.56 % per count, see below) instead of load. Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). p16 (read): second axis FFF8CD77 = (ETC throttle position FFF8A342 - 10)/4 = (ETC actual position FFF8A2B6 - 1000)/256 (0x09D58E, 0x09DAAE, 0x0A0680, 0x06AB94): a throttle-position byte, about 0.56 % per count (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Tip-Out Limit (TGV Open, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Cap on the target EGR rate for a short time after a pedal tip-out (inferred), by rpm and load, TGVs open. No effect on a stock car: the tip-out function is switched off by a calibration setting, and stock has no limit anyway.
Details: When used: never in stock - the transient flag FFF8A811 bit 7 (0x0FA884) needs cal 0x2D2AD = 0x5A ('Z'), and stock is 1 (read). Transient cap A819 (0x0FA1F8, rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616, read): while the flag is set, the ramped target A817 = min(this, base target) for EGR Tip-Out Limit Duration passes, then ramps back up by cal 0x2D6CE per pass (0x0FA068, read). The flag is set when FFF8AF00 (pedal, per my research notes) is at or below cal 0x2D2A8 and has fallen by at least cal 0x2D2AA against a sample from cal 0x2D2AC passes earlier (read), i.e. a pedal tip-out (inferred). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). Stock 250 everywhere (no limit). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Tip-Out Limit Duration (Off in Stock)
table.description:
How long, by manifold pressure, the EGR tip-out cap is held after a pedal tip-out. No effect on a stock car: the tip-out function is switched off by a calibration setting.
Details: When used: never in stock (see EGR Target Rate Tip-Out Limit). 0x0FA068 (read): looked up with FFF8869C (copy of MAP FFF88A34, read) on the rising edge of the tip-out flag; while the flag counter FFF8B2A8 is below it, the target is held at the tip-out limit. Stock 8. p16 (read): EGR module 0x0F94A8 runs every 10 ms (0x07C408 <- 0x1DFE3C). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Timing Advance (Multi-Injection, TGV Closed, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Multi-injection copy of EGR Timing Advance (TGV Closed). Normally unused in stock because the multi-injection modes are disabled; stock data identical to the single-injection table.
Details: When used: only while FFF8A775 bit 2 is set (every injector in a 2- or 3-injection strategy; the multi-injection windows are disabled in stock, so normally unused). TGV-closed side. 0x0DC97C / 0x0DD0DC (read): while EGR is active (FFF8A813 bit 7) the advance = EGR realisation ratio FFF8B290/256 x on/off fade (05B950/05B95C/05B968 or 05BA04/05BA10/05BA1C by rpm, 255 in stock) x [(1 - v) x (TGV Closed table) + v x (TGV Open table) + DAM-weighted pair (05B988/05B9B0 or 05BA3C/05BA64, scaled by 05B9C4/05BA78(DAM)/128 = 0 in stock)], v = TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8, each table read as x/2 - 64 degrees; stored as 2 x deg + 128 in FFF8A763 (single injection) / FFF8A767. FFF8A769 = FFF8A767 when FFF8A775 bit 2 is set (all four injectors in a 2- or 3-injection strategy, 0x0FAABC), else FFF8A763 (0x0DD454, read). FFF8A769 enters the timing request FFF8A78A (0x0E0A30) and the alternate final-timing value FFF8A733 of 0x0D9E40 (used only with cal 0x239AE bit 1 set, clear in stock) (read). Through the request it reaches the fired timing wherever Primary Ignition + this + KCA + FLKC is below the Base Timing (EGR Active) map: 0x0C13B4 -> FFF8AF22 -> 0x0C39DC / 0x0DD568 give fired base = min(Base Timing + comps, request + KCA + FLKC) (read; min() form computed). It can never lift the fired timing above the Base Timing (EGR Active) maps. Axes rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8ADE4 (400-6400 rpm, 10-240 %; rows above 32768 are padding). Stock identical to EGR Timing Advance (TGV Closed). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Timing Advance (Multi-Injection, TGV Open, Off in Stock)
table.description:

Details: When used: only while FFF8A775 bit 2 is set (see the TGV Closed table; normally unused in stock). table.name: TGV Torque Threshold Enter (Drive Modes 1/4, Default/Sport Sharp)
table.description:
Main requested-torque threshold, by rpm, below which the TGVs may close (drive modes 1 and 4, the default); they reopen above the matching Exit table. Coolant and air-flow conditions also apply. Stock 59 ft-lb (80 Nm) at 400 rpm, 144 ft-lb (195 Nm) peak at 2000 rpm, 0 from 5200 rpm.
Details: When used: Selected in 0x10D93C by drive mode FFF8A8C1: A for modes 1 (default), 4 and 0 (read). TGV request logic 0x10D93C (read): the request byte FFF8A888 is 3 unless all of these hold: coolant FFF88A44 at or above TGV Coolant Minimum (hysteresis cal 0x37B46 - 16384, stock 409 = 1 C), requested torque FFF8AEE2 (0x0BA868, Nm = x/80 - 200) below the rpm-based TGV Torque Threshold (it must fall below the Enter table and then rise above the Exit table to clear), air quantity FFF8B4D6 below TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter 0x37A4A, Exit 0x37A48), and FFF8A88D = 0. When they hold, FFF8A888 = 1, or 2 if the intake air temperature FFF88A48 is below TGV IAT Threshold (vehicle speed) or FFF88E28 bit 0/2 is set; FFF8A888 = 2 also while combustion mode FFF8A85C is below cal 0x37B48. State 1 requests TGV close: it runs the timer FFF8B3E0 (0x10C3D0) and FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is set once the timer reaches TGV Close Delay (05D384, by vehicle speed; stock 1 s at standstill, 2 s from 4 km/h). States 2 (close blocked: cold intake air, FFF88E28 bit 0/2, or combustion mode below cal 0x37B48) and 3 (close conditions not met) reset the timer, so the TGVs stay open (read). Which threshold pair is used depends on FFF8A8C1 (1, 2, 3 or other) and FFF8A8A2 bit 5 (not identified). table.name: TGV Close Delay
table.description:

table.name: TGV Open Fraction from Position (Closing)
table.description:
Converts measured TGV position into the open fraction used to blend every TGV-open / TGV-closed table (fuel, timing, AVCS) while the TGVs are closing; the blend also cannot fall faster than about 0.5 s from open to closed. Stock identical to the Opening table: keep them consistent.

The fueling, ignition and AVCS blends then move to their TGV-closed tables. Stock 0 % at or below 213, 100 % at 901. Confidence: read.

table.name: TGV Open Fraction from Position (Opening)
table.description:
Converts measured TGV position into the open fraction used to blend every TGV-open / TGV-closed table (fuel, timing, AVCS) while the TGVs are opening; the blend ramps at about 1 s from closed to open unless the valves open faster. Stock identical to the Closing table: keep them consistent.
Details: When used: while FFF8A881 bit 4 is clear (TGVs commanded open). 0x10C948 (read): the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 (0 = closed, 65535 = open; the blend weight for every TGV closed/open table pair) rises by cal 0x379EC (655) per 10 ms pass, about 1 s from closed to open, and is never below this table of the filtered average position of the two TGV sensors (FFF88AA6 / FFF88AA8, filter cal 0x37A14): output = max(this(position), previous + 655). Confidence: read.

table.name: TGV Motor Duty Compensation

table.name: TGV Drive Duty (Opening)

table.name: TGV Torque Threshold Exit (Start Modes, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Exit threshold paired with TGV Torque Threshold Enter (Start Modes). No effect on a stock car: the setting that selects it is 0 in stock, so it is never used.
Details: When used: Never used in stock (cal 0x37B4A = 0, read). TGV request logic 0x10D93C (read): the request byte FFF8A888 is 3 unless all of these hold: coolant FFF88A44 at or above TGV Coolant Minimum (hysteresis cal 0x37B46 - 16384, stock 409 = 1 C), requested torque FFF8AEE2 (0x0BA868, Nm = x/80 - 200) below the rpm-based TGV Torque Threshold (it must fall below the Enter table and then rise above the Exit table to clear), air quantity FFF8B4D6 below TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter 0x37A4A, Exit 0x37A48), and FFF8A88D = 0. When they hold, FFF8A888 = 1, or 2 if the intake air temperature FFF88A48 is below TGV IAT Threshold (vehicle speed) or FFF88E28 bit 0/2 is set; FFF8A888 = 2 also while combustion mode FFF8A85C is below cal 0x37B48. State 1 requests TGV close: it runs the timer FFF8B3E0 (0x10C3D0) and FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is set once the timer reaches TGV Close Delay (05D384, by vehicle speed; stock 1 s at standstill, 2 s from 4 km/h). States 2 (close blocked: cold intake air, FFF88E28 bit 0/2, or combustion mode below cal 0x37B48) and 3 (close conditions not met) reset the timer, so the TGVs stay open (read). Which threshold pair is used depends on FFF8A8C1 (1, 2, 3 or other) and FFF8A8A2 bit 5 (not identified). Each threshold is table(rpm FFF8CE9C) + TGV Torque Threshold Offset(rpm, FFF88AE6) - 16000, so the offset table is centred on 16000 (0 ft-lb). Pairs with TGV Torque Threshold Enter (Start Modes, Off in Stock). Confidence: read.

table.name: Cruise Pedal Equivalent (Other Drive Modes)
table.description:
Converts the cruise control torque request into a pedal-position equivalent by torque and rpm; while cruise is active the ECU uses the higher of this and the real pedal. Used in the default drive mode (cruise meaning inferred). Stock 0 % at 0 ft-lb, 100 % from 258 ft-lb (350 Nm). table.name: Cruise Maximum Speed (km/h Meter)
table.description:
Upper cruise speed by meter (market) code; the name 'maximum cruise speed' is inferred from the values. The ECU picks one of six tables by meter units (km/h or mph, inferred) and a cruise option flag from the meter. This is the standard km/h version. Stock 114 km/h for codes 0/1, 145 for 2/3, 250 for the rest.
Details: Cruise module 0x165AC4/0x1663AC, 20 ms task (read). Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16C1A0 (read): FFF8B9F0 = one of six tables by meter code FFF8A88C. B9F0 is the upper cruise speed: the tap logic 0x16D068 and the gain selection in 0x16AF7C compare the speed with it (read); 'maximum cruise speed' inferred from the values. Selection: FFF811E1 b4 clear -> 05EFE0 (FFF8A8A7 b0 clear) / 05EFEC (b0 set); b4 set and FFF8AB40 b2 clear -> 05EFB0 / 05EFBC; b4 and AB40 b2 set -> 05EFC8 / 05EFD4. FFF8A8A7 b0 comes from CAN (0x119EF8); the standard b0-set table 05EFEC holds whole-mph values (71 / 90 mph) where 05EFE0 holds whole km/h (114 / 145 km/h), so b0 = meter in mph (inferred); the Meter Cruise Option b0-set tables 05EFBC / 05EFD4 hold the same whole-km/h values as their km/h twins (114 / 145 / 200 km/h = 70.8 / 90.1 / 124.3 mph), so with that option the ECU uses the same km/h limits whatever the meter unit (read). FFF811E1 b4 is a latched CAN flag from the meter frame 0x282 byte 7 bit 0 (0x119B54, read; called Meter Cruise Option elsewhere). Stock 114 km/h for codes 0/1, 145 km/h for 2/3, 250 km/h for 4-15. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Set Speed Ramp While Accelerating
table.description:
How fast the cruise target speed rises, by speed, while the raise (accelerate) switch is held. Stock about 2.3 km/h per second up to 120 km/h, a little slower above.
Details: Cruise module 0x165AC4/0x1663AC, 20 ms task (read). Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16AAE0 (read): while an accelerate request is held (FFF88E11 b5, or b4 from the raise switch, still set from the previous pass) the cruise target FFF8B9DE = min(max set speed FFF8B9EC, max(target + this, speed + this)) every pass; this(cruise speed FFF8B9F4). Stock 6 counts (2.3 km/h per s, 1.5 mph/s) up to 120 km/h, 5 at 130-140, 4 (1.6 km/h per s) at 150 km/h. On the first pass of a request the step is 05EDEC (10 km/h above the current speed, not defined here); lowering uses 05EDE0/05EDD4. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Torque Limit Offset
table.description:
Torque margin by rpm that caps the cruise control torque request above a base torque value, limiting how hard cruise can drive the engine. One table edits all three copies (including the monitor copy). Stock about 190 ft-lb (258 Nm) at low rpm falling to about 96 ft-lb (130 Nm) at high rpm.
Details: Cruise module 0x165AC4/0x1663AC, 20 ms task (read). Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16BD54 (read): while cruise is controlling (FFF8AB40 b5) the cruise torque request FFF8B9E2 = min(controller torque, FFF8AE72 + this(rpm FFF8CD5C) - 16000), i.e. this table is a torque margin in Nm above FFF8AE72 (= AF64 - AF62, 0x0BAE68). 0x16AF7C writes the same sum to FFF8B9E0 (no reader found). FFF8B9E2 drives the cruise pedal equivalent (05ED14 etc.) and replaces the driver request in 0x0BB53C. Descriptors 05EF20 (0x16BD54) and 05FBBC (monitor copy 0x18B3EC) read the same data 0x04071C, so this one entry edits all three. Stock 0 ft-lb at 0 rpm, 190 ft-lb (258 Nm) at 400-800 rpm, 166 ft-lb (226 Nm) at 1200, 146 ft-lb (197 Nm) at 1600, 117-120 ft-lb (158-162 Nm) at 2000-3200, 107 ft-lb (145 Nm) at 3600, 104 ft-lb (140 Nm) at 4000, 93-99 ft-lb (126-135 Nm) at 4400-6000 rpm. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Speed Error Gain (Default)
table.description:

table.name: Cruise Integrator Preset (Engage)
table.description:
Value the cruise controller's integral term is preset to when cruise starts controlling or returns to holding speed, by speed and acceleration. Stock nonzero only for gentle deceleration, larger at higher speed.

Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16AF7C (read): the controller integrator FFF86B48 is preset to (feed-forward + this(speed FFF8B9F4, acceleration FFF8B9C2) x 0.025) / 2 on the pass cruise control starts controlling (FFF8AB40 b5 rising) and on the change from state 0xCF to the hold state 0x33. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Integrator Preset (After Tap)
table.description:
Value the cruise controller's integral term is preset to after a set-speed switch tap, by speed and acceleration, so speed settles smoothly. Stock positive when decelerating, negative when accelerating, 0 near steady speed.

Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16AF7C (read): the controller integrator FFF86B48 is preset to (feed-forward + this(speed FFF8B9F4, acceleration FFF8B9C2) x 0.025) / 2 on the change from state 0x23 to 0x33 (enabled by cal 0x3F850 b3 = 1) and from 0xB0 to 0x33 (cal 0x3F850 b4 = 1). table.name: Cruise Vehicle Speed from CAN Speed
table.description:
Converts the CAN vehicle speed into the speed used by cruise control, per meter (market) code, as a straight line (scale and offset). The offsets probably make the set speed match the speedometer. Stock 1.0 x speed for most codes, up to 1.048 x + 1.8 km/h.
Details: Cruise module 0x165AC4/0x1663AC, 20 ms task (read). Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16C2D0 (read): while FFF88E28 b0 and the VDC CAN fault FFF88BF9 b0 are clear and FFF88B94 b2 is set, the cruise speed FFF8B9F4 = filter(this(meter code FFF8A88C, CAN speed FFF8B4C2), weight 05F054); otherwise B9F4 = cal 0x4073C (10 km/h). The column axis is 0 and 5333 (300 km/h) followed by 14 points just above 300 km/h (5334-5347) holding the same values, so each row is a straight line: speed x k + offset (edit columns 2-16 together). Stock row 0 (and 7, 10, 11, 13-15) = 1.000 x speed; row 1 1.048 x + 1.8 km/h; rows 2/3 0.997 x + 1.0 km/h; rows 4-6, 8, 12 1.036 x + 1.9 km/h; row 9 1.016 x + 2.7 km/h. The row offsets look like speedometer corrections so the set speed matches the meter (inferred). Above 300 km/h the last column holds. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Vehicle Speed Filter Weight
table.description:
Smoothing weight for the vehicle speed used by cruise control, by speed error and speed. Larger = less smoothing, quicker reaction. Stock 0.3 at zero error up to 0.8 at 0.4 km/h error; 0.25 at 200 km/h.
Details: Cruise module 0x165AC4/0x1663AC, 20 ms task (read). Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16C2D0 (read): first-order filter (0x6CEC) of 05F040's output into FFF8B9F4 with this weight. Axis 1 = FFF8B9C4 = speed - cruise target while cruise is controlling, else 0 (0x1693D8, read; shown in km/h); axis 2 = the previous filtered speed. Stock 0.30 at zero error, 0.40 at +/-0.2 km/h, 0.80 at +/-0.4 km/h (0.40 at 150 km/h); 0.25 everywhere at 200 km/h. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Excess Acceleration Threshold (Meter Cruise Option, Alternate)
table.description:
With one cruise option and an alternate flag only: if the car accelerates faster than this (by speed) for 0.2 s while cruise is on without pedal input, cruise ends (probably a runaway check). Stock 21.6 km/h/s up to 40 km/h, 10.8 km/h/s at 80 km/h.
Details: Cruise module 0x165AC4/0x1663AC, 20 ms task (read). Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16E6EC (read): used only while FFF811E1 b4 and FFF8AB40 b2 are set (05F080 otherwise, not defined here). Counts passes in FFF8AB5A while cruise is active (FFF88E12 b1) without pedal override (88E12 b5), FFF88E28 b0 / 88A26 b0 clear, manifold pressure FFF88A34 >= cal 0x409FC (53 kPa) and acceleration FFF8B9C2 >= this(speed); more than cal 0x409FE (10 passes, 0.2 s) sets FFF8AB43 b3, which ends cruise via 0x16E314 (inferred: runaway-acceleration check). Stock 21.6 km/h/s up to 40 km/h, 16.2 at 60, 10.8 km/h/s at 80 km/h. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Acceleration Cancel Threshold (Meter Cruise Option)
table.description:
With one cruise option only: if the car accelerates faster than this (by speed) for 3 s while cruise is on, cruise is cancelled and stays unavailable for the rest of the drive (probably a runaway check). Stock 20 km/h/s at low speed down to 4 km/h/s at 200 km/h.
Details: When used: only with the meter flag FFF811E1 bit 4 ('Meter Cruise Option', CAN 0x282) and FFF88BB2 bit 2, while cruise is active (FFF88E12 bit 1) and has been for cal 0x35C02 = 200 passes without FFF88E12 bit 5. 0x119200 (read; 10 ms task via 0x110AAC; arguments from the call at seg_0x110000:601): FFF8A8A4 bit 3 is set after cal 0x35C00 = 300 passes (3 s) of FFF8B3F8 > cal 0x35BFC (24000 = 74 ft-lb, 100 Nm) together with either (a) the acceleration FFF88E78 > this(cruise vehicle speed FFF8B9F4), or (b) speed above the set speed FFF8B9FA by more than cal 0x35BFE (3 km/h) for 200 passes, no raise/lower switch edge (FFF88E11 bits 4/5) for 200 passes and FFF88E78 > cal 0x35BFA (1.75 km/h/s). table.name: Cruise Speed Error Gain (State 0xC0)
table.description:

State 0xC0 is entered on FFF8AB3F bit 6 (0x170164) (read); the lower-switch side by the state numbering (inferred, group_C). Used only while FFF8AB42 bit 2 is clear (otherwise Set-Speed Approach). Stock flat 160 (no error or acceleration dependence). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Brake Override Pedal Limit Ramp-Down Rate
table.description:
How fast, by vehicle speed, brake override ramps the accelerator signal down. Larger = faster torque cut when brake and accelerator overlap. Stock 14-18 % pedal per second. Part of the brake override, which limits the accelerator signal when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held.
Details: When used: while brake override is active (FFF8AC8F bit 0). Brake override module 0x181B38 (10 ms task 0x1DFE3C, read): it limits the accelerator pedal that feeds the torque request, FFF88A5E = min(pedal FFF88EE6, limit FFF8BAFA) (0x09E800, read), when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held. Brake detection: VDC CAN frame 0x0D1 byte 2 (FFF88DF9, slew-limited 8/pass into FFF8AC94; brake pressure, inferred) against a threshold, or discrete input FFF88E2F bit 3 (pin PF10; brake switch, inferred) when the pressure signal is not valid (FFF8AC8F bit 4 clear). Vehicle speed FFF8AC95 = km/h from the wheel speeds or FFF88BE8 x 9/160 (0x182E34, read). The module sets no DTC (no DTC monitor record points at its RAM, read). 0x182900 (read, lookup by speed FFF8AC95 checked in the assembly at 0x182A6E): limit FFF8BAFA = max(previous limit - this, Brake Override Pedal Limit Floor), capped at cal 0x433B6 = 26214 (40 % pedal); if the pedal is below the limit the limit follows the pedal. FFF88A5E = min(pedal, limit). Stock 92, 92, 105, 118 per pass at 30/60/90/120 km/h = 14, 14, 16, 18 % pedal per second. Larger = faster torque cut when brake and accelerator overlap. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Brake Override Pedal Limit Floor
table.description:
Lowest pedal value, by vehicle speed, that brake override ramps the accelerator signal down to. Stock 1-3 % pedal. Part of the brake override, which limits the accelerator signal when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held.
Details: When used: while brake override is active (FFF8AC8F bit 0). Brake override module 0x181B38 (10 ms task 0x1DFE3C, read): it limits the accelerator pedal that feeds the torque request, FFF88A5E = min(pedal FFF88EE6, limit FFF8BAFA) (0x09E800, read), when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held. table.name: Brake Override Recovery Rate (Pedal Held)
table.description:
How fast, by vehicle speed, the pedal limit is raised again after the brake is released while the driver keeps the accelerator pressed. Stock 50-100 % pedal per second. Part of the brake override, which limits the accelerator signal when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held.
Details: When used: after the brake is released (recovery FFF8AC90 bit 7) in recovery state FFF8AC8E = 1. Brake override module 0x181B38 (10 ms task 0x1DFE3C, read): it limits the accelerator pedal that feeds the torque request, FFF88A5E = min(pedal FFF88EE6, limit FFF8BAFA) (0x09E800, read), when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held. Brake detection: VDC CAN frame 0x0D1 byte 2 (FFF88DF9, slew-limited 8/pass into FFF8AC94; brake pressure, inferred) against a threshold, or discrete input FFF88E2F bit 3 (pin PF10; brake switch, inferred) when the pressure signal is not valid (FFF8AC8F bit 4 clear). Vehicle speed FFF8AC95 = km/h from the wheel speeds or FFF88BE8 x 9/160 (0x182E34, read). The module sets no DTC (no DTC monitor record points at its RAM, read). table.description:
Time, by vehicle speed, over which full pedal is restored after brake override ends (recovery ends early if the pedal is released or reached). Stock 0.3-0.5 s. Part of the brake override, which limits the accelerator signal when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held.
