Surge Damping Timing Curve (AT/CVT Gear 1)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1). Not used on this manual-transmission calibration, so it has no effect on a stock car. Stock 0, so it has no effect.
Details: When used: AT/CVT only (FFF88ADA bit 7 clear; it is always set on this manual coding), gear FFF88FCE = 1 (0x0DBB20, read: the AT/CVT curve branch, mirrored by the MT branch that reads Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1); the MT coding flag s4 picks the MT curve). Full-scale timing correction (degrees, negative = retard) by the largest throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE since the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 set (0x0DBB20 holds the maximum in FFF8B0F0 and resets it to 0 while the trigger is clear, read), before the phase, coolant, mode and cal factors (read). Surge damping term FFF8A758 (0x0DBB20, called from the 10 ms module 0x0DE0E0; stack args verified with callers.py: s0 = gear FFF88FCE, s4 = MT coding FFF88ADA bit 7, s8 = FFF8B0EE, s12 = rpm FFF8CE9C, s16 = FFF88C64 bit 5, s20 = combustion mode FFF8A85C, read): A758 = Curve(FFF8B0EE) x PhaseFactor(FFF8A75E) x CoolantFactor FFF8A75C x ModeFactor(A85C) x cal factor (MT coding: cal 0x306E5 = 254, or cal 0x306E7 = 128 once FFF88C64 bit 5 has been clear for cal 0x306E8 = 150 passes) / 255^4, in 0.5-degree units, capped at +63.5 degrees, and 0 when the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 is clear or when the current swing count has lasted longer than its time cal 0x306EA..0x306FA (100/20/100/10/100/5/100/100/100 passes of 10 ms for counts 0..8) (read). A758 is added to the final timing sum in 0x0D9E40 (read), so negative values retard. Trigger (read): 0x0DC1E8 counts passes while FFF8A7A1 bit 3 is set, the throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE >= cal 0x3084E (131 = 0.4 % per 20 ms, MT; hysteresis 0x3084C) and FFF8B112 (0x0E0D14 of FFF88A3A) <= cal 0x30842; 0x0E1350 sets FFF8A7A1 bit 2 when that count exceeds a per-gear, per-rpm-band threshold (cals 0x30F62..0x30FAC); it is dropped after cal 0x30850 (90) active passes. FFF8A75E counts rpm swings (0x0DC324, see p17p_surge_phase). FFF88FCE is the gear: on the MT coding 0x08254C copies FFF8A8B6, which 0x11422C derives from the ratio gear FFF8A623 (read). Reading: a timing intervention after a throttle step that retards while rpm swings up and releases while it swings down, i.e. driveline surge (shuffle) damping (inferred from the structure; the stock odd-count-only factors fit it). Stock 0 at every flow change. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 05B880 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 04F4D4. Confidence: read.

table.description:
Base spark target by rpm and coolant for the cold-start / catalyst-heating mode (pedal released, car stopped, below 4000 rpm); the manual-car set. Torque, run-time and re-entry adders go on top. It feeds the torque model and cold-start monitors; the fired spark probably follows other paths. Stock +17 degrees cold at low rpm, down to about -10 to -12.5 when warm.

A647 is the spark the torque model compensates for (0x0C2514, 0x0C1EA8) and the reference of the cold-start retard monitors (0x1CB70C, 0x132568: A72A - A854) (read); the fired spark in this mode follows FFF8A74C/FFF8A76B (0x0DA428), not A854 (read). Otherwise in mode 1 A854 = 05D0BC x 05D0A8 / 256 + FFF8A789 - 32 (both tables 0 in stock, so the normal request); in mode 3 A854 = A72A (normal target) (read). with cal 0x2996C bit 6 set (clear in stock) A854 is forced to cal 0x2A0C0 (0 in stock). table.name: Boost Limit
table.description:
Boost ceiling by rpm that the torque/throttle model uses as its full-load manifold pressure: the model's target MAP is (torque request / full-load reference torque) x this, and it also scales the throttle-area input. It is not an overboost cut (see Overboost Limit). Raise it together with Target Boost so the model's full-load pressure matches the boost you run. Stock 211 kPa absolute peak (about 16 psi gauge), matching Target Boost.
Details: 0x1086F8 (20 ms boost task) -> FFF8A84F (raw) and FFF8A84E = (raw + 13.3) x f - 13, where f is the target's baro/IAT factor: the compensated boost ceiling (read). The torque-model task 0x0C3D14 copies it to FFF8AFAE = A84E << 8 (0x0C3D0C, read). AFAE is the full-load manifold pressure of the throttle/torque model. Target MAP FFF8AF6A = (torque request / full-load reference torque) x this (0x0C2F0C). FFF8AF8A = Throttle Required Area column input AFA8 x this (0x0C3408). The pressure ratio AF6C = AF8A / this (0x0C2F9C) selects the high-pressure spark-compensation filter above 0.85 (all read). Also read by the airflow/torque model 0x111AB8 (role there not decoded). It is not an overboost cut; see Overboost Limit for that. Stock 211 kPa abs peak (about 16 psi gauge), matching Target Boost. Raise it with Target Boost. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 05CFC8 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 050B0C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default)
Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 2, Sport)
Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent)
Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp)
Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual. Stock 74 ft-lb (100 Nm) per step everywhere, i.e. no Stage 1 limit.
Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 (1, default) with AT/CVT Coding; unused in stock (manual coding). AT/CVT Coding set = FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5); FFF88ADA bit 7 is permanently set in stock (my research notes), so the AT/CVT Coding tables are unused on the manual car. Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default) (0598F8) as Step1 (read: the selection at 0x0BCB12..0x0BCC20). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Main path: with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step1 = (Stage 1 table - 16000) x gear factor (cal 0x1FC98 + 2(g-1): 1, 1, 3, 3, 3 in stock, 255 = x1) x Stage 1 Pedal Multiplier(FFF8AF00) / 65025, Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA (boost target / wastegate duty axis). Stock 24000 everywhere = 74 ft-lb (100 Nm) per 10 ms, i.e. no Stage 1 limit (same as the high-gear cells of the Stage 2 AT/CVT Coding tables). Its rpm axis (0x2000A) differs from the manual table's. The torque monitor 0x1877B4 reads the same data bytes through its own descriptor (05F674), so it stays consistent. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 0598BC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 04D860. Confidence: inferred.

(1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else 255 = x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). Rev Limit RPM
table.description:
The rev limit (stock 6700 rpm): above it the ECU cuts fuel to all four cylinders on every firing and closes the throttle; spark is not cut or retarded. To move the limit, set this, Rev Limit Full Cut RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM, Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM and Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) to the new rpm and Rev Limit Reset RPM about 100 lower.
Details: When used: always. The rev limit: above this rpm the rev latch sets and the ECU enters limit state 0x0B (part 1); with the stock Full Cut values that is at once a fuel cut on all four cylinders (parts 2-3). It is also the level stage 2 of the throttle cap holds above (part 5). Stock 34304 = 6,700 rpm. Rev limiter and limit-state cuts (LF75404S; read unless marked). The rev limiter is a fuel cut. (1) Limit state, 0x0BE140 (10 ms torque module 0x0BE694): the rev latch FFF8416A sets when rpm FFF8CD54 > Rev Limit RPM (the comparator FFF84169 then uses Rev Limit Reset RPM) and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Reset RPM and MAP FFF88FF4 < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP. The overboost latch FFF84167 sets when MAP >= Overboost Limit (compensated, FFF8A851) + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) and releases below that level minus Overboost Cut Hysteresis (Limit State). Either latch gives limit state FFF8A639 = 0x0B. Priority: not running = 1, FFF8A640 bit 0 = 0x19, latch FFF8416C = 0x1B (cals 0x22FB2-0x22FBC, not decoded), then 0x0B, then the vehicle-speed latch = 0x0C (see Vehicle Speed Limit). (2) Full-cut latch, 0x0BAE98: FFF840C4 sets when rpm >= Rev Limit Full Cut RPM and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM and MAP < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP (above Rev Limit Full Cut Speed Threshold the pair Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM / Stage 2 RPM is used instead; never in stock). In state 0x0B the final torque cap FFF8AE54 (0x0B9DC8) is limited to FFF8AE8A: zero indicated torque (32000 - losses FFF8AF62) while this latch or the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6 (Overboost Limit + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay) is set, otherwise FFF8AF3A = the current air torque minus losses, i.e. no reduction. (3) Fuel: 0x0C4BA0 turns the cap into the torque ratio FFF8A64F; in limit states 8, 9, 0x0B, 0x0C and 0x18-0x1B, 0x0C1AC8 turns the ratio into the number of cylinders to cut FFF8A643 (Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio thresholds; a zero cap gives 4). Once per combustion event (crank-synchronous list 0x07D0E0) 0x0C4B84 makes a cut decision FFF8A648 from the count and the last three decisions (4 = every event, 3 = three in four, 2 = every second, 1 = one in four; the pattern is in code, not a cal). 0x0C88C8 (list 0x07D1C2) latches it into the cut flag of the cylinder being scheduled (FFF8A6F5-FFF8A6F8). For a flagged cylinder the fuel time is 0 (0x0D1D7C/0x0D1FB8) and both start angles are 0x1FE (0x0CB394/0x0CB604), which the injector driver 0x1DCA04 treats as no pulse. So the cut is a true injector cut, all four cylinders, every event. (4) Spark is neither cut nor retarded: the coil scheduler 0x1DB804 only checks FFF8C6F4 (set at the first injection after sync, cleared only on stop), and with Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Rev/Overboost Cut set (stock) 0x0DD568 uses the normal spark target FFF8A72A in state 0x0B instead of Torque Reduction Spark Retard. (5) Throttle: with Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable set (stock) 0x0BDA84 caps the throttle-side request FFF8AE4C in state 0x0B by 0x0BAFA8: Rev/Boost Limit Torque (Stage 1) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM (held while > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold)) or MAP FFF8AF70 > Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 1 MAP (held while > Stage 1 Reset MAP); else (Stage 2) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) (held while > Rev Limit RPM) or MAP > Stage 1 Reset MAP (held while > Stage 2 Hold MAP); else (Base). The torque monitor (0x186F0C) repeats this with the same data. Stock behaviour: above 6,700 rpm all four injectors are cut every event, the throttle closes toward a 37 ft-lb (50 Nm) request and the spark is unchanged; fuel returns as soon as rpm is back at 6,700 or below with MAP under 168 kPa abs (no rpm hysteresis on the fuel cut), and the Base throttle cap (about 166 ft-lb, 225 Nm there, rarely binding) lasts until 6,600 rpm. A hard cut; stage 2 is never selected because its thresholds equal stage 1's. To move the limit, set Rev Limit RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM, Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM and Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) to the new rpm and Rev Limit Reset RPM about 100 rpm lower. Setting the Full Cut pair above Rev Limit RPM gives a throttle-only soft stage between them (inferred). The Fail-Safe Rev Limit cals (6,100 rpm) cut fuel the same way, in any state, when their fault flags are set. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 01DEDE by the code that reads it (read). Address 01A99A. Confidence: read.

table.name: Overboost Limit
table.description:
Overboost limit by rpm, compensated for baro and intake temperature like the boost target. Boost 26.7 kPa over it for 2 s sets the overboost flag, and 33 kPa over it starts the overboost cut (throttle cap, then a full fuel cut once the flag is set). Raise it when raising boost targets (stock 211 kPa absolute peak). Note: the boost-control pressure reading stops at about 269 kPa absolute, so an Overboost Limit above about 236 kPa absolute (269 minus the 33 kPa cut margin) can never trigger the overboost cut.
Details: When used: always. 0x1087D4 (20 ms boost task) -> FFF8A850 (raw) and FFF8A851 = (raw + 13.3) x f - 13, f = the boost target's baro/IAT factor FFF8B3B2/32768 (read; cal 0x290A8 = 1 would use a fixed value, 0 in stock). Two overboost reactions use FFF8A851 (read): (a) 0x0C0FE0 (10 ms): MAP FFF88FF4 >= this + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay passes in a row sets the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6, cleared when MAP <= this + Overboost Flag Reset Margin; (b) 0x0BE140: MAP >= this + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) puts the ECU in limit state 0x0B, which caps the throttle at once. The flag makes the state-0x0B cut a full fuel cut on all four cylinders (see Rev Limit RPM); on its own, outside state 0x0B, it reduces nothing. It also feeds a diagnostic 0x1B8310. Stock 211 kPa abs peak, the same as Boost Limit from 2,000 rpm. Raise it with Target Boost. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 05CFD4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 050B18. Confidence: read.

Once per combustion event (crank-synchronous list 0x07D0E0) 0x0C4B84 makes a cut decision FFF8A648 from the count and the last three decisions (4 = every event, 3 = three in four, 2 = every second, 1 = one in four; the pattern is in code, not a cal). 0x0C88C8 (list 0x07D1C2) latches it into the cut flag of the cylinder being scheduled (FFF8A6F5-FFF8A6F8). Stock behaviour: above 6,700 rpm all four injectors are cut every event, the throttle closes toward a 37 ft-lb (50 Nm) request and the spark is unchanged; fuel returns as soon as rpm is back at 6,700 or below with MAP under 168 kPa abs (no rpm hysteresis on the fuel cut), and the Base throttle cap (about 166 ft-lb, 225 Nm there, rarely binding) lasts until 6,600 rpm. Setting the Full Cut pair above Rev Limit RPM gives a throttle-only soft stage between them (inferred). The Fail-Safe Rev Limit cals (6,100 rpm) cut fuel the same way, in any state, when their fault flags are set. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 01DE86 by the code that reads it (read). Address 01A942. table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable
table.description:
Lets the rev limiter and overboost cut close the throttle (the Rev/Boost Limit Torque tables). Set in stock; cleared, the limiter is probably fuel-cut only.
Details: Set in stock. With this bit set, 0x0BDA84 replaces the throttle-side request FFF8AE4C by the Rev/Boost Limit Torque cap FFF8AE8C (0x0BAFA8) in limit state 0x0B; the torque monitor 0x189488 reads the same bit (read). Address 0202DE bit 0 (value 1). Confidence: read.

table.name: Overboost Flag Reset Margin
table.description:
Once set, the overboost flag clears only when boost falls to Overboost Limit plus this. Stock 0 kPa.

Stock 0. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 01DEF6 by the code that reads it (read). Address 01A9B2. Confidence: read.

table.name: Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State)
table.description:
Boost above Overboost Limit plus this enters the overboost cut state: the throttle is capped at once, and fuel to all cylinders is cut only if the 2-second overboost flag is also set. Stock 33 kPa.
Details: When used: always. Overboost latch FFF84167 (0x0BE140, read): sets when MAP FFF88FF4 >= Overboost Limit (the baro/IAT-compensated FFF8A851) + this, and releases when MAP < that level minus Overboost Cut Hysteresis (Limit State). table.name: Overboost Cut Hysteresis (Limit State)
table.description:
How far boost must fall below the overboost cut level before the overboost cut state ends. Stock 15 kPa.
Details: When used: always. Subtracted from the overboost latch level while the latch FFF84167 is set (0x0BE208-0x0BE222, read): the overboost cut state 0x0B releases when MAP FFF88FF4 < Overboost Limit + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) - this. table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed
table.description:

Details: When used: only in limit state 0x0C (vehicle-speed latch, see Vehicle Speed Limit). 0x0C058C (read): latch FFF84188 sets when vehicle speed FFF99835 >= this (minus Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed Hysteresis while above it) and holds until speed is below and MAP <= Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP; while set, FFF8AF1A = zero torque, which in state 0x0C cuts fuel on all four cylinders every event (0x0B9DC8, 0x0C1AC8). table.name: Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Speed Limit
table.description:
Keeps normal spark timing during the vehicle-speed limiter. Set in stock; leave it set.
Details: Set in stock. Same as Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Rev/Overboost Cut for limit state 0x0C (vehicle-speed limiter) (0x0DD568, read). Bits 5 and 4 do the same for states 0x19 and 0x1A (not decoded); state 0x1B always uses the normal target. Leave set. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 0239AE by the code that reads it (read). Address 01FFA2 bit 6 (value 64). Confidence: read.

table.name: Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Rev/Overboost Cut
table.description:
Keeps normal spark timing during the rev limiter and overboost cut instead of retarding it. Set in stock; leave it set.
Details: Set in stock (byte 0xF0). In limit state 0x0B (rev limiter, overboost cut) 0x0DD568 sets the spark angle FFF8A76A to the normal spark target FFF8A72A instead of base timing FFF8A645 minus Torque Reduction Spark Retard (asm 0x0DD5F8-0x0DD62A, read), so the limiter does not retard the spark. Cleared, the full cut would ask for about 34 degrees of retard (ratio floor cal 0x2FDE4 = 102, inferred from the table). Leave set. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 0239AE by the code that reads it (read). Address 01FFA2 bit 7 (value 128). Confidence: read.

table.name: External Torque Limit Baro Factor (Off in Stock)
External Torque Limit IAT Factor (Off in Stock)
Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio (1 Cylinder)
table.description:
When a cut state asks for less torque than this share of the engine's current torque, one cylinder in four is cut. Also sets the first decel fuel cut stage. Stock 75 %.
Details: When used: in the cut limit states (decel fuel cut, rev/overboost/speed cuts). Below this torque ratio at least 1 cylinder is cut. 0x0C1AC8 (read): in limit states 8, 9, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x18 (unless FFF8A638 = 2) and 0x19-0x1B the torque ratio FFF8A64F (capped / unreduced torque, 0x0C4BA0) is compared with four thresholds: cylinders cut FFF8A643 = 0 if the ratio >= the 1-cylinder threshold, 1 if >= the 2-cylinder threshold, 2 if >= the 3-cylinder threshold, 3 if >= the 4-cylinder threshold, else 4 (each threshold minus Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio Hysteresis while it is crossed). Once per event 0x0C4B84 then skips n of every 4 injections. The same four cals set the torque level of each decel fuel cut stage (0x0B9EF0), so changing them also changes the decel cut. The rev limiter and the overboost full cut use a zero cap (ratio 0, 4 cylinders) and do not depend on them. Stock 192 = 75 %. Further gating in 0x0C1AC8 (read): the ratio comparison also runs outside those states while FFF8A63B bit 0 or FFF899EC bit 1 / bit 4 is set; while FFF89BFE bit 2 is set (a fault latch from 0x09FE44, meaning not decoded) the count is instead taken from cals 0x23D58-0x23D5F by rpm FFF8CD62 and speed FFF99835 (not yet defined) and overrides both this ratio and the Fail-Safe Rev Limit; and with engine state FFF99844 = 4, or FFF8A65F bit 7 set while FFF89066 bit 0 is clear, the count is cal 0x38248 (the cylinder count, 4), i.e. all cylinders. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 023D53 by the code that reads it (read). Address 020347. Confidence: read.

table.name: Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio (2 Cylinders)

Below this torque ratio at least 2 cylinders are cut. 0x0C1AC8 (read): in limit states 8, 9, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x18 (unless FFF8A638 = 2) and 0x19-0x1B the torque ratio FFF8A64F (capped / unreduced torque, 0x0C4BA0) is compared with four thresholds: cylinders cut FFF8A643 = 0 if the ratio >= the 1-cylinder threshold, 1 if >= the 2-cylinder threshold, 2 if >= the 3-cylinder threshold, 3 if >= the 4-cylinder threshold, else 4 (each threshold minus Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio Hysteresis while it is crossed). table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs closed, no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount). Stock EGR and non-EGR tables are identical.
Details: When used: every pass of the 0x110000 torque module. Weight (1 - TGV open) x (1 - EGR). Stock: 14-49 ft-lb (19-66 Nm) at zero load, 260-306 ft-lb (352-415 Nm) at 2.81 g/rev (217 % load) from 2400 rpm (119 ft-lb, 162 Nm cap at 800 rpm); identical to the EGR table 05D64C. 0x118318 (DAM 1 set -> FFF8B490) and 0x1186A4 (DAM 0 set -> FFF8B4A2), called from 0x110000 with rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616, TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 and EGR realisation FFF8B290 (read): closed = TGV-closed x (1 - w) + TGV-closed-EGR x w, open = TGV-open x (1 - w) + TGV-open-EGR x w with w = B290/256, result = closed x (1 - B3E8) + open x B3E8, all above the 16000 zero point (read; same blend as the Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables in 0x0C0010). 0x10ED6C interpolates the two sets by DAM: FFF8B48A = B490 x DAM + B4A2 x (1 - DAM) with FFF811AE = DAM x 16 (read), and 0x118A40 subtracts (B490 - B4A2) x (1 - DAM) from the torque it reports as FFF8B4B2 (0.1 ft-lb, 0.1 Nm, 10000 = 0) (read). So these are the engine torque the ECU expects from the air charge, at full and at zero knock-learning advance (inferred from the DAM interpolation). They do not set the throttle or boost; they shape the estimated/reported engine torque (inferred). Axes: rpm FFF8CE9C x load % FFF8A616. table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier B
table.description:
Torque-model smoothing multiplier by coolant (1.0 = normal; very high values mean no smoothing), used in another phase after a combustion-mode change. Stock 1.0 flat. Leave alone.
Details: 0x0C1EA8 (read): AF4E multiplies the rpm-based filter coefficient AFAC (0x0C38E0) in 0x0C2514 (AF58), 0x0C1854 (predicted air torque AF40) and 0x0C39DC (AF3E): k = AF4E x AFAC/512. 512 = 1.0; values that push k past 65535 mean no lag. Selected in state S1: after combustion-mode change 4 -> 1, while in mode 1, FFF886AB bit 5 set and final timing above the spark target. Stock 1.0 flat. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 059EA0 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: 0x0AFD40 (= LF75404S 0x0C1EA8) has 7 inputs, no TGV-closed flag (2015 param 8, FFF8A881 bit 4, is not passed: caller seg 0x0B0000 line 1534) and reads 5 tables: S2 -> 04DDE4 / 04DDFC (Alt), S1 -> 04DDF0, S3 -> 04DE14 / 04DE08 (Alt) (read); S1 table (read); the automatic port had it by data only. Descriptor 04DDF0. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt)

table.name: EGR Timing Advance (TGV Closed)

FFF8A769 = FFF8A767 when FFF8A775 bit 2 is set (all four injectors in a 2- or 3-injection strategy, 0x0FAABC), else FFF8A763 (0x0DD454, read). It can never lift the fired timing above the Base Timing (EGR Active) maps. Axes rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8ADE4 (400-6400 rpm, 10-240 %; rows above 32768 are padding). Stock up to +13.5 degrees at 800-4800 rpm, 0.39-0.78 g/rev (30-60 % load). Byte-identical to EGR Timing Advance (Multi-Injection, TGV Closed) in stock. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 05B974 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: 0x0C9144 is the counterpart of 0x0DC97C (callsites has no pair): called from 0x0CA6B4 right after 0x0C96B0 (= 0x0DD0DC) with the same args (EGR active FFF89C93 bit7, rpm, load, EGR realisation FFF8A67C = B290, TGV fraction FFF8A7DA = B3E8, DAM), same fade lookups 0x4F5A4/0x4F5B0/0x4F5BC (= 05B950/05B95C/05B968). Details: 0x0FA760 (read, disassembly): FFF8A81D = this(rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616) + EGR Upstream Pressure Baro Adder x Multiplier / 128, clamped 0..255. 0x0F943C turns it into the pressure difference across the valve FFF8A810 = A81D - MAP, which indexes EGR Valve Flow Model; 0x0FAAFC requires MAP + cal 0x2CCD1 (5 kPa) <= A81D x 2/3 to enable EGR (read). Reading it as the exhaust-side (upstream) pressure is inferred; stock 152 (101.3 kPa) at idle up to 255 (170 kPa) at high rpm and load. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 05CB3C by identical axes and data (read). Descriptor 0506E0. Confidence: inferred.

TGV Coolant Minimum
table.description:
Minimum coolant temperature for the TGVs to close (probably; part of the TGV close conditions). Stock 5 degC.
Details: TGV request logic 0x10D93C (read): the request byte FFF8A888 is 3 unless all of these hold: coolant FFF88A44 at or above TGV Coolant Minimum (hysteresis cal 0x37B46 - 16384, stock 409 = 1 C), requested torque FFF8AEE2 (0x0BA868, Nm = x/80 - 200) below the rpm-based TGV Torque Threshold (it must fall below the Enter table and then rise above the Exit table to clear), air quantity FFF8B4D6 below TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter 0x37A4A, Exit 0x37A48), and FFF8A88D = 0. When they hold, FFF8A888 = 1, or 2 if the intake air temperature FFF88A48 is below TGV IAT Threshold (vehicle speed) or FFF88E28 bit 0/2 is set; FFF8A888 = 2 also while combustion mode FFF8A85C is below cal 0x37B48. State 1 requests TGV close: it runs the timer FFF8B3E0 (0x10C3D0) and FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is set once the timer reaches TGV Close Delay (05D384, by vehicle speed; stock 1 s at standstill, 2 s from 4 km/h). States 2 (close blocked: cold intake air, FFF88E28 bit 0/2, or combustion mode below cal 0x37B48) and 3 (close conditions not met) reset the timer, so the TGVs stay open (read). Which threshold pair is used depends on FFF8A8C1 (1, 2, 3 or other) and FFF8A8A2 bit 5 (not identified). Each threshold is table(rpm FFF8CE9C) + TGV Torque Threshold Offset(rpm, FFF88AE6) - 16000, so the offset table is centred on 16000 (0 ft-lb). Used while FFF899D7 bit 0 is clear. Stock 18432 = 5 degC. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 037A44 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: CORRECTED (auto 032690 wrong). 0x0F8E10 (pair of 0x10D93C, ratio 0.91), disassembly 0x0F8F4A..0x0F8F5E: one unconditional read MOV.L @(0x0F90E0,PC)=0x00032692, MOVU.W, minus hysteresis W[0x32792] (= ref 0x37B46) when latch FFF853EE is set, compared with coolant param_1 (read). Following cals 0x32694/0x32696/0x32698 sit where ref has 0x37A48/0x37A4A/0x37A4C, so the 2015 LV9N block has one coolant minimum, not two. 0x32690 is not referenced anywhere (no literal in the ROM, no decompiler reference); it holds 0x00C8, the tail of a preceding 0x00C8 run. Address 032692. Confidence: read.

Brake Override Delay
table.description:
How long the brake must be pressed over a held accelerator, by pedal position and speed, before brake override starts cutting the pedal signal (above 7 km/h). Stock 2 s at light pedal, 0.5 s from 60 % pedal. Part of the brake override, which limits the accelerator signal when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held.
Details: When used: while the VDC brake-pressure signal is valid (FFF8AC8F bit 4); 05F2E0 (200 = 2 s, flat) replaces it otherwise. Brake override module 0x181B38 (10 ms task 0x1DFE3C, read): it limits the accelerator pedal that feeds the torque request, FFF88A5E = min(pedal FFF88EE6, limit FFF8BAFA) (0x09E800, read), when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held. Brake detection: VDC CAN frame 0x0D1 byte 2 (FFF88DF9, slew-limited 8/pass into FFF8AC94; brake pressure, inferred) against a threshold, or discrete input FFF88E2F bit 3 (pin PF10; brake switch, inferred) when the pressure signal is not valid (FFF8AC8F bit 4 clear). Vehicle speed FFF8AC95 = km/h from the wheel speeds or FFF88BE8 x 9/160 (0x182E34, read). The module sets no DTC (no DTC monitor record points at its RAM, read). 0x1832C4 (read, args checked in the assembly): override request FFF8AC91 bit 1 sets when the time FFF8BADA since the brake was applied while the accelerator was already pressed (FFF8AC90 bit 6, 0x1831EC) reaches this(pedal FFF88EE6, speed FFF8AC95), with speed >= cal 0x43472 (7 km/h) and either pedal >= 05F2C0 (1.1 %) or a deceleration-confirmed brake (FFF8AC91 bit 2). FFF8AC91 bit 1 (or bit 0, the brake-switch path 0x183680) sets the active flag FFF8AC8F bit 0 (0x183B68), which starts the pedal-limit ramp. Stock 200 passes (2.0 s) at 11 % pedal; 1.25-1.5 s at 23 %; 0.75-1.0 s at 40 %; 0.5 s from 60 % pedal. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 05F2CC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 052974. Confidence: inferred.

Intake Air Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the main intake air temperature sensor voltage to degrees; this IAT feeds the timing, boost and fuel compensations and the scan-tool reading. Its voltage axis is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling, so edit only the temperatures when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06AF58, read). ADC channel 19 (0xFFFFE864, untrimmed) -> FFF88D38 -> FFF88F30, filtered by cal 0x579B6 (65535 = no filter in stock) -> FFF88F34 / FFF88F32, looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) to give FFF88662 = degC + 50: the OBD IAT FFF8CEE5, the IAT behind FFF88A48 (the IAT axis of the timing, boost, throttle and fuel compensation tables) and the IAT read by fuel 0x0C589C and purge 0x0D4E78 (for Purge Air Density (IAT, Baro), 0x0D44DC) (read). This is IAT sensor 1 (P0112 / P0113, read), probably the element in the MAF housing (inferred). The voltage axis (0x579FC, 32 points 0...4.96 V in 0.16 V steps; 65536 = 5 V inferred) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling: change only the temperature values for a different thermistor, or both sensors move. While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BA x 256 (stock 3.40 V, about 20 C) is used. Stock: 205 C at 0 V, 25 C at 3.20 V, -50 C from 4.80 V (identical to IAT 2). LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 060850 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0539D4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling
table.description:
Converts the second intake temperature sensor's voltage to degrees. This is the air temperature the ECU's airflow model uses to work out air density, and it probably comes from the manifold pressure (TMAP) sensor, so update it when you swap that sensor for one with a different thermistor. Its voltage axis is shared with the main IAT table; change only the temperatures.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06B304, read). ADC channel 20 (0xFFFFE868, untrimmed) -> FFF88D40 -> FFF88F36, filtered by cal 0x579B8 (no filter in stock) -> FFF88F38 / FFF88F3A, looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF888CF (degC + 50; FFF888D4 from the unfaulted value). This is IAT sensor 2 (P0097 / P0098 monitors on the same voltage, read). FFF888CF is the air temperature of the speed-density airflow model (0x11DF4C: density from MAP and IAT 2 + 223 K) and is also read by requested torque 0x0BE694, ignition 0x0D98F8 / 0x0D9A10 / 0x0DE0E0 and AVCS 0x15969C (read), so a wrong curve shifts the modelled air and load. Probably the thermistor of the manifold TMAP sensor (inferred from its use as the manifold air temperature): when fitting a different TMAP / MAP sensor with its own thermistor, change these temperature values. The voltage axis (0x579FC) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor Scaling, so change only the data. While faulted (FFF88FCD bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BB x 256 (stock 3.40 V, about 20 C) is used. Stock identical to IAT 1. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 06085C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0539E0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Coolant Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts coolant temperature sensor voltage to degrees. Every coolant-based table and the scan-tool coolant reading use this. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BA46, read). Coolant sensor voltage FFF8865E (input 0 of the 8-way multiplexer on ADC channel 21, untrimmed, 65536 = 5 V inferred) is filtered by cal 0x56EE8 (65535 = no filter) into FFF88ADC and looked up here (boot lookup 0x73BC) into FFF88AE8 / FFF88AE0 (256 x (degC + 50)): FFF8CD65 (coolant byte, degC + 50), the OBD coolant value and FFF88A44 (the coolant axis of most tables). While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 1) a warm-up model from cals 0x56EEC-0x56EF2 replaces it. Range faults: P0117 below Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit, P0118 above Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit. Stock: 205 C at 0 V, 25.7 C at 3.20 V, -50 C from 4.80 V. Change only when fitting a different sensor. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 060874 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0539F8. Confidence: read.

table.name: Oil Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts oil temperature sensor voltage to degrees; this oil temperature feeds the AVCS and idle tables and the scan-tool reading. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BEA0, read). Oil temperature sensor voltage FFF88AA2 (input 7 of the 8-way multiplexer on ADC channel 21, untrimmed) is filtered by cal 0x56F76 (65535 = no filter) into FFF88AE4 and looked up here (boot lookup 0x73BC). Output unit 256 x (degC + 50), read: FFF88E24 = (output - 0xA00) x 256 / 205 and OBD PID 0x5C reports FFF88E24 x 205 / 65536 = degC + 40. FFF88E24 / FFF88E26 is the oil temperature of the AVCS and idle tables (oil_temp_obd axis). Range faults: P0197 below Oil Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit, P0198 above Oil Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit. Stock identical to the coolant curve. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 060880 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 053A04. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range)
table.description:
Converts the front wideband A/F sensor signal to lambda when the reading is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37. This is the measured lambda used by closed loop fueling. Identical to A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich) in stock; edit both together.
Details: When used: Used while FFF88AFB bit 4 is clear: the A/F signal is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37 (window -800..1000 with hysteresis 333, 0x0843F8, read); gain cal 0x571F0 = 2. Identical to Near Stoich in stock; edit both together. 0x06C1A8 (read): the A/F sensor signal FFF88B2E is looked up here (boot lookup 0x6A0C) into FFF88AF6, the measured lambda of the closed loop (B308 = 43194 x 32768 / FFF88AF6, 0x0FF3CC). Stock lambda 1.00 at signal -25...0. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 06088C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 053A10. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich)
table.description:
Converts the front A/F sensor signal to lambda when it reads within about lambda 0.90-1.37, at a higher gain. Shares its axis with A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range) and is identical to it in stock; edit both together.
Details: When used: Used while the A/F signal is within about lambda 0.90-1.37 (FFF88AFB bit 4 set, 0x0843F8, read); higher gain cal 0x571F1 = 9 (gain reading inferred). Second A/F sensor table in 0x06C1A8 (read); shares the axis with A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range). Identical to it in stock; edit both together. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 060898 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 053A1C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Fuel Level Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the fuel sender reading, which the instrument cluster sends to the ECU over CAN, to fuel level (219 = 100 %). The ECU averages it and reports it as fuel level to a scan tool. Stock: full at the lowest input, empty at the highest.
Details: When used: always (0x06C336, read). Input: the fuel sender reading sent by the combination meter on CAN 0x282 bytes 0-1 (10-bit, FFF88E04 -> 0x1108B8 -> FFF8B43C; not an ECU analog input). 0x06C336 forms FFF88BD0 = FFF8B43C x 2867 / (FFF8B43C + cal 0x572E0 (720)), filters it into FFF88BCC and looks it up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF88BD4; FFF88BD7 is its average over cal 0x572E6 samples taken while FFF88A76 is at least cal 0x572E4, kept in backup RAM FFF806BB/806BC, and reported by OBD PID 0x2F as x 255 / 219 (read). So this is the fuel level curve, 219 = 100 %. P0463 / P0462 when FFF88BCC is above cal 0x572DA / below cal 0x572DE (0x0714E0 / 0x071548, read). Stock: full (219) at the lowest input, empty at 2432 and above. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 0608A4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 053A28. Confidence: read.

P0087 Rail Pressure Low Limit
table.description:
Rail pressure floor by rpm for P0087 (rail pressure too low): the code counts a fault when actual pressure stays more than 0.30 MPa (hysteresis cal) below this value for about 10 seconds, i.e. below 0.40 MPa in stock, and recovers when pressure is back at this value. Stock 0.70 MPa at all rpm.
Details: 0x0752A8 (read, boot lookup 0x72AC): the absolute low-pressure test fails while actual rail pressure FFF88884 < this(rpm FFF8CD56) - hysteresis cal 0x574DA for cal 0x574E0 passes -> P0087. Stock 1148 = 0.70 MPa flat. p16 (read): 0x0752A8 (<- 0x0A1D2C <- 0x1DFE3C) runs every 10 ms; 200 passes = 2 s, 1000 passes = 10 s. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 0609C4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 053B3C. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1
table.description:
Crankshaft roughness level, by rpm and load, that confirms channel 1 of the P219A A/F imbalance monitor. It sets no code by itself; P219A needs both this and A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1 exceeded. Raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never). Stock off below 1500 rpm, above 4000 rpm and below 0.91 g/rev (70 % load).
Details: When used: once per combustion event (0x1908E4, crank-synchronous list 0x1E1D1C) while the P219A monitor runs (FFF8ACD1). Confirms channel 1 of P219A (A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1). 0x18E130 (read): threshold FFF8BC5E = this(rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616) x 05FCB0(coolant)/8192 x 05FCBC/128 (both 1.0 in stock) x 1.0 (float constants 1000/2^33 and 8.192, 0x18E23C / 0x18E248, read); x 100 instead (capped at 65535, so during that window any cell >= 336 can never be exceeded) until the neutral input FFF88ADA bit 6 has been unchanged for cal 0x4496E = 150 passes (1.5 s; FFF8ACCD bit 5, 0x1912B4) - the A/C-state stability bit 6 (0x191324, cal 0x436B2 = 0) is always set; 65535 while FFF88A2D bit 0; 05FC90 (all 65535) replaces it near standstill with the pedal released (FFF8ACCD bit 0: FFF88C64 bit 5 and speed < 2 km/h) and 05FC68 (all 65535) while FFF8AA3F is set. 0x18F14C sets FFF8ACC5 = 2 when the crank fluctuation FFF8BC5C - 0x8000 > threshold x 250/256 (so an event counts when the fluctuation exceeds 0.977 x the cell value). 0x18D180... count those events per cylinder (FFF8ACC2 = 1..4, cylinder inferred) into FFF8BC24/28/2C/30 and in total FFF8BC48; at the end of a 2000-event window (FFF8BC20 = cal 0x436F0) 0x18F364 judges FFF8ACC7 = 2 'rough' when a cylinder count > cal 0x436F4 (17) or the total > cal 0x436F6 (17) (with a cylinder share > cal 0x43704 = 0) (read). That latches FFF8ACD8 (0x191850). The channel 1 judgement 0x18F980 gives FFF8ACCB = 2 (exceeded, which sets FFF8ACCF bit 1 and through it the P219A result in 0x19198C) only when the A/F swing exceeded its reference (FFF8ACCE bit 4) AND FFF8ACD8 (or FFF8ACD4) is set; FFF8ACCB = 1 (passed) when the swing passed (FFF8ACCE bit 5, cal 0x436C0 = 1) (read). So the roughness test is a required confirmation: a channel 1 P219A needs both the A/F swing and this crank roughness. (The alternative pass by roughness, FFF8ACD5 and FFF8ACD9, cannot occur in stock: with cal 0x436EE = 0 the second window FFF8BC1E always matches, so FFF8ACC7 never reaches 4; read.) The largest count and its limit are also Mode $06 values FFF815CE / FFF815D0 (0x18EB24 / 0x18EBA8, test 0xDC in the 0x0A0000 reporter, read). Raising cells makes the confirmation harder (65535 = never), lowering makes it easier; it does not set a DTC by itself. Stock 615-775 at 1500 rpm (live in normal driving; only the 1.5 s neutral-settling window makes cells >= 336 unreachable), 200-556 at 3000 rpm, 138-388 at 3500 rpm, 163-220 at 4000 rpm for loads 0.91-2.07 g/rev (70-160 %); 65535 (off) below 1500 rpm, above 4000 rpm and below 0.91 g/rev (70 % load). LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 05FC7C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 053294. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 2
table.description:
Crankshaft roughness level that confirms channel 2 of the P219A monitor (paired with A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2). Lower than Threshold 1, so more sensitive. Sets no code by itself; raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never). Stock off outside 1500-4000 rpm and 0.91-2.07 g/rev (70-160 % load).
Details: When used: as A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1, for channel 2 of P219A (A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2). 0x18E250 (read): same gating and scaling (x 05FD10(coolant)/8192 x 05FD1C/128, both 1.0) into FFF8BC60 -> FFF8BC64; 0x18F0F8 sets FFF8ACC4 = 2 on an exceedance; per-cylinder counters FFF8BC32..BC44 (0x18D4C8...) and the 2000-event window judgement FFF8ACC6 (0x18F1A0: a cylinder count > cal 0x436FC (17) or the total > cal 0x436FE (17) gives 2 'rough') latch FFF8ACDB (0x191920). The channel 2 judgement 0x18F928 gives FFF8ACCA = 2 (exceeded: FFF8ACCF bit 3 -> P219A result) only when the swing exceeded (FFF8ACCE bit 2) AND FFF8ACDB (or FFF8ACD6) is set; = 1 (passed) when the swing passed (FFF8ACCE bit 3, cal 0x436C1 = 1) (read). Mode $06 values FFF815D2 / FFF815D4 (0x18EFCC / 0x18F050, read). Stock 237-283 at 1500 rpm, 82-370 at 3000 rpm, 82-200 at 3500 rpm, 82-98 at 4000 rpm (lower = more sensitive than threshold 1), loads 0.91-2.07 g/rev (70-160 %); 65535 (off) elsewhere. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 05FCDC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 0532F4. Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable
table.description:
Master switch for EGR (set in stock). Clearing it is expected to keep EGR off, so the EGR-off variants of base timing, closed loop target and throttle tables become the live ones (inferred).
Details: Set in stock. One of the EGR enable conditions computed by 0x0FAAFC (FFF8A811 bit 0), with coolant, rpm and load windows, engine running and normal combustion mode (read). Clearing it is expected to keep EGR off, so the EGR-off table variants (Base Timing (EGR Off, ...), Closed Loop Target (..., EGR Off), the non-EGR Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables) become the live ones (inferred). LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 02F796 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (read) 0x0E4ADC (pair of 0x0F94A8) stores (0x2A9DA & 0x20) at @(40,R15) and passes it as param_8 of 0x0E60D8 (pair of 0x0FAAFC); stack slot checked in the disassembly (param_8 = param_5 slot + 4, as ref), tested at @(91,R15) in 0x0E60D8 like ref; also passed to 0x0E5260 (ref 0x0F9C3C). Same byte as the transmission-coding bit, as in ref. Stock byte 0x20: bit5 set (ref 0x20). Address 02A9DA bit 5 (value 32). Confidence: read.

table.name: Transmission Coding: From Input Port
table.description:
When set, the manual/automatic coding is read from a hardware input instead of Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT. Clear in all stock images; leave clear.
Details: Clear in all stock images. When set, the transmission coding (FFF886AB bit 7) is taken from a latched input-port bit (FFF80238 bit 7, set once port bit FFF8A2A4 bit 7 is seen) instead of Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT (read, 0x06A38C). Leave clear. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 02F796 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (read) 0x05CA7C (pair of 0x06A38C; LV9N100F/101C code identical 0x50000-0x11CB66) reads the byte through literal 0x05CF04 = 0x0002A9DA, tests 0x40: set -> latch FFF80238 bit7 / port bit, clear -> 0x2A9D8 bit1 (literal 0x05D19C), same structure as ref. Stock byte 0x20: bit6 clear (ref 0x20). Address 02A9DA bit 6 (value 64). Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Torque Rise: Enable Path B
table.description:
Enables the second (Path B) tip-in torque shaping. Clear in stock, and all Path B tables are 0 and its rpm limit is 0, so setting only this bit does essentially nothing. Leave clear unless you calibrate the whole Path B set.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0x01). The torque module 0x0BE694 passes this bit to the rise shaping 0x0BB958 (BLD.B #6 at 0x0BF3D0, stack argument 11, read), and the torque monitor call passes it to 0x1877B4 (read). When set, Path B of the target-torque rise shaping can act (all "Target Torque Rise ... (Path B, ..., Off in Stock)" tables), and a request below Path B Start Torque passes unshaped. Path B also needs rpm <= cal 0x22A04, which is 0 in stock, so setting only this bit changes nothing but the Start Torque bypass (and Path B tables are all 0 ft-lb in stock, so that bypass never triggers). Leave clear unless the whole Path B set is calibrated. Bit 7 of the same byte is a separate switch passed to another torque routine (seg_0x0B0000.c:9252). LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 023704 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: the rise-shaping function 0x0A9F14 (counterpart of LF75404S 0x0BB958; it reads the Path B pedal multiplier table) is called once, with (cal 0x1FCF8 & 0x40) as its only bit-6 cal flag argument, as LF75404S passes cal 0x23704 bit 6 (read); stock byte 0x01 (bit 6 clear). Address 01FCF8 bit 6 (value 64). Confidence: read.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling: Use Alternate Map

When set, Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate, Off in Stock) probably replaces the normal open loop fueling strategy. Clear in stock; leave clear unless you have filled that table.

Passed by the open-loop fueling readers 0x0CE854 and 0x0CE5E8 (read): when set, Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate, Off in Stock) is used in place of the base + DAM-scaled knock additive strategy (inferred). table.name: VE: Use AVCS-Not-Ready Table
table.description:
When set, Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready, Off in Stock) is used while the cams are probably not yet under control. Clear in stock; leave clear.
Details: Clear in stock. 0x11E308 uses Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready, Off in Stock) only when this bit is set and FFF8A83B bit 7 is clear (read); FFF8A83B bit 7 = AVCS ready (inferred). table.name: Base Timing: Pedal-Released Tables Enable
table.description:
Set in stock: with the pedal released, Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed/Open) replaces the normal EGR Active/Off base timing tables. Clear it to use the normal base timing tables off-throttle too.
Details: Set in stock (all images). With this bit set and FFF8A774 bit 0 (pedal released) set, Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed/Open) replaces the EGR Active/Off base timing tables (read, 0x0C2C08). Clear it to use the normal base timing tables with the pedal released. LV9N100F: located from LF75404S 01071E by the code that reads it (read). Address 01071E bit 0 (value 1). Confidence: read.

table.name: Multi-Injection Allowed During High-Pedal Latch 1
table.description:
Allows double/triple injection while one of the high-pedal latches is set (clear = not allowed; clear in stock). Has no effect on a stock car because the multi-injection windows are disabled, so stock always uses single injection.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 1
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for cylinder 1 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders. Stock all 128 (no effect).
Details: Multiplier on injector 1's fuel quantity before the split into injections: 0x0D168C writes FFF8C060 = quantity x this(quantity, rpm) / 128 + the per-cylinder transient (wall-film + throttle-rate) fuel term FFF8C1E4 (0x0F6260; not learned: 0x8000 = none, reset to 0x8000 outside running; adds 4 x (term - 32768) counts) (read). Order 1-4 is the order the code processes FFF8C060-C06C; the transient fuel module's cylinder masks (05C8A0-05C8C4, read in 0x0F5AD0) only fit firing order 1-3-2-4 if slot n is cylinder n+1, so 1-4 is the cylinder number (inferred, strong). All 128 (no change) in stock. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05B1FC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 0673FC. Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Fuel Quantity Limit

scaling.category: mg fuel per cylinder (stock Injector Scaling)
scaling.units: mg (stoich fuel per cylinder per cycle)

scaling.category: base pulse (0.3 MPa reference, any Injector Scaling)

table.description:
Ceiling on the base fuel quantity, the stoichiometric fuel the ECU calculates from measured air before any enrichment. Its meaning in air depends on Injector Scaling: stock it allows about 5 g of air per revolution, but lowering the injector flow figure (for example for E85) lowers the ceiling. Raise it in proportion when you raise Injector Scaling, or the engine will run lean at high airflow.
Details: When used: always while running (every pass of 0x0B7E00, which computes load and the base fuel quantity, read). Upper limit of the base (stoichiometric) fuel quantity FFF8ADEA. 0x0B8030 (read) computes FFF8ADEA = air quantity FFF8C250 x Injector Scaling x 0.10266 / 14.7 / 4 / rpm x 0.125 (= 0.5587 x Injector Scaling x air per cylinder per cycle in g) and stores min(that, this) (0x0B80FC-0x0B8112: MOVU.W @0x23696, CMP/GE, read). The limited value is what the rest of the fuel path uses: the base pulse 0x0D15EC (FFF8C05C = 16 x FFF8ADEA x trims), before the enrichment/fuel factor 0x0D1528 and the flow compensation and latency 0x0D2BB8; the transient-fuel film model 0x0F5F84; the fuel load FFF8ADEE (0x0B895C); and the fuel-used accumulators 0x06B70E (read). Above the limit the base pulse stops rising with airflow, so the mixture goes lean as air keeps rising; enrichment is applied on top of the limited value and does not lift it (inferred from the order of the calls). The raw unit includes Injector Scaling, so the limit in air terms moves with it: air per revolution at the limit = this x 3.580 / Injector Scaling (raw) g/rev = this x reference injector flow [g/s] x 0.0004704. Shown in g/rev for stock Injector Scaling 2918 (2.61 g/s). Stock 4060 = 4.98 g/rev (2.49 g per cylinder per cycle, about 556 g/s at 6700 rpm), well beyond the stock turbo. With Injector Scaling at 1.74 g/s (fuel added for E85 by lowering the flow figure) the limit drops to 3.32 g/rev; below about 1.73 g/s it falls under the 3.31 g/rev (256 %) ceiling of engine load FFF8ADE4 (0x0B7EFC, read) and becomes the first limit reached. When you raise Injector Scaling raw (lower reference flow), raise this in proportion: new = 4060 x new raw / 2918 keeps 4.98 g/rev (u16, up to 65535). On AT/CVT codings, while FFF886AB bit 5 is set (meaning not decoded), the value is first smoothed by boot filter 0x6CEC with cal 0x23694 (stock 255); the limit applies on either path (read). 4060 in all eight images; the same code in LF78001H 0x0C1770, LF79002P 0x0C83DC, LF79100P 0x0C788C, LF9C100P 0x0C0ED8, LV9N 0x0A6840 (read). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 023696 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: Base fuel quantity cap: the first-stage fuel quantity routine (counterpart of LF75404S 0x0B8030; LF79002P 0x0C83DC, LF79100P 0x0C788C, LF9C100P 0x0C0ED8, LF78001H 0x0C1770) stores min(quantity, this cal); stock 4060 as in LF75404S (read, my research notes). Address 02A792. Confidence: read.

Fuel multiplier for injector 4 when it fires three times per cycle (128 = x1.0). Probably unused on a stock car, which runs one injection per cycle; stock all 128.
Details: When used: Applies with three injections per cycle (unused in stock). Written to FFF8A6AE by 0x0CF764 (read). Injector 4's quantity (0x0D1BC0) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A6A2 equals 3 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). All 128 (x1.0) in stock. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05AEC4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 066FDC. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1, Fallback, Off in Stock)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in combustion mode 1 after a warm-up fallback has latched. Off in stock: the fallback is enabled by a calibration switch that is off. Stock 15 MPa flat.
Details: When used: Used only while FFF899D7 bit 0 is set, a once-per-drive warm-up fallback latch (0x081EFC) gated by cal 0x59134 bit 0, which is 0 in stock, so never used in stock (read). 0x165180 (read): target in combustion mode FFF8A85C = 1 while FFF899D7 bit 0 is set (else Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1)); coolant FFF88A44. Stock 15 MPa flat. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05EB84 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 06B188. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1, Fallback, AT/CVT Coding, Off in Stock)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1, Fallback, Off in Stock). Only with the automatic/CVT coding and the warm-up fallback active, so never used on a stock car.
Details: When used: Only with the automatic/CVT transmission coding (Cal Switches: Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT); unused on a manual car (read). LF79100P: a table LF75404S does not have; scaling and axes as Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1, Fallback, Off in Stock). Evidence: carried over from the second reference. Descriptor 06B194. Confidence: read.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling
table.description:
Base open-loop (power enrichment) AFR target by rpm and load, used once the exhaust temperature estimate is high enough. The ECU uses the richer of this and the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV ..., AVCS ...) group: to lean, edit both; to richen, either. Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop).
Details: Note: the ECU has a second open-loop fuel path: the four "Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV ..., AVCS ...)" tables 05ABB0..05ABEC, blended by TGV and AVCS (0x0CE5E8 -> FFF8A681); 0x0CEA80 takes the richer of the two (max). To lean the open-loop target edit both sets; richening works with either (read, my research notes). Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor. Base open-loop enrichment target, 0x0CE854. Used only while the exhaust temperature estimate FFF8AFD0 (see Exhaust Temperature Model Map A/B) is >= cal 0x18DD4 (39322, hysteresis cal 0x18DD6 = 2185), or its integral FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8 (65535); otherwise this path contributes 0 (read). While cal 0x2F79A bit 4 is clear (stock; the first argument of 0x0CE854), the additive term (Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive x DAM multiplier) is added, minus Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive x Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier(DAM)/128, both all zero in stock (read). The result is rate-limited (FFF84424) into FFF8A682, and FFF8A684 = max(FFF8A682, other enrichments) feeds commanded lambda. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05AC6C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 066D84. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description:
Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. Stock identical to Primary Open Loop Fueling; edit all five together. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.
Details: When used: whenever the open-loop delay has expired (see below); the blend follows TGV position and AVCS state. TGV-closed base, weight 1 - a (AVCS not in active control). 0x0CE5E8 (read; called from 0x0C589C with rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616, cal 0x2F79A bit 4, DAM FFF811AE, AVCS weight FFF8A743 and TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8): TGV-closed base = 05ABB0 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABD8 x a/255, TGV-open base = 05ABC4 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABEC x a/255, where a = FFF8A743 is the AVCS-active weight from 0x0D952C (255 while both cam controllers are in active control, my research notes); blend FFF8A69B = closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + open x FFF8B3E8. With cal 0x2F79A bit 4 clear (stock): FFF8A681 = clamp(blend + Additive x DAM Multiplier(DAM)/128 - 05AC14 x 05AC3C(DAM)/128 (Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group) x its DAM multiplier; both all zero in stock), 0, 255). With the bit set: Alternate (+ cal 0x13DCD) while DAM16 < cal 0x1391C (16), else blend + cal 0x13DCD. 0x0CEA80 (read) then takes FFF8A681 (only once FFF8AFD6 >= FFF8AFE6, the open-loop delay, and when >= cal 0x13DD0 = 5), scales it by cal 0x237CA/128 (x1.0), rate-limits its rise by 05ACD4(rpm) and sets FFF8A684 = max(that, FFF8A682), FFF8A682 being Primary Open Loop Fueling from 0x0CE854. FFF8A684 is the open-loop enrichment in commanded lambda 256/(256 + B030 + A684 + AFE8) (0x171C88). So the commanded open-loop mixture is the richer of the two systems: to lean the target, lower this group as well as Primary Open Loop Fueling; to richen, raise this group (Primary Open Loop Fueling alone only takes effect while its exhaust-temperature enable holds: 0x0CE854 sets FFF8A683 to 0 unless FFF8AFD0 >= cal 0x18DD4 or FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8, read). Stock: byte-identical to Primary Open Loop Fueling (05AC6C) and to the other three tables of this group (AFR 14.7 down to about 10.7 at high load); edit all five together. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05ABB0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 066AE8. Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Angle of the first pulse when two injections per cycle are used. Stock never uses multiple injections (the quantity windows are disabled), so it has no effect.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC, stored directly (0x0CFC20: code = 1440 - x, then clamped to 0.5-540 BTDC; read). Same scale as every other Injection Timing / injection-angle table. When used: Angle of the first pulse when two injections per cycle are used, in normal fuel mode (0x0CB394, read). Stock never uses multiple injections: the Double/Triple Injection Quantity Windows are 65535 (read). Injection angle for FFF8B054 (0x0C589C via 0x0CFC20-style helper, read): computed only while FFF99844 is 2 or 3 (otherwise a fixed 0x1FE) (0x0CFC20, read). 0x0CB394 uses B054 for two injections and B058 for three in normal fuel mode (read); the Double Injection tables cover 1100-3200 rpm, the Triple Injection tables 600-1300 rpm. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05AF94 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: port from LF79002P (call-site mapping on near-identical code); the LF75404S-based pick 067190 is the known sibling crosswise pairing seen in LF79002P/LF9C100P (read: confirmed by the decompiled callers / reader positions against LF79002P, 2026-10-29). table.name: Catalyst Heating Injection Angle 2
table.description:
Angle of the second (late, after top dead centre) pulse during stratified catalyst heating, by spark target; negative = after TDC. Stock pinned at the late limit, about 170 degrees after TDC. Has no effect in stock: Catalyst Heating Second Injection Share is 0, so the pulse gets no fuel.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC; negative = AFTER that TDC (expansion stroke). This angle is an offset in segment 0, the 180 degrees after firing TDC (0x0CB604 mode 3 uses it with segment 0; the pulse-fit check 0x075D84 places it B064 + 1440 after the first pulse B062, read), so it is shown as -offset/2: clamped to 0 to -179.5 (0x0D0468, read), and -170 to -179.5 act as -169.5 (0x1DCA04, read). Stock pins at the -179.5 clamp (stored -170 at spark 24 BTDC only): a late expansion-stroke pulse, about 170 degrees ATDC in effect (its quantity is Catalyst Heating Second Injection Share, cal 0x2A3CA, which is 0 in stock, so stock fires no second pulse in this mode). Catalyst-heating mode = FFF8A85C 2 (0x109B4C, read): it maps to fuel mode 3 (0x108B08), in which the ignition target is FFF8A76C (0x0DA51C, read) and the injection angle is FFF8B062 (0x0CB394, read). FFF8B064 = this(FFF8A76C), clamped to 0-359 (0x0D0468, read); used for the second injection's angle by 0x0CB604 (read). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05B194 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 067394. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Normal)
table.description:
Second-pulse injection angle in catalyst-heating phase 2, by rpm and spark target; compression stroke, limited to 10.5-180 BTDC. Used when the TGVs are not closed. Stock 40 BTDC (100 BTDC at 1350-1450 rpm with late spark); identical to the TGV Closed table.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (0 = firing TDC, 180 = intake BDC (start of compression), 360 = gas-exchange TDC, 540 = expansion BDC); larger = earlier. Same scale as every Injection Timing table. Second pulse of the phase 2 split; clamped to 0.5-180 BTDC (code 1080-1439, 0x0D023C, read), i.e. the compression stroke; 0.5-10 BTDC act as 10.5 (0x1DCA04, read). Stock 40 BTDC, and 100 BTDC at 1350-1450 rpm with the spark target at 7 degrees ATDC or later. When used: Selected by FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) in 0x0D023C: this one while it is clear (read). Stock identical to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Closed). Injection angle FFF8B060 from rpm and FFF8A76B (0x0D023C, read), the second-injection angle in fuel mode 2 (0x0CB604, read). table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 1
table.description:
One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Stock boundaries are 0.41 / 0.92 / 1.70 / 3.19 g/rev (31.5 / 71.5 / 131.5 / 246.5 % load) (this is boundary 1, stock 31.5 %). Keep them in increasing order.
Details: Fine learning knock correction cells (0x0E1C58, read): the cell FFF8A790 = 5 x rpm range + load range (0...34). Seven rpm ranges are split at the six boundaries 0x1C24A...0x1C254 on FFF8CE9C, five load ranges at the four boundaries 0x1C240...0x1C246 on FFF8ADE4, each with a hysteresis band (0x1C256 rpm, 0x1C248 load). The learned value for the cell is FFF81414[cell] (s16, x 256); 0x0E73CC applies FFF8A7A7 = min(that, KCA Max x (16 - DAM) x 16) / 256, in 0.3516 degree counts; it is not added to the fired timing directly: like KCA it enters the timing request (0x0C13B4 -> FFF8AF22 -> 0x0C39DC / 0x0DD568), so fired base timing = min(Base Timing + comps, request + KCA + FLKC), and in limit states 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B through the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088). 0x0DFA88 also sums it into the total knock correction FFF8A77B, whose only consumer (0x0DDBBC -> FFF8A770) is zero in stock (read). A negative learned value therefore retards the spark only where the request side is the lower one (most of the high-load map in stock); where Base Timing is lower it is hidden until it pulls the request below Base Timing. Feedback knock correction is the only knock term added directly (0x0D9E40). load boundary. Stock 0.41 / 0.92 / 1.70 / 3.19 g/rev (31.5 / 71.5 / 131.5 / 246.5 % load). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 01C240 by the code that reads it (read). Address 022730. Confidence: read.

table.description:
Base ignition timing map for the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration) with the TGVs closed; identical to the TGV Open table in stock. It is only an upper limit: the ECU fires the lower of this map and Closed-Pedal Timing Target (plus its corrections), and in stock the target is far lower, so raising this map at idle or when coasting does nothing.
Details: When used: Used while the accelerator is fully released (FFF8A774 bit 0: pedal-zero flag FFF88C64 bit 5 in engine state 2/3, vehicle speed FFF99835 at or below cal 0x2FDB2 = 200 km/h (inferred); 0x0E127C / 0x09FF9A, read), TGVs closed; enabled by cal 0x1071E bit 0, set in all four images. The TGV Closed and TGV Open tables are identical in stock. Base ignition timing. 0x0C2C08 uses this 16x16 table when cal 0x1071E bit 0 and FFF8A774 bit 0 are both set, and F2 set (F2 = FFF8A881 bit 4). The result is rate-limited (cals 0x1058C / 0x1058E) and the IAT compensation FFF8A782 and Closed-Pedal Timing Coolant Compensation FFF8A788 are added (0x0C2C08) to give base timing FFF8A645, which is only the upper limit of the fired timing: with the pedal released 0x0DD568 sets FFF8A76A = FFF8A645 - Torque Reduction Spark Retard(FFF8AF22 >> 7), where FFF8AF22 (0x0C13B4) is the efficiency of the closed-pedal timing request (Closed-Pedal Timing Target + FFF8A788 + FFF8A782 + Post-Start Closed-Pedal Timing Advance, 0x0E0A30) plus KCA + FLKC, so in effect FFF8A76A = min(FFF8A645, that request + KCA + FLKC) (read; min() form computed from the inverse tables). FFF8A76A then goes through 0x0DD760, 0x0DA600 and 0x0D9E40 to FFF8A744. In stock the request at idle (about 6-8 degrees at 500-900 rpm, warm) is far below this map (19-28 degrees at 400-1000 rpm, 0.13-0.39 g/rev (10-30 % load)), and it stays below it when coasting (17 vs 34 degrees at 2000 rpm), so idle and coast timing are set by Closed-Pedal Timing Target and raising this map there has no effect (computed from stock data); lowering it below the target does take effect. The F2 selector is FFF8A881 bit 4, set by the TGV module 0x10CAE0 (0x10DEFC) - set = TGVs closed (see below). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, so FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction; 0x10C948 drives it toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so that bit set = TGVs closed. table.name: Boost Limit
table.description:
Boost ceiling by rpm that the torque/throttle model uses as its full-load manifold pressure: the model's target MAP is (torque request / full-load reference torque) x this, and it also scales the throttle-area input. Stock 211 kPa absolute peak (about 16 psi gauge), matching Target Boost.

The torque-model task 0x0C3D14 copies it to FFF8AFAE = A84E << 8 (0x0C3D0C, read). AFAE is the full-load manifold pressure of the throttle/torque model. Target MAP FFF8AF6A = (torque request / full-load reference torque) x this (0x0C2F0C). FFF8AF8A = Throttle Required Area column input AFA8 x this (0x0C3408). The pressure ratio AF6C = AF8A / this (0x0C2F9C) selects the high-pressure spark-compensation filter above 0.85 (all read). Also read by the airflow/torque model 0x111AB8 (role there not decoded). It is not an overboost cut; see Overboost Limit for that. Stock 211 kPa abs peak (about 16 psi gauge), matching Target Boost. Raise it with Target Boost. table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual. Stock 74 ft-lb (100 Nm) per step everywhere, i.e. no Stage 1 limit.
Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 (1, default) with AT/CVT Coding; unused in stock (manual coding). AT/CVT Coding set = FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5); FFF88ADA bit 7 is permanently set in stock (my research notes), so the AT/CVT Coding tables are unused on the manual car. Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default) (0598F8) as Step1 (read: the selection at 0x0BCB12..0x0BCC20). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Main path: with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step1 = (Stage 1 table - 16000) x gear factor (cal 0x1FC98 + 2(g-1): 1, 1, 3, 3, 3 in stock, 255 = x1) x Stage 1 Pedal Multiplier(FFF8AF00) / 65025, Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA (boost target / wastegate duty axis). Stock 24000 everywhere = 74 ft-lb (100 Nm) per 10 ms, i.e. no Stage 1 limit (same as the high-gear cells of the Stage 2 AT/CVT Coding tables). Its rpm axis (0x2000A) differs from the manual table's. The torque monitor 0x1877B4 reads the same data bytes through its own descriptor (05F674), so it stays consistent. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 0598BC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 06535C. Confidence: inferred.

Rev Limit RPM
table.description:
The rev limit (stock 6700 rpm): above it the ECU cuts fuel to all four cylinders on every firing and closes the throttle; spark is not cut or retarded. To move the limit, set this, Rev Limit Full Cut RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM, Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM and Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) to the new rpm and Rev Limit Reset RPM about 100 lower.
Details: When used: always. The rev limit: above this rpm the rev latch sets and the ECU enters limit state 0x0B (part 1); with the stock Full Cut values that is at once a fuel cut on all four cylinders (parts 2-3). It is also the level stage 2 of the throttle cap holds above (part 5). Stock 34304 = 6,700 rpm. Rev limiter and limit-state cuts (LF75404S; read unless marked). The rev limiter is a fuel cut. (1) Limit state, 0x0BE140 (10 ms torque module 0x0BE694): the rev latch FFF8416A sets when rpm FFF8CD54 > Rev Limit RPM (the comparator FFF84169 then uses Rev Limit Reset RPM) and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Reset RPM and MAP FFF88FF4 < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP. The overboost latch FFF84167 sets when MAP >= Overboost Limit (compensated, FFF8A851) + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) and releases below that level minus Overboost Cut Hysteresis (Limit State). Either latch gives limit state FFF8A639 = 0x0B. Priority: not running = 1, FFF8A640 bit 0 = 0x19, latch FFF8416C = 0x1B (cals 0x22FB2-0x22FBC, not decoded), then 0x0B, then the vehicle-speed latch = 0x0C (see Vehicle Speed Limit). (2) Full-cut latch, 0x0BAE98: FFF840C4 sets when rpm >= Rev Limit Full Cut RPM and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM and MAP < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP (above Rev Limit Full Cut Speed Threshold the pair Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM / Stage 2 RPM is used instead; never in stock). In state 0x0B the final torque cap FFF8AE54 (0x0B9DC8) is limited to FFF8AE8A: zero indicated torque (32000 - losses FFF8AF62) while this latch or the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6 (Overboost Limit + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay) is set, otherwise FFF8AF3A = the current air torque minus losses, i.e. no reduction. (3) Fuel: 0x0C4BA0 turns the cap into the torque ratio FFF8A64F; in limit states 8, 9, 0x0B, 0x0C and 0x18-0x1B, 0x0C1AC8 turns the ratio into the number of cylinders to cut FFF8A643 (Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio thresholds; a zero cap gives 4). Once per combustion event (crank-synchronous list 0x07D0E0) 0x0C4B84 makes a cut decision FFF8A648 from the count and the last three decisions (4 = every event, 3 = three in four, 2 = every second, 1 = one in four; the pattern is in code, not a cal). 0x0C88C8 (list 0x07D1C2) latches it into the cut flag of the cylinder being scheduled (FFF8A6F5-FFF8A6F8). For a flagged cylinder the fuel time is 0 (0x0D1D7C/0x0D1FB8) and both start angles are 0x1FE (0x0CB394/0x0CB604), which the injector driver 0x1DCA04 treats as no pulse. So the cut is a true injector cut, all four cylinders, every event. (4) Spark is neither cut nor retarded: the coil scheduler 0x1DB804 only checks FFF8C6F4 (set at the first injection after sync, cleared only on stop), and with Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Rev/Overboost Cut set (stock) 0x0DD568 uses the normal spark target FFF8A72A in state 0x0B instead of Torque Reduction Spark Retard. (5) Throttle: with Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable set (stock) 0x0BDA84 caps the throttle-side request FFF8AE4C in state 0x0B by 0x0BAFA8: Rev/Boost Limit Torque (Stage 1) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM (held while > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold)) or MAP FFF8AF70 > Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 1 MAP (held while > Stage 1 Reset MAP); else (Stage 2) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) (held while > Rev Limit RPM) or MAP > Stage 1 Reset MAP (held while > Stage 2 Hold MAP); else (Base). The torque monitor (0x186F0C) repeats this with the same data. Stock behaviour: above 6,700 rpm all four injectors are cut every event, the throttle closes toward a 37 ft-lb (50 Nm) request and the spark is unchanged; fuel returns as soon as rpm is back at 6,700 or below with MAP under 168 kPa abs (no rpm hysteresis on the fuel cut), and the Base throttle cap (about 166 ft-lb, 225 Nm there, rarely binding) lasts until 6,600 rpm. A hard cut; stage 2 is never selected because its thresholds equal stage 1's. To move the limit, set Rev Limit RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM, Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM and Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) to the new rpm and Rev Limit Reset RPM about 100 rpm lower. Setting the Full Cut pair above Rev Limit RPM gives a throttle-only soft stage between them (inferred). The Fail-Safe Rev Limit cals (6,100 rpm) cut fuel the same way, in any state, when their fault flags are set. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 01DEDE by the code that reads it (read). Address 0243CE. Confidence: read.

table.name: Overboost Limit
table.description:
Overboost limit by rpm, compensated for baro and intake temperature like the boost target. Boost 26.7 kPa over it for 2 s sets the overboost flag, and 33 kPa over it starts the overboost cut (throttle cap, then a full fuel cut once the flag is set). Raise it when raising boost targets (stock 211 kPa absolute peak). Note: the boost-control pressure reading stops at about 269 kPa absolute, so an Overboost Limit above about 236 kPa absolute (269 minus the 33 kPa cut margin) can never trigger the overboost cut.
Details: When used: always. 0x1087D4 (20 ms boost task) -> FFF8A850 (raw) and FFF8A851 = (raw + 13.3) x f - 13, f = the boost target's baro/IAT factor FFF8B3B2/32768 (read; cal 0x290A8 = 1 would use a fixed value, 0 in stock). Two overboost reactions use FFF8A851 (read): (a) 0x0C0FE0 (10 ms): MAP FFF88FF4 >= this + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay passes in a row sets the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6, cleared when MAP <= this + Overboost Flag Reset Margin; (b) 0x0BE140: MAP >= this + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) puts the ECU in limit state 0x0B, which caps the throttle at once. The flag makes the state-0x0B cut a full fuel cut on all four cylinders (see Rev Limit RPM); on its own, outside state 0x0B, it reduces nothing. It also feeds a diagnostic 0x1B8310. Stock 211 kPa abs peak, the same as Boost Limit from 2,000 rpm. Raise it with Target Boost. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05CFD4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 0693AC. Confidence: read.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed

The Fail-Safe Rev Limit cals (6,100 rpm) cut fuel the same way, in any state, when their fault flags are set. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 01DEEA by its caller in the decompiled code (read). table.description:

Details: When used: in the cut limit states (decel fuel cut, rev/overboost/speed cuts). Below this torque ratio at least 1 cylinder is cut. 0x0C1AC8 (read): in limit states 8, 9, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x18 (unless FFF8A638 = 2) and 0x19-0x1B the torque ratio FFF8A64F (capped / unreduced torque, 0x0C4BA0) is compared with four thresholds: cylinders cut FFF8A643 = 0 if the ratio >= the 1-cylinder threshold, 1 if >= the 2-cylinder threshold, 2 if >= the 3-cylinder threshold, 3 if >= the 4-cylinder threshold, else 4 (each threshold minus Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio Hysteresis while it is crossed). The rev limiter and the overboost full cut use a zero cap (ratio 0, 4 cylinders) and do not depend on them. Stock 192 = 75 %. table.description:
Intake-temperature factor on the step rate of a small throttle offset ramp. Has no effect on a stock car because the base step is 0. Stock all 1.0.
Details: 0x0C30F8: FFF8AF7E = cal 0x11ACE x this(IAT) x 05A080(baro) >> 14, the per-pass step of the AF9C throttle offset ramp (0x0C3700). cal 0x11ACE = 0, so inactive in stock; all 1.0. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). p16 (read): this torque-model function (0x0C3E34 subtree) runs every 10 ms (0x07C408 <- 0x1DFE3C); 'pass' = 10 ms. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05A074 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: three look-alike readers 0x0D1DCC/0x0D1E1C/0x0D1E6C (= LF75404S 0x0C30F8/0x0C3150/0x0C31A8), told apart by their gain cal (0x11ACE / 0x11AD0 / 0x1080E, same addresses as 2015) and call order, and they keep the 2015 data addresses (read): IAT table of 0x0D1DCC (cal 0x11ACE), data 0x011ADC as LF75404S 05A074 (read); the automatic port had 065C4C, which is the third reader 0x0D1E6C (cal 0x1080E, = 05A0A4). Descriptor 065C1C. Confidence: read.
