table.name: Throttle Air Spark Compensation Limit
table.description:
Caps, by actual ignition timing, how much the throttle model may add air to make up for retarded timing. Stock 1.5x at 22.5 degrees or more up to 3.1x at -15 degrees, so it does not bind in normal warm running. Shares data with two other entries: editing one edits all three.
Details: 0x0C37D8 (read): FFF8AFA8 = 32768 x (AF2C/AF64) x min(this(final timing FFF8A642), AF56)/8192; the result indexes Throttle Required Area 05A148. It caps the spark-efficiency air compensation (AF56, normally ~1.0) as a function of the actual final timing; stock 1.50x at >=22.5 deg up to 3.13x at -15 deg, so it does not bind in normal warm running. Shares its data (0x0107E8) with 05A124 and 05F414 (0x185FFC): editing one edits all three. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05A118 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: twins 0x0D23F8 (reads 065CC0) and 0x0D2498 (reads 065CCC) share data 0x0107E8; the parent calls 0x0D2498(FFF8B542) then 0x0D23F8(FFF8B540) as LF75404S calls 0x0C385C(AF2E -> AFAA, 05A124) then 0x0C37D8(AF2C -> AFA8, 05A118), and the 0x0D23F8 output FFF8B5BC feeds 0x0D3850, the Throttle Required Area (065CF0) reader, as AFA8 feeds 05A148 (read). The automatic port had 065CCC, the Alt Request twin (same data). Descriptor 065CC0. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs closed, no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount). Stock EGR and non-EGR tables are identical.
Details: When used: every pass of the 0x110000 torque module. Weight (1 - TGV open) x (1 - EGR). Stock: 14-49 ft-lb (19-66 Nm) at zero load, 260-306 ft-lb (352-415 Nm) at 2.81 g/rev (217 % load) from 2400 rpm (119 ft-lb, 162 Nm cap at 800 rpm); identical to the EGR table 05D64C. 0x118318 (DAM 1 set -> FFF8B490) and 0x1186A4 (DAM 0 set -> FFF8B4A2), called from 0x110000 with rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616, TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 and EGR realisation FFF8B290 (read): closed = TGV-closed x (1 - w) + TGV-closed-EGR x w, open = TGV-open x (1 - w) + TGV-open-EGR x w with w = B290/256, result = closed x (1 - B3E8) + open x B3E8, all above the 16000 zero point (read; same blend as the Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables in 0x0C0010). 0x10ED6C interpolates the two sets by DAM: FFF8B48A = B490 x DAM + B4A2 x (1 - DAM) with FFF811AE = DAM x 16 (read), and 0x118A40 subtracts (B490 - B4A2) x (1 - DAM) from the torque it reports as FFF8B4B2 (0.1 ft-lb, 0.1 Nm, 10000 = 0) (read). So these are the engine torque the ECU expects from the air charge, at full and at zero knock-learning advance (inferred from the DAM interpolation). They do not set the throttle or boost; they shape the estimated/reported engine torque (inferred). Axes: rpm FFF8CE9C x load % FFF8A616. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05D638 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (read) CORRECTION of the existing curated_LF79100P placement (069B1C, which is the DAM 0 set). 0x126960 is the first call (-> FFF8BB28, the B490/DAM 1 slot of the DAM interpolator 0x11E444, identical to LF75404S 0x10ED6C after normalisation); lookup 1 -> &DAT_069ACC (LF75404S 05D638). ROM: 069ACC 16x16 u16 data u16@03E70E; axes identical to LF75404S; data identical to LF75404S (0/256 cells differ), stock min/max 17522/49201 (LF75404S 17522/49201). Descriptor 069ACC. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Base

A/F Sensor Exhaust Model Condensate at Start
A/F Sensor Exhaust Model Condensation Flow Factor
A/F Sensor Exhaust Model Saturation Vapour Pressure

table.description:
2017+ / Forester version of A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Hot Restart Factor: on a hot restart the exhaust model starts from the stored pipe temperature times this factor, by stored temperature and coolant drop. Stock 1.0 at no drop to 0.7 at 30 C drop, the same for every stored temperature. Normally leave alone.
Details: When used: before the engine runs, on a hot restart: coolant at start high enough (cals 0x4B638/0x4B639 = 10/110, i.e. the same >= 60 C, 50 C to stay test as LF75404S cals 0x4234C/D) and last running coolant FFF8069B >= cal 0x4B63B (130 = 80 C). 2017+/Forester replacement of the LF75404S 1D table A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Hot Restart Factor (05F1E4), which these images do not have. LF79002P 0x1866D8 (counterpart of LF75404S 0x1802F4; stack arguments checked in the LF79002P disassembly: param_9 @72 = FFF81678, called at 0x18716A, read): the modelled exhaust pipe temperature (K x 32) starts at max(FFF81678 x this(FFF81678, coolant drop)/256, min(IAT, coolant) (C150/C152)). FFF81678 is the pipe temperature latched when the engine stops (0x1866B8, read; = LF75404S FFF815BA). Axis 1 = that stored pipe temperature (u16, K x 32; the lookup 0x1B0D7C clamps it and the drop to the axis ends), axis 2 = the coolant drop since the engine last ran, FFF8069B - FFF88D96 x 160/65536 - 10 (s8, degC) (read). Stock identical in all four images and in every row (no dependence on the stored temperature): 1.00 (255) at 0 C drop, 0.95 at 5, 0.90 at 10, 0.85 at 15, 0.80 at 20, 0.75 at 25, 0.70 at 30 and 35 C drop - the same curve as LF75404S 05F1E4, with 5 C steps. LF79100P: a table LF75404S does not have. Evidence: Phase 19 group X (my research notes): reader 0x186818, call site 1868D0; replaces the 1D hot-restart factor of the 2015 code (read). Descriptor 06B824. Confidence: read.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A Enrichment Adder (Zero in Stock)
table.description:

The table uses that same 24 x 20 grid (400-9200 rpm x 0.91-2.97 g/rev (70-230 % load)). All zero in LF79002P, LF79100P and LF9C100P (read), so the term has no effect in stock. table.name: Intake Cam Target 1A (TGV Open, Normal, Altitude)
table.description:
Intake cam advance target (degrees from the fully retarded rest position) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open, used at altitude (blended in by AVCS Barometric Blend; near sea level the 1B table is used instead). Higher = earlier intake valve timing. The normal vs high-pedal split is inferred from the switching conditions.
Details: Convention (read, see FU_UNITS): crank degrees of intake cam ADVANCE from its learned rest position; 0 = rest (fully retarded, inferred), larger = more advance (earlier valve events). Values below 0 ask for less than the rest position: the OCV then sits at minimum duty and the cam stays at rest (inferred). AVCS target (intake 0x15C250, exhaust 0x16032C, read): target = coolant terms + v x [S_A x w + S_B x (1 - w)] + (1 - v) x [3A x w + (3B + Coolant Offset 3B x Coolant Factor 3 / 128) x (1 - w)], clamped to +/-90 degrees, 364.09 counts per degree. v = FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction: sets 1/2 apply with TGVs open, set 3 with TGVs closed. w = FFF8B948 = AVCS Barometric Blend (barometric pressure FFF88668, via 0x15B1E0, read): the A tables apply at altitude, the B tables at sea level. Stock w = 1 at or below 84 kPa (about 5200 ft) and 0 at or above 98 kPa (about 1000 ft), so near sea level only the B tables are used. S = set 1 or set 2, chosen by FFF8A8A4 bit 7 (stack argument +24 from 0x15969C, read). That bit is a high-pedal latch (0x11C15C / 0x10F848, read): it sets when the accelerator FFF88A5E is at or above High Pedal Entry Threshold (90 % stock, by barometric pressure) while vehicle speed is not jumping (under cal 0x35B16... per gear) and some status flags (FFF88A2D bit 0, FFF88ADA bit 6, FFF8A8A2 bit 6) are clear, or when FFF8A8A5 bit 2 or 4 is set; it clears once the pedal is below cal 0x36518 (85 %). So set 1 = normal driving and set 2 = near wide-open pedal (meaning inferred from these conditions). In stock (sea-level B tables), intake set 2 differs from set 1 across the map: about +10...+35 degrees more advance below 1.03 g/rev and about 10...20 degrees less advance at 1.29 g/rev and above from 1200 to 4400 rpm, equal from 5600 rpm; exhaust set 2 differs mainly below 1.03 g/rev; the altitude (A) sets differ only below 0.52 g/rev. The set-3 terms are active because cal 0x3ACF6 = 1 in both images. Set 1, A table (weight w). Stock -11...30 degrees. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05E4BC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 06AA14. Confidence: inferred.

It is added to both base timing and the timing request, so it moves the fired timing directly. Stock -3.5 to +10.5 degrees at 800-2400 rpm, 0.39-1.03 g/rev (30-80 % load).
Details: When used: TGV-closed side (the TGV-open table 05B9E4 is flat 128 in stock). 0x0DCEE8 (read): while EGR is active (FFF8A813 bit 7, with on/off delays cals 0x239B0/0x239B2) FFF8A765 = 128 + FFF8B290/256 x EGR Coolant Timing Adjustment Coolant Multiplier(coolant)/255 x [(1 - v) x (TGV Closed table - 128) + v x (05B9E4 - 128)] half-degrees, v = TGV open fraction; 128 when EGR is off. 0x0E0584 adds FFF8A765 - 128 into FFF8A787 (coolant timing compensation), which is added to base timing FFF8A645 (0x0C2C08, pedal pressed) and to the timing request (0x0E0A30) (read). It is not a separate term of the sum 0x0D9E40, but it reaches the fired timing through FFF8A645 -> FFF8A76A -> FFF8A74B -> FFF8A744 (0x0DD568 / 0x0DD760 / 0x0DA600) on both sides of the min(Base Timing, request + KCA + FLKC) limit, so it moves the fired timing directly (read). Stock -3.5..+10.5 degrees at 800-2400 rpm, 0.39-1.03 g/rev (30-80 % load). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05B9D0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 067C90. Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Upstream Pressure Estimate
table.description:
Estimated pressure upstream of the EGR valve (probably exhaust side) by rpm and load. The difference to manifold pressure sets the modelled EGR flow and decides whether EGR may be enabled. Stock about 101 kPa at idle up to 170 kPa at high rpm and load.
Details: 0x0FA760 (read, disassembly): FFF8A81D = this(rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616) + EGR Upstream Pressure Baro Adder x Multiplier / 128, clamped 0..255. 0x0F943C turns it into the pressure difference across the valve FFF8A810 = A81D - MAP, which indexes EGR Valve Flow Model; 0x0FAAFC requires MAP + cal 0x2CCD1 (5 kPa) <= A81D x 2/3 to enable EGR (read). Reading it as the exhaust-side (upstream) pressure is inferred; stock 152 (101.3 kPa) at idle up to 255 (170 kPa) at high rpm and load. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05CB3C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 068F14. Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Minimum coolant temperature for the TGVs to close (probably; part of the TGV close conditions). Stock 5 degC.
Details: TGV request logic 0x10D93C (read): the request byte FFF8A888 is 3 unless all of these hold: coolant FFF88A44 at or above TGV Coolant Minimum (hysteresis cal 0x37B46 - 16384, stock 409 = 1 C), requested torque FFF8AEE2 (0x0BA868, Nm = x/80 - 200) below the rpm-based TGV Torque Threshold (it must fall below the Enter table and then rise above the Exit table to clear), air quantity FFF8B4D6 below TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter 0x37A4A, Exit 0x37A48), and FFF8A88D = 0. When they hold, FFF8A888 = 1, or 2 if the intake air temperature FFF88A48 is below TGV IAT Threshold (vehicle speed) or FFF88E28 bit 0/2 is set; FFF8A888 = 2 also while combustion mode FFF8A85C is below cal 0x37B48. State 1 requests TGV close: it runs the timer FFF8B3E0 (0x10C3D0) and FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is set once the timer reaches TGV Close Delay (05D384, by vehicle speed; stock 1 s at standstill, 2 s from 4 km/h). States 2 (close blocked: cold intake air, FFF88E28 bit 0/2, or combustion mode below cal 0x37B48) and 3 (close conditions not met) reset the timer, so the TGVs stay open (read). Which threshold pair is used depends on FFF8A8C1 (1, 2, 3 or other) and FFF8A8A2 bit 5 (not identified). Each threshold is table(rpm FFF8CE9C) + TGV Torque Threshold Offset(rpm, FFF88AE6) - 16000, so the offset table is centred on 16000 (0 ft-lb). Used while FFF899D7 bit 0 is clear. Stock 18432 = 5 degC. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 037A44 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (read) Counterpart reader(s) 0x10D93C->0x11CD60 (ref 1 access(es), target 1, size [2]); decompile token alignment puts this cal at the position of LF75404S 0x037A44 (1 reference(s), votes {'0404FC': 1}); machine-code effective addresses of the target function confirm 0x0404FC is accessed as u16. Stock 18432 (LF75404S 18432). Matches the layout address. Address 0404FC. Confidence: read.

table.description:
How long the brake must be pressed over a held accelerator, by pedal position and speed, before brake override starts cutting the pedal signal (above 7 km/h). Stock 2 s at light pedal, 0.5 s from 60 % pedal. Part of the brake override, which limits the accelerator signal when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held.
Details: When used: while the VDC brake-pressure signal is valid (FFF8AC8F bit 4); 05F2E0 (200 = 2 s, flat) replaces it otherwise. Brake override module 0x181B38 (10 ms task 0x1DFE3C, read): it limits the accelerator pedal that feeds the torque request, FFF88A5E = min(pedal FFF88EE6, limit FFF8BAFA) (0x09E800, read), when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held. Brake detection: VDC CAN frame 0x0D1 byte 2 (FFF88DF9, slew-limited 8/pass into FFF8AC94; brake pressure, inferred) against a threshold, or discrete input FFF88E2F bit 3 (pin PF10; brake switch, inferred) when the pressure signal is not valid (FFF8AC8F bit 4 clear). Vehicle speed FFF8AC95 = km/h from the wheel speeds or FFF88BE8 x 9/160 (0x182E34, read). The module sets no DTC (no DTC monitor record points at its RAM, read). 0x1832C4 (read, args checked in the assembly): override request FFF8AC91 bit 1 sets when the time FFF8BADA since the brake was applied while the accelerator was already pressed (FFF8AC90 bit 6, 0x1831EC) reaches this(pedal FFF88EE6, speed FFF8AC95), with speed >= cal 0x43472 (7 km/h) and either pedal >= 05F2C0 (1.1 %) or a deceleration-confirmed brake (FFF8AC91 bit 2). FFF8AC91 bit 1 (or bit 0, the brake-switch path 0x183680) sets the active flag FFF8AC8F bit 0 (0x183B68), which starts the pedal-limit ramp. Stock 200 passes (2.0 s) at 11 % pedal; 1.25-1.5 s at 23 %; 0.75-1.0 s at 40 %; 0.5 s from 60 % pedal. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05F2CC by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: brake-override set function 0x1891A4 (= LF75404S 0x1832C4) (read): same code (a 2D lookup without arguments, the 2D lookup(param_3, param_4) compared with param_2, a 1D lookup(param_4)); called from 0x187CE0 as callee 36 of 44 (0x8A0 calls not counted), right after the Brake Override Recovery Time reader, as 0x1832C4 is in 0x181B38; its 2D argument table is 06B908. The automatic code pick 06B944 is the 2D table of the next reader 0x189524 (= LF75404S 0x183680, table 05F308, whose stock data are flat 200): the code-identical sibling. stock data equal LF75404S 05F2CC (read). Descriptor 06B908. Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Road speed per 1000 rpm for each gear, used only by the gear advice function. No effect on a stock car: the gear advice function is switched off by a calibration setting. The values do not match the 6MT and probably belong to another transmission.
Details: When used: never in stock (cal 0x57585 bit 3 clear). Same data block as descriptor 05D468 (one entry). Road speed per 1000 rpm for gear index 1-8: stock 11.3, 16.3, 22.6, 29.7, 37.5, 53.9, 53.9, 53.9. 0x11031C (read; called at seg_0x110000.c:1175 with cal 0x57585 bit 3, gear FFF8A8BA, speed FFF88BE8, selector FFF8A8C3): only when cal 0x57585 bit 3 is set, FFF8558A = this(gear) (the Alternate table when FFF8A8C3 = 2) and FFF85588 = speed x 28800 / FFF8558A -> FFF8B434. 0x110398 does the same with the second gear index FFF8A8BC (0x1143CC) through the shared descriptors -> FFF8B436. 0x116A0C (gear advice, gated by the same bit) uses B436/B434 as rpm x 0.1953125 to convert the current power to torque at those engine speeds (read). Stock cal 0x57585 = 0x73 (bit 3 clear): the block 0x11031C / 0x110398 / 0x114360 / 0x116A0C keeps its outputs at their reset values and never reads these tables. The values (11.3 to 53.9 km/h per 1000 rpm over 6 steps here, 11.0 to 53.9 over 8 in the Alternate table) do not fit the 6MT, so this belongs to another transmission (inferred). table.name: Gear Advice Consumption Map (Off in Stock)
table.description:
Fuel consumption map by torque and rpm (probably g/kWh) for a gear-shift advice function that picks the most economical gear. One table edits all three copies. No effect on a stock car: the gear advice function is switched off by a calibration setting.
Details: When used: never in stock (cal 0x57585 bit 3 clear). Gear advice module 0x116A0C (read; called at seg_0x110000.c:1208 with cal 0x57585 bit 3, which is clear in stock 0x73, so the function returns at once and never reads its tables). With the bit set it takes the current power (torque x rpm / 9549.3), the engine speed in the gear below (FFF8B434, gear FFF8A8BA = gear - 1, 0x114360) and in the gear above (FFF8B436, gear FFF8A8BC = gear + 1, 0x1143CC), looks up the consumption map at the three points and advises the gear with the lowest value (FFF85678 / FFF85679, biases cal 0x36E4E/0x36E50 = 3 %). 'Alternate' tables are used when FFF8A8C3 = 2. Descriptors 05D4D8, 05D504 and 05D518 share this data block (037352): 05D4D8 at the current torque FFF8B468 = DAM-blended torque FFF8B48A - FFF8A8CC x 128 (0x1161DC) and rpm, 05D504 / 05D518 at the torque needed for the same power in the lower / upper gear (read). One entry edits all three. Stock minimum 7703 (241 g/kWh as x/32, inferred) at 2000 rpm / 133 ft-lb (180 Nm); 10000-14000 at light load or high rpm; rows from 280 ft-lb (380 Nm) repeat. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05D4D8 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 06996C. Confidence: inferred.

Converts the main intake air temperature sensor voltage to degrees; this IAT feeds the timing, boost and fuel compensations and the scan-tool reading. Its voltage axis is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling, so edit only the temperatures when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06AF58, read). ADC channel 19 (0xFFFFE864, untrimmed) -> FFF88D38 -> FFF88F30, filtered by cal 0x579B6 (65535 = no filter in stock) -> FFF88F34 / FFF88F32, looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) to give FFF88662 = degC + 50: the OBD IAT FFF8CEE5, the IAT behind FFF88A48 (the IAT axis of the timing, boost, throttle and fuel compensation tables) and the IAT read by fuel 0x0C589C and purge 0x0D4E78 (for Purge Air Density (IAT, Baro), 0x0D44DC) (read). This is IAT sensor 1 (P0112 / P0113, read), probably the element in the MAF housing (inferred). The voltage axis (0x579FC, 32 points 0...4.96 V in 0.16 V steps; 65536 = 5 V inferred) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling: change only the temperature values for a different thermistor, or both sensors move. While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BA x 256 (stock 3.40 V, about 20 C) is used. Stock: 205 C at 0 V, 25 C at 3.20 V, -50 C from 4.80 V (identical to IAT 2). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 060850 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 06D098. Confidence: read.

table.name: Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling
table.description:
Converts the second intake temperature sensor's voltage to degrees. This is the air temperature the ECU's airflow model uses to work out air density, and it probably comes from the manifold pressure (TMAP) sensor, so update it when you swap that sensor for one with a different thermistor. Its voltage axis is shared with the main IAT table; change only the temperatures.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06B304, read). ADC channel 20 (0xFFFFE868, untrimmed) -> FFF88D40 -> FFF88F36, filtered by cal 0x579B8 (no filter in stock) -> FFF88F38 / FFF88F3A, looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF888CF (degC + 50; FFF888D4 from the unfaulted value). This is IAT sensor 2 (P0097 / P0098 monitors on the same voltage, read). FFF888CF is the air temperature of the speed-density airflow model (0x11DF4C: density from MAP and IAT 2 + 223 K) and is also read by requested torque 0x0BE694, ignition 0x0D98F8 / 0x0D9A10 / 0x0DE0E0 and AVCS 0x15969C (read), so a wrong curve shifts the modelled air and load. Probably the thermistor of the manifold TMAP sensor (inferred from its use as the manifold air temperature): when fitting a different TMAP / MAP sensor with its own thermistor, change these temperature values. The voltage axis (0x579FC) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor Scaling, so change only the data. While faulted (FFF88FCD bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BB x 256 (stock 3.40 V, about 20 C) is used. Stock identical to IAT 1. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 06085C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 06D0A4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Coolant Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts coolant temperature sensor voltage to degrees. Every coolant-based table and the scan-tool coolant reading use this. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BA46, read). Coolant sensor voltage FFF8865E (input 0 of the 8-way multiplexer on ADC channel 21, untrimmed, 65536 = 5 V inferred) is filtered by cal 0x56EE8 (65535 = no filter) into FFF88ADC and looked up here (boot lookup 0x73BC) into FFF88AE8 / FFF88AE0 (256 x (degC + 50)): FFF8CD65 (coolant byte, degC + 50), the OBD coolant value and FFF88A44 (the coolant axis of most tables). While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 1) a warm-up model from cals 0x56EEC-0x56EF2 replaces it. Range faults: P0117 below Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit, P0118 above Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit. Stock: 205 C at 0 V, 25.7 C at 3.20 V, -50 C from 4.80 V. Change only when fitting a different sensor. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 060874 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 06D0BC. Confidence: read.

table.name: Oil Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts oil temperature sensor voltage to degrees; this oil temperature feeds the AVCS and idle tables and the scan-tool reading. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BEA0, read). Oil temperature sensor voltage FFF88AA2 (input 7 of the 8-way multiplexer on ADC channel 21, untrimmed) is filtered by cal 0x56F76 (65535 = no filter) into FFF88AE4 and looked up here (boot lookup 0x73BC). Output unit 256 x (degC + 50), read: FFF88E24 = (output - 0xA00) x 256 / 205 and OBD PID 0x5C reports FFF88E24 x 205 / 65536 = degC + 40. FFF88E24 / FFF88E26 is the oil temperature of the AVCS and idle tables (oil_temp_obd axis). Range faults: P0197 below Oil Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit, P0198 above Oil Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit. Stock identical to the coolant curve. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 060880 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 06D0C8. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range)
table.description:
Converts the front wideband A/F sensor signal to lambda when the reading is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37. This is the measured lambda used by closed loop fueling. Identical to A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich) in stock; edit both together.
Details: When used: Used while FFF88AFB bit 4 is clear: the A/F signal is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37 (window -800..1000 with hysteresis 333, 0x0843F8, read); gain cal 0x571F0 = 2. Identical to Near Stoich in stock; edit both together. 0x06C1A8 (read): the A/F sensor signal FFF88B2E is looked up here (boot lookup 0x6A0C) into FFF88AF6, the measured lambda of the closed loop (B308 = 43194 x 32768 / FFF88AF6, 0x0FF3CC). Stock lambda 1.00 at signal -25...0. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 06088C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 06D0D4. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich)
table.description:
Converts the front A/F sensor signal to lambda when it reads within about lambda 0.90-1.37, at a higher gain. Shares its axis with A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range) and is identical to it in stock; edit both together.
Details: When used: Used while the A/F signal is within about lambda 0.90-1.37 (FFF88AFB bit 4 set, 0x0843F8, read); higher gain cal 0x571F1 = 9 (gain reading inferred). Second A/F sensor table in 0x06C1A8 (read); shares the axis with A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range). Identical to it in stock; edit both together. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 060898 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 06D0E0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Fuel Level Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the fuel sender reading, which the instrument cluster sends to the ECU over CAN, to fuel level (219 = 100 %). The ECU averages it and reports it as fuel level to a scan tool. Stock: full at the lowest input, empty at the highest.
Details: When used: always (0x06C336, read). Input: the fuel sender reading sent by the combination meter on CAN 0x282 bytes 0-1 (10-bit, FFF88E04 -> 0x1108B8 -> FFF8B43C; not an ECU analog input). 0x06C336 forms FFF88BD0 = FFF8B43C x 2867 / (FFF8B43C + cal 0x572E0 (720)), filters it into FFF88BCC and looks it up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF88BD4; FFF88BD7 is its average over cal 0x572E6 samples taken while FFF88A76 is at least cal 0x572E4, kept in backup RAM FFF806BB/806BC, and reported by OBD PID 0x2F as x 255 / 219 (read). So this is the fuel level curve, 219 = 100 %. P0463 / P0462 when FFF88BCC is above cal 0x572DA / below cal 0x572DE (0x0714E0 / 0x071548, read). Stock: full (219) at the lowest input, empty at 2432 and above. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 0608A4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 06D0EC. Confidence: read.

table.name: Battery Temperature Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the battery temperature sensor voltage to degrees for the charging-voltage control. It is probably the temperature half of the battery sensor, whose current signal the ECU also reads. Leave alone unless the battery sensor is changed.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06C768, read). ADC channel 9 (0xFFFFE852, untrimmed) -> FFF8939A, filtered by cal 0x590F0 into FFF8939E (cal 0x590EE replaces the input while FFF88BCA bit 2 or 3 is set) and looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF893A0 (degC + 50), read only by the charging-voltage control 0x136CD8 (temperature-compensated voltage targets); the unfiltered value gives FFF893A1, reported by SSM as x - 10 (0x11F0E8, read). Identity (inferred): its companion input ADC channel 4 (FFF89390, 0x06C554) is a linear signal centred on 2.5 V (FFF89396 = 12800 - 0.488 x (sample - 32768); SSM x/128 + 28 puts zero at 2.5 V, about -50 A per volt), i.e. a bidirectional battery current, read by charging control 0x136BC0 and idle 0x0EE338; the two inputs share their filter cal block and their range monitors (FFF88BCA bits 2-5, 0x0715B0-0x07175C) are both enabled by cal 0x57584 bit 4, which is clear in stock (monitors off). A current + temperature pair used only for charging is the battery sensor, so this is battery temperature. Stock: 100 C at 0.32 V, 20 C at 2.37 V, -40 C from 4.71 V (NTC). Leave alone unless the battery sensor is changed. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 0608B0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 06D0F8. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Rear O2 Sensor Ready Heater Energy Threshold
table.description:
How much heater energy, by coolant temperature at start, the rear O2 sensor must have received before it is treated as warmed up and ready. Raising it delays the rear O2 sensor (and its diagnostics) becoming active. Stock about 130 s of heating at -40 C to about 90 s at 60 C.
Details: When used: while the engine runs (run state FFF8906B = 3). 0x1028D0 (read; called from 0x101CF0): FFF8A833 bit 7 is set (and held until the run state leaves 3) when the accumulated rear O2 heater drive FFF88E6E > this(coolant at start FFF88A46; the -40 C row is used when the coolant sensor is faulted, FFF88E28 bit 1), or when FFF8881E >= cal 0x4B900 (9437) for cal 0x4B904 (50) passes. Rear O2 identity: the heater output FFF9980E bit 2 is driven by 0x06EC70 for FFF8CE0B of every 24 40-ms passes, and 0x073570 monitors that output against FFF8CE0B into FFF89CB4 bits 0/1, the P0037 / P0038 (heater circuit, bank 1 sensor 2) monitor records (dtc_monitors slots 182 / 180, read). FFF88E6E sums FFF8CE0B every 40 ms (0x06ED92, read), so it is heater energy since start; FFF8CE0B = 0 while the heater is held off (initial delay from 0x608F4, high load, battery out of range; 0x06E7D8, read). FFF8881E = 2 x (ADC channel 11 - ADC channel 25) (0x1E0000 task, read); it is the oxygen-sensor signal that gates Fuel Cut Recovery Enrichment (0x0CAE40: FFF8881E < cal 0x14F5C, read), so the second path is 'sensor already reads rich' (inferred). FFF8A833 bit 7 feeds the catalyst/rear-O2 module 0x101CF0 (0x1023E0, 0x102B58) and the rear O2 diagnostics 0x1B8890 / 0x1B902C (P0137, result FFF8AD93 bit 7) and 0x123C68 (read). Meaning 'sensor ready / warmed up' inferred. Stock 26250 at -40 C falling to 18125 at 60 C start coolant; at 13.75 V with the default heater stage that is about 130 s and 90 s of heating (inferred, 200 counts/s). Raising it delays the rear O2 sensor being treated as ready. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05CEB0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 069288. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Intake Air Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit (P0112)
Intake Air Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit (P0113)
Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Voltage Low Limit (P0097)
Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Voltage High Limit (P0098)
Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit (P0117)
Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit (P0118)
Oil Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit (P0197)
Oil Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit (P0198)
Rail Pressure Sensor Voltage Low Limit (P0192)
Rail Pressure Sensor Voltage High Limit (P0193)
P0087 Rail Pressure Low Limit
table.description:
Rail pressure floor by rpm for P0087 (rail pressure too low): the code counts a fault when actual pressure stays more than 0.30 MPa (hysteresis cal) below this value for about 10 seconds, i.e. below 0.40 MPa in stock, and recovers when pressure is back at this value. Stock 0.70 MPa at all rpm.
Details: 0x0752A8 (read, boot lookup 0x72AC): the absolute low-pressure test fails while actual rail pressure FFF88884 < this(rpm FFF8CD56) - hysteresis cal 0x574DA for cal 0x574E0 passes -> P0087. Stock 1148 = 0.70 MPa flat. p16 (read): 0x0752A8 (<- 0x0A1D2C <- 0x1DFE3C) runs every 10 ms; 200 passes = 2 s, 1000 passes = 10 s. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 0609C4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 06D2C4. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1
table.description:
Crankshaft roughness level, by rpm and load, that confirms channel 1 of the P219A A/F imbalance monitor. It sets no code by itself; P219A needs both this and A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1 exceeded. Raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never). Stock off below 1500 rpm, above 4000 rpm and below 0.91 g/rev (70 % load).
Details: When used: once per combustion event (0x1908E4, crank-synchronous list 0x1E1D1C) while the P219A monitor runs (FFF8ACD1). Confirms channel 1 of P219A (A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1). 0x18E130 (read): threshold FFF8BC5E = this(rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616) x 05FCB0(coolant)/8192 x 05FCBC/128 (both 1.0 in stock) x 1.0 (float constants 1000/2^33 and 8.192, 0x18E23C / 0x18E248, read); x 100 instead (capped at 65535, so during that window any cell >= 336 can never be exceeded) until the neutral input FFF88ADA bit 6 has been unchanged for cal 0x4496E = 150 passes (1.5 s; FFF8ACCD bit 5, 0x1912B4) - the A/C-state stability bit 6 (0x191324, cal 0x436B2 = 0) is always set; 65535 while FFF88A2D bit 0; 05FC90 (all 65535) replaces it near standstill with the pedal released (FFF8ACCD bit 0: FFF88C64 bit 5 and speed < 2 km/h) and 05FC68 (all 65535) while FFF8AA3F is set. 0x18F14C sets FFF8ACC5 = 2 when the crank fluctuation FFF8BC5C - 0x8000 > threshold x 250/256 (so an event counts when the fluctuation exceeds 0.977 x the cell value). 0x18D180... count those events per cylinder (FFF8ACC2 = 1..4, cylinder inferred) into FFF8BC24/28/2C/30 and in total FFF8BC48; at the end of a 2000-event window (FFF8BC20 = cal 0x436F0) 0x18F364 judges FFF8ACC7 = 2 'rough' when a cylinder count > cal 0x436F4 (17) or the total > cal 0x436F6 (17) (with a cylinder share > cal 0x43704 = 0) (read). That latches FFF8ACD8 (0x191850). The channel 1 judgement 0x18F980 gives FFF8ACCB = 2 (exceeded, which sets FFF8ACCF bit 1 and through it the P219A result in 0x19198C) only when the A/F swing exceeded its reference (FFF8ACCE bit 4) AND FFF8ACD8 (or FFF8ACD4) is set; FFF8ACCB = 1 (passed) when the swing passed (FFF8ACCE bit 5, cal 0x436C0 = 1) (read). So the roughness test is a required confirmation: a channel 1 P219A needs both the A/F swing and this crank roughness. (The alternative pass by roughness, FFF8ACD5 and FFF8ACD9, cannot occur in stock: with cal 0x436EE = 0 the second window FFF8BC1E always matches, so FFF8ACC7 never reaches 4; read.) The largest count and its limit are also Mode $06 values FFF815CE / FFF815D0 (0x18EB24 / 0x18EBA8, test 0xDC in the 0x0A0000 reporter, read). Raising cells makes the confirmation harder (65535 = never), lowering makes it easier; it does not set a DTC by itself. Stock 615-775 at 1500 rpm (live in normal driving; only the 1.5 s neutral-settling window makes cells >= 336 unreachable), 200-556 at 3000 rpm, 138-388 at 3500 rpm, 163-220 at 4000 rpm for loads 0.91-2.07 g/rev (70-160 %); 65535 (off) below 1500 rpm, above 4000 rpm and below 0.91 g/rev (70 % load). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05FC7C by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: A/F imbalance threshold readers 0x192DB0 and 0x192EB8 (= LF75404S 0x18E130 / 0x18E250; same code: 1D lookup by FFF8xxxx, 2D lookup chosen by a flag and param_2, 1D byte lookup of param, product clamped to 7999.878 x 8.192; the 2017-style builds drop the 4th flag argument) are called in the same order as in LF75404S (Threshold 2 reader first, then Threshold 1) and write FFF8C332 / FFF8C334, copied to the next words by the 11-insn functions as LF75404S FFF8BC5E / FFF8BC60 (read). Threshold 1 = the table 0x192DB0 reads in the flag-clear, param_2-clear branch: 06C2B8 (as 0x18E130 reads 05FC7C). The automatic port left it unresolved (conflict between the code-identical siblings 0x192DB0 and 0x192EB8); stock data equal LF75404S 05FC7C (read). Descriptor 06C2B8. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 2
table.description:
Crankshaft roughness level that confirms channel 2 of the P219A monitor (paired with A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2). Lower than Threshold 1, so more sensitive. Sets no code by itself; raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never). Stock off outside 1500-4000 rpm and 0.91-2.07 g/rev (70-160 % load).
Details: When used: as A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1, for channel 2 of P219A (A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2). 0x18E250 (read): same gating and scaling (x 05FD10(coolant)/8192 x 05FD1C/128, both 1.0) into FFF8BC60 -> FFF8BC64; 0x18F0F8 sets FFF8ACC4 = 2 on an exceedance; per-cylinder counters FFF8BC32..BC44 (0x18D4C8...) and the 2000-event window judgement FFF8ACC6 (0x18F1A0: a cylinder count > cal 0x436FC (17) or the total > cal 0x436FE (17) gives 2 'rough') latch FFF8ACDB (0x191920). The channel 2 judgement 0x18F928 gives FFF8ACCA = 2 (exceeded: FFF8ACCF bit 3 -> P219A result) only when the swing exceeded (FFF8ACCE bit 2) AND FFF8ACDB (or FFF8ACD6) is set; = 1 (passed) when the swing passed (FFF8ACCE bit 3, cal 0x436C1 = 1) (read). Mode $06 values FFF815D2 / FFF815D4 (0x18EFCC / 0x18F050, read). Stock 237-283 at 1500 rpm, 82-370 at 3000 rpm, 82-200 at 3500 rpm, 82-98 at 4000 rpm (lower = more sensitive than threshold 1), loads 0.91-2.07 g/rev (70-160 %); 65535 (off) elsewhere. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05FCDC by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: A/F imbalance threshold readers 0x192DB0 and 0x192EB8 (= LF75404S 0x18E130 / 0x18E250; same code: 1D lookup by FFF8xxxx, 2D lookup chosen by a flag and param_2, 1D byte lookup of param, product clamped to 7999.878 x 8.192; the 2017-style builds drop the 4th flag argument) are called in the same order as in LF75404S (Threshold 2 reader first, then Threshold 1) and write FFF8C332 / FFF8C334, copied to the next words by the 11-insn functions as LF75404S FFF8BC5E / FFF8BC60 (read). Threshold 2 = the table 0x192EB8 reads in the same branch: 06C318 (as 0x18E250 reads 05FCDC); stock data equal LF75404S 05FCDC (read). Descriptor 06C318. Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable
table.description:
Master switch for EGR (set in stock). Clearing it is expected to keep EGR off, so the EGR-off variants of base timing, closed loop target and throttle tables become the live ones (inferred).
Details: Set in stock. One of the EGR enable conditions computed by 0x0FAAFC (FFF8A811 bit 0), with coolant, rpm and load windows, engine running and normal combustion mode (read). Clearing it is expected to keep EGR off, so the EGR-off table variants (Base Timing (EGR Off, ...), Closed Loop Target (..., EGR Off), the non-EGR Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables) become the live ones (inferred). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 02F796 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (read) Caller of 0x10A02C passes (DAT_00037c0a & 0x20) as param_8; 0x10922C (pair of 0x0F9C3C) passes it to 0x10A52C (pair of 0x0FB088). Stock 0x20 (bit5 set). Address 037C0A bit 5 (value 32). Confidence: read.

table.name: Transmission Coding: From Input Port
table.description:
When set, the manual/automatic coding is read from a hardware input instead of Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT. Clear in all stock images; leave clear.
Details: Clear in all stock images. When set, the transmission coding (FFF886AB bit 7) is taken from a latched input-port bit (FFF80238 bit 7, set once port bit FFF8A2A4 bit 7 is seen) instead of Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT (read, 0x06A38C). Leave clear. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 02F796 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (read) 0x0776D4 (pair of 0x06A38C): (DAT_00037c0a & 0x40) == 0 selects DAT_00037c08 & 2, else latched input port. Shared byte with EGR Enable (bit5) is correct. Stock byte 0x20 (bit6 clear). Address 037C0A bit 6 (value 64). Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Torque Rise: Enable Path B
table.description:
Enables the second (Path B) tip-in torque shaping. Clear in stock, and all Path B tables are 0 and its rpm limit is 0, so setting only this bit does essentially nothing. Leave clear unless you calibrate the whole Path B set.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0x01). The torque module 0x0BE694 passes this bit to the rise shaping 0x0BB958 (BLD.B #6 at 0x0BF3D0, stack argument 11, read), and the torque monitor call passes it to 0x1877B4 (read). When set, Path B of the target-torque rise shaping can act (all "Target Torque Rise ... (Path B, ..., Off in Stock)" tables), and a request below Path B Start Torque passes unshaped. Path B also needs rpm <= cal 0x22A04, which is 0 in stock, so setting only this bit changes nothing but the Start Torque bypass (and Path B tables are all 0 ft-lb in stock, so that bypass never triggers). Leave clear unless the whole Path B set is calibrated. Bit 7 of the same byte is a separate switch passed to another torque routine (seg_0x0B0000.c:9252). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 023704 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: the rise-shaping function 0x0CA978 (counterpart of LF75404S 0x0BB958; it reads the Path B pedal multiplier table) is called once, with (cal 0x2A800 & 0x40) as its only bit-6 cal flag argument, as LF75404S passes cal 0x23704 bit 6 (read); stock byte 0x01 (bit 6 clear). Address 02A800 bit 6 (value 64). Confidence: read.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling: Use Alternate Map
table.description:
When set, Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate, Off in Stock) probably replaces the normal open loop fueling strategy. Clear in stock; leave clear unless you have filled that table.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0x8F). Passed by the open-loop fueling readers 0x0CE854 and 0x0CE5E8 (read): when set, Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate, Off in Stock) is used in place of the base + DAM-scaled knock additive strategy (inferred). Leave clear unless you have filled that table. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 02F79A by the code that reads it (read). Address 037C0E bit 4 (value 16). Confidence: read.

table.name: VE: Use AVCS-Not-Ready Table
table.description:
When set, Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready, Off in Stock) is used while the cams are probably not yet under control. Clear in stock; leave clear.
Details: Clear in stock. 0x11E308 uses Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready, Off in Stock) only when this bit is set and FFF8A83B bit 7 is clear (read); FFF8A83B bit 7 = AVCS ready (inferred). Leave clear. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 02C4D0 by the code that reads it (read). Address 03491C bit 0 (value 1). Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing: Pedal-Released Tables Enable
table.description:
Set in stock: with the pedal released, Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed/Open) replaces the normal EGR Active/Off base timing tables. Clear it to use the normal base timing tables off-throttle too.
Details: Set in stock (all images). With this bit set and FFF8A774 bit 0 (pedal released) set, Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed/Open) replaces the EGR Active/Off base timing tables (read, 0x0C2C08). Clear it to use the normal base timing tables with the pedal released. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 01071E by the code that reads it (read). Address 01071E bit 0 (value 1). Confidence: read.

table.name: Multi-Injection Allowed During High-Pedal Latch 1
table.description:
Allows double/triple injection while one of the high-pedal latches is set (clear = not allowed; clear in stock). Has no effect on a stock car because the multi-injection windows are disabled, so stock always uses single injection.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0xE0). The multi-injection enable FFF8A775 bit 0 (0x10B650) requires the high-pedal latch FFF8A8A3 bit 6 to be clear unless this bit is set (read; the pairing of bit and latch follows the argument order at the call in 0x109008, inferred). Only matters if the double/triple injection windows are opened (they are 65535 in stock, so stock always uses single injection). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 02996D by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: the multi-injection enable call (counterpart of LF75404S 0x10B650 called from 0x109008) passes bits 0, 1 and 2 of cal 0x31CF5 as the three latch-allow arguments, in the same order (read); stock byte 0xE0 as in 2015 (read). Address 031CF5 bit 0 (value 1). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Multi-Injection Allowed During High-Pedal Latch 2
table.description:
Allows double/triple injection while a second high-pedal latch is set (clear in stock). Has no effect on a stock car because the multi-injection windows are disabled, so stock always uses single injection.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0xE0). The multi-injection enable FFF8A775 bit 0 (0x10B650) requires the high-pedal latch FFF8A8A4 bit 6 to be clear unless this bit is set (read; the pairing of bit and latch follows the argument order at the call in 0x109008, inferred). Only matters if the double/triple injection windows are opened (they are 65535 in stock, so stock always uses single injection). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 02996D by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: the multi-injection enable call (counterpart of LF75404S 0x10B650 called from 0x109008) passes bits 0, 1 and 2 of cal 0x31CF5 as the three latch-allow arguments, in the same order (read); stock byte 0xE0 as in 2015 (read). Address 031CF5 bit 1 (value 2). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 1
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for cylinder 1 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders. Stock all 128 (no effect).
Details: Multiplier on injector 1's fuel quantity before the split into injections: 0x0D168C writes FFF8C060 = quantity x this(quantity, rpm) / 128 + the per-cylinder transient (wall-film + throttle-rate) fuel term FFF8C1E4 (0x0F6260; not learned: 0x8000 = none, reset to 0x8000 outside running; adds 4 x (term - 32768) counts) (read). Order 1-4 is the order the code processes FFF8C060-C06C; the transient fuel module's cylinder masks (05C8A0-05C8C4, read in 0x0F5AD0) only fit firing order 1-3-2-4 if slot n is cylinder n+1, so 1-4 is the cylinder number (inferred, strong). All 128 (no change) in stock. LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 05B1FC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009DA0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 1 (Single Injection)
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for injector 1 when it fires once per cycle, which appears to be the stock case (128 = x1.0). Stock all 128, so it has no effect.
Details: When used: Strategy byte = injections per cycle (FFF8A69E, 0x0CF3EC, read): this one applies with one injection (the stock case). Written to FFF8A6A3 by 0x0CF630 (read). Injector 1's quantity (0x0D168C) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A69F equals 1 (read). LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 05ADE8 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 0098A4. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injector 2/4 Rail Pressure Offset
table.description:
Pressure offset added to measured rail pressure before looking up Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4), by rpm and load; probably the pressure difference of the rail without the sensor. Stock all 0 (no effect).
Details: 0x06D43A (read): FFF89222 = sat(rail pressure FFF88886 + this(rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616)), interpolated by 0x00671C (descriptor 0x0608E4: data, u16 axis, u8 axis, 16, 16; row = rpm, read). FFF89222 indexes the injector flow compensation 05A844 used only for injectors 2 and 4 (0x0CB0C8, read); injectors 1 and 3 use 05A838 with FFF88886. Likely the pressure difference of the rail without the sensor (inferred from the boxer layout). Signed, in the rail-pressure unit. Stock all 0 (2015, 2016). LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 0608E4 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (from LF9C100P) FUN_0000684c(&0x063438, rpm FFF8E51C, load FFF8BA26) added to the rail pressure and saturated, the same code as LF75404S 0x06D43A (read); descriptor {data, rpm axis u16, load axis u8, 16, 16} read from the image. Descriptor boot 063438. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 4, Start Delay)
Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 3, Pedal Released)
Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 3, Pedal Applied)
Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in combustion mode 1 (an early warm-up phase); the one the stock car uses, since the fallback version never activates. Stock 15 MPa flat.
Details: When used: The combustion mode 1 target in stock (FFF899D7 bit 0 never sets, read). 0x165180 (read): target in combustion mode 1 while FFF899D7 bit 0 is clear. Stock 15 MPa flat. LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 05EB4C by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (from LF9C100P) Phase 11: the selector flag (2017 FFF8AD5A bit 0, 2018 FFF8BC16 bit 0, 2015 FFF8A7E2 bit 0) is state FFF8AD55 in {1,2,3,4,6} (0x103C64 / 0x0FD5FC in 2017). State 1 is forced while FFF889FB bit 7 (2015 FFF886AB bit 7) is set, and that bit is set permanently by the transmission coding cal (2015 0x2F794/0x2F796, 2017 0x36B70/0x36B72, 2018 0x37FEC/0x37FEE: bit 1 clear, bit 6 clear) in all four stock images (read). So the flag-set table is the one the stock (manual) car uses; the flag-clear table is for the other coding, whose state machine uses engine speed minus a received transmission speed (AT/CVT, inferred). rail-pressure selection 0x1693A4, combustion mode 1, fallback flag clear (read). Descriptor 00DC88. Confidence: read.

So the flag-set table is the one the stock (manual) car uses; the flag-clear table is for the other coding, whose state machine uses engine speed minus a received transmission speed (AT/CVT, inferred). table.name: Base Fuel Quantity Limit

scaling.category: mg fuel per cylinder (stock Injector Scaling)
scaling.units: mg (stoich fuel per cylinder per cycle)

scaling.category: base pulse (0.3 MPa reference, any Injector Scaling)

table.description:
Ceiling on the base fuel quantity, the stoichiometric fuel the ECU calculates from measured air before any enrichment. Its meaning in air depends on Injector Scaling: stock it allows about 5 g of air per revolution, but lowering the injector flow figure (for example for E85) lowers the ceiling. Raise it in proportion when you raise Injector Scaling, or the engine will run lean at high airflow.
Details: When used: always while running (every pass of 0x0B7E00, which computes load and the base fuel quantity, read). Upper limit of the base (stoichiometric) fuel quantity FFF8ADEA. 0x0B8030 (read) computes FFF8ADEA = air quantity FFF8C250 x Injector Scaling x 0.10266 / 14.7 / 4 / rpm x 0.125 (= 0.5587 x Injector Scaling x air per cylinder per cycle in g) and stores min(that, this) (0x0B80FC-0x0B8112: MOVU.W @0x23696, CMP/GE, read). The limited value is what the rest of the fuel path uses: the base pulse 0x0D15EC (FFF8C05C = 16 x FFF8ADEA x trims), before the enrichment/fuel factor 0x0D1528 and the flow compensation and latency 0x0D2BB8; the transient-fuel film model 0x0F5F84; the fuel load FFF8ADEE (0x0B895C); and the fuel-used accumulators 0x06B70E (read). Above the limit the base pulse stops rising with airflow, so the mixture goes lean as air keeps rising; enrichment is applied on top of the limited value and does not lift it (inferred from the order of the calls). The raw unit includes Injector Scaling, so the limit in air terms moves with it: air per revolution at the limit = this x 3.580 / Injector Scaling (raw) g/rev = this x reference injector flow [g/s] x 0.0004704. Shown in g/rev for stock Injector Scaling 2918 (2.61 g/s). Stock 4060 = 4.98 g/rev (2.49 g per cylinder per cycle, about 556 g/s at 6700 rpm), well beyond the stock turbo. With Injector Scaling at 1.74 g/s (fuel added for E85 by lowering the flow figure) the limit drops to 3.32 g/rev; below about 1.73 g/s it falls under the 3.31 g/rev (256 %) ceiling of engine load FFF8ADE4 (0x0B7EFC, read) and becomes the first limit reached. When you raise Injector Scaling raw (lower reference flow), raise this in proportion: new = 4060 x new raw / 2918 keeps 4.98 g/rev (u16, up to 65535). On AT/CVT codings, while FFF886AB bit 5 is set (meaning not decoded), the value is first smoothed by boot filter 0x6CEC with cal 0x23694 (stock 255); the limit applies on either path (read). 4060 in all eight images; the same code in LF78001H 0x0C1770, LF79002P 0x0C83DC, LF79100P 0x0C788C, LF9C100P 0x0C0ED8, LV9N 0x0A6840 (read). LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 023696 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (from LF9C100P) Base fuel quantity cap: the first-stage fuel quantity routine (counterpart of LF75404S 0x0B8030; LF79002P 0x0C83DC, LF79100P 0x0C788C, LF9C100P 0x0C0ED8, LF78001H 0x0C1770) stores min(quantity, this cal); stock 4060 as in LF75404S (read, my research notes). Address 02A94A. Confidence: read.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling
table.description:
Base open-loop (power enrichment) AFR target by rpm and load, used once the exhaust temperature estimate is high enough. The ECU uses the richer of this and the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV ..., AVCS ...) group: to lean, edit both; to richen, either. Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop).

To lean the open-loop target edit both sets; richening works with either (read, my research notes). Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor. Base open-loop enrichment target, 0x0CE854. Used only while the exhaust temperature estimate FFF8AFD0 (see Exhaust Temperature Model Map A/B) is >= cal 0x18DD4 (39322, hysteresis cal 0x18DD6 = 2185), or its integral FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8 (65535); otherwise this path contributes 0 (read). While cal 0x2F79A bit 4 is clear (stock; the first argument of 0x0CE854), the additive term (Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive x DAM multiplier) is added, minus Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive x Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier(DAM)/128, both all zero in stock (read). The result is rate-limited (FFF84424) into FFF8A682, and FFF8A684 = max(FFF8A682, other enrichments) feeds commanded lambda. LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 05AC6C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009728. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description:
Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. Stock identical to Primary Open Loop Fueling; edit all five together. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

TGV-closed base, weight 1 - a (AVCS not in active control). 0x0CE5E8 (read; called from 0x0C589C with rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616, cal 0x2F79A bit 4, DAM FFF811AE, AVCS weight FFF8A743 and TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8): TGV-closed base = 05ABB0 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABD8 x a/255, TGV-open base = 05ABC4 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABEC x a/255, where a = FFF8A743 is the AVCS-active weight from 0x0D952C (255 while both cam controllers are in active control, my research notes); blend FFF8A69B = closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + open x FFF8B3E8. With cal 0x2F79A bit 4 clear (stock): FFF8A681 = clamp(blend + Additive x DAM Multiplier(DAM)/128 - 05AC14 x 05AC3C(DAM)/128 (Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group) x its DAM multiplier; both all zero in stock), 0, 255). FFF8A684 is the open-loop enrichment in commanded lambda 256/(256 + B030 + A684 + AFE8) (0x171C88). table.description:

Details: Enrichment amount FFF843EA (0x0CD834, read); this TGV Open table is used when TGV state flag FFF8A881 bit 4 (passed in by 0x0C73D0, read) is clear. Coolant axis is the value latched at start (FFF843F4) or the current one (read). Unit 1/256 of base fuel (inferred). table.description:
Angle of the first pulse when two injections per cycle are used. Stock never uses multiple injections (the quantity windows are disabled), so it has no effect.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC, stored directly (0x0CFC20: code = 1440 - x, then clamped to 0.5-540 BTDC; read). Same scale as every other Injection Timing / injection-angle table. When used: Angle of the first pulse when two injections per cycle are used, in normal fuel mode (0x0CB394, read). Stock never uses multiple injections: the Double/Triple Injection Quantity Windows are 65535 (read). Injection angle for FFF8B054 (0x0C589C via 0x0CFC20-style helper, read): computed only while FFF99844 is 2 or 3 (otherwise a fixed 0x1FE) (0x0CFC20, read). 0x0CB394 uses B054 for two injections and B058 for three in normal fuel mode (read); the Double Injection tables cover 1100-3200 rpm, the Triple Injection tables 600-1300 rpm. table.name: Catalyst Heating Injection Angle 2
table.description:
Angle of the second (late, after top dead centre) pulse during stratified catalyst heating, by spark target; negative = after TDC. Stock pinned at the late limit, about 170 degrees after TDC. Has no effect in stock: Catalyst Heating Second Injection Share is 0, so the pulse gets no fuel.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC; negative = AFTER that TDC (expansion stroke). This angle is an offset in segment 0, the 180 degrees after firing TDC (0x0CB604 mode 3 uses it with segment 0; the pulse-fit check 0x075D84 places it B064 + 1440 after the first pulse B062, read), so it is shown as -offset/2: clamped to 0 to -179.5 (0x0D0468, read), and -170 to -179.5 act as -169.5 (0x1DCA04, read). Stock pins at the -179.5 clamp (stored -170 at spark 24 BTDC only): a late expansion-stroke pulse, about 170 degrees ATDC in effect (its quantity is Catalyst Heating Second Injection Share, cal 0x2A3CA, which is 0 in stock, so stock fires no second pulse in this mode). Catalyst-heating mode = FFF8A85C 2 (0x109B4C, read): it maps to fuel mode 3 (0x108B08), in which the ignition target is FFF8A76C (0x0DA51C, read) and the injection angle is FFF8B062 (0x0CB394, read). FFF8B064 = this(FFF8A76C), clamped to 0-359 (0x0D0468, read); used for the second injection's angle by 0x0CB604 (read). LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 05B194 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009D38. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Normal)
table.description:
Second-pulse injection angle in catalyst-heating phase 2, by rpm and spark target; compression stroke, limited to 10.5-180 BTDC. Used when the TGVs are not closed. Stock 40 BTDC (100 BTDC at 1350-1450 rpm with late spark); identical to the TGV Closed table.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (0 = firing TDC, 180 = intake BDC (start of compression), 360 = gas-exchange TDC, 540 = expansion BDC); larger = earlier. Same scale as every Injection Timing table. Second pulse of the phase 2 split; clamped to 0.5-180 BTDC (code 1080-1439, 0x0D023C, read), i.e. the compression stroke; 0.5-10 BTDC act as 10.5 (0x1DCA04, read). Stock 40 BTDC, and 100 BTDC at 1350-1450 rpm with the spark target at 7 degrees ATDC or later. When used: Selected by FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) in 0x0D023C: this one while it is clear (read). Stock identical to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Closed). Injection angle FFF8B060 from rpm and FFF8A76B (0x0D023C, read), the second-injection angle in fuel mode 2 (0x0CB604, read). LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 05B130 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (from LF9C100P) Phase 11: the selector flag (2017 FFF8AD5A bit 0, 2018 FFF8BC16 bit 0, 2015 FFF8A7E2 bit 0) is state FFF8AD55 in {1,2,3,4,6} (0x103C64 / 0x0FD5FC in 2017). State 1 is forced while FFF889FB bit 7 (2015 FFF886AB bit 7) is set, and that bit is set permanently by the transmission coding cal (2015 0x2F794/0x2F796, 2017 0x36B70/0x36B72, 2018 0x37FEC/0x37FEE: bit 1 clear, bit 6 clear) in all four stock images (read). So the flag-set table is the one the stock (manual) car uses; the flag-clear table is for the other coding, whose state machine uses engine speed minus a received transmission speed (AT/CVT, inferred). angle function 0x0DAA44, TGVs not forced closed (FFF8BCBA bit 4 clear) (read). In 2018 the two variants differ. Descriptor 009CAC. Confidence: inferred.

table.description:

table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 1
table.description:
One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Stock boundaries are 0.41 / 0.92 / 1.70 / 3.19 g/rev (31.5 / 71.5 / 131.5 / 246.5 % load) (this is boundary 1, stock 31.5 %). Keep them in increasing order.
Details: Fine learning knock correction cells (0x0E1C58, read): the cell FFF8A790 = 5 x rpm range + load range (0...34). Seven rpm ranges are split at the six boundaries 0x1C24A...0x1C254 on FFF8CE9C, five load ranges at the four boundaries 0x1C240...0x1C246 on FFF8ADE4, each with a hysteresis band (0x1C256 rpm, 0x1C248 load). The learned value for the cell is FFF81414[cell] (s16, x 256); 0x0E73CC applies FFF8A7A7 = min(that, KCA Max x (16 - DAM) x 16) / 256, in 0.3516 degree counts; it is not added to the fired timing directly: like KCA it enters the timing request (0x0C13B4 -> FFF8AF22 -> 0x0C39DC / 0x0DD568), so fired base timing = min(Base Timing + comps, request + KCA + FLKC), and in limit states 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B through the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088). 0x0DFA88 also sums it into the total knock correction FFF8A77B, whose only consumer (0x0DDBBC -> FFF8A770) is zero in stock (read). A negative learned value therefore retards the spark only where the request side is the lower one (most of the high-load map in stock); where Base Timing is lower it is hidden until it pulls the request below Base Timing. Feedback knock correction is the only knock term added directly (0x0D9E40). load boundary. Stock 0.41 / 0.92 / 1.70 / 3.19 g/rev (31.5 / 71.5 / 131.5 / 246.5 % load). LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 01C240 by the code that reads it (read). Address 022770. Confidence: read.

table.name: FBKC Retard Step (Secondary Knock, State 0x0D, Unused in Stock)
table.description:
Timing pulled per event by feedback knock correction when the secondary knock detector fires. Unused in stock because every Secondary Knock Threshold is at maximum, so that detector never triggers. Stock about 1.4 degrees.
Details: Feedback knock correction (0x0E2BE4, read): FFF8A79A is an s8 integrator kept at or below 0 and added directly to the fired timing (x 0.3516 degrees, 0x0D9E40): it is the only knock term of that sum, and FFF8A79A is one value for the whole engine, so a knock event on any cylinder retards all four (the fired timing FFF8A744 is recomputed per event for the next cylinder, but no per-cylinder knock retard exists; read). The state FFF8A79C (set once per combustion event by 0x0E2F94 from that event's knock results FFF8A7AD / FFF8A7B5; FFF8A7C1 is the knock-window-length flag (1 = extended window), used there only to reload per-cylinder hold counters FFF84920...FFF84930 from cal 0x27014 when it changes, purpose inferred) picks the action: states 0x0E, 0x0D, 7 and 6 subtract a step (floor = minus FBKC Maximum Retard); states 0x0C, 2, 0 (outside the rpm window) and the other non-knock states (0x0A outside the window, 0x0B) add the recovery step 0x1C271; 0x10 (inside the rpm window, no knock, fewer than cal 0x1C288 = 100 events since the last knock) holds the correction unchanged; 0x0F (inside the window, no knock, >= 100 events) adds 0x1C270, 8/9 add 0x1C272 (capped at 0); 5 = FFF8A79B x 0x1C26E / 128; 3 and 4 load the fixed values 0x1C26F / 0x1C278; 1 = 0. States (0x0E2F94, read, in priority order): 1 = knock control off (cal 0x56EE7 bit 7); 2 = FFF886AB bit 5 or load FFF8ADE4 <= cal 0x1C27E (0); 3 / 4 = FFF88E29 bit 3 / FFF88E2A bit 6 (fixed -14 counts = -4.9 degrees, inferred knock-sensor fault default); 5 = engine speed above FBKC Window RPM Maximum (hold); inside the rpm window: 6 / 0x0D = knock A (FFF8A7AD, intensity > Secondary Knock Threshold, never in stock) with / without FFF8AA85 bit 0, 7 / 0x0E = knock B (FFF8A7B5, intensity > Knock Threshold, the active one); 0x0F = no knock and FFF8B130 (events since the last knock, 0x0E7C7C) >= cal 0x1C288 (100), 0x10 = no knock, fewer events; 8 / 9 hold; 0x0A / 0x0B / 0x0C other conditions (0x0B: A/F FFF88AF6 above a lambda threshold). Subtracted per pass in state 0x0D. table.name: Knock Threshold (Event 1, Short Window)
table.description:

Details: Knock decision (0x0E8654 / 0x0E80B4, read): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4) the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot] (output of the signal processing 0x0E51E4) is compared with two thresholds. Knock B, FFF8A7B5 = intensity > Knock Threshold (this family, FFF8C1CC[slot] by 0x0E77E0) or FFF8CDC4[slot] >= cal 0x1BD92 (65535, off); this is the active path in stock and drives FBKC states 7 / 0x0E (retard 0x1C275 / 0x1C274, 4 counts = 1.41 degrees). table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 2, Channel 2)
table.description:
Knock signal processing for event slot 2, channel 2 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 2 (Event 2), knock channel 2 of 8 (index 1 of FFF8CDB0; enabled in stock: bit 1 of cal 0x1B97D is clear), on the knock window where FFF8A7C3 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C190[1] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D3, gain curve cal 0x26F7F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F (per slot; stock 0xC1 = channels 1, 7 and 8 off) give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes (cal 0x28B9E = 0 in stock selects these flags): +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Stock 4 to 97 (raw); the sibling tables for channels 1, 7 and 8 (masked in stock) are all 0. LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 05BEAC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00AB80. Confidence: read.

table.description:
AT/CVT version of Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1). Not used on this manual-transmission calibration, so it has no effect on a stock car. Stock 0, so it has no effect.

Full-scale timing correction (degrees, negative = retard) by the largest throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE since the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 set (0x0DBB20 holds the maximum in FFF8B0F0 and resets it to 0 while the trigger is clear, read), before the phase, coolant, mode and cal factors (read). Surge damping term FFF8A758 (0x0DBB20, called from the 10 ms module 0x0DE0E0; stack args verified with callers.py: s0 = gear FFF88FCE, s4 = MT coding FFF88ADA bit 7, s8 = FFF8B0EE, s12 = rpm FFF8CE9C, s16 = FFF88C64 bit 5, s20 = combustion mode FFF8A85C, read): A758 = Curve(FFF8B0EE) x PhaseFactor(FFF8A75E) x CoolantFactor FFF8A75C x ModeFactor(A85C) x cal factor (MT coding: cal 0x306E5 = 254, or cal 0x306E7 = 128 once FFF88C64 bit 5 has been clear for cal 0x306E8 = 150 passes) / 255^4, in 0.5-degree units, capped at +63.5 degrees, and 0 when the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 is clear or when the current swing count has lasted longer than its time cal 0x306EA..0x306FA (100/20/100/10/100/5/100/100/100 passes of 10 ms for counts 0..8) (read). A758 is added to the final timing sum in 0x0D9E40 (read), so negative values retard. Trigger (read): 0x0DC1E8 counts passes while FFF8A7A1 bit 3 is set, the throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE >= cal 0x3084E (131 = 0.4 % per 20 ms, MT; hysteresis 0x3084C) and FFF8B112 (0x0E0D14 of FFF88A3A) <= cal 0x30842; 0x0E1350 sets FFF8A7A1 bit 2 when that count exceeds a per-gear, per-rpm-band threshold (cals 0x30F62..0x30FAC); it is dropped after cal 0x30850 (90) active passes. table.name: A/C Cut Timing Retard Step (Alternate Logic) (Off in Stock)
Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base ignition timing map for the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration) with the TGVs closed; identical to the TGV Open table in stock. It is only an upper limit: the ECU fires the lower of this map and Closed-Pedal Timing Target (plus its corrections), and in stock the target is far lower, so raising this map at idle or when coasting does nothing.
Details: When used: Used while the accelerator is fully released (FFF8A774 bit 0: pedal-zero flag FFF88C64 bit 5 in engine state 2/3, vehicle speed FFF99835 at or below cal 0x2FDB2 = 200 km/h (inferred); 0x0E127C / 0x09FF9A, read), TGVs closed; enabled by cal 0x1071E bit 0, set in all four images. The TGV Closed and TGV Open tables are identical in stock. Base ignition timing. 0x0C2C08 uses this 16x16 table when cal 0x1071E bit 0 and FFF8A774 bit 0 are both set, and F2 set (F2 = FFF8A881 bit 4). The result is rate-limited (cals 0x1058C / 0x1058E) and the IAT compensation FFF8A782 and Closed-Pedal Timing Coolant Compensation FFF8A788 are added (0x0C2C08) to give base timing FFF8A645, which is only the upper limit of the fired timing: with the pedal released 0x0DD568 sets FFF8A76A = FFF8A645 - Torque Reduction Spark Retard(FFF8AF22 >> 7), where FFF8AF22 (0x0C13B4) is the efficiency of the closed-pedal timing request (Closed-Pedal Timing Target + FFF8A788 + FFF8A782 + Post-Start Closed-Pedal Timing Advance, 0x0E0A30) plus KCA + FLKC, so in effect FFF8A76A = min(FFF8A645, that request + KCA + FLKC) (read; min() form computed from the inverse tables). FFF8A76A then goes through 0x0DD760, 0x0DA600 and 0x0D9E40 to FFF8A744. In stock the request at idle (about 6-8 degrees at 500-900 rpm, warm) is far below this map (19-28 degrees at 400-1000 rpm, 0.13-0.39 g/rev (10-30 % load)), and it stays below it when coasting (17 vs 34 degrees at 2000 rpm), so idle and coast timing are set by Closed-Pedal Timing Target and raising this map there has no effect (computed from stock data); lowering it below the target does take effect. The F2 selector is FFF8A881 bit 4, set by the TGV module 0x10CAE0 (0x10DEFC) - set = TGVs closed (see below). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, so FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction; 0x10C948 drives it toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so that bit set = TGVs closed. LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 05A034 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 008580. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed-Pedal Timing Coolant Compensation RPM Multiplier
Post-Start Closed-Pedal Timing Advance (Coolant at Start)
Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1)
table.description:
Base spark target by rpm and coolant for the cold-start / catalyst-heating mode (pedal released, car stopped, below 4000 rpm); the manual-car set. Torque, run-time and re-entry adders go on top. It feeds the torque model and cold-start monitors; the fired spark probably follows other paths. Stock +17 degrees cold at low rpm, down to about -10 to -12.5 when warm.
Details: When used: set A7E2 bit 0 set, FFF899D7 bit 0 clear (the manual-car case). Base term. Stock +17 deg at 500-800 rpm with coolant up to 20 degC; it falls with rpm and coolant to -12.5 deg (ATDC) from 1075 rpm at 20-30 degC and to -10 deg from 600 rpm when hot (>= 70 degC). 0x108BAC (catalyst-heating module, read) writes FFF8A854, which 0x0C3200 selects as the spark target FFF8A647 in fuel mode FFF8A852 = 2 (combustion mode FFF8A85C 1 or 3, 0x108B08). A647 is the spark the torque model compensates for (0x0C2514, 0x0C1EA8) and the reference of the cold-start retard monitors (0x1CB70C, 0x132568: A72A - A854) (read); the fired spark in this mode follows FFF8A74C/FFF8A76B (0x0DA428), not A854 (read). Otherwise in mode 1 A854 = 05D0BC x 05D0A8 / 256 + FFF8A789 - 32 (both tables 0 in stock, so the normal request); in mode 3 A854 = A72A (normal target) (read). with cal 0x2996C bit 6 set (clear in stock) A854 is forced to cal 0x2A0C0 (0 in stock). Units: A854 is compared with A72A and final timing in 0.5 degree units (inferred). All four sets are identical in stock. LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 05D008 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00BDF4. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Boost Limit
table.description:
Boost ceiling by rpm that the torque/throttle model uses as its full-load manifold pressure: the model's target MAP is (torque request / full-load reference torque) x this, and it also scales the throttle-area input. It is not an overboost cut (see Overboost Limit). Raise it together with Target Boost so the model's full-load pressure matches the boost you run. Stock 211 kPa absolute peak (about 16 psi gauge), matching Target Boost.
Details: 0x1086F8 (20 ms boost task) -> FFF8A84F (raw) and FFF8A84E = (raw + 13.3) x f - 13, where f is the target's baro/IAT factor: the compensated boost ceiling (read). The torque-model task 0x0C3D14 copies it to FFF8AFAE = A84E << 8 (0x0C3D0C, read). AFAE is the full-load manifold pressure of the throttle/torque model. Target MAP FFF8AF6A = (torque request / full-load reference torque) x this (0x0C2F0C). FFF8AF8A = Throttle Required Area column input AFA8 x this (0x0C3408). The pressure ratio AF6C = AF8A / this (0x0C2F9C) selects the high-pressure spark-compensation filter above 0.85 (all read). Also read by the airflow/torque model 0x111AB8 (role there not decoded). It is not an overboost cut; see Overboost Limit for that. Stock 211 kPa abs peak (about 16 psi gauge), matching Target Boost. Raise it with Target Boost. table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default)
Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 2, Sport)
Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent)
Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp)
Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual. Stock 74 ft-lb (100 Nm) per step everywhere, i.e. no Stage 1 limit.
Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 (1, default) with AT/CVT Coding; unused in stock (manual coding). AT/CVT Coding set = FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5); FFF88ADA bit 7 is permanently set in stock (my research notes), so the AT/CVT Coding tables are unused on the manual car. Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default) (0598F8) as Step1 (read: the selection at 0x0BCB12..0x0BCC20). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Main path: with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step1 = (Stage 1 table - 16000) x gear factor (cal 0x1FC98 + 2(g-1): 1, 1, 3, 3, 3 in stock, 255 = x1) x Stage 1 Pedal Multiplier(FFF8AF00) / 65025, Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA (boost target / wastegate duty axis). Stock 24000 everywhere = 74 ft-lb (100 Nm) per 10 ms, i.e. no Stage 1 limit (same as the high-gear cells of the Stage 2 AT/CVT Coding tables). Its rpm axis (0x2000A) differs from the manual table's. The torque monitor 0x1877B4 reads the same data bytes through its own descriptor (05F674), so it stays consistent. LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 0598BC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 007CEC. Confidence: inferred.
