Rev Limit RPM
table.description:
The rev limit (stock 6700 rpm): above it the ECU cuts fuel to all four cylinders on every firing and closes the throttle; spark is not cut or retarded. To move the limit, set this, Rev Limit Full Cut RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM, Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM and Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) to the new rpm and Rev Limit Reset RPM about 100 lower.
Details: When used: always. The rev limit: above this rpm the rev latch sets and the ECU enters limit state 0x0B (part 1); with the stock Full Cut values that is at once a fuel cut on all four cylinders (parts 2-3). It is also the level stage 2 of the throttle cap holds above (part 5). Stock 34304 = 6,700 rpm. Rev limiter and limit-state cuts (LF75404S; read unless marked). The rev limiter is a fuel cut. (1) Limit state, 0x0BE140 (10 ms torque module 0x0BE694): the rev latch FFF8416A sets when rpm FFF8CD54 > Rev Limit RPM (the comparator FFF84169 then uses Rev Limit Reset RPM) and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Reset RPM and MAP FFF88FF4 < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP. The overboost latch FFF84167 sets when MAP >= Overboost Limit (compensated, FFF8A851) + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) and releases below that level minus Overboost Cut Hysteresis (Limit State). Either latch gives limit state FFF8A639 = 0x0B. Priority: not running = 1, FFF8A640 bit 0 = 0x19, latch FFF8416C = 0x1B (cals 0x22FB2-0x22FBC, not decoded), then 0x0B, then the vehicle-speed latch = 0x0C (see Vehicle Speed Limit). (2) Full-cut latch, 0x0BAE98: FFF840C4 sets when rpm >= Rev Limit Full Cut RPM and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM and MAP < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP (above Rev Limit Full Cut Speed Threshold the pair Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM / Stage 2 RPM is used instead; never in stock). In state 0x0B the final torque cap FFF8AE54 (0x0B9DC8) is limited to FFF8AE8A: zero indicated torque (32000 - losses FFF8AF62) while this latch or the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6 (Overboost Limit + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay) is set, otherwise FFF8AF3A = the current air torque minus losses, i.e. no reduction. (3) Fuel: 0x0C4BA0 turns the cap into the torque ratio FFF8A64F; in limit states 8, 9, 0x0B, 0x0C and 0x18-0x1B, 0x0C1AC8 turns the ratio into the number of cylinders to cut FFF8A643 (Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio thresholds; a zero cap gives 4). Once per combustion event (crank-synchronous list 0x07D0E0) 0x0C4B84 makes a cut decision FFF8A648 from the count and the last three decisions (4 = every event, 3 = three in four, 2 = every second, 1 = one in four; the pattern is in code, not a cal). 0x0C88C8 (list 0x07D1C2) latches it into the cut flag of the cylinder being scheduled (FFF8A6F5-FFF8A6F8). For a flagged cylinder the fuel time is 0 (0x0D1D7C/0x0D1FB8) and both start angles are 0x1FE (0x0CB394/0x0CB604), which the injector driver 0x1DCA04 treats as no pulse. So the cut is a true injector cut, all four cylinders, every event. (4) Spark is neither cut nor retarded: the coil scheduler 0x1DB804 only checks FFF8C6F4 (set at the first injection after sync, cleared only on stop), and with Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Rev/Overboost Cut set (stock) 0x0DD568 uses the normal spark target FFF8A72A in state 0x0B instead of Torque Reduction Spark Retard. (5) Throttle: with Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable set (stock) 0x0BDA84 caps the throttle-side request FFF8AE4C in state 0x0B by 0x0BAFA8: Rev/Boost Limit Torque (Stage 1) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM (held while > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold)) or MAP FFF8AF70 > Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 1 MAP (held while > Stage 1 Reset MAP); else (Stage 2) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) (held while > Rev Limit RPM) or MAP > Stage 1 Reset MAP (held while > Stage 2 Hold MAP); else (Base). The torque monitor (0x186F0C) repeats this with the same data. Stock behaviour: above 6,700 rpm all four injectors are cut every event, the throttle closes toward a 37 ft-lb (50 Nm) request and the spark is unchanged; fuel returns as soon as rpm is back at 6,700 or below with MAP under 168 kPa abs (no rpm hysteresis on the fuel cut), and the Base throttle cap (about 166 ft-lb, 225 Nm there, rarely binding) lasts until 6,600 rpm. A hard cut; stage 2 is never selected because its thresholds equal stage 1's. To move the limit, set Rev Limit RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM, Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM and Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) to the new rpm and Rev Limit Reset RPM about 100 rpm lower. Setting the Full Cut pair above Rev Limit RPM gives a throttle-only soft stage between them (inferred). The Fail-Safe Rev Limit cals (6,100 rpm) cut fuel the same way, in any state, when their fault flags are set. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 01DEDE by the code that reads it (read). Address 0259FA. Confidence: read.

table.name: Rev Limit Full Cut RPM
table.description:

Either latch gives limit state FFF8A639 = 0x0B. Once per combustion event (crank-synchronous list 0x07D0E0) 0x0C4B84 makes a cut decision FFF8A648 from the count and the last three decisions (4 = every event, 3 = three in four, 2 = every second, 1 = one in four; the pattern is in code, not a cal). 0x0C88C8 (list 0x07D1C2) latches it into the cut flag of the cylinder being scheduled (FFF8A6F5-FFF8A6F8). table.name: Overboost Limit
table.description:
Overboost limit by rpm, compensated for baro and intake temperature like the boost target. Boost 26.7 kPa over it for 2 s sets the overboost flag, and 33 kPa over it starts the overboost cut (throttle cap, then a full fuel cut once the flag is set). Raise it when raising boost targets (stock 211 kPa absolute peak). Note: the boost-control pressure reading stops at about 269 kPa absolute, so an Overboost Limit above about 236 kPa absolute (269 minus the 33 kPa cut margin) can never trigger the overboost cut.
Details: When used: always. 0x1087D4 (20 ms boost task) -> FFF8A850 (raw) and FFF8A851 = (raw + 13.3) x f - 13, f = the boost target's baro/IAT factor FFF8B3B2/32768 (read; cal 0x290A8 = 1 would use a fixed value, 0 in stock). Two overboost reactions use FFF8A851 (read): (a) 0x0C0FE0 (10 ms): MAP FFF88FF4 >= this + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay passes in a row sets the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6, cleared when MAP <= this + Overboost Flag Reset Margin; (b) 0x0BE140: MAP >= this + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) puts the ECU in limit state 0x0B, which caps the throttle at once. The flag makes the state-0x0B cut a full fuel cut on all four cylinders (see Rev Limit RPM); on its own, outside state 0x0B, it reduces nothing. It also feeds a diagnostic 0x1B8310. Stock 211 kPa abs peak, the same as Boost Limit from 2,000 rpm. Raise it with Target Boost. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05CFD4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 06D2A8. table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 1 MAP
table.description:
During a rev or overboost cut, manifold pressure above which the stage 1 throttle cap is used. It does not start a cut by itself. Stock 256 kPa absolute.
Details: When used: only in limit state 0x0B. Stage 1 of the throttle-side cap (Rev/Boost Limit Torque (Stage 1)) is used when MAP FFF8AF70 (copy of FFF88FF4) > this and stays on while MAP > Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 1 Reset MAP. It does not start a cut by itself. Stock 62130 = 256 kPa abs. Rev limiter and limit-state cuts (LF75404S; read unless marked). The rev limiter is a fuel cut. (1) Limit state, 0x0BE140 (10 ms torque module 0x0BE694): the rev latch FFF8416A sets when rpm FFF8CD54 > Rev Limit RPM (the comparator FFF84169 then uses Rev Limit Reset RPM) and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Reset RPM and MAP FFF88FF4 < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP. The overboost latch FFF84167 sets when MAP >= Overboost Limit (compensated, FFF8A851) + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) and releases below that level minus Overboost Cut Hysteresis (Limit State). Either latch gives limit state FFF8A639 = 0x0B. Priority: not running = 1, FFF8A640 bit 0 = 0x19, latch FFF8416C = 0x1B (cals 0x22FB2-0x22FBC, not decoded), then 0x0B, then the vehicle-speed latch = 0x0C (see Vehicle Speed Limit). (2) Full-cut latch, 0x0BAE98: FFF840C4 sets when rpm >= Rev Limit Full Cut RPM and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM and MAP < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP (above Rev Limit Full Cut Speed Threshold the pair Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM / Stage 2 RPM is used instead; never in stock). In state 0x0B the final torque cap FFF8AE54 (0x0B9DC8) is limited to FFF8AE8A: zero indicated torque (32000 - losses FFF8AF62) while this latch or the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6 (Overboost Limit + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay) is set, otherwise FFF8AF3A = the current air torque minus losses, i.e. no reduction. (3) Fuel: 0x0C4BA0 turns the cap into the torque ratio FFF8A64F; in limit states 8, 9, 0x0B, 0x0C and 0x18-0x1B, 0x0C1AC8 turns the ratio into the number of cylinders to cut FFF8A643 (Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio thresholds; a zero cap gives 4). Once per combustion event (crank-synchronous list 0x07D0E0) 0x0C4B84 makes a cut decision FFF8A648 from the count and the last three decisions (4 = every event, 3 = three in four, 2 = every second, 1 = one in four; the pattern is in code, not a cal). 0x0C88C8 (list 0x07D1C2) latches it into the cut flag of the cylinder being scheduled (FFF8A6F5-FFF8A6F8). For a flagged cylinder the fuel time is 0 (0x0D1D7C/0x0D1FB8) and both start angles are 0x1FE (0x0CB394/0x0CB604), which the injector driver 0x1DCA04 treats as no pulse. So the cut is a true injector cut, all four cylinders, every event. (4) Spark is neither cut nor retarded: the coil scheduler 0x1DB804 only checks FFF8C6F4 (set at the first injection after sync, cleared only on stop), and with Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Rev/Overboost Cut set (stock) 0x0DD568 uses the normal spark target FFF8A72A in state 0x0B instead of Torque Reduction Spark Retard. (5) Throttle: with Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable set (stock) 0x0BDA84 caps the throttle-side request FFF8AE4C in state 0x0B by 0x0BAFA8: Rev/Boost Limit Torque (Stage 1) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM (held while > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold)) or MAP FFF8AF70 > Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 1 MAP (held while > Stage 1 Reset MAP); else (Stage 2) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) (held while > Rev Limit RPM) or MAP > Stage 1 Reset MAP (held while > Stage 2 Hold MAP); else (Base). The torque monitor (0x186F0C) repeats this with the same data. Stock behaviour: above 6,700 rpm all four injectors are cut every event, the throttle closes toward a 37 ft-lb (50 Nm) request and the spark is unchanged; fuel returns as soon as rpm is back at 6,700 or below with MAP under 168 kPa abs (no rpm hysteresis on the fuel cut), and the Base throttle cap (about 166 ft-lb, 225 Nm there, rarely binding) lasts until 6,600 rpm. A hard cut; stage 2 is never selected because its thresholds equal stage 1's. To move the limit, set Rev Limit RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM, Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM and Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) to the new rpm and Rev Limit Reset RPM about 100 rpm lower. Setting the Full Cut pair above Rev Limit RPM gives a throttle-only soft stage between them (inferred). The Fail-Safe Rev Limit cals (6,100 rpm) cut fuel the same way, in any state, when their fault flags are set. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 01DE88 by the calibration block offset of its neighbours (inferred). Address 0259A4. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable
table.description:
Lets the rev limiter and overboost cut close the throttle (the Rev/Boost Limit Torque tables). Set in stock; cleared, the limiter is probably fuel-cut only.
Details: Set in stock. With this bit set, 0x0BDA84 replaces the throttle-side request FFF8AE4C by the Rev/Boost Limit Torque cap FFF8AE8C (0x0BAFA8) in limit state 0x0B; the torque monitor 0x189488 reads the same bit (read). Cleared, the rev limiter and the overboost cut become fuel-only: no throttle closing during the cut (inferred). LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 023CEA by the code that reads it (read). Address 02C6FE bit 0 (value 1). Confidence: read.

table.name: Overboost Flag Reset Margin
table.description:
Once set, the overboost flag clears only when boost falls to Overboost Limit plus this. Stock 0 kPa.
Details: When used: always. 0x0C0FE0 (read): once set, the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6 (Overboost Limit + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay) stays set until MAP FFF88FF4 <= Overboost Limit + this. The flag forces the zero torque cap in the overboost/rev cut state (0x0BAE98 -> FFF8AE8A, applied in limit state 0x0B; Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State)) and also feeds 0x1B8310 (0x1B828C / 0x1B83CC, the overboost diagnostic, inferred in my research notes), so this margin also sets how long that monitor sees overboost. Stock 0. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 01DEF6 by the calibration block offset of its neighbours (inferred). Address 025A12. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State)
table.description:
Boost above Overboost Limit plus this enters the overboost cut state: the throttle is capped at once, and fuel to all cylinders is cut only if the 2-second overboost flag is also set. Stock 33 kPa.
Details: When used: always. Overboost latch FFF84167 (0x0BE140, read): sets when MAP FFF88FF4 >= Overboost Limit (the baro/IAT-compensated FFF8A851) + this, and releases when MAP < that level minus Overboost Cut Hysteresis (Limit State). While set (and no higher state) the limit state FFF8A639 is 0x0B, the same state as the rev limiter (see Rev Limit RPM). In that state the throttle-side request is capped at once (Rev/Boost Limit Torque (Base) by rpm, or the stage tables above 256 kPa abs); fuel is cut on all four cylinders every event only once the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6 is also set (MAP >= Overboost Limit + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay, 2.0 s stock) or rpm reaches Rev Limit Full Cut RPM; spark is not retarded. When MAP falls below the release level the state ends and fuel returns even if the flag is still set (inferred from the state gating, read). Stock 8448 = 33 kPa, about 244 kPa abs at the 211 kPa stock limit peak. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 01DEE6 by the calibration block offset of its neighbours (inferred). Address 025A02. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Overboost Cut Hysteresis (Limit State)
table.description:
How far boost must fall below the overboost cut level before the overboost cut state ends. Stock 15 kPa.
Details: When used: always. Subtracted from the overboost latch level while the latch FFF84167 is set (0x0BE208-0x0BE222, read): the overboost cut state 0x0B releases when MAP FFF88FF4 < Overboost Limit + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) - this. See Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) for what the state does. Stock 3840 = 15 kPa, so the state releases 18 kPa above the Overboost Limit. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 01DEE8 by the calibration block offset of its neighbours (inferred). Address 025A04. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed
table.description:
Speed at which the active speed limiter cuts fuel to all cylinders; without it the limiter does nothing. Stock 255 km/h (no effect in stock).
Details: When used: only in limit state 0x0C (vehicle-speed latch, see Vehicle Speed Limit). 0x0C058C (read): latch FFF84188 sets when vehicle speed FFF99835 >= this (minus Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed Hysteresis while above it) and holds until speed is below and MAP <= Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP; while set, FFF8AF1A = zero torque, which in state 0x0C cuts fuel on all four cylinders every event (0x0B9DC8, 0x0C1AC8). Without it state 0x0C reduces nothing. Stock 255 km/h (off). LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 01DEF9 by the calibration block offset of its neighbours (inferred). Address 025A15. Confidence: inferred.

(4) Spark is neither cut nor retarded: the coil scheduler 0x1DB804 only checks FFF8C6F4 (set at the first injection after sync, cleared only on stop), and with Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Rev/Overboost Cut set (stock) 0x0DD568 uses the normal spark target FFF8A72A in state 0x0B instead of Torque Reduction Spark Retard. (5) Throttle: with Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable set (stock) 0x0BDA84 caps the throttle-side request FFF8AE4C in state 0x0B by 0x0BAFA8: Rev/Boost Limit Torque (Stage 1) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM (held while > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold)) or MAP FFF8AF70 > Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 1 MAP (held while > Stage 1 Reset MAP); else (Stage 2) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) (held while > Rev Limit RPM) or MAP > Stage 1 Reset MAP (held while > Stage 2 Hold MAP); else (Base). The torque monitor (0x186F0C) repeats this with the same data. Stock behaviour: above 6,700 rpm all four injectors are cut every event, the throttle closes toward a 37 ft-lb (50 Nm) request and the spark is unchanged; fuel returns as soon as rpm is back at 6,700 or below with MAP under 168 kPa abs (no rpm hysteresis on the fuel cut), and the Base throttle cap (about 166 ft-lb, 225 Nm there, rarely binding) lasts until 6,600 rpm. A hard cut; stage 2 is never selected because its thresholds equal stage 1's. To move the limit, set Rev Limit RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM, Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM and Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) to the new rpm and Rev Limit Reset RPM about 100 rpm lower. Setting the Full Cut pair above Rev Limit RPM gives a throttle-only soft stage between them (inferred). table.description:
When a cut state asks for less torque than this share of the engine's current torque, one cylinder in four is cut. Also sets the first decel fuel cut stage. Stock 75 %.
Details: When used: in the cut limit states (decel fuel cut, rev/overboost/speed cuts). Below this torque ratio at least 1 cylinder is cut. 0x0C1AC8 (read): in limit states 8, 9, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x18 (unless FFF8A638 = 2) and 0x19-0x1B the torque ratio FFF8A64F (capped / unreduced torque, 0x0C4BA0) is compared with four thresholds: cylinders cut FFF8A643 = 0 if the ratio >= the 1-cylinder threshold, 1 if >= the 2-cylinder threshold, 2 if >= the 3-cylinder threshold, 3 if >= the 4-cylinder threshold, else 4 (each threshold minus Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio Hysteresis while it is crossed). Once per event 0x0C4B84 then skips n of every 4 injections. The same four cals set the torque level of each decel fuel cut stage (0x0B9EF0), so changing them also changes the decel cut. The rev limiter and the overboost full cut use a zero cap (ratio 0, 4 cylinders) and do not depend on them. Stock 192 = 75 %. Further gating in 0x0C1AC8 (read): the ratio comparison also runs outside those states while FFF8A63B bit 0 or FFF899EC bit 1 / bit 4 is set; while FFF89BFE bit 2 is set (a fault latch from 0x09FE44, meaning not decoded) the count is instead taken from cals 0x23D58-0x23D5F by rpm FFF8CD62 and speed FFF99835 (not yet defined) and overrides both this ratio and the Fail-Safe Rev Limit; and with engine state FFF99844 = 4, or FFF8A65F bit 7 set while FFF89066 bit 0 is clear, the count is cal 0x38248 (the cylinder count, 4), i.e. all cylinders. table.name: Throttle Air Spark Compensation Limit
table.description:
Caps, by actual ignition timing, how much the throttle model may add air to make up for retarded timing. Stock 1.5x at 22.5 degrees or more up to 3.1x at -15 degrees, so it does not bind in normal warm running. Shares data with two other entries: editing one edits all three.

It caps the spark-efficiency air compensation (AF56, normally ~1.0) as a function of the actual final timing; stock 1.50x at >=22.5 deg up to 3.13x at -15 deg, so it does not bind in normal warm running. Shares its data (0x0107E8) with 05A124 and 05F414 (0x185FFC): editing one edits all three. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs closed, no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount). Stock EGR and non-EGR tables are identical.
Details: When used: every pass of the 0x110000 torque module. Weight (1 - TGV open) x (1 - EGR). Stock: 14-49 ft-lb (19-66 Nm) at zero load, 260-306 ft-lb (352-415 Nm) at 2.81 g/rev (217 % load) from 2400 rpm (119 ft-lb, 162 Nm cap at 800 rpm); identical to the EGR table 05D64C. 0x118318 (DAM 1 set -> FFF8B490) and 0x1186A4 (DAM 0 set -> FFF8B4A2), called from 0x110000 with rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616, TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 and EGR realisation FFF8B290 (read): closed = TGV-closed x (1 - w) + TGV-closed-EGR x w, open = TGV-open x (1 - w) + TGV-open-EGR x w with w = B290/256, result = closed x (1 - B3E8) + open x B3E8, all above the 16000 zero point (read; same blend as the Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables in 0x0C0010). 0x10ED6C interpolates the two sets by DAM: FFF8B48A = B490 x DAM + B4A2 x (1 - DAM) with FFF811AE = DAM x 16 (read), and 0x118A40 subtracts (B490 - B4A2) x (1 - DAM) from the torque it reports as FFF8B4B2 (0.1 ft-lb, 0.1 Nm, 10000 = 0) (read). So these are the engine torque the ECU expects from the air charge, at full and at zero knock-learning advance (inferred from the DAM interpolation). They do not set the throttle or boost; they shape the estimated/reported engine torque (inferred). Axes: rpm FFF8CE9C x load % FFF8A616. table.description:

table.name: Intake Cam Target 1A (TGV Open, Normal, Altitude)
table.description:
Intake cam advance target (degrees from the fully retarded rest position) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open, used at altitude (blended in by AVCS Barometric Blend; near sea level the 1B table is used instead). Higher = earlier intake valve timing. The normal vs high-pedal split is inferred from the switching conditions.
Details: Convention (read, see FU_UNITS): crank degrees of intake cam ADVANCE from its learned rest position; 0 = rest (fully retarded, inferred), larger = more advance (earlier valve events). Values below 0 ask for less than the rest position: the OCV then sits at minimum duty and the cam stays at rest (inferred). AVCS target (intake 0x15C250, exhaust 0x16032C, read): target = coolant terms + v x [S_A x w + S_B x (1 - w)] + (1 - v) x [3A x w + (3B + Coolant Offset 3B x Coolant Factor 3 / 128) x (1 - w)], clamped to +/-90 degrees, 364.09 counts per degree. v = FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction: sets 1/2 apply with TGVs open, set 3 with TGVs closed. w = FFF8B948 = AVCS Barometric Blend (barometric pressure FFF88668, via 0x15B1E0, read): the A tables apply at altitude, the B tables at sea level. Stock w = 1 at or below 84 kPa (about 5200 ft) and 0 at or above 98 kPa (about 1000 ft), so near sea level only the B tables are used. S = set 1 or set 2, chosen by FFF8A8A4 bit 7 (stack argument +24 from 0x15969C, read). That bit is a high-pedal latch (0x11C15C / 0x10F848, read): it sets when the accelerator FFF88A5E is at or above High Pedal Entry Threshold (90 % stock, by barometric pressure) while vehicle speed is not jumping (under cal 0x35B16... per gear) and some status flags (FFF88A2D bit 0, FFF88ADA bit 6, FFF8A8A2 bit 6) are clear, or when FFF8A8A5 bit 2 or 4 is set; it clears once the pedal is below cal 0x36518 (85 %). So set 1 = normal driving and set 2 = near wide-open pedal (meaning inferred from these conditions). In stock (sea-level B tables), intake set 2 differs from set 1 across the map: about +10...+35 degrees more advance below 1.03 g/rev and about 10...20 degrees less advance at 1.29 g/rev and above from 1200 to 4400 rpm, equal from 5600 rpm; exhaust set 2 differs mainly below 1.03 g/rev; the altitude (A) sets differ only below 0.52 g/rev. table.name: A/C Idle Air Steady (A/C Load Sw On, Neutral Sw Off, Above 14 km/h)

Brake override module 0x181B38 (10 ms task 0x1DFE3C, read): it limits the accelerator pedal that feeds the torque request, FFF88A5E = min(pedal FFF88EE6, limit FFF8BAFA) (0x09E800, read), when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held. Brake detection: VDC CAN frame 0x0D1 byte 2 (FFF88DF9, slew-limited 8/pass into FFF8AC94; brake pressure, inferred) against a threshold, or discrete input FFF88E2F bit 3 (pin PF10; brake switch, inferred) when the pressure signal is not valid (FFF8AC8F bit 4 clear). Vehicle speed FFF8AC95 = km/h from the wheel speeds or FFF88BE8 x 9/160 (0x182E34, read). The module sets no DTC (no DTC monitor record points at its RAM, read). 0x1832C4 (read, args checked in the assembly): override request FFF8AC91 bit 1 sets when the time FFF8BADA since the brake was applied while the accelerator was already pressed (FFF8AC90 bit 6, 0x1831EC) reaches this(pedal FFF88EE6, speed FFF8AC95), with speed >= cal 0x43472 (7 km/h) and either pedal >= 05F2C0 (1.1 %) or a deceleration-confirmed brake (FFF8AC91 bit 2). FFF8AC91 bit 1 (or bit 0, the brake-switch path 0x183680) sets the active flag FFF8AC8F bit 0 (0x183B68), which starts the pedal-limit ramp. Stock 200 passes (2.0 s) at 11 % pedal; 1.25-1.5 s at 23 %; 0.75-1.0 s at 40 %; 0.5 s from 60 % pedal. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05F2CC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 06FCC4. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Gear Advice Consumption Map (Off in Stock)
table.description:
Fuel consumption map by torque and rpm (probably g/kWh) for a gear-shift advice function that picks the most economical gear. One table edits all three copies. No effect on a stock car: the gear advice function is switched off by a calibration setting.
Details: When used: never in stock (cal 0x57585 bit 3 clear). 'Alternate' tables are used when FFF8A8C3 = 2. Descriptors 05D4D8, 05D504 and 05D518 share this data block (037352): 05D4D8 at the current torque FFF8B468 = DAM-blended torque FFF8B48A - FFF8A8CC x 128 (0x1161DC) and rpm, 05D504 / 05D518 at the torque needed for the same power in the lower / upper gear (read). table.name: Intake Air Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the main intake air temperature sensor voltage to degrees; this IAT feeds the timing, boost and fuel compensations and the scan-tool reading. Its voltage axis is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling, so edit only the temperatures when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06AF58, read). ADC channel 19 (0xFFFFE864, untrimmed) -> FFF88D38 -> FFF88F30, filtered by cal 0x579B6 (65535 = no filter in stock) -> FFF88F34 / FFF88F32, looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) to give FFF88662 = degC + 50: the OBD IAT FFF8CEE5, the IAT behind FFF88A48 (the IAT axis of the timing, boost, throttle and fuel compensation tables) and the IAT read by fuel 0x0C589C and purge 0x0D4E78 (for Purge Air Density (IAT, Baro), 0x0D44DC) (read). This is IAT sensor 1 (P0112 / P0113, read), probably the element in the MAF housing (inferred). The voltage axis (0x579FC, 32 points 0...4.96 V in 0.16 V steps; 65536 = 5 V inferred) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling: change only the temperature values for a different thermistor, or both sensors move. While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BA x 256 (stock 3.40 V, about 20 C) is used. Stock: 205 C at 0 V, 25 C at 3.20 V, -50 C from 4.80 V (identical to IAT 2). LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 060850 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0713E4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling
table.description:
Converts the second intake temperature sensor's voltage to degrees. This is the air temperature the ECU's airflow model uses to work out air density, and it probably comes from the manifold pressure (TMAP) sensor, so update it when you swap that sensor for one with a different thermistor. Its voltage axis is shared with the main IAT table; change only the temperatures.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06B304, read). ADC channel 20 (0xFFFFE868, untrimmed) -> FFF88D40 -> FFF88F36, filtered by cal 0x579B8 (no filter in stock) -> FFF88F38 / FFF88F3A, looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF888CF (degC + 50; FFF888D4 from the unfaulted value). This is IAT sensor 2 (P0097 / P0098 monitors on the same voltage, read). FFF888CF is the air temperature of the speed-density airflow model (0x11DF4C: density from MAP and IAT 2 + 223 K) and is also read by requested torque 0x0BE694, ignition 0x0D98F8 / 0x0D9A10 / 0x0DE0E0 and AVCS 0x15969C (read), so a wrong curve shifts the modelled air and load. Probably the thermistor of the manifold TMAP sensor (inferred from its use as the manifold air temperature): when fitting a different TMAP / MAP sensor with its own thermistor, change these temperature values. The voltage axis (0x579FC) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor Scaling, so change only the data. While faulted (FFF88FCD bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BB x 256 (stock 3.40 V, about 20 C) is used. Stock identical to IAT 1. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 06085C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0713F0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Coolant Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts coolant temperature sensor voltage to degrees. Every coolant-based table and the scan-tool coolant reading use this. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BA46, read). Coolant sensor voltage FFF8865E (input 0 of the 8-way multiplexer on ADC channel 21, untrimmed, 65536 = 5 V inferred) is filtered by cal 0x56EE8 (65535 = no filter) into FFF88ADC and looked up here (boot lookup 0x73BC) into FFF88AE8 / FFF88AE0 (256 x (degC + 50)): FFF8CD65 (coolant byte, degC + 50), the OBD coolant value and FFF88A44 (the coolant axis of most tables). While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 1) a warm-up model from cals 0x56EEC-0x56EF2 replaces it. Range faults: P0117 below Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit, P0118 above Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit. Stock: 205 C at 0 V, 25.7 C at 3.20 V, -50 C from 4.80 V. Change only when fitting a different sensor. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 060874 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 071408. Confidence: read.

table.name: Oil Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts oil temperature sensor voltage to degrees; this oil temperature feeds the AVCS and idle tables and the scan-tool reading. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BEA0, read). table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range)

Details: When used: Used while the A/F signal is within about lambda 0.90-1.37 (FFF88AFB bit 4 set, 0x0843F8, read); higher gain cal 0x571F1 = 9 (gain reading inferred). table.name: Fuel Level Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the fuel sender reading, which the instrument cluster sends to the ECU over CAN, to fuel level (219 = 100 %). The ECU averages it and reports it as fuel level to a scan tool. Stock: full at the lowest input, empty at the highest.
Details: When used: always (0x06C336, read). Input: the fuel sender reading sent by the combination meter on CAN 0x282 bytes 0-1 (10-bit, FFF88E04 -> 0x1108B8 -> FFF8B43C; not an ECU analog input). 0x06C336 forms FFF88BD0 = FFF8B43C x 2867 / (FFF8B43C + cal 0x572E0 (720)), filters it into FFF88BCC and looks it up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF88BD4; FFF88BD7 is its average over cal 0x572E6 samples taken while FFF88A76 is at least cal 0x572E4, kept in backup RAM FFF806BB/806BC, and reported by OBD PID 0x2F as x 255 / 219 (read). So this is the fuel level curve, 219 = 100 %. P0463 / P0462 when FFF88BCC is above cal 0x572DA / below cal 0x572DE (0x0714E0 / 0x071548, read). Stock: full (219) at the lowest input, empty at 2432 and above. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 0608A4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 071438. Confidence: read.

table.name: Battery Temperature Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the battery temperature sensor voltage to degrees for the charging-voltage control. It is probably the temperature half of the battery sensor, whose current signal the ECU also reads. Leave alone unless the battery sensor is changed.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06C768, read). ADC channel 9 (0xFFFFE852, untrimmed) -> FFF8939A, filtered by cal 0x590F0 into FFF8939E (cal 0x590EE replaces the input while FFF88BCA bit 2 or 3 is set) and looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF893A0 (degC + 50), read only by the charging-voltage control 0x136CD8 (temperature-compensated voltage targets); the unfiltered value gives FFF893A1, reported by SSM as x - 10 (0x11F0E8, read). Identity (inferred): its companion input ADC channel 4 (FFF89390, 0x06C554) is a linear signal centred on 2.5 V (FFF89396 = 12800 - 0.488 x (sample - 32768); SSM x/128 + 28 puts zero at 2.5 V, about -50 A per volt), i.e. a bidirectional battery current, read by charging control 0x136BC0 and idle 0x0EE338; the two inputs share their filter cal block and their range monitors (FFF88BCA bits 2-5, 0x0715B0-0x07175C) are both enabled by cal 0x57584 bit 4, which is clear in stock (monitors off). A current + temperature pair used only for charging is the battery sensor, so this is battery temperature. Stock: 100 C at 0.32 V, 20 C at 2.37 V, -40 C from 4.71 V (NTC). Leave alone unless the battery sensor is changed. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 0608B0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 071444. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Rear O2 Sensor Ready Heater Energy Threshold
table.description:
How much heater energy, by coolant temperature at start, the rear O2 sensor must have received before it is treated as warmed up and ready. Raising it delays the rear O2 sensor (and its diagnostics) becoming active. Stock about 130 s of heating at -40 C to about 90 s at 60 C.
Details: When used: while the engine runs (run state FFF8906B = 3). 0x1028D0 (read; called from 0x101CF0): FFF8A833 bit 7 is set (and held until the run state leaves 3) when the accumulated rear O2 heater drive FFF88E6E > this(coolant at start FFF88A46; the -40 C row is used when the coolant sensor is faulted, FFF88E28 bit 1), or when FFF8881E >= cal 0x4B900 (9437) for cal 0x4B904 (50) passes. Rear O2 identity: the heater output FFF9980E bit 2 is driven by 0x06EC70 for FFF8CE0B of every 24 40-ms passes, and 0x073570 monitors that output against FFF8CE0B into FFF89CB4 bits 0/1, the P0037 / P0038 (heater circuit, bank 1 sensor 2) monitor records (dtc_monitors slots 182 / 180, read). FFF88E6E sums FFF8CE0B every 40 ms (0x06ED92, read), so it is heater energy since start; FFF8CE0B = 0 while the heater is held off (initial delay from 0x608F4, high load, battery out of range; 0x06E7D8, read). FFF8881E = 2 x (ADC channel 11 - ADC channel 25) (0x1E0000 task, read); it is the oxygen-sensor signal that gates Fuel Cut Recovery Enrichment (0x0CAE40: FFF8881E < cal 0x14F5C, read), so the second path is 'sensor already reads rich' (inferred). FFF8A833 bit 7 feeds the catalyst/rear-O2 module 0x101CF0 (0x1023E0, 0x102B58) and the rear O2 diagnostics 0x1B8890 / 0x1B902C (P0137, result FFF8AD93 bit 7) and 0x123C68 (read). Meaning 'sensor ready / warmed up' inferred. Stock 26250 at -40 C falling to 18125 at 60 C start coolant; at 13.75 V with the default heater stage that is about 130 s and 90 s of heating (inferred, 200 counts/s). Raising it delays the rear O2 sensor being treated as ready. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05CEB0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 06D184. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Enable
table.description:

Details: Set in stock. One of the EGR enable conditions computed by 0x0FAAFC (FFF8A811 bit 0), with coolant, rpm and load windows, engine running and normal combustion mode (read). Clearing it is expected to keep EGR off, so the EGR-off table variants (Base Timing (EGR Off, ...), Closed Loop Target (..., EGR Off), the non-EGR Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables) become the live ones (inferred). table.name: Transmission Coding: From Input Port
table.description:
When set, the manual/automatic coding is read from a hardware input instead of Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT. Clear in all stock images; leave clear.
Details: Clear in all stock images. When set, the transmission coding (FFF886AB bit 7) is taken from a latched input-port bit (FFF80238 bit 7, set once port bit FFF8A2A4 bit 7 is seen) instead of Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT (read, 0x06A38C). Leave clear. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 02F796 by the code that reads it (read). Address 03B7BA bit 6 (value 64). Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Torque Rise: Enable Path B
table.description:
Enables the second (Path B) tip-in torque shaping. Clear in stock, and all Path B tables are 0 and its rpm limit is 0, so setting only this bit does essentially nothing. Leave clear unless you calibrate the whole Path B set.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0x01). The torque module 0x0BE694 passes this bit to the rise shaping 0x0BB958 (BLD.B #6 at 0x0BF3D0, stack argument 11, read), and the torque monitor call passes it to 0x1877B4 (read). When set, Path B of the target-torque rise shaping can act (all "Target Torque Rise ... (Path B, ..., Off in Stock)" tables), and a request below Path B Start Torque passes unshaped. Path B also needs rpm <= cal 0x22A04, which is 0 in stock, so setting only this bit changes nothing but the Start Torque bypass (and Path B tables are all 0 ft-lb in stock, so that bypass never triggers). Leave clear unless the whole Path B set is calibrated. Bit 7 of the same byte is a separate switch passed to another torque routine (seg_0x0B0000.c:9252). LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 023704 by the code that reads it (read). Address 02C118 bit 6 (value 64). Confidence: read.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling: Use Alternate Map
table.description:
When set, Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate, Off in Stock) probably replaces the normal open loop fueling strategy. Clear in stock; leave clear unless you have filled that table.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0x8F). Passed by the open-loop fueling readers 0x0CE854 and 0x0CE5E8 (read): when set, Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate, Off in Stock) is used in place of the base + DAM-scaled knock additive strategy (inferred). Leave clear unless you have filled that table. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 02F79A by the calibration block offset of its neighbours (inferred). Address 03B7BE bit 4 (value 16). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: VE: Use AVCS-Not-Ready Table
table.description:
When set, Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready, Off in Stock) is used while the cams are probably not yet under control. Clear in stock; leave clear.
Details: Clear in stock. 0x11E308 uses Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready, Off in Stock) only when this bit is set and FFF8A83B bit 7 is clear (read); FFF8A83B bit 7 = AVCS ready (inferred). Leave clear. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 02C4D0 by the code that reads it (read). Address 036CB8 bit 0 (value 1). Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing: Pedal-Released Tables Enable
table.description:
Set in stock: with the pedal released, Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed/Open) replaces the normal EGR Active/Off base timing tables. Clear it to use the normal base timing tables off-throttle too.

table.name: Multi-Injection Allowed During High-Pedal Latch 1
table.description:
Allows double/triple injection while one of the high-pedal latches is set (clear = not allowed; clear in stock). Has no effect on a stock car because the multi-injection windows are disabled, so stock always uses single injection.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0xE0). table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 1
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for cylinder 1 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders. Stock all 128 (no effect).
Details: Multiplier on injector 1's fuel quantity before the split into injections: 0x0D168C writes FFF8C060 = quantity x this(quantity, rpm) / 128 + the per-cylinder transient (wall-film + throttle-rate) fuel term FFF8C1E4 (0x0F6260; not learned: 0x8000 = none, reset to 0x8000 outside running; adds 4 x (term - 32768) counts) (read). Order 1-4 is the order the code processes FFF8C060-C06C; the transient fuel module's cylinder masks (05C8A0-05C8C4, read in 0x0F5AD0) only fit firing order 1-3-2-4 if slot n is cylinder n+1, so 1-4 is the cylinder number (inferred, strong). All 128 (no change) in stock. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 05B1FC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 052B84. Confidence: read.

table.description:

Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Base Fuel Quantity Limit

scaling.category: mg fuel per cylinder (stock Injector Scaling)
scaling.units: mg (stoich fuel per cylinder per cycle)

scaling.category: base pulse (0.3 MPa reference, any Injector Scaling)

table.description:
Ceiling on the base fuel quantity, the stoichiometric fuel the ECU calculates from measured air before any enrichment. Its meaning in air depends on Injector Scaling: stock it allows about 5 g of air per revolution, but lowering the injector flow figure (for example for E85) lowers the ceiling. Raise it in proportion when you raise Injector Scaling, or the engine will run lean at high airflow.
Details: When used: always while running (every pass of 0x0B7E00, which computes load and the base fuel quantity, read). Upper limit of the base (stoichiometric) fuel quantity FFF8ADEA. 0x0B8030 (read) computes FFF8ADEA = air quantity FFF8C250 x Injector Scaling x 0.10266 / 14.7 / 4 / rpm x 0.125 (= 0.5587 x Injector Scaling x air per cylinder per cycle in g) and stores min(that, this) (0x0B80FC-0x0B8112: MOVU.W @0x23696, CMP/GE, read). The limited value is what the rest of the fuel path uses: the base pulse 0x0D15EC (FFF8C05C = 16 x FFF8ADEA x trims), before the enrichment/fuel factor 0x0D1528 and the flow compensation and latency 0x0D2BB8; the transient-fuel film model 0x0F5F84; the fuel load FFF8ADEE (0x0B895C); and the fuel-used accumulators 0x06B70E (read). Above the limit the base pulse stops rising with airflow, so the mixture goes lean as air keeps rising; enrichment is applied on top of the limited value and does not lift it (inferred from the order of the calls). The raw unit includes Injector Scaling, so the limit in air terms moves with it: air per revolution at the limit = this x 3.580 / Injector Scaling (raw) g/rev = this x reference injector flow [g/s] x 0.0004704. Shown in g/rev for stock Injector Scaling 2918 (2.61 g/s). Stock 4060 = 4.98 g/rev (2.49 g per cylinder per cycle, about 556 g/s at 6700 rpm), well beyond the stock turbo. With Injector Scaling at 1.74 g/s (fuel added for E85 by lowering the flow figure) the limit drops to 3.32 g/rev; below about 1.73 g/s it falls under the 3.31 g/rev (256 %) ceiling of engine load FFF8ADE4 (0x0B7EFC, read) and becomes the first limit reached. When you raise Injector Scaling raw (lower reference flow), raise this in proportion: new = 4060 x new raw / 2918 keeps 4.98 g/rev (u16, up to 65535). On AT/CVT codings, while FFF886AB bit 5 is set (meaning not decoded), the value is first smoothed by boot filter 0x6CEC with cal 0x23694 (stock 255); the limit applies on either path (read). 4060 in all eight images; the same code in LF78001H 0x0C1770, LF79002P 0x0C83DC, LF79100P 0x0C788C, LF9C100P 0x0C0ED8, LV9N 0x0A6840 (read). LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 023696 by the code that reads it (read). Address 02152A. Confidence: read.

Details: Enrichment amount FFF843EA (0x0CD834, read); this TGV Closed table is used when TGV state flag FFF8A881 bit 4 (passed in by 0x0C73D0, read) is set. Faded to zero by After-Start Enrichment Decay 1 (TGV Closed), the three faded terms' maximum is scaled by the RPM multiplier into FFF8B012/B016/B01A/B01E (read), and FFF8B012 adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 (0x0D1400, read). table.description:
Angle of the first pulse when two injections per cycle are used. Stock never uses multiple injections (the quantity windows are disabled), so it has no effect.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC, stored directly (0x0CFC20: code = 1440 - x, then clamped to 0.5-540 BTDC; read). Same scale as every other Injection Timing / injection-angle table. When used: Angle of the first pulse when two injections per cycle are used, in normal fuel mode (0x0CB394, read). Stock never uses multiple injections: the Double/Triple Injection Quantity Windows are 65535 (read). Injection angle for FFF8B054 (0x0C589C via 0x0CFC20-style helper, read): computed only while FFF99844 is 2 or 3 (otherwise a fixed 0x1FE) (0x0CFC20, read). 0x0CB394 uses B054 for two injections and B058 for three in normal fuel mode (read); the Double Injection tables cover 1100-3200 rpm, the Triple Injection tables 600-1300 rpm. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 05AF94 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 05291C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Injection Angle 2
table.description:
Angle of the second (late, after top dead centre) pulse during stratified catalyst heating, by spark target; negative = after TDC. Stock pinned at the late limit, about 170 degrees after TDC. Has no effect in stock: Catalyst Heating Second Injection Share is 0, so the pulse gets no fuel.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC; negative = AFTER that TDC (expansion stroke). This angle is an offset in segment 0, the 180 degrees after firing TDC (0x0CB604 mode 3 uses it with segment 0; the pulse-fit check 0x075D84 places it B064 + 1440 after the first pulse B062, read), so it is shown as -offset/2: clamped to 0 to -179.5 (0x0D0468, read), and -170 to -179.5 act as -169.5 (0x1DCA04, read). Stock pins at the -179.5 clamp (stored -170 at spark 24 BTDC only): a late expansion-stroke pulse, about 170 degrees ATDC in effect (its quantity is Catalyst Heating Second Injection Share, cal 0x2A3CA, which is 0 in stock, so stock fires no second pulse in this mode). Catalyst-heating mode = FFF8A85C 2 (0x109B4C, read): it maps to fuel mode 3 (0x108B08), in which the ignition target is FFF8A76C (0x0DA51C, read) and the injection angle is FFF8B062 (0x0CB394, read). FFF8B064 = this(FFF8A76C), clamped to 0-359 (0x0D0468, read); used for the second injection's angle by 0x0CB604 (read). LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 05B194 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 052B1C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Normal)
table.description:
Second-pulse injection angle in catalyst-heating phase 2, by rpm and spark target; compression stroke, limited to 10.5-180 BTDC. Used when the TGVs are not closed. Stock 40 BTDC (100 BTDC at 1350-1450 rpm with late spark); identical to the TGV Closed table.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (0 = firing TDC, 180 = intake BDC (start of compression), 360 = gas-exchange TDC, 540 = expansion BDC); larger = earlier. Same scale as every Injection Timing table. Second pulse of the phase 2 split; clamped to 0.5-180 BTDC (code 1080-1439, 0x0D023C, read), i.e. the compression stroke; 0.5-10 BTDC act as 10.5 (0x1DCA04, read). Stock 40 BTDC, and 100 BTDC at 1350-1450 rpm with the spark target at 7 degrees ATDC or later. When used: Selected by FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) in 0x0D023C: this one while it is clear (read). Stock identical to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Closed). Injection angle FFF8B060 from rpm and FFF8A76B (0x0D023C, read), the second-injection angle in fuel mode 2 (0x0CB604, read). LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 05B130 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 052AB8. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 1
table.description:
One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Stock boundaries are 0.41 / 0.92 / 1.70 / 3.19 g/rev (31.5 / 71.5 / 131.5 / 246.5 % load) (this is boundary 1, stock 31.5 %). Keep them in increasing order.
Details: Fine learning knock correction cells (0x0E1C58, read): the cell FFF8A790 = 5 x rpm range + load range (0...34). Seven rpm ranges are split at the six boundaries 0x1C24A...0x1C254 on FFF8CE9C, five load ranges at the four boundaries 0x1C240...0x1C246 on FFF8ADE4, each with a hysteresis band (0x1C256 rpm, 0x1C248 load). The learned value for the cell is FFF81414[cell] (s16, x 256); 0x0E73CC applies FFF8A7A7 = min(that, KCA Max x (16 - DAM) x 16) / 256, in 0.3516 degree counts; it is not added to the fired timing directly: like KCA it enters the timing request (0x0C13B4 -> FFF8AF22 -> 0x0C39DC / 0x0DD568), so fired base timing = min(Base Timing + comps, request + KCA + FLKC), and in limit states 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B through the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088). 0x0DFA88 also sums it into the total knock correction FFF8A77B, whose only consumer (0x0DDBBC -> FFF8A770) is zero in stock (read). A negative learned value therefore retards the spark only where the request side is the lower one (most of the high-load map in stock); where Base Timing is lower it is hidden until it pulls the request below Base Timing. Feedback knock correction is the only knock term added directly (0x0D9E40). load boundary. Stock 0.41 / 0.92 / 1.70 / 3.19 g/rev (31.5 / 71.5 / 131.5 / 246.5 % load). LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 01C240 by the code that reads it (read). Address 019B84. Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 2, Channel 2)
table.description:
Knock signal processing for event slot 2, channel 2 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F (per slot; stock 0xC1 = channels 1, 7 and 8 off) give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes (cal 0x28B9E = 0 in stock selects these flags): +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). table.description:
Base ignition timing map for the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration) with the TGVs closed; identical to the TGV Open table in stock. It is only an upper limit: the ECU fires the lower of this map and Closed-Pedal Timing Target (plus its corrections), and in stock the target is far lower, so raising this map at idle or when coasting does nothing.
Details: When used: Used while the accelerator is fully released (FFF8A774 bit 0: pedal-zero flag FFF88C64 bit 5 in engine state 2/3, vehicle speed FFF99835 at or below cal 0x2FDB2 = 200 km/h (inferred); 0x0E127C / 0x09FF9A, read), TGVs closed; enabled by cal 0x1071E bit 0, set in all four images. table.name: Boost Limit
table.description:
Boost ceiling by rpm that the torque/throttle model uses as its full-load manifold pressure: the model's target MAP is (torque request / full-load reference torque) x this, and it also scales the throttle-area input. It is not an overboost cut (see Overboost Limit). Raise it together with Target Boost so the model's full-load pressure matches the boost you run. Stock 211 kPa absolute peak (about 16 psi gauge), matching Target Boost.
Details: 0x1086F8 (20 ms boost task) -> FFF8A84F (raw) and FFF8A84E = (raw + 13.3) x f - 13, where f is the target's baro/IAT factor: the compensated boost ceiling (read). The torque-model task 0x0C3D14 copies it to FFF8AFAE = A84E << 8 (0x0C3D0C, read). AFAE is the full-load manifold pressure of the throttle/torque model. Target MAP FFF8AF6A = (torque request / full-load reference torque) x this (0x0C2F0C). FFF8AF8A = Throttle Required Area column input AFA8 x this (0x0C3408). The pressure ratio AF6C = AF8A / this (0x0C2F9C) selects the high-pressure spark-compensation filter above 0.85 (all read). Also read by the airflow/torque model 0x111AB8 (role there not decoded). It is not an overboost cut; see Overboost Limit for that. Stock 211 kPa abs peak (about 16 psi gauge), matching Target Boost. Raise it with Target Boost. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 05CFC8 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 054958. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default)

Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual. Stock 74 ft-lb (100 Nm) per step everywhere, i.e. no Stage 1 limit.
Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 (1, default) with AT/CVT Coding; unused in stock (manual coding). AT/CVT Coding set = FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5); FFF88ADA bit 7 is permanently set in stock (my research notes), so the AT/CVT Coding tables are unused on the manual car. Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default) (0598F8) as Step1 (read: the selection at 0x0BCB12..0x0BCC20). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Main path: with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step1 = (Stage 1 table - 16000) x gear factor (cal 0x1FC98 + 2(g-1): 1, 1, 3, 3, 3 in stock, 255 = x1) x Stage 1 Pedal Multiplier(FFF8AF00) / 65025, Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA (boost target / wastegate duty axis). Stock 24000 everywhere = 74 ft-lb (100 Nm) per 10 ms, i.e. no Stage 1 limit (same as the high-gear cells of the Stage 2 AT/CVT Coding tables). Its rpm axis (0x2000A) differs from the manual table's. The torque monitor 0x1877B4 reads the same data bytes through its own descriptor (05F674), so it stays consistent. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 0598BC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 051444. Confidence: inferred.

Rev Limit RPM
table.description:
The rev limit (stock 6700 rpm): above it the ECU cuts fuel to all four cylinders on every firing and closes the throttle; spark is not cut or retarded. To move the limit, set this, Rev Limit Full Cut RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM, Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM and Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) to the new rpm and Rev Limit Reset RPM about 100 lower.
Details: When used: always. The rev limit: above this rpm the rev latch sets and the ECU enters limit state 0x0B (part 1); with the stock Full Cut values that is at once a fuel cut on all four cylinders (parts 2-3). It is also the level stage 2 of the throttle cap holds above (part 5). Stock 34304 = 6,700 rpm. Rev limiter and limit-state cuts (LF75404S; read unless marked). The rev limiter is a fuel cut. (1) Limit state, 0x0BE140 (10 ms torque module 0x0BE694): the rev latch FFF8416A sets when rpm FFF8CD54 > Rev Limit RPM (the comparator FFF84169 then uses Rev Limit Reset RPM) and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Reset RPM and MAP FFF88FF4 < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP. The overboost latch FFF84167 sets when MAP >= Overboost Limit (compensated, FFF8A851) + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) and releases below that level minus Overboost Cut Hysteresis (Limit State). Either latch gives limit state FFF8A639 = 0x0B. Priority: not running = 1, FFF8A640 bit 0 = 0x19, latch FFF8416C = 0x1B (cals 0x22FB2-0x22FBC, not decoded), then 0x0B, then the vehicle-speed latch = 0x0C (see Vehicle Speed Limit). (2) Full-cut latch, 0x0BAE98: FFF840C4 sets when rpm >= Rev Limit Full Cut RPM and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM and MAP < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP (above Rev Limit Full Cut Speed Threshold the pair Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM / Stage 2 RPM is used instead; never in stock). In state 0x0B the final torque cap FFF8AE54 (0x0B9DC8) is limited to FFF8AE8A: zero indicated torque (32000 - losses FFF8AF62) while this latch or the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6 (Overboost Limit + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay) is set, otherwise FFF8AF3A = the current air torque minus losses, i.e. no reduction. (3) Fuel: 0x0C4BA0 turns the cap into the torque ratio FFF8A64F; in limit states 8, 9, 0x0B, 0x0C and 0x18-0x1B, 0x0C1AC8 turns the ratio into the number of cylinders to cut FFF8A643 (Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio thresholds; a zero cap gives 4). Once per combustion event (crank-synchronous list 0x07D0E0) 0x0C4B84 makes a cut decision FFF8A648 from the count and the last three decisions (4 = every event, 3 = three in four, 2 = every second, 1 = one in four; the pattern is in code, not a cal). 0x0C88C8 (list 0x07D1C2) latches it into the cut flag of the cylinder being scheduled (FFF8A6F5-FFF8A6F8). For a flagged cylinder the fuel time is 0 (0x0D1D7C/0x0D1FB8) and both start angles are 0x1FE (0x0CB394/0x0CB604), which the injector driver 0x1DCA04 treats as no pulse. So the cut is a true injector cut, all four cylinders, every event. (4) Spark is neither cut nor retarded: the coil scheduler 0x1DB804 only checks FFF8C6F4 (set at the first injection after sync, cleared only on stop), and with Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Rev/Overboost Cut set (stock) 0x0DD568 uses the normal spark target FFF8A72A in state 0x0B instead of Torque Reduction Spark Retard. (5) Throttle: with Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable set (stock) 0x0BDA84 caps the throttle-side request FFF8AE4C in state 0x0B by 0x0BAFA8: Rev/Boost Limit Torque (Stage 1) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM (held while > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold)) or MAP FFF8AF70 > Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 1 MAP (held while > Stage 1 Reset MAP); else (Stage 2) while rpm > Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) (held while > Rev Limit RPM) or MAP > Stage 1 Reset MAP (held while > Stage 2 Hold MAP); else (Base). The torque monitor (0x186F0C) repeats this with the same data. Stock behaviour: above 6,700 rpm all four injectors are cut every event, the throttle closes toward a 37 ft-lb (50 Nm) request and the spark is unchanged; fuel returns as soon as rpm is back at 6,700 or below with MAP under 168 kPa abs (no rpm hysteresis on the fuel cut), and the Base throttle cap (about 166 ft-lb, 225 Nm there, rarely binding) lasts until 6,600 rpm. A hard cut; stage 2 is never selected because its thresholds equal stage 1's. To move the limit, set Rev Limit RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM, Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM and Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) to the new rpm and Rev Limit Reset RPM about 100 rpm lower. Setting the Full Cut pair above Rev Limit RPM gives a throttle-only soft stage between them (inferred). The Fail-Safe Rev Limit cals (6,100 rpm) cut fuel the same way, in any state, when their fault flags are set. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 01DEDE by the code that reads it (read). Address 01B822. Confidence: read.

table.name: Overboost Limit
table.description:
Overboost limit by rpm, compensated for baro and intake temperature like the boost target. Boost 26.7 kPa over it for 2 s sets the overboost flag, and 33 kPa over it starts the overboost cut (throttle cap, then a full fuel cut once the flag is set). Raise it when raising boost targets (stock 211 kPa absolute peak). Note: the boost-control pressure reading stops at about 269 kPa absolute, so an Overboost Limit above about 236 kPa absolute (269 minus the 33 kPa cut margin) can never trigger the overboost cut.
Details: When used: always. 0x1087D4 (20 ms boost task) -> FFF8A850 (raw) and FFF8A851 = (raw + 13.3) x f - 13, f = the boost target's baro/IAT factor FFF8B3B2/32768 (read; cal 0x290A8 = 1 would use a fixed value, 0 in stock). Two overboost reactions use FFF8A851 (read): (a) 0x0C0FE0 (10 ms): MAP FFF88FF4 >= this + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay passes in a row sets the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6, cleared when MAP <= this + Overboost Flag Reset Margin; (b) 0x0BE140: MAP >= this + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) puts the ECU in limit state 0x0B, which caps the throttle at once. The flag makes the state-0x0B cut a full fuel cut on all four cylinders (see Rev Limit RPM); on its own, outside state 0x0B, it reduces nothing. It also feeds a diagnostic 0x1B8310. Stock 211 kPa abs peak, the same as Boost Limit from 2,000 rpm. Raise it with Target Boost. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 05CFD4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 054964. Confidence: read.

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs closed, no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount). Stock EGR and non-EGR tables are identical.
Details: When used: every pass of the 0x110000 torque module. Weight (1 - TGV open) x (1 - EGR). Multiplier (128 = 1.0) by coolant temperature on Intake Cam Coolant Offset A (Altitude) and B (Sea Level), the cold-engine corrections for the normal TGV-open cam targets. Stock: all 0, so the intake coolant offsets have no effect.
Details: Convention (read, see FU_UNITS): scales the coolant offset only; the offset is intake advance / exhaust retard from rest. AVCS target (intake 0x15C250, exhaust 0x16032C, read): target = coolant terms + v x [S_A x w + S_B x (1 - w)] + (1 - v) x [3A x w + (3B + Coolant Offset 3B x Coolant Factor 3 / 128) x (1 - w)], clamped to +/-90 degrees, 364.09 counts per degree. v = FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction: sets 1/2 apply with TGVs open, set 3 with TGVs closed. w = FFF8B948 = AVCS Barometric Blend (barometric pressure FFF88668, via 0x15B1E0, read): the A tables apply at altitude, the B tables at sea level. Stock w = 1 at or below 84 kPa (about 5200 ft) and 0 at or above 98 kPa (about 1000 ft), so near sea level only the B tables are used. S = set 1 or set 2, chosen by FFF8A8A4 bit 7 (stack argument +24 from 0x15969C, read). That bit is a high-pedal latch (0x11C15C / 0x10F848, read): it sets when the accelerator FFF88A5E is at or above High Pedal Entry Threshold (90 % stock, by barometric pressure) while vehicle speed is not jumping (under cal 0x35B16... per gear) and some status flags (FFF88A2D bit 0, FFF88ADA bit 6, FFF8A8A2 bit 6) are clear, or when FFF8A8A5 bit 2 or 4 is set; it clears once the pedal is below cal 0x36518 (85 %). So set 1 = normal driving and set 2 = near wide-open pedal (meaning inferred from these conditions). In stock (sea-level B tables), intake set 2 differs from set 1 across the map: about +10...+35 degrees more advance below 1.03 g/rev and about 10...20 degrees less advance at 1.29 g/rev and above from 1200 to 4400 rpm, equal from 5600 rpm; exhaust set 2 differs mainly below 1.03 g/rev; the altitude (A) sets differ only below 0.52 g/rev. The set-3 terms are active because cal 0x3ACF6 = 1 in both images. Multiplier (/128) on Intake Cam Coolant Offset A/B by coolant FFF88A44. All 0 in stock. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 05E468 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: LV9N301A intake / exhaust target functions 0x148BA4 / 0x14CC4C (read in the disassembly, 0x148C0C-0x148CE2 and 0x14CCA8-0x14CD62): value = coolant offset x coolant factor + target, target = the High Pedal table when the high-pedal flag is set, else the Normal table; only when cal byte 0x3854E is non-zero a second, TGV-closed value = set-3 coolant offset x set-3 coolant factor + TGV-closed target is computed and the two are blended by the TGV weight. There is no barometric (Sea Level / Altitude) pair: one table per set, named A as in LV9N101C; unlike LV9N101C the TGV-closed set has its own coolant offset and factor, as LF75404S's set 3. This entry: descriptor 0x055B50. Descriptor 055B50. Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Timing Advance (TGV Closed)
table.description:
Extra timing advance requested while EGR is active with the TGVs closed, by rpm and load, scaled by how much EGR is flowing. It is added to the Primary Ignition request, so it reaches the spark only where that request (plus knock advance) is below the Base Timing (EGR Active) map, never above it. Stock up to +13.5 degrees at 800-4800 rpm, 0.39-0.78 g/rev (30-60 % load).
Details: When used: single injection (FFF8A775 bit 2 clear, the stock case), TGV-closed side. 0x0DC97C / 0x0DD0DC (read): while EGR is active (FFF8A813 bit 7) the advance = EGR realisation ratio FFF8B290/256 x on/off fade (05B950/05B95C/05B968 or 05BA04/05BA10/05BA1C by rpm, 255 in stock) x [(1 - v) x (TGV Closed table) + v x (TGV Open table) + DAM-weighted pair (05B988/05B9B0 or 05BA3C/05BA64, scaled by 05B9C4/05BA78(DAM)/128 = 0 in stock)], v = TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8, each table read as x/2 - 64 degrees; stored as 2 x deg + 128 in FFF8A763 (single injection) / FFF8A767. FFF8A769 = FFF8A767 when FFF8A775 bit 2 is set (all four injectors in a 2- or 3-injection strategy, 0x0FAABC), else FFF8A763 (0x0DD454, read). FFF8A769 enters the timing request FFF8A78A (0x0E0A30) and the alternate final-timing value FFF8A733 of 0x0D9E40 (used only with cal 0x239AE bit 1 set, clear in stock) (read). Through the request it reaches the fired timing wherever Primary Ignition + this + KCA + FLKC is below the Base Timing (EGR Active) map: 0x0C13B4 -> FFF8AF22 -> 0x0C39DC / 0x0DD568 give fired base = min(Base Timing + comps, request + KCA + FLKC) (read; min() form computed). It can never lift the fired timing above the Base Timing (EGR Active) maps. Axes rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8ADE4 (400-6400 rpm, 10-240 %; rows above 32768 are padding). Stock up to +13.5 degrees at 800-4800 rpm, 0.39-0.78 g/rev (30-60 % load). Byte-identical to EGR Timing Advance (Multi-Injection, TGV Closed) in stock. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 05B974 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 0532FC. Confidence: read.

table.description:
Minimum coolant temperature for the TGVs to close (probably; part of the TGV close conditions). Stock 5 degC.

Which threshold pair is used depends on FFF8A8C1 (1, 2, 3 or other) and FFF8A8A2 bit 5 (not identified). So this build has the two coolant minimums of LF75404S (LV9N101C has one), and 0x37A44 corresponds to 0x35456. Address 035456. Confidence: read.

table.description:
Minimum coolant for TGV closing used only while a warm-up fallback flag is set. No effect on a stock car: that fallback is switched off by a calibration setting in stock. Stock 5 degC, same as TGV Coolant Minimum.
Details: When used: Only while FFF899D7 bit 0 is set (warm-up fallback latch gated by cal 0x59134 bit 0 = 0), so never used in stock (read). TGV request logic 0x10D93C (read): the request byte FFF8A888 is 3 unless all of these hold: coolant FFF88A44 at or above TGV Coolant Minimum (hysteresis cal 0x37B46 - 16384, stock 409 = 1 C), requested torque FFF8AEE2 (0x0BA868, Nm = x/80 - 200) below the rpm-based TGV Torque Threshold (it must fall below the Enter table and then rise above the Exit table to clear), air quantity FFF8B4D6 below TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter 0x37A4A, Exit 0x37A48), and FFF8A88D = 0. When they hold, FFF8A888 = 1, or 2 if the intake air temperature FFF88A48 is below TGV IAT Threshold (vehicle speed) or FFF88E28 bit 0/2 is set; FFF8A888 = 2 also while combustion mode FFF8A85C is below cal 0x37B48. State 1 requests TGV close: it runs the timer FFF8B3E0 (0x10C3D0) and FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is set once the timer reaches TGV Close Delay (05D384, by vehicle speed; stock 1 s at standstill, 2 s from 4 km/h). States 2 (close blocked: cold intake air, FFF88E28 bit 0/2, or combustion mode below cal 0x37B48) and 3 (close conditions not met) reset the timer, so the TGVs stay open (read). Which threshold pair is used depends on FFF8A8C1 (1, 2, 3 or other) and FFF8A8A2 bit 5 (not identified). Each threshold is table(rpm FFF8CE9C) + TGV Torque Threshold Offset(rpm, FFF88AE6) - 16000, so the offset table is centred on 16000 (0 ft-lb). Used while FFF899D7 bit 0 is set. Stock 18432 = 5 degC. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 037A46 by the code that reads it (read). Address 035458. Confidence: read.

table.description:
How long the brake must be pressed over a held accelerator, by pedal position and speed, before brake override starts cutting the pedal signal (above 7 km/h). Stock 2 s at light pedal, 0.5 s from 60 % pedal. Part of the brake override, which limits the accelerator signal when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held.
Details: When used: while the VDC brake-pressure signal is valid (FFF8AC8F bit 4); 05F2E0 (200 = 2 s, flat) replaces it otherwise. Brake override module 0x181B38 (10 ms task 0x1DFE3C, read): it limits the accelerator pedal that feeds the torque request, FFF88A5E = min(pedal FFF88EE6, limit FFF8BAFA) (0x09E800, read), when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held. Brake detection: VDC CAN frame 0x0D1 byte 2 (FFF88DF9, slew-limited 8/pass into FFF8AC94; brake pressure, inferred) against a threshold, or discrete input FFF88E2F bit 3 (pin PF10; brake switch, inferred) when the pressure signal is not valid (FFF8AC8F bit 4 clear). Vehicle speed FFF8AC95 = km/h from the wheel speeds or FFF88BE8 x 9/160 (0x182E34, read). The module sets no DTC (no DTC monitor record points at its RAM, read). 0x1832C4 (read, args checked in the assembly): override request FFF8AC91 bit 1 sets when the time FFF8BADA since the brake was applied while the accelerator was already pressed (FFF8AC90 bit 6, 0x1831EC) reaches this(pedal FFF88EE6, speed FFF8AC95), with speed >= cal 0x43472 (7 km/h) and either pedal >= 05F2C0 (1.1 %) or a deceleration-confirmed brake (FFF8AC91 bit 2). FFF8AC91 bit 1 (or bit 0, the brake-switch path 0x183680) sets the active flag FFF8AC8F bit 0 (0x183B68), which starts the pedal-limit ramp. Stock 200 passes (2.0 s) at 11 % pedal; 1.25-1.5 s at 23 %; 0.75-1.0 s at 40 %; 0.5 s from 60 % pedal. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 05F2CC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 05693C. Confidence: inferred.

Intake Air Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the main intake air temperature sensor voltage to degrees; this IAT feeds the timing, boost and fuel compensations and the scan-tool reading. Its voltage axis is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling, so edit only the temperatures when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06AF58, read). ADC channel 19 (0xFFFFE864, untrimmed) -> FFF88D38 -> FFF88F30, filtered by cal 0x579B6 (65535 = no filter in stock) -> FFF88F34 / FFF88F32, looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) to give FFF88662 = degC + 50: the OBD IAT FFF8CEE5, the IAT behind FFF88A48 (the IAT axis of the timing, boost, throttle and fuel compensation tables) and the IAT read by fuel 0x0C589C and purge 0x0D4E78 (for Purge Air Density (IAT, Baro), 0x0D44DC) (read). This is IAT sensor 1 (P0112 / P0113, read), probably the element in the MAF housing (inferred). The voltage axis (0x579FC, 32 points 0...4.96 V in 0.16 V steps; 65536 = 5 V inferred) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling: change only the temperature values for a different thermistor, or both sensors move. While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BA x 256 (stock 3.40 V, about 20 C) is used. Stock: 205 C at 0 V, 25 C at 3.20 V, -50 C from 4.80 V (identical to IAT 2). LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 060850 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 05799C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling
table.description:
Converts the second intake temperature sensor's voltage to degrees. This is the air temperature the ECU's airflow model uses to work out air density, and it probably comes from the manifold pressure (TMAP) sensor, so update it when you swap that sensor for one with a different thermistor. Its voltage axis is shared with the main IAT table; change only the temperatures.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06B304, read). ADC channel 20 (0xFFFFE868, untrimmed) -> FFF88D40 -> FFF88F36, filtered by cal 0x579B8 (no filter in stock) -> FFF88F38 / FFF88F3A, looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF888CF (degC + 50; FFF888D4 from the unfaulted value). This is IAT sensor 2 (P0097 / P0098 monitors on the same voltage, read). FFF888CF is the air temperature of the speed-density airflow model (0x11DF4C: density from MAP and IAT 2 + 223 K) and is also read by requested torque 0x0BE694, ignition 0x0D98F8 / 0x0D9A10 / 0x0DE0E0 and AVCS 0x15969C (read), so a wrong curve shifts the modelled air and load. Probably the thermistor of the manifold TMAP sensor (inferred from its use as the manifold air temperature): when fitting a different TMAP / MAP sensor with its own thermistor, change these temperature values. The voltage axis (0x579FC) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor Scaling, so change only the data. While faulted (FFF88FCD bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BB x 256 (stock 3.40 V, about 20 C) is used. Stock identical to IAT 1. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 06085C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0579A8. Confidence: read.

table.name: Coolant Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts coolant temperature sensor voltage to degrees. Every coolant-based table and the scan-tool coolant reading use this. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BA46, read). Coolant sensor voltage FFF8865E (input 0 of the 8-way multiplexer on ADC channel 21, untrimmed, 65536 = 5 V inferred) is filtered by cal 0x56EE8 (65535 = no filter) into FFF88ADC and looked up here (boot lookup 0x73BC) into FFF88AE8 / FFF88AE0 (256 x (degC + 50)): FFF8CD65 (coolant byte, degC + 50), the OBD coolant value and FFF88A44 (the coolant axis of most tables). While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 1) a warm-up model from cals 0x56EEC-0x56EF2 replaces it. Range faults: P0117 below Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit, P0118 above Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit. Stock: 205 C at 0 V, 25.7 C at 3.20 V, -50 C from 4.80 V. Change only when fitting a different sensor. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 060874 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0579C0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Oil Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts oil temperature sensor voltage to degrees; this oil temperature feeds the AVCS and idle tables and the scan-tool reading. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BEA0, read). Oil temperature sensor voltage FFF88AA2 (input 7 of the 8-way multiplexer on ADC channel 21, untrimmed) is filtered by cal 0x56F76 (65535 = no filter) into FFF88AE4 and looked up here (boot lookup 0x73BC). Output unit 256 x (degC + 50), read: FFF88E24 = (output - 0xA00) x 256 / 205 and OBD PID 0x5C reports FFF88E24 x 205 / 65536 = degC + 40. FFF88E24 / FFF88E26 is the oil temperature of the AVCS and idle tables (oil_temp_obd axis). Range faults: P0197 below Oil Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit, P0198 above Oil Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit. Stock identical to the coolant curve. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 060880 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0579CC. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range)
table.description:
Converts the front wideband A/F sensor signal to lambda when the reading is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37. This is the measured lambda used by closed loop fueling. Identical to A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich) in stock; edit both together.
Details: When used: Used while FFF88AFB bit 4 is clear: the A/F signal is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37 (window -800..1000 with hysteresis 333, 0x0843F8, read); gain cal 0x571F0 = 2. Identical to Near Stoich in stock; edit both together. 0x06C1A8 (read): the A/F sensor signal FFF88B2E is looked up here (boot lookup 0x6A0C) into FFF88AF6, the measured lambda of the closed loop (B308 = 43194 x 32768 / FFF88AF6, 0x0FF3CC). Stock lambda 1.00 at signal -25...0. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 06088C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0579D8. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich)
table.description:
Converts the front A/F sensor signal to lambda when it reads within about lambda 0.90-1.37, at a higher gain. Shares its axis with A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range) and is identical to it in stock; edit both together.
Details: When used: Used while the A/F signal is within about lambda 0.90-1.37 (FFF88AFB bit 4 set, 0x0843F8, read); higher gain cal 0x571F1 = 9 (gain reading inferred). Second A/F sensor table in 0x06C1A8 (read); shares the axis with A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range). Identical to it in stock; edit both together. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 060898 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0579E4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Fuel Level Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the fuel sender reading, which the instrument cluster sends to the ECU over CAN, to fuel level (219 = 100 %). The ECU averages it and reports it as fuel level to a scan tool. Stock: full at the lowest input, empty at the highest.
Details: When used: always (0x06C336, read). Input: the fuel sender reading sent by the combination meter on CAN 0x282 bytes 0-1 (10-bit, FFF88E04 -> 0x1108B8 -> FFF8B43C; not an ECU analog input). 0x06C336 forms FFF88BD0 = FFF8B43C x 2867 / (FFF8B43C + cal 0x572E0 (720)), filters it into FFF88BCC and looks it up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF88BD4; FFF88BD7 is its average over cal 0x572E6 samples taken while FFF88A76 is at least cal 0x572E4, kept in backup RAM FFF806BB/806BC, and reported by OBD PID 0x2F as x 255 / 219 (read). So this is the fuel level curve, 219 = 100 %. P0463 / P0462 when FFF88BCC is above cal 0x572DA / below cal 0x572DE (0x0714E0 / 0x071548, read). Stock: full (219) at the lowest input, empty at 2432 and above. LV9N301A: located from LF75404S 0608A4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0579F0. Confidence: read.
