This is IAT sensor 2 (P0097 / P0098 monitors on the same voltage, read). FFF888CF is the air temperature of the speed-density airflow model (0x11DF4C: density from MAP and IAT 2 + 223 K) and is also read by requested torque 0x0BE694, ignition 0x0D98F8 / 0x0D9A10 / 0x0DE0E0 and AVCS 0x15969C (read), so a wrong curve shifts the modelled air and load. Probably the thermistor of the manifold TMAP sensor (inferred from its use as the manifold air temperature): when fitting a different TMAP / MAP sensor with its own thermistor, change these temperature values. The voltage axis (0x579FC) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor Scaling, so change only the data. While faulted (FFF88FCD bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BB x 256 (stock 3.40 V, about 20 C) is used. Stock identical to IAT 1. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 06085C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 05DE8C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Coolant Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts coolant temperature sensor voltage to degrees. Every coolant-based table and the scan-tool coolant reading use this. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BA46, read). Coolant sensor voltage FFF8865E (input 0 of the 8-way multiplexer on ADC channel 21, untrimmed, 65536 = 5 V inferred) is filtered by cal 0x56EE8 (65535 = no filter) into FFF88ADC and looked up here (boot lookup 0x73BC) into FFF88AE8 / FFF88AE0 (256 x (degC + 50)): FFF8CD65 (coolant byte, degC + 50), the OBD coolant value and FFF88A44 (the coolant axis of most tables). While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 1) a warm-up model from cals 0x56EEC-0x56EF2 replaces it. Range faults: P0117 below Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit, P0118 above Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit. Stock: 205 C at 0 V, 25.7 C at 3.20 V, -50 C from 4.80 V. Change only when fitting a different sensor. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 060874 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 05DEA4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Oil Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts oil temperature sensor voltage to degrees; this oil temperature feeds the AVCS and idle tables and the scan-tool reading. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BEA0, read). Oil temperature sensor voltage FFF88AA2 (input 7 of the 8-way multiplexer on ADC channel 21, untrimmed) is filtered by cal 0x56F76 (65535 = no filter) into FFF88AE4 and looked up here (boot lookup 0x73BC). Output unit 256 x (degC + 50), read: FFF88E24 = (output - 0xA00) x 256 / 205 and OBD PID 0x5C reports FFF88E24 x 205 / 65536 = degC + 40. FFF88E24 / FFF88E26 is the oil temperature of the AVCS and idle tables (oil_temp_obd axis). Range faults: P0197 below Oil Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit, P0198 above Oil Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit. Stock identical to the coolant curve. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 060880 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 05DEB0. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range)
table.description:
Converts the front wideband A/F sensor signal to lambda when the reading is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37. This is the measured lambda used by closed loop fueling. Identical to A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich) in stock; edit both together.
Details: When used: Used while FFF88AFB bit 4 is clear: the A/F signal is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37 (window -800..1000 with hysteresis 333, 0x0843F8, read); gain cal 0x571F0 = 2. Identical to Near Stoich in stock; edit both together. 0x06C1A8 (read): the A/F sensor signal FFF88B2E is looked up here (boot lookup 0x6A0C) into FFF88AF6, the measured lambda of the closed loop (B308 = 43194 x 32768 / FFF88AF6, 0x0FF3CC). Stock lambda 1.00 at signal -25...0. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 06088C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 05DEBC. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich)
table.description:
Converts the front A/F sensor signal to lambda when it reads within about lambda 0.90-1.37, at a higher gain. Shares its axis with A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range) and is identical to it in stock; edit both together.
Details: When used: Used while the A/F signal is within about lambda 0.90-1.37 (FFF88AFB bit 4 set, 0x0843F8, read); higher gain cal 0x571F1 = 9 (gain reading inferred). Second A/F sensor table in 0x06C1A8 (read); shares the axis with A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range). Identical to it in stock; edit both together. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 060898 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 05DEC8. Confidence: read.

table.name: Fuel Level Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the fuel sender reading, which the instrument cluster sends to the ECU over CAN, to fuel level (219 = 100 %). The ECU averages it and reports it as fuel level to a scan tool. Stock: full at the lowest input, empty at the highest.
Details: When used: always (0x06C336, read). Input: the fuel sender reading sent by the combination meter on CAN 0x282 bytes 0-1 (10-bit, FFF88E04 -> 0x1108B8 -> FFF8B43C; not an ECU analog input). 0x06C336 forms FFF88BD0 = FFF8B43C x 2867 / (FFF8B43C + cal 0x572E0 (720)), filters it into FFF88BCC and looks it up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF88BD4; FFF88BD7 is its average over cal 0x572E6 samples taken while FFF88A76 is at least cal 0x572E4, kept in backup RAM FFF806BB/806BC, and reported by OBD PID 0x2F as x 255 / 219 (read). So this is the fuel level curve, 219 = 100 %. P0463 / P0462 when FFF88BCC is above cal 0x572DA / below cal 0x572DE (0x0714E0 / 0x071548, read). Stock: full (219) at the lowest input, empty at 2432 and above. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 0608A4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 05DED4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Battery Temperature Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the battery temperature sensor voltage to degrees for the charging-voltage control. It is probably the temperature half of the battery sensor, whose current signal the ECU also reads. Leave alone unless the battery sensor is changed.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06C768, read). ADC channel 9 (0xFFFFE852, untrimmed) -> FFF8939A, filtered by cal 0x590F0 into FFF8939E (cal 0x590EE replaces the input while FFF88BCA bit 2 or 3 is set) and looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF893A0 (degC + 50), read only by the charging-voltage control 0x136CD8 (temperature-compensated voltage targets); the unfiltered value gives FFF893A1, reported by SSM as x - 10 (0x11F0E8, read). Identity (inferred): its companion input ADC channel 4 (FFF89390, 0x06C554) is a linear signal centred on 2.5 V (FFF89396 = 12800 - 0.488 x (sample - 32768); SSM x/128 + 28 puts zero at 2.5 V, about -50 A per volt), i.e. a bidirectional battery current, read by charging control 0x136BC0 and idle 0x0EE338; the two inputs share their filter cal block and their range monitors (FFF88BCA bits 2-5, 0x0715B0-0x07175C) are both enabled by cal 0x57584 bit 4, which is clear in stock (monitors off). A current + temperature pair used only for charging is the battery sensor, so this is battery temperature. Stock: 100 C at 0.32 V, 20 C at 2.37 V, -40 C from 4.71 V (NTC). Leave alone unless the battery sensor is changed. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 0608B0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 05DEE0. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Rear O2 Sensor Ready Heater Energy Threshold
table.description:
How much heater energy, by coolant temperature at start, the rear O2 sensor must have received before it is treated as warmed up and ready. Raising it delays the rear O2 sensor (and its diagnostics) becoming active. Stock about 130 s of heating at -40 C to about 90 s at 60 C.
Details: When used: while the engine runs (run state FFF8906B = 3). 0x1028D0 (read; called from 0x101CF0): FFF8A833 bit 7 is set (and held until the run state leaves 3) when the accumulated rear O2 heater drive FFF88E6E > this(coolant at start FFF88A46; the -40 C row is used when the coolant sensor is faulted, FFF88E28 bit 1), or when FFF8881E >= cal 0x4B900 (9437) for cal 0x4B904 (50) passes. Rear O2 identity: the heater output FFF9980E bit 2 is driven by 0x06EC70 for FFF8CE0B of every 24 40-ms passes, and 0x073570 monitors that output against FFF8CE0B into FFF89CB4 bits 0/1, the P0037 / P0038 (heater circuit, bank 1 sensor 2) monitor records (dtc_monitors slots 182 / 180, read). FFF88E6E sums FFF8CE0B every 40 ms (0x06ED92, read), so it is heater energy since start; FFF8CE0B = 0 while the heater is held off (initial delay from 0x608F4, high load, battery out of range; 0x06E7D8, read). FFF8881E = 2 x (ADC channel 11 - ADC channel 25) (0x1E0000 task, read); it is the oxygen-sensor signal that gates Fuel Cut Recovery Enrichment (0x0CAE40: FFF8881E < cal 0x14F5C, read), so the second path is 'sensor already reads rich' (inferred). FFF8A833 bit 7 feeds the catalyst/rear-O2 module 0x101CF0 (0x1023E0, 0x102B58) and the rear O2 diagnostics 0x1B8890 / 0x1B902C (P0137, result FFF8AD93 bit 7) and 0x123C68 (read). Meaning 'sensor ready / warmed up' inferred. Stock 26250 at -40 C falling to 18125 at 60 C start coolant; at 13.75 V with the default heater stage that is about 130 s and 90 s of heating (inferred, 200 counts/s). Raising it delays the rear O2 sensor being treated as ready. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 05CEB0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 05A614. Confidence: inferred.

Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit (P0118)

Oil Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit (P0198)
Rail Pressure Sensor Voltage Low Limit (P0192)
Rail Pressure Sensor Voltage High Limit (P0193)
P0087 Rail Pressure Low Limit
table.description:
Rail pressure floor by rpm for P0087 (rail pressure too low): the code counts a fault when actual pressure stays more than 0.30 MPa (hysteresis cal) below this value for about 10 seconds, i.e. below 0.40 MPa in stock, and recovers when pressure is back at this value. Stock 0.70 MPa at all rpm.
Details: 0x0752A8 (read, boot lookup 0x72AC): the absolute low-pressure test fails while actual rail pressure FFF88884 < this(rpm FFF8CD56) - hysteresis cal 0x574DA for cal 0x574E0 passes -> P0087. Stock 1148 = 0.70 MPa flat. p16 (read): 0x0752A8 (<- 0x0A1D2C <- 0x1DFE3C) runs every 10 ms; 200 passes = 2 s, 1000 passes = 10 s. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 0609C4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 05DFF4. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1
table.description:
Crankshaft roughness level, by rpm and load, that confirms channel 1 of the P219A A/F imbalance monitor. It sets no code by itself; P219A needs both this and A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1 exceeded. Raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never). Stock off below 1500 rpm, above 4000 rpm and below 0.91 g/rev (70 % load).
Details: When used: once per combustion event (0x1908E4, crank-synchronous list 0x1E1D1C) while the P219A monitor runs (FFF8ACD1). Confirms channel 1 of P219A (A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1). 0x18E130 (read): threshold FFF8BC5E = this(rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616) x 05FCB0(coolant)/8192 x 05FCBC/128 (both 1.0 in stock) x 1.0 (float constants 1000/2^33 and 8.192, 0x18E23C / 0x18E248, read); x 100 instead (capped at 65535, so during that window any cell >= 336 can never be exceeded) until the neutral input FFF88ADA bit 6 has been unchanged for cal 0x4496E = 150 passes (1.5 s; FFF8ACCD bit 5, 0x1912B4) - the A/C-state stability bit 6 (0x191324, cal 0x436B2 = 0) is always set; 65535 while FFF88A2D bit 0; 05FC90 (all 65535) replaces it near standstill with the pedal released (FFF8ACCD bit 0: FFF88C64 bit 5 and speed < 2 km/h) and 05FC68 (all 65535) while FFF8AA3F is set. 0x18F14C sets FFF8ACC5 = 2 when the crank fluctuation FFF8BC5C - 0x8000 > threshold x 250/256 (so an event counts when the fluctuation exceeds 0.977 x the cell value). 0x18D180... count those events per cylinder (FFF8ACC2 = 1..4, cylinder inferred) into FFF8BC24/28/2C/30 and in total FFF8BC48; at the end of a 2000-event window (FFF8BC20 = cal 0x436F0) 0x18F364 judges FFF8ACC7 = 2 'rough' when a cylinder count > cal 0x436F4 (17) or the total > cal 0x436F6 (17) (with a cylinder share > cal 0x43704 = 0) (read). That latches FFF8ACD8 (0x191850). The channel 1 judgement 0x18F980 gives FFF8ACCB = 2 (exceeded, which sets FFF8ACCF bit 1 and through it the P219A result in 0x19198C) only when the A/F swing exceeded its reference (FFF8ACCE bit 4) AND FFF8ACD8 (or FFF8ACD4) is set; FFF8ACCB = 1 (passed) when the swing passed (FFF8ACCE bit 5, cal 0x436C0 = 1) (read). So the roughness test is a required confirmation: a channel 1 P219A needs both the A/F swing and this crank roughness. (The alternative pass by roughness, FFF8ACD5 and FFF8ACD9, cannot occur in stock: with cal 0x436EE = 0 the second window FFF8BC1E always matches, so FFF8ACC7 never reaches 4; read.) The largest count and its limit are also Mode $06 values FFF815CE / FFF815D0 (0x18EB24 / 0x18EBA8, test 0xDC in the 0x0A0000 reporter, read). Raising cells makes the confirmation harder (65535 = never), lowering makes it easier; it does not set a DTC by itself. Stock 615-775 at 1500 rpm (live in normal driving; only the 1.5 s neutral-settling window makes cells >= 336 unreachable), 200-556 at 3000 rpm, 138-388 at 3500 rpm, 163-220 at 4000 rpm for loads 0.91-2.07 g/rev (70-160 %); 65535 (off) below 1500 rpm, above 4000 rpm and below 0.91 g/rev (70 % load). LF75200T: located from LF75404S 05FC7C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 05D2AC. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 2
table.description:
Crankshaft roughness level that confirms channel 2 of the P219A monitor (paired with A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2). Lower than Threshold 1, so more sensitive. Sets no code by itself; raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never). Stock off outside 1500-4000 rpm and 0.91-2.07 g/rev (70-160 % load).
Details: When used: as A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1, for channel 2 of P219A (A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2). 0x18E250 (read): same gating and scaling (x 05FD10(coolant)/8192 x 05FD1C/128, both 1.0) into FFF8BC60 -> FFF8BC64; 0x18F0F8 sets FFF8ACC4 = 2 on an exceedance; per-cylinder counters FFF8BC32..BC44 (0x18D4C8...) and the 2000-event window judgement FFF8ACC6 (0x18F1A0: a cylinder count > cal 0x436FC (17) or the total > cal 0x436FE (17) gives 2 'rough') latch FFF8ACDB (0x191920). The channel 2 judgement 0x18F928 gives FFF8ACCA = 2 (exceeded: FFF8ACCF bit 3 -> P219A result) only when the swing exceeded (FFF8ACCE bit 2) AND FFF8ACDB (or FFF8ACD6) is set; = 1 (passed) when the swing passed (FFF8ACCE bit 3, cal 0x436C1 = 1) (read). Mode $06 values FFF815D2 / FFF815D4 (0x18EFCC / 0x18F050, read). Stock 237-283 at 1500 rpm, 82-370 at 3000 rpm, 82-200 at 3500 rpm, 82-98 at 4000 rpm (lower = more sensitive than threshold 1), loads 0.91-2.07 g/rev (70-160 %); 65535 (off) elsewhere. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 05FCDC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 05D30C. Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable
table.description:
Master switch for EGR (set in stock). Clearing it is expected to keep EGR off, so the EGR-off variants of base timing, closed loop target and throttle tables become the live ones (inferred).
Details: Set in stock. One of the EGR enable conditions computed by 0x0FAAFC (FFF8A811 bit 0), with coolant, rpm and load windows, engine running and normal combustion mode (read). Clearing it is expected to keep EGR off, so the EGR-off table variants (Base Timing (EGR Off, ...), Closed Loop Target (..., EGR Off), the non-EGR Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables) become the live ones (inferred). LF75200T: located from LF75404S 02F796 by the code that reads it (read). Address 02D88E bit 5 (value 32). Confidence: read.

table.name: Transmission Coding: From Input Port
table.description:
When set, the manual/automatic coding is read from a hardware input instead of Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT. Clear in all stock images; leave clear.
Details: Clear in all stock images. When set, the transmission coding (FFF886AB bit 7) is taken from a latched input-port bit (FFF80238 bit 7, set once port bit FFF8A2A4 bit 7 is seen) instead of Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT (read, 0x06A38C). Leave clear. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 02F796 by the code that reads it (read). Address 02D88E bit 6 (value 64). Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Torque Rise: Enable Path B
table.description:
Enables the second (Path B) tip-in torque shaping. Clear in stock, and all Path B tables are 0 and its rpm limit is 0, so setting only this bit does essentially nothing. Leave clear unless you calibrate the whole Path B set.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0x01). The torque module 0x0BE694 passes this bit to the rise shaping 0x0BB958 (BLD.B #6 at 0x0BF3D0, stack argument 11, read), and the torque monitor call passes it to 0x1877B4 (read). When set, Path B of the target-torque rise shaping can act (all "Target Torque Rise ... (Path B, ..., Off in Stock)" tables), and a request below Path B Start Torque passes unshaped. Path B also needs rpm <= cal 0x22A04, which is 0 in stock, so setting only this bit changes nothing but the Start Torque bypass (and Path B tables are all 0 ft-lb in stock, so that bypass never triggers). Leave clear unless the whole Path B set is calibrated. Bit 7 of the same byte is a separate switch passed to another torque routine (seg_0x0B0000.c:9252). LF75200T: located from LF75404S 023704 by the code that reads it (read). Address 0228E4 bit 6 (value 64). Confidence: read.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling: Use Alternate Map
table.description:
When set, Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate, Off in Stock) probably replaces the normal open loop fueling strategy. Clear in stock; leave clear unless you have filled that table.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0x8F). Passed by the open-loop fueling readers 0x0CE854 and 0x0CE5E8 (read): when set, Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate, Off in Stock) is used in place of the base + DAM-scaled knock additive strategy (inferred). Leave clear. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 02C4D0 by the code that reads it (read). Address 02A9D0 bit 0 (value 1). Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing: Pedal-Released Tables Enable

Set in stock: with the pedal released, Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed/Open) replaces the normal EGR Active/Off base timing tables. Clear it to use the normal base timing tables off-throttle too.
